`scripts/ghidra/ExportDependencies.java`:

```java
// Catalogue-level call evidence; computed calls remain an explicit open boundary.
// @category FS15
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class ExportDependencies extends GhidraScript {
    private String csv(String value){return "\""+value.replace("\"","\"\"")+"\"";}
    @Override public void run() throws Exception {
        Path out=Paths.get(getScriptArgs()[0]);Files.createDirectories(out);
        Path temporary=out.resolve("dependencies.csv.tmp");int count=0;
        try(BufferedWriter writer=Files.newBufferedWriter(temporary,StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            writer.write("entry,external,thunk,call_sites,computed_call_sites,callees\n");
            FunctionIterator functions=currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctions(true);
            while(functions.hasNext()) {
                monitor.checkCancelled();Function function=functions.next();
                int calls=0,computed=0;
                if(!function.isExternal()) {
                    InstructionIterator instructions=currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(),true);
                    while(instructions.hasNext()) {
                        Instruction instruction=instructions.next();
                        if(instruction.getFlowType().isCall()) {
                            calls++;if(instruction.getFlowType().isComputed())computed++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                TreeSet<String> callees=new TreeSet<>();
                for(Function callee:function.getCalledFunctions(monitor))callees.add(callee.getEntryPoint().toString());
                if(function.isThunk()) {
                    Function target=function.getThunkedFunction(false);
                    if(target!=null)callees.add(target.getEntryPoint().toString());
                }
                writer.write(csv(function.getEntryPoint().toString())+","+function.isExternal()+","+function.isThunk()+","+
                    calls+","+computed+","+csv(String.join(";",callees))+"\n");count++;
            }
        }
        Files.move(temporary,out.resolve("dependencies.csv"),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        Files.writeString(out.resolve("dependencies-complete.txt"),Integer.toString(count)+"\n",StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        println("Dependency evidence exported for "+count+" catalogued functions. Computed calls are not resolved by this export.");
    }
}
```

`scripts/ghidra/ExportFullProgram.java`:

```java
// Resumable full catalogue export. Output remains local recovered pseudocode.
// @category FS15
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.*;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.io.*;

public class ExportFullProgram extends GhidraScript {
    private void replace(Path temp, Path target) throws Exception {
        for (int attempt=0; ; attempt++) {
            try { Files.move(temp,target,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING); return; }
            catch (FileSystemException busy) {
                if (attempt>=39) throw busy;
                Thread.sleep(25); // A Windows progress reader can briefly deny rename.
            }
        }
    }
    private String csv(String s) { return "\"" + s.replace("\"", "\"\"").replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ") + "\""; }
    private void progress(Path out, int total, int eligible, int processed, int ok, int failed, int reused, boolean complete) throws Exception {
        String json = "{\n  \"program\": " + csv(currentProgram.getName()) + ",\n" +
            "  \"catalogued\": " + total + ",\n  \"eligible\": " + eligible + ",\n  \"processed\": " + processed +
            ",\n  \"exported\": " + ok + ",\n  \"failed\": " + failed + ",\n  \"reused\": " + reused +
            ",\n  \"complete_pass\": " + complete + ",\n  \"scope\": \"Ghidra pseudocode; not compilable recovered engine source\"\n}\n";
        Path temp = out.resolve("progress.tmp");
        Files.writeString(temp, json, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        replace(temp, out.resolve("progress.json"));
    }
    @Override public void run() throws Exception {
        String[] args = getScriptArgs();
        if (args.length < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Output directory required");
        Path out = Paths.get(args[0]); Files.createDirectories(out);
        int timeout = args.length > 1 ? Integer.parseInt(args[1]) : 10;
        if (timeout < 1 || timeout > 600) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Timeout must be 1..600 seconds");
        int total = 0, eligible = 0, processed = 0, ok = 0, failed = 0, reused = 0;
        FunctionManager fm = currentProgram.getFunctionManager();
        FunctionIterator count = fm.getFunctions(true);
        try(BufferedWriter catalogue=Files.newBufferedWriter(out.resolve("functions.csv"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            catalogue.write("entry,name,size,thunk,external,prototype\n");
            while(count.hasNext()) {
                Function f=count.next();total++;if(!f.isExternal()&&!f.isThunk())eligible++;
                catalogue.write(csv(f.getEntryPoint().toString())+","+csv(f.getName())+","+f.getBody().getNumAddresses()+","+f.isThunk()+","+f.isExternal()+","+csv(f.getPrototypeString(false,false))+"\n");
            }
        }
        DecompInterface decompiler = new DecompInterface();
        // Large registration functions exceeded Ghidra's default response cap.
        // Increase transport capacity; retain normal decompilation semantics.
        DecompileOptions options = new DecompileOptions();
        options.setMaxPayloadMBytes(128);
        decompiler.setOptions(options);
        // This exporter only consumes C text, not HighFunction/AST metadata.
        decompiler.toggleSyntaxTree(false);
        if (!decompiler.openProgram(currentProgram)) throw new IOException("Cannot open decompiler program");
        progress(out,total,eligible,0,0,0,0,false);
        try (BufferedWriter index = Files.newBufferedWriter(out.resolve("decompiled-index.csv"), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            index.write("entry,name,size,status,file,diagnostic\n");
            FunctionIterator functions = fm.getFunctions(true);
            while (functions.hasNext() && !monitor.isCancelled()) {
                Function f=functions.next();
                if (f.isExternal() || f.isThunk()) continue;
                String filename = f.getEntryPoint() + "_" + f.getName().replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_") + ".c";
                Path target=out.resolve(filename);
                String identity="/* Ghidra pseudocode; not buildable source.\n * Program: " + currentProgram.getName() +
                    "\n * Address: " + f.getEntryPoint() + "\n * Export: full catalogue\n */\n\n";
                String status="failed", diagnostic="";
                if (Files.isRegularFile(target) && Files.readString(target).startsWith(identity)) {
                    status="ok"; reused++;
                } else {
                    try {
                        DecompileResults result=decompiler.decompileFunction(f,timeout,monitor);
                        if (result.decompileCompleted() && result.getDecompiledFunction()!=null) {
                            Path temp=out.resolve(filename+".tmp");
                            Files.writeString(temp,identity+result.getDecompiledFunction().getC(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                            replace(temp,target);
                            status="ok";
                        } else diagnostic=result.getErrorMessage();
                    } catch (Exception error) { diagnostic=error.toString(); }
                }
                processed++;if (status.equals("ok")) ok++;else failed++;
                index.write(csv(f.getEntryPoint().toString())+","+csv(f.getName())+","+f.getBody().getNumAddresses()+","+status+","+csv(status.equals("ok")?filename:"")+","+csv(diagnostic)+"\n");
                index.flush();
                if (processed%100==0) {
                    progress(out,total,eligible,processed,ok,failed,reused,false);
                    println("Full export: "+processed+"/"+eligible+"; ok="+ok+" failed="+failed);
                }
            }
        } finally { decompiler.dispose(); }
        progress(out,total,eligible,processed,ok,failed,reused,processed==eligible);
        println("Full export ended: "+ok+" exported, "+failed+" failed, "+reused+" reused");
    }
}
```

`scripts/ghidra/ExportInstructions.java`:

```java
// Local-only instruction evidence for recovering exact math order and calls.
// @category FS15
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public class ExportInstructions extends GhidraScript {
    @Override public void run() throws Exception {
        String[] args=getScriptArgs();
        Path out=Paths.get(args[0]);Files.createDirectories(out);
        for(int i=1;i<args.length;i++) {
            Address address=toAddr(args[i]);
            if(address==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid address: "+args[i]);
            Function function=currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(address);
            if(function==null||function.isExternal()||function.isThunk())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected catalogued native function: "+address);
            StringBuilder text=new StringBuilder("Program: "+currentProgram.getName()+"\nFunction: "+address+"\n");
            InstructionIterator instructions=currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(),true);
            while(instructions.hasNext()) {
                monitor.checkCancelled();
                Instruction instruction=instructions.next();
                text.append(instruction.getAddress()).append("  ").append(instruction).append("\n");
            }
            Files.writeString(out.resolve(address+".asm"),text.toString(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            println("Local instruction evidence: "+address);
        }
        Files.writeString(out.resolve("instructions-complete.txt"),String.join("\n",args)+"\n",StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }
}
```

`scripts/ghidra/ExportLeafReference.java`:

```java
// Validate and export one self-contained native leaf for local differential tests.
// @category FS15
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.program.model.address.*;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.HexFormat;

public class ExportLeafReference extends GhidraScript {
    @Override public void run() throws Exception {
        String[] args = getScriptArgs();
        Address entry = toAddr(args[0]);
        Path out = Paths.get(args[1]);
        Files.createDirectories(out);
        Function f = currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(entry);
        if (f == null || f.isThunk() || f.isExternal()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a local native function");
        Address end = f.getBody().getMaxAddress();
        int length = (int)end.subtract(entry) + 1;
        StringBuilder listing = new StringBuilder();
        InstructionIterator instructions = currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(f.getBody(), true);
        int count = 0;
        while (instructions.hasNext()) {
            Instruction instruction = instructions.next();
            if (instruction.getFlowType().isCall()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Reference calls another function: " + instruction);
            if (instruction.toString().toUpperCase().contains("RIP")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("RIP-relative reference requires relocation: " + instruction);
            for (Reference ref : instruction.getReferencesFrom()) {
                Address target = ref.getToAddress();
                if (target.isMemoryAddress() && !f.getBody().contains(target)) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Reference leaves function: " + instruction + " -> " + target);
                }
            }
            listing.append(instruction.getAddress()).append("  ").append(instruction.toString()).append("\n");
            count++;
        }
        byte[] code = new byte[length];
        currentProgram.getMemory().getBytes(entry, code);
        String hash = HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(code));
        Files.write(out.resolve("rle8-reference.bin"), code);
        Files.writeString(out.resolve("rle8-reference.asm"), listing.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        String json = "{\n  \"program\": \"" + currentProgram.getName() + "\",\n  \"entry\": \"" + entry + "\",\n  \"length\": " + length + ",\n  \"instruction_count\": " + count + ",\n  \"sha256\": \"" + hash + "\",\n  \"external_calls\": false,\n  \"external_memory_references\": false\n}\n";
        Files.writeString(out.resolve("rle8-reference.json"), json, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        println(json);
    }
}
```

`scripts/ghidra/InspectAddresses.java`:

```java
// Inspect callers, data references, and nearby pointer tables without modifying code.
// @category FS15
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public class InspectAddresses extends GhidraScript {
    @Override public void run() throws Exception {
        String[] args = getScriptArgs();
        Path out = Paths.get(args[0]);
        Files.createDirectories(out);
        FunctionManager fm = currentProgram.getFunctionManager();
        for (int i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {
            Address address = toAddr(args[i]);
            StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder("Address: " + address + "\n");
            Function targetFunction = fm.getFunctionContaining(address);
            if (targetFunction != null) {
                text.append("Function: ").append(targetFunction.getEntryPoint()).append(" ").append(targetFunction.getName()).append("\n");
                for (Function callee : targetFunction.getCalledFunctions(monitor)) {
                    text.append("CALLS ").append(callee.getEntryPoint()).append(" ").append(callee.getName()).append("\n");
                }
            }
            ReferenceIterator refs = currentProgram.getReferenceManager().getReferencesTo(address);
            while (refs.hasNext()) {
                Reference r = refs.next();
                Function f = fm.getFunctionContaining(r.getFromAddress());
                text.append("REF ").append(r.getFromAddress()).append(" ").append(r.getReferenceType()).append(" FROM ")
                    .append(f == null ? "data" : f.getEntryPoint() + " " + f.getName()).append("\n");
            }
            for (int offset = 0; offset < 256; offset += 8) {
                Address at = address.add(offset);
                try {
                    long value = currentProgram.getMemory().getLong(at);
                    Address pointer = toAddr(value);
                    Function f = fm.getFunctionAt(pointer);
                    text.append("QWORD ").append(at).append(" = ").append(Long.toUnsignedString(value,16));
                    if (f != null) text.append(" FUNCTION ").append(f.getName());
                    Data d = getDataAt(pointer);
                    if (d != null && d.getValue() instanceof String) text.append(" STRING ").append(d.getValue());
                    text.append("\n");
                } catch (Exception e) { break; }
            }
            Files.writeString(out.resolve(address + ".txt"), text, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            println("Inspection written: " + out.resolve(address + ".txt"));
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/ghidra/RecoverBindingFunctions.java`:

```java
// Audit explicit native binding targets; create functions only in uncovered executable code.
// @category FS15
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.MemoryBlock;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.io.*;

public class RecoverBindingFunctions extends GhidraScript {
    private String csv(String value) { return "\""+value.replace("\"","\"\"")+"\""; }
    @Override public void run() throws Exception {
        String[] args=getScriptArgs();
        if(args.length<2)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Output directory and explicit binding targets required");
        Path out=Paths.get(args[0]); Files.createDirectories(out);
        FunctionManager manager=currentProgram.getFunctionManager();
        int created=0;
        try(BufferedWriter file=Files.newBufferedWriter(out.resolve("bindings.csv"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            file.write("target,status,containing_function,size\n");
            for(int i=1;i<args.length;i++) {
                Address address=toAddr(args[i]);
                Function function=manager.getFunctionAt(address);
                String status="existing_entry";
                if(function==null) {
                    function=manager.getFunctionContaining(address);
                    status="inside_existing_function";
                    if(function==null) {
                        MemoryBlock block=currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(address);
                        status="not_executable";
                        if(block!=null && block.isExecute() && block.isInitialized()) {
                            disassemble(address);
                            function=createFunction(address,null);
                            status=function==null?"creation_failed":"created_from_explicit_binding";
                            if(function!=null)created++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                file.write(csv(address.toString())+","+csv(status)+","+csv(function==null?"":function.getEntryPoint().toString())+","+(function==null?0:function.getBody().getNumAddresses())+"\n");
            }
        }
        try(BufferedWriter file=Files.newBufferedWriter(out.resolve("functions.csv"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            file.write("entry,name,size,thunk,external,prototype\n");
            FunctionIterator functions=manager.getFunctions(true);
            while(functions.hasNext()) {
                Function function=functions.next();
                file.write(csv(function.getEntryPoint().toString())+","+csv(function.getName())+","+function.getBody().getNumAddresses()+","+function.isThunk()+","+function.isExternal()+","+csv(function.getPrototypeString(false,false))+"\n");
            }
        }
        println("Explicit binding audit: "+(args.length-1)+" targets, "+created+" newly identified functions; existing bodies were not split");
    }
}
```

`scripts/ghidra/RecoverVtableFunctions.java`:

```java
// Explicit, constructor-observed vtable slots only. Never split existing bodies.
// @category FS15
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.*;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.MemoryBlock;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class RecoverVtableFunctions extends GhidraScript {
    @Override public void run() throws Exception {
        String[] args=getScriptArgs();Path out=Paths.get(args[0]);Files.createDirectories(out);
        FunctionManager manager=currentProgram.getFunctionManager();
        Map<String,String[]> previous=new HashMap<>();
        Path prior=out.resolve("slots.csv");
        if(Files.isRegularFile(prior))for(String line:Files.readAllLines(prior,StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            String[] row=line.split(",",-1);
            if(row.length==5&&row[3].equals("created_from_explicit_vtable"))previous.put(row[0]+":"+row[1],row);
        }
        Set<String> createdTargets=new HashSet<>();int createdNow=0,slots=0;
        try(BufferedWriter writer=Files.newBufferedWriter(out.resolve("slots.csv"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            writer.write("table,slot,target,status,containing_function\n");
            for(int i=1;i<args.length;i++) {
                String[] spec=args[i].split(":");Address table=toAddr(spec[0]);int count=Integer.parseInt(spec[1]);
                if(table==null||count<1||count>128)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid bounded table specification");
                for(int slot=0;slot<count;slot++) {
                    monitor.checkCancelled();
                    Address target=toAddr(currentProgram.getMemory().getLong(table.add(slot*8L)));
                    MemoryBlock block=currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(target);
                    if(block==null||!block.isExecute()||!block.isInitialized())
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Non-executable vtable slot "+table+"+"+slot*8);
                    Function function=manager.getFunctionAt(target);String status="existing_entry";
                    if(function==null) {
                        function=manager.getFunctionContaining(target);status="inside_existing_function";
                        if(function==null) {
                            disassemble(target);function=createFunction(target,null);
                            if(function==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot create uncovered target "+target);
                            status="created_from_explicit_vtable";createdNow++;createdTargets.add(target.toString());
                        }
                    }
                    String[] old=previous.get(table+":"+slot*8);
                    if(status.equals("existing_entry")&&old!=null&&old[2].equals(target.toString())&&old[4].equals(function.getEntryPoint().toString())) {
                        status="created_from_explicit_vtable";createdTargets.add(target.toString());
                    }
                    writer.write(table+","+slot*8+","+target+","+status+","+function.getEntryPoint()+"\n");slots++;
                }
            }
        }
        Files.writeString(out.resolve("complete.txt"),slots+","+createdTargets.size()+"\n",StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        println("Vtable audit: "+slots+" explicit slots; "+createdNow+" uncovered functions created now; "+createdTargets.size()+" creation records retained. Existing bodies were not split.");
    }
}
```

`scripts/index_native_exports.py`:

```py
"""Verify a full local Ghidra pass and index explicit engine API descriptors.

Recovered pseudocode and detailed API associations stay local. Only aggregate
counts, hashes and unresolved entry points are published by this script.
"""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
from inventory import ROOT, sha256, write_json
from native_gar import EXPECTED_IMAGE, DEFAULT_IMAGE

CALLS = re.compile(r'\bFUN_([0-9a-f]+)\(')
ASSIGNMENT = re.compile(r'(local_[0-9a-f]+) = (.*);')
REGISTRATION = re.compile(r'FUN_(140024f50|140031bc0)\((.*),&(local_[0-9a-f]+)\);')


def descriptors(code, registration):
    """Match explicit descriptor slots, including reordered initializers.

    The two observed registration functions use the same descriptor layout:
    vtable at +0, name at +0x60, implementation at +0x68. Stack-local suffixes
    count down as addresses increase. Do not associate adjacent unrelated data.
    """
    assigned = {}
    consumed = {}
    for line_number, line in enumerate(code.splitlines()):
        match = ASSIGNMENT.fullmatch(line.strip())
        if match:
            assigned[match[1]] = (match[2], line_number)
        call = REGISTRATION.fullmatch(re.sub(r'\s+', '', line))
        if not call:
            continue
        base = call[3]
        offset = int(base[6:], 16)
        if offset < 0x68:
            continue
        slots = [base, 'local_' + format(offset - 0x60, 'x'), 'local_' + format(offset - 0x68, 'x')]
        values = [assigned.get(slot) for slot in slots]
        if any(value is None or line_number - value[1] > 40 or value[1] <= consumed.get(base, -1) for value in values):
            continue
        vtable, name, implementation = [value[0] for value in values]
        if vtable != '&PTR_FUN_1404b6300':
            continue
        name_match = re.fullmatch(r'"([^"\\]+)"', name)
        impl_match = re.fullmatch(r'(FUN_|&LAB_)([0-9a-f]+)', implementation)
        if name_match is None or impl_match is None:
            continue
        result = dict(name=name_match[1], implementation='0x' + impl_match[2],
                      implementation_kind='code_label' if impl_match[1] == '&LAB_' else 'function',
                      registration_function='0x' + registration,
                      registration_service='0x' + call[1],
                      evidence='explicit descriptor vtable, +0x60 name, +0x68 callable and observed registration call')
        if call[1] == '140031bc0':
            wrapper = re.search(r',FUN_([0-9a-f]+)$', call[2])
            if wrapper is None:
                continue
            result['wrapper'] = '0x' + wrapper[1]
        consumed[base] = line_number
        yield result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--export', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'recovered/decompiled/game-full')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    progress = json.loads((args.export / 'progress.json').read_text())
    if not progress['complete_pass']:
        parser.error('Full export has not finished; leave its current progress intact')
    if sha256(DEFAULT_IMAGE) != EXPECTED_IMAGE:
        parser.error('Native analysis image does not match the pinned reference')
    with (args.export / 'decompiled-index.csv').open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    if len(rows) != progress['eligible'] or len({row['entry'] for row in rows}) != len(rows):
        raise ValueError('Incomplete/duplicate function catalogue')
    catalogue_path = args.export / 'functions.csv'
    if not catalogue_path.exists():
        catalogue_path = ROOT / 'recovered/decompiled/game-runtime/functions.csv'
    with catalogue_path.open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        catalogue = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    eligible = {row['entry']: row for row in catalogue if row['thunk'] == 'false' and row['external'] == 'false'}
    if len(catalogue) != progress['catalogued'] or {row['entry'] for row in rows} != eligible.keys():
        raise ValueError('Full export differs from the original analyzed function catalogue')
    if any(row['size'] != eligible[row['entry']]['size'] for row in rows):
        raise ValueError('Function sizes differ from the analyzed catalogue')
    bindings = []
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    byte_count = 0
    by_address = {}
    for row in rows:
        if row['status'] != 'ok':
            continue
        path = args.export / row['file']
        if path.parent != args.export or path.suffix != '.c':
            raise ValueError('Unexpected export path')
        data = path.read_bytes()
        code = data.decode('utf-8')
        if f' * Address: {row["entry"]}\n' not in code or ' * Export: full catalogue\n' not in code:
            raise ValueError(f'Export identity differs: {row["entry"]}')
        digest.update((row['entry'] + ':' + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() + '\n').encode())
        byte_count += len(data)
        by_address['0x' + row['entry']] = sorted({'0x' + address for address in CALLS.findall(code)})
        bindings.extend(descriptors(code, row['entry']))
    counts = Counter(row['status'] for row in rows)
    if counts['ok'] != progress['exported'] or counts['failed'] != progress['failed']:
        raise ValueError('Export progress and verified files disagree')
    for binding in bindings:
        if binding['implementation_kind'] == 'code_label' and binding['implementation'][2:] in eligible:
            binding['pseudocode_reference_kind'] = 'code_label'
            binding['implementation_kind'] = 'function'
        binding['direct_named_callees'] = by_address.get(binding['implementation'], [])
    if not any(row['name'] == 'createWheelShape' for row in bindings):
        raise ValueError('Expected engine wheel descriptors were not recovered')
    write_json(ROOT / 'analysis/engine-bindings.json', dict(scope='Observed explicit engine descriptors; signatures and full behavior still require validation', bindings=bindings))
    failures = [dict(entry='0x' + row['entry'], size=int(row['size']), diagnostic=row['diagnostic']) for row in rows if row['status'] != 'ok']
    summary = dict(reference_sha256=EXPECTED_IMAGE, catalogued=progress['catalogued'], eligible=progress['eligible'],
                   excluded_thunks_or_external=progress['catalogued'] - progress['eligible'],
                   exported=counts['ok'], failed=counts['failed'], complete_pass=True,
                   pseudocode_bytes=byte_count, export_set_sha256=digest.hexdigest(),
                   explicit_engine_descriptors=len(bindings), distinct_engine_names=len({row['name'] for row in bindings}),
                   descriptor_registration_functions=len({row['registration_function'] for row in bindings}),
                   descriptor_function_pointers=sum(row['implementation_kind'] == 'function' for row in bindings),
                   descriptor_code_labels=sum(row['implementation_kind'] == 'code_label' for row in bindings),
                   descriptor_scope='Observed native scripting descriptors, including general utilities; overlap with earlier Lua/native mappings is possible.',
                   unresolved=failures,
                   scope='All eligible functions in the existing Ghidra catalogue were attempted. Pseudocode is not buildable recovered source or proof of complete function discovery, signatures, engine reconstruction or behavior parity.')
    write_json(ROOT / 'analysis/native-export-summary.json', summary)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`scripts/index_portability.py`:

```py
"""Audit known native call dependencies; never equate pseudocode with a port.

Ghidra dependency edges and per-function details remain local. Virtual/computed
calls, dynamic loads, undiscovered functions and incomplete types mean this is
an observed graph, not a complete engine link graph or proof of port readiness.
"""
import csv
import hashlib
import json
from inventory import ROOT, PE, sha256, write_json
from native_gar import DEFAULT_IMAGE, EXPECTED_IMAGE
from index_recompilation import COMPONENTS, source_pinned


def closure(graph, seeds):
    """Include unresolved targets instead of silently discarding missing edges."""
    pending = list(seeds)
    reached, missing = set(), set()
    while pending:
        address = pending.pop()
        if address in reached:
            continue
        reached.add(address)
        if address not in graph:
            missing.add(address)
            continue
        pending.extend(graph[address]['callees'])
    return reached, missing


def main():
    if sha256(DEFAULT_IMAGE) != EXPECTED_IMAGE:
        raise ValueError('Native reference image differs from the pinned analysis')
    path = ROOT/'analysis/native-dependencies/dependencies.csv'
    with path.open(newline='',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    expected_count = int((path.parent/'dependencies-complete.txt').read_text())
    with (ROOT/'recovered/decompiled/game-full/functions.csv').open(newline='',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        catalogue = {row['entry']:row for row in csv.DictReader(stream)}
    graph = {}
    for row in rows:
        entry = row['entry']
        if entry in graph or entry not in catalogue:
            raise ValueError('Dependency entry is duplicated or outside the pseudocode catalogue')
        if any(row[field]!=catalogue[entry][field] for field in ('external','thunk')):
            raise ValueError('Dependency and pseudocode catalogues differ')
        graph[entry] = dict(callees=row['callees'].split(';') if row['callees'] else [],
                           external=row['external']=='true',thunk=row['thunk']=='true',
                           call_sites=int(row['call_sites']),computed_call_sites=int(row['computed_call_sites']))
    if len(rows)!=expected_count or graph.keys()!=catalogue.keys():
        raise ValueError('Dependency export is incomplete for the current catalogue')
    recovered = set()
    for _, entries, evidence in COMPONENTS:
        report=json.loads((ROOT/evidence).read_text())
        if not source_pinned(ROOT,report):
            raise ValueError('Recompilation evidence is absent/stale: '+evidence)
        recovered.update(entry.removeprefix('0x') for entry in entries)
    bindings=json.loads((ROOT/'analysis/engine-bindings.json').read_text())['bindings']
    seeds={row['implementation'].removeprefix('0x') for row in bindings}
    roots={'script_descriptors':seeds,'native_crt_startup':{'1403fc96c'}}
    roots['render_view_lifetime']={'14012ca00','14012cc40'}
    roots['opengl_vertex_index_buffers']={'140065c60','140074850','140074920','140074990','140074a10','140074a40','140074ab0','140074b70','140074bd0'}
    roots['wheel_force_adapter']={'1400e76c0'}
    roots['physics_manager_startup']={'1400c29d0'}
    roots['physics_step_dispatch_and_worker']={'1400c7a60','1400c3c50','1400c3b90'}
    roots['physics_post_step_contact_and_wheel_readback']={'1400ca150','1400ca080','140144ce0','140145190','140144ef0','1400c7b20'}
    vtable_path=ROOT/'analysis/vtable-discovery/slots.csv'
    if vtable_path.exists():
        with vtable_path.open(newline='',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            slots=list(csv.DictReader(stream))
        memory_tables={'1404bbb38','1404d9ff8'}
        roots['observed_scene_vtables']={row['target'] for row in slots if row['table'] not in memory_tables}
        roots['observed_memory_stream_vtables']={row['target'] for row in slots if row['table'] in memory_tables}
    audits={}
    for name, targets in roots.items():
        reached, missing=closure(graph,targets)
        external_targets={entry for entry in missing if entry.startswith('EXTERNAL:')}
        eligible={entry for entry in reached if entry in graph and not graph[entry]['external'] and not graph[entry]['thunk']}
        audits[name]=dict(seed_entries=len(targets),known_reachable_entries=len(reached)-len(missing),
            eligible_reachable_entries=len(eligible),bounded_recovered_entries=len(eligible&recovered),
            remaining_entries_without_validated_components=len(eligible-recovered),
            functions_with_computed_calls=sum(graph[entry]['computed_call_sites']>0 for entry in eligible),
            computed_call_sites=sum(graph[entry]['computed_call_sites'] for entry in eligible),
            external_targets_outside_function_catalogue=len(external_targets),
            uncatalogued_native_target_entries=len(missing-external_targets),
            scope='Known static Ghidra edges, including known thunk targets. Computed calls are counted, not closed.')
    image=PE(DEFAULT_IMAGE.read_bytes())
    imports=[dict(library=row['dll'],imports=len(row['functions'])) for row in image.imports()]
    details=dict(reference_sha256=EXPECTED_IMAGE,graph=graph,recovered_entries=sorted(recovered),
                 roots={name:sorted(values) for name,values in roots.items()})
    write_json(ROOT/'analysis/native-portability.json',details)
    summary=dict(reference_sha256=EXPECTED_IMAGE,dependency_export_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        catalogued_entries=len(graph),known_distinct_call_edges=sum(len(row['callees']) for row in graph.values()),
        eligible_functions_with_undefined_prototypes=sum(
            'undefined' in row['prototype'] for row in catalogue.values() if row['external']=='false' and row['thunk']=='false'),
        native_import_libraries=imports,root_audits=audits,
        full_link_graph_recovered=False,full_native_rebuild_verified=False,switch_build_verified=False,
        scope='Static dependency inventory from the current catalogue. Undefined prototypes are decompiler observations, '
              'not recovered types. Static CRT roots do not include all dynamic/virtual engine initialization. '
              'Counts are not engine completion percentages.')
    write_json(ROOT/'analysis/native-portability-summary.json',summary)
    print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
```

`scripts/index_recompilation.py`:

```py
"""Track pseudocode separately from bounded, source-pinned native reconstructions.

Detailed per-function work stays local. The aggregate is not an engine-completion
percentage: the catalogue includes runtime/library code and discovery is open.
"""
from collections import Counter
import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from inventory import ROOT, write_json

COMPONENTS = [
    ('opengl_array_index_range_draw_dispatch', ['0x140065540'],
        'analysis/gl-draw-validation.json'),
    ('ge6_motor_clutch_and_differential_network',
        ['0x140155940','0x140155d50'],
        'analysis/ge6-vehicle-drive-validation.json'),
    ('ge6_vehicle_wheel_velocity_friction_and_braking_empty_drivetrain',
        ['0x1401540b0'],
        'analysis/ge6-vehicle-velocity-validation.json'),

def source_pinned(root, report):
    pins = report.get('rebuilt_source_sha256', {})
    if report.get('status') != 'passed' or not pins:
        return False
    for path, digest in pins.items():
        target=(root/path).resolve()
        if not any(target.is_relative_to((root/p).resolve()) for p in ('src/core','src/ge6')) or not target.is_file():
            return False
        if hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
            return False
    return True


def main():
    export = ROOT / 'recovered/decompiled/game-full'
    progress = json.loads((export / 'progress.json').read_text())
    if not progress['complete_pass']:
        raise ValueError('Wait for a completed catalogue export before indexing recompilation work')
    with (export / 'decompiled-index.csv').open(newline='') as stream:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    work = {'0x'+row['entry']:dict(entry='0x'+row['entry'],stage='pseudocode_only',
                                 pseudocode=row['file'],size=int(row['size'])) for row in rows}
    if len(work) != progress['eligible'] or any(row['status'] != 'ok' for row in rows):
        raise ValueError('Current pseudocode catalogue is incomplete or contains duplicate entries')
    components = []
    for name, addresses, evidence in COMPONENTS:
        report = json.loads((ROOT/evidence).read_text())
        if not source_pinned(ROOT, report):
            raise ValueError('Native evidence is absent or stale for component: '+name)
        for address in addresses:
            if address not in work or work[address]['stage'] != 'pseudocode_only':
                raise ValueError('Reconstruction entry is absent or duplicated: '+address)
            work[address].update(stage='validated_component_paths',component=name,evidence=evidence,
                                 limitation=report.get('scope','Bounded component comparisons only'))
        components.append(dict(name=name,entries=len(addresses),evidence=evidence))
    write_json(ROOT/'analysis/native-recompilation.json',dict(functions=list(work.values())))
    counts=Counter(row['stage'] for row in work.values())
    discovery_path=ROOT/'analysis/binding-discovery/bindings.csv'
    discovery=[]
    if discovery_path.exists():
        with discovery_path.open(newline='') as stream:
            discovery=list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    write_json(ROOT/'analysis/binding-discovery-summary.json',dict(
        explicit_unique_targets=len(discovery),new_functions=sum(row['status']=='created_from_explicit_binding' for row in discovery),
        scope='Only explicit native binding code labels were audited; existing function bodies were not split; wider discovery remains open'))
    report=dict(catalogued=progress['catalogued'],eligible=progress['eligible'],
                pseudocode_only=counts['pseudocode_only'],validated_component_path_entries=counts['validated_component_paths'],
                components=components,full_native_rebuild_verified=False,switch_build_verified=False,
                scope='Bounded source-pinned component recovery, not a function-completion percentage or a complete GE6/console rebuild')
    write_json(ROOT/'analysis/native-recompilation-summary.json',report)
    print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
```

```py
"""Verify explicit scene vtable discovery against pinned data and exported code."""
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import struct
from inventory import ROOT,PE,sha256,write_json
from native_gar import DEFAULT_IMAGE,EXPECTED_IMAGE

TABLES={'1404c0cd8':'1400b15e0','1404c5d98':'14010fa90','1404c1c48':'1400d7a70','1404c1078':'1400b5870','1404c1d98':'1400d9bc0'}


def main():
    if sha256(DEFAULT_IMAGE)!=EXPECTED_IMAGE:raise ValueError('Unsupported native image')
    image=DEFAULT_IMAGE.read_bytes();pe=PE(image)
    discovery=ROOT/'analysis/vtable-discovery'
    expected_slots,expected_created=map(int,(discovery/'complete.txt').read_text().strip().split(','))
    with (discovery/'slots.csv').open(newline='') as stream:all_rows=list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    if len(all_rows)!=expected_slots or len({r['target'] for r in all_rows if r['status']=='created_from_explicit_vtable'})!=expected_created:
        raise ValueError('Combined vtable discovery completion marker differs')
    rows=[r for r in all_rows if r['table'] in TABLES]
    with (ROOT/'recovered/decompiled/game-full/decompiled-index.csv').open(newline='') as stream:
        catalogue={row['entry']:row for row in csv.DictReader(stream)}
    expected={(table,str(slot)) for table in TABLES for slot in range(0,64,8)}
    if len(rows)!=len(expected) or {(r['table'],r['slot']) for r in rows}!=expected:
        raise ValueError('Incomplete or duplicate bounded vtable slots')
    for row in rows:
        pointer=struct.unpack_from('<Q',image,pe.offset(int(row['table'],16)-pe.base+int(row['slot'])))[0]
        if pointer!=int(row['target'],16) or row['containing_function']!=row['target']:
            raise ValueError('Vtable pointer or catalogue entry differs')
        if row['target'] not in catalogue or catalogue[row['target']]['status']!='ok':
            raise ValueError('Vtable target has no successful pseudocode export')
    for table,constructor in TABLES.items():
        row=catalogue[constructor]
        if '&PTR_FUN_'+table not in (ROOT/'recovered/decompiled/game-full'/row['file']).read_text():
            raise ValueError('Missing observed constructor/vtable association')
    created=sorted({row['target'] for row in rows if row['status']=='created_from_explicit_vtable'})
    report=dict(status='passed',reference_sha256=EXPECTED_IMAGE,tables=len(TABLES),observed_slots=len(rows),
        distinct_targets=len({row['target'] for row in rows}),newly_catalogued_functions=len(created),
        new_entries=['0x'+entry for entry in created],
        discovery_csv_sha256=hashlib.sha256((discovery/'slots.csv').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        existing_function_bodies_split=False,
        scope='Five constructor-observed scene-node tables including LOD, Camera and Light, eight explicit slots each. '
              'All targets have local pseudocode exports. This is not an exhaustive engine vtable, class or lifecycle recovery.')
    write_json(ROOT/'analysis/scene-vtables-summary.json',report)
    print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

`scripts/inventory.py`:

```py
"""Read-only inventory of FS15; work only on local copies of the binaries."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import struct
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_GAME = Path(os.environ.get("FS15_GAME_DIR", r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Farming Simulator 15"))


def sha256(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def entropy(data):
    if not data:
        return 0.0
    size = len(data)
    return round(-sum((n / size) * math.log2(n / size) for n in Counter(data).values()), 4)


class PE:
    """Small PE reader for provenance, addressing, imports, exports and sections."""
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        if data[:2] != b"MZ":
            raise ValueError("Not a DOS/PE image")
        pe = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3c)[0]
        if data[pe:pe + 4] != b"PE\0\0":
            raise ValueError("Missing PE signature")
        self.machine, nsections, self.timestamp = struct.unpack_from("<HHI", data, pe + 4)
        opt_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, pe + 20)[0]
        opt = pe + 24
        self.bits = {0x10b: 32, 0x20b: 64}[struct.unpack_from("<H", data, opt)[0]]
        self.entry_rva = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, opt + 16)[0]
        self.base = struct.unpack_from("<Q" if self.bits == 64 else "<I", data,
                                       opt + (24 if self.bits == 64 else 28))[0]
        self.size_headers = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, opt + 60)[0]
        self.subsystem = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, opt + 68)[0]
        directory_start = opt + (112 if self.bits == 64 else 96)
        ndirs = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, directory_start - 4)[0]
        self.directories = [struct.unpack_from("<II", data, directory_start + i * 8)
                            for i in range(min(ndirs, 16))]
        self.sections = []
        for i in range(nsections):
            off = opt + opt_size + i * 40
            name = data[off:off + 8].split(b"\0")[0].decode("ascii", errors="replace")
            vsize, rva, size, raw = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", data, off + 8)
            flags = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off + 36)[0]
            self.sections.append(dict(name=name, rva=rva, virtual_size=vsize,
                                      raw_offset=raw, raw_size=size,
                                      flags=f"0x{flags:08x}",
                                      entropy=entropy(data[raw:raw + size])))

    def offset(self, rva):
        if 0 <= rva < self.size_headers:
            return rva
        for section in self.sections:
            delta = rva - section["rva"]
            if 0 <= delta < section["raw_size"]:
                return section["raw_offset"] + delta
        raise ValueError(f"RVA without file backing: {rva:x}")

    def address(self, offset):
        for section in self.sections:
            if section["raw_offset"] <= offset < section["raw_offset"] + section["raw_size"]:
                rva = section["rva"] + offset - section["raw_offset"]
                return rva, self.base + rva, section["name"]
        return None, None, ""

    def cstr(self, offset):
        end = self.data.find(b"\0", offset)
        if end < 0:
            raise ValueError("Unterminated string")
        return self.data[offset:end].decode("ascii", errors="replace")

    def imports(self):
        if len(self.directories) < 2 or not self.directories[1][0]:
            return []
        rows = []
        descriptor = self.offset(self.directories[1][0])
        step = self.bits // 8
        while True:
            original, timestamp, chain, name_rva, thunk = struct.unpack_from("<IIIII", self.data, descriptor)
            if not any((original, timestamp, chain, name_rva, thunk)):
                break
            dll = self.cstr(self.offset(name_rva))
            table = self.offset(original or thunk)
            functions = []
            index = 0
            while True:
                value = struct.unpack_from("<Q" if self.bits == 64 else "<I", self.data, table + index * step)[0]
                if value == 0:
                    break
                ordinal = bool(value & (1 << (self.bits - 1)))
                name = f"ordinal:{value & 0xffff}" if ordinal else self.cstr(self.offset(value) + 2)
                functions.append(dict(name=name, iat_va=f"0x{self.base + thunk + index * step:x}"))
                index += 1
            rows.append(dict(dll=dll, functions=functions))
            descriptor += 20
        return rows

    def exports(self):
        if not self.directories or not self.directories[0][0]:
            return []
        start = self.offset(self.directories[0][0])
        base, nfuncs, nnames, funcs, names, ords = struct.unpack_from("<IIIIII", self.data, start + 16)
        output = []
        for i in range(nnames):
            name_rva = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.data, self.offset(names) + i * 4)[0]
            ordinal = struct.unpack_from("<H", self.data, self.offset(ords) + i * 2)[0]
            rva = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.data, self.offset(funcs) + ordinal * 4)[0]
            output.append(dict(name=self.cstr(self.offset(name_rva)), ordinal=base + ordinal,
                               va=f"0x{self.base + rva:x}"))
        return output

    def report(self):
        exceptions = self.directories[3] if len(self.directories) > 3 else (0, 0)
        return dict(bits=self.bits, machine=f"0x{self.machine:04x}",
                    image_base=f"0x{self.base:x}", entry_rva=f"0x{self.entry_rva:x}",
                    entry_va=f"0x{self.base + self.entry_rva:x}",
                    coff_timestamp=self.timestamp, subsystem=self.subsystem,
                    sections=self.sections, imports=self.imports(), exports=self.exports(),
                    x64_runtime_function_records=exceptions[1] // 12 if self.bits == 64 else None)


def strings(data, pe):
    for pattern, encoding in [(rb"[\x20-\x7e]{6,}", "ascii"),
                              (rb"(?:[\x20-\x7e]\x00){6,}", "utf-16-le")]:
        for match in re.finditer(pattern, data):
            rva, va, section = pe.address(match.start())
            yield dict(offset=f"0x{match.start():x}", rva=f"0x{rva:x}" if rva is not None else "",
                       va=f"0x{va:x}" if va is not None else "", section=section,
                       encoding=encoding, text=match.group().decode(encoding))


def write_json(path, obj):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--game", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_GAME)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    game = args.game.resolve(strict=True)
    if game == ROOT or ROOT.is_relative_to(game):
        raise ValueError("Analysis workspace must be separate from the installed game")
    output = ROOT / "analysis"
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    inputs = ROOT / "inputs"
    inputs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(game / "FarmingSimulator2015.xml", inputs / "FarmingSimulator2015.xml")
    files = []
    for path in sorted(game.rglob("*")):
        if path.is_file():
            files.append(dict(path=path.relative_to(game).as_posix(), size=path.stat().st_size,
                              extension=path.suffix.lower()))
    write_json(output / "files.json", files)
    targets = ["x64/FarmingSimulator2015Game.exe", "x86/FarmingSimulator2015Game.exe",
               "FarmingSimulator2015.exe", "dedicatedServer.exe"]
    binaries = []
    for relative in targets:
        source = game / relative
        local = inputs / relative
        local.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        source_hash = sha256(source)
        if not local.exists() or sha256(local) != source_hash:
            shutil.copy2(source, local)
        if sha256(local) != source_hash:
            raise ValueError(f"Copy verification failed: {relative}")
        data = local.read_bytes()
        pe = PE(data)
        report = pe.report()
        report.update(path=relative, size=len(data), sha256=source_hash)
        label = relative.replace("/", "_").removesuffix(".exe")
        write_json(output / "pe" / f"{label}.json", report)
        rows = list(strings(data, pe))
        string_path = output / "strings" / f"{label}.csv"
        string_path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        with string_path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=["offset", "rva", "va", "section", "encoding", "text"])
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(rows)
        candidates = [row for row in rows if re.search(
            r"\.lua\b|\.pdb\b|\.cpp\b|\.gar\b|lua[A-Z_]|GIANTS Engine|^Lua|^LUA|^\.?AV", row["text"])]
        write_json(output / "strings" / f"{label}_anchors.json", candidates)
        report["strings_count"] = len(rows)
        report["anchors_count"] = len(candidates)
        binaries.append(report)
        print(f"{relative}: {pe.bits} bit, {len(rows)} strings, {len(candidates)} anchors", flush=True)
    archives = []
    for name in ("dataS.gar", "dataS2.gar"):
        source = game / name
        with source.open("rb") as stream:
            header = stream.read(256)
        archives.append(dict(path=name, size=source.stat().st_size, sha256=sha256(source),
                             header_hex=header.hex(), first_256_entropy=entropy(header),
                             recognized_zip=zipfile.is_zipfile(source)))
    sdk_manifest = []
    for name in ("sampleMod.zip", "modMapSDK.zip"):
        source = game / "sdk" / name
        local = inputs / "sdk" / name
        local.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source, local)
        destination = (ROOT / "recovered" / "sdk" / source.stem).resolve()
        destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(local) as archive:
            for entry in archive.infolist():
                target = (destination / entry.filename).resolve()
                if not target.is_relative_to(destination):
                    raise ValueError(f"Unsafe SDK ZIP path: {entry.filename}")
                archive.extract(entry, destination)
                sdk_manifest.append(dict(archive=name, path=entry.filename, size=entry.file_size,
                                         crc32=f"{entry.CRC:08x}"))
    write_json(output / "sdk-manifest.json", sdk_manifest)
    state = dict(created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), game_root=str(game),
                 version=(game / "VERSION").read_text().strip(), file_count=len(files),
                 total_bytes=sum(row["size"] for row in files),
                 extensions=dict(Counter(row["extension"] for row in files)),
                 binaries=binaries, archives=archives,
                 sdk_entries=len(sdk_manifest),
                 sdk_lua=[row["path"] for row in sdk_manifest if row["path"].endswith(".lua")])
    write_json(output / "inventory.json", state)
    print(json.dumps({k: state[k] for k in ["version", "file_count", "total_bytes", "extensions", "sdk_lua"]}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```py
"""Detect a local FS15 installation and prepare original assets for the host.

No game assets are downloaded. Existing extraction/mesh/script tools are reused;
their original-code dependencies remain explicit. All generated data stays local.
"""
import argparse
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EXPECTED_IMAGE='6d1beaf9d7e3c57dd51cec03385a53bda82b4ac946e622d8d2fa592a56d71f9f'
GAME_FILES=('FarmingSimulator2015.xml','x64/FarmingSimulator2015Game.exe',
            'data/maps/map01.i3d','data/maps/map02.i3d')
HOME_FILES=('data/maps/map01.i3d','data/maps/map02.i3d','data/maps/map01.meshes',
            'data/maps/map02.meshes','data/maps/map01/map01_dem.png',
            'data/maps/map02/americanMap_dem.png','data/sky/environment.curves',
            'profileTemplate/careerVehicles_map01.xml','profileTemplate/careerVehicles_map02.xml')
TERRAIN_FILES=('data/maps/map01.i3d','data/maps/map02.i3d',
               'data/maps/map01/map01_dem.png','data/maps/map02/americanMap_dem.png',
               'data/maps/map01/pda_map_H.dds','data/maps/map02/pda_map_H.dds')


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()


def valid_game(path):
    return all((Path(path)/name).is_file() for name in GAME_FILES)


def library_paths(text):
    # Steam's quoted VDF paths; also accept the older numeric library entries.
    for key,value in re.findall(r'"([^"\n]+)"\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"',text):
        if key=='path' or (key.isdigit() and (':' in value or value.startswith('/'))):
            yield Path(value.replace('\\\\','\\').replace('\\"','"'))


def detect_installations(root=ROOT,steam_roots=None):
    root=Path(root)
    candidates=[]
    if os.environ.get('FS15_GAME_DIR'):candidates.append(Path(os.environ['FS15_GAME_DIR']))
    for path,key in ((root/'build/launcher/settings.json','GameDirectory'),
                     (root/'build/native-engine/manifest.json','game_directory'),
                     (root/'build/launcher/assets.json','game_directory')):
        try:
            value=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')).get(key)
            if value:candidates.append(Path(value))
        except (OSError,ValueError,AttributeError):pass
    roots=list(steam_roots or [])
    if steam_roots is None:
        roots.extend(Path(os.environ.get(env,''))/'Steam' for env in ('ProgramFiles(x86)','ProgramFiles') if os.environ.get(env))
        if os.name=='nt':
            import winreg
            for hive,key,name in ((winreg.HKEY_CURRENT_USER,r'Software\Valve\Steam','SteamPath'),
                                  (winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE,r'SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Valve\Steam','InstallPath')):
                try:
                    with winreg.OpenKey(hive,key) as registry:roots.append(Path(winreg.QueryValueEx(registry,name)[0]))
                except OSError:pass
    for steam in list(roots):
        try:roots.extend(library_paths((steam/'steamapps/libraryfolders.vdf').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')))
        except OSError:pass
    for steam in roots:
        apps=steam/'steamapps'
        candidates.append(apps/'common/Farming Simulator 15')
        try:
            text=(apps/'appmanifest_313160.acf').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
            match=re.search(r'"installdir"\s*"([^"\n]+)"',text)
            if match and '/' not in match[1] and '\\' not in match[1] and match[1] not in ('.','..'):
                candidates.append(apps/'common'/match[1])
        except OSError:pass
    unique={str(path.resolve()):path.resolve() for path in candidates if valid_game(path)}
    return list(unique.values())


def resource_status(root=ROOT):
    root=Path(root)
    missing=[name for name in HOME_FILES if not (root/'recovered/gar'/name).is_file()]
    for map_id in ('map01','map02'):
        for name in ('fruit_density.grle','cultivator_density.grle'):
            relative=f'data/maps/{map_id}/{name}'
            if not (root/'recovered/gar'/relative).is_file():missing.append(relative)
    for name in ('gui/MainScreen.lua','vehicles/WheelsUtil.lua'):
        if not (root/'recovered/lua/dataS/scripts'/name).is_file():missing.append('recovered Lua: '+name)
    try:
        vehicles=json.loads((root/'recovered/mission-provenance.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))['vehicles']
        if not vehicles:missing.append('prepared starting fleets')
        for vehicle in vehicles:
            for path in (Path(vehicle['runtime']),Path(vehicle['runtime']).with_suffix('.meshes')):
                if not (root/'recovered/gar'/path).is_file():missing.append(path.as_posix())
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError):missing.append('prepared starting fleets')
    incomplete=False
    try:incomplete=json.loads((root/'build/launcher/assets.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')).get('status')!='complete'
    except FileNotFoundError:pass
    except (OSError,ValueError,AttributeError):incomplete=True
    executable=next((p for p in (root/'FS15EngineRebuilt.exe',root/'build/Release/FS15EngineRebuilt.exe') if p.is_file()),None)
    return dict(assets_present=not missing,missing=missing,host_built=executable is not None,
                preparation_incomplete=incomplete,home_launch_ready=not missing and executable is not None and not incomplete,
                scope='Required-file preflight only; full resource hash validation and rendered startup are separate')


def checked_output(root,relative):
    root=Path(root).resolve()
    target=root/relative
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Generated output escapes the workspace: '+str(relative))
    for parent in (target,*target.parents):
        if parent==root:break
        if parent.is_symlink() or (hasattr(parent,'is_junction') and parent.is_junction()):
            raise ValueError('Linked preparation output: '+str(relative))
    return target


def preflight_outputs(root):
    # Existing preparation scripts write many referenced paths. Reject redirected
    # parent directories before invoking them, not just the top-level directory.
    for relative in ('recovered','inputs/archives','analysis','build/shape-bridge','build/mission-meshes'):
        base=checked_output(root,relative)
        if base.exists():
            for path in base.rglob('*'):
                if path.is_symlink() or (hasattr(path,'is_junction') and path.is_junction()):
                    raise ValueError('Linked preparation output: '+str(path.relative_to(root)))


def copy_verified(source,target):
    if target.is_symlink() or (hasattr(target,'is_junction') and target.is_junction()):
        raise ValueError('Linked import destination: '+str(target))
    digest=sha(source)
    if target.is_file() and sha(target)==digest:return False
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    pending=target.with_name(target.name+'.importing')
    if pending.is_symlink() or (pending.exists() and not pending.is_file()):raise ValueError('Unexpected pending import: '+str(pending))
    try:
        shutil.copyfile(source,pending)
        if sha(pending)!=digest:raise ValueError('Source changed or copy verification failed: '+source.name)
        os.replace(pending,target)
    finally:
        if pending.exists():pending.unlink()
    return True


@contextmanager
def preparation_lock(root):
    path=checked_output(root,'build/launcher/assets.lock')
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('a+b') as stream:
        stream.seek(0);stream.write(b'0');stream.flush();stream.seek(0)
        try:
            if os.name=='nt':
                import msvcrt
                msvcrt.locking(stream.fileno(),msvcrt.LK_NBLCK,1)
            else:
                import fcntl
                fcntl.flock(stream.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except OSError as error:raise ValueError('Another resource preparation is running') from error
        try:yield
        finally:
            stream.seek(0)
            if os.name=='nt':msvcrt.locking(stream.fileno(),msvcrt.LK_UNLCK,1)
            else:fcntl.flock(stream.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_UN)


def emit(kind,**values):
    print('LAUNCHER_EVENT '+json.dumps(dict(event=kind,**values)),flush=True)


def prepare_assets(root,game,run=None):
    root,game=Path(root).resolve(),Path(game).resolve(strict=True)
    if not valid_game(game):raise ValueError('Select the installed FS15 directory containing data and x64')
    if game.is_relative_to(root/'recovered') or root.is_relative_to(game):
        raise ValueError('The game installation and workspace outputs must be separate')
    run=run or (lambda command:subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,check=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONUTF8='1')))
    ps=shutil.which('pwsh') or shutil.which('powershell')
    if not ps:raise ValueError('PowerShell is required for the existing Windows preparation tools')
    def python(script,*args):return [sys.executable,'-u',str(root/'scripts'/script),*map(str,args)]
    def powershell(script,*args):return [ps,'-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',str(root/'scripts'/script),*map(str,args)]
    with preparation_lock(root):
        preflight_outputs(root)
        manifest_path=checked_output(root,'build/launcher/assets.json')
        report=dict(status='preparing',game_directory=str(game),started_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),steps=[],installation_modified=False)
        def save():manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        save()
        def step(number,title,action):
            emit('progress',percent=number,title=title)
            action();report['steps'].append(title);save()
        try:
            step(5,'Checking local Lua and mesh tools',lambda: None)
            if not (root/'tools/LuaJIT/src/luajit.exe').is_file() or not (root/'tools/luajit-decompiler/main.py').is_file():
                run(powershell('setup_lua_tools.ps1'))
            if not (root/'build/shape-bridge/FS15ShapeBridge.dll').is_file():run(powershell('setup_shapes_tools.ps1'))
            # Archive extraction still requires the explicitly pinned original
            # oracle. Do not launch a game or capture a process as a side effect.
            recovery=root/'analysis/lua-recovery.json'
            def scripts_current():
                try:
                    rows=json.loads(recovery.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))['files']
                    return bool(rows) and all(row['status'] in ('exact_match','syntax_only') and
                        sha((root/'recovered/lua/dataS'/row['path']).with_suffix('.lua'))==row['source_sha256'] for row in rows)
                except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError):return False
            def archive_current(name):
                try:
                    manifest=json.loads((root/'analysis'/(name+'-extraction.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
                    from gar import safe_relative_name
                    return sha(game/(name+'.gar'))==manifest['archive_sha256'] and bool(manifest['files']) and all(
                        sha(root/'recovered/gar'/name/safe_relative_name(row['name']).as_posix())==row['sha256'] for row in manifest['files'])
                except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError):return False
            if not scripts_current() or not all(archive_current(name) for name in ('dataS','dataS2')):
                image=root/'inputs/runtime/FarmingSimulator2015Game.runtime.bin'
                if not image.is_file() or sha(image)!=EXPECTED_IMAGE:
                    raise ValueError('GAR extraction needs the verified local FS15 1.4.2.0 native analysis image. See docs/LAUNCHER.md; loose assets alone cannot boot the recovered frontend.')
                for index,name in enumerate(('dataS','dataS2')):
                    source=game/(name+'.gar');target=checked_output(root,'inputs/archives/'+name+'.gar')
                    step(12+index*8,'Extracting local '+name+' archive',lambda source=source,target=target: (
                        copy_verified(source,target),run(python('extract_gar.py',target,'--decode-luajit','--validate-xml'))))
                step(30,'Recovering and validating Lua sources',lambda:run(python('recover_lua.py')))
                if not scripts_current():raise ValueError('Lua recovery did not produce a completely compilable source set')
            def terrain():
                for name in TERRAIN_FILES:copy_verified(game/name,checked_output(root,'recovered/gar/'+name))
                run(powershell('prepare-engine-assets.ps1','-GameDir',game))
            step(45,'Preparing original terrain and layer textures',terrain)
            step(60,'Decoding original map meshes and sky resources',lambda:run(python('prepare_scene.py','--game-dir',game)))
            step(80,'Preparing original starting fleets and field grids',lambda:run(python('prepare_mission.py','--game-dir',game)))
            status=resource_status(root)
            if not status['assets_present']:raise ValueError('Preparation incomplete: '+', '.join(status['missing']))
            # Record content hashes rather than treating an old marker as proof.
            files={}
            for path in (root/'recovered/gar').rglob('*'):
                if path.is_file():files[path.relative_to(root/'recovered/gar').as_posix()]=dict(bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(path))
            report.update(status='complete',completed_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),files=files)
            save();status=resource_status(root);report['resource_status']=status
            save();emit('complete',percent=100,title='Original resources prepared locally',files=len(files),**status)
        except BaseException as error:
            report.update(status='failed',error=str(error));save();raise
    return report


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('action',choices=('detect','status','prepare'))
    parser.add_argument('--game-dir',type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.action=='detect':emit('installations',paths=[str(p) for p in detect_installations()])
        elif args.action=='status':emit('resources',**resource_status())
        elif args.game_dir:prepare_assets(ROOT,args.game_dir)
        else:raise ValueError('Select your FS15 installation first')
    except (OSError,ValueError,subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
        emit('error',title=str(error));return 1
    return 0


if __name__=='__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local Linux frontend test launcher. Never uploads results or scans saves."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--smoke', action='store_true', help='Run checks without opening an interactive window')
    parser.add_argument('--root', type=Path, help='Prepared local resource directory')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    package = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    resources = args.root.resolve() if args.root else package/'resources'
    output = package/'test-results'/datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S-%f')
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    report = {'scope': 'recovered English frontend test', 'native_engine_started': False,
              'playable': False, 'system': platform.system(), 'machine': platform.machine(),
              'kernel': platform.release(), 'libc': platform.libc_ver(),
              'display': {k: os.environ.get(k, '') for k in ('XDG_SESSION_TYPE', 'SDL_VIDEODRIVER')},
              'smoke_exit': None, 'interactive_exit': None, 'status': 'failed'}
    report['resources_from_package'] = args.root is None
    code = 1
    try:
        if platform.system() != 'Linux' or platform.machine().lower() not in ('x86_64', 'amd64'):
            raise RuntimeError('This package requires Linux x86_64.')
        manifest_file = package/'TESTER-MANIFEST.json'
        if not manifest_file.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError('Missing TESTER-MANIFEST.json; extract the complete tester package.')
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        for row in manifest['files']:
            relative = PurePosixPath(row['path'])
            if relative.is_absolute() or '..' in relative.parts:
                raise RuntimeError('Unsafe manifest path')
            path = package.joinpath(*relative.parts)
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != row['sha256']:
                raise RuntimeError('Package verification failed: '+str(relative))
        report['package_verified'] = True
        exe = package/'bin/FS15MenuLinux'
        deps = subprocess.run(['ldd', str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
        missing = [line.split('=>')[0].strip() for line in deps.stdout.splitlines() if 'not found' in line]
        report['missing_libraries'] = missing
        report['loader_errors'] = deps.stderr.strip()
        if deps.returncode or missing:
            raise RuntimeError('Runtime libraries missing or incompatible: '+', '.join(missing)+
                               '. See README-LINUX.txt for dependency packages; nothing was installed automatically.')
        if not (resources/'bootstrap.lua').is_file():
            raise RuntimeError('No prepared resources. Prepare a local package from your game copy; see README-LINUX.txt.')
        base = [str(exe), '--root', str(resources), '--output-dir', str(output), '--empty-saves']
        with (output/'console.log').open('w', encoding='utf-8') as log:
            smoke_env = dict(os.environ, SDL_VIDEODRIVER='dummy')
            smoke = subprocess.run(base+['--smoke', '--test-inputs', '--capture-dir', str(output/'screens'),
                                         '--screenshot', str(output/'MainScreen.png')],
                                   stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=smoke_env, timeout=180)
            report['smoke_exit'] = smoke.returncode
            smoke_log = output/'menu-runtime.log'
            if smoke_log.exists():
                smoke_log.rename(output/'smoke-runtime.log')
            if smoke.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError('Frontend self-check failed. Return the generated results archive.')
            if not args.smoke:
                print('Opening the recovered menu. Test Career, difficulty/map selection, Credits/Back and Quit.', flush=True)
                interactive = subprocess.run(base+['--screenshot', str(output/'window-first-frame.png')],
                                             stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                report['interactive_exit'] = interactive.returncode
                if interactive.returncode:
                    raise RuntimeError('Interactive menu failed. Return the generated results archive.')
        code = 0
        report['status'] = 'passed'
    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        report['error'] = str(error)
        print(str(error), file=sys.stderr)
    finally:
        (output/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
        archive = output.with_suffix('.tar.gz')
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'w:gz') as tar:
            tar.add(output, arcname=output.name)
        print('Results to return: '+str(archive))
        print('This archive contains this run\'s logs, system details and screenshots; no saves or game resource directories.')
    return code


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```

`scripts/ljd_driver.py`:

```py
"""Project adapter for the pinned LJD checkout; preserve observed bytecode intent.

LJD's slot substitution can reuse the same literal object in sibling arguments.
Its identity-based writer then skips later occurrences, producing `f(nil, , )`.
Copying leaf literals at substitution keeps the values and their occurrences.
Empty TNEW allocations also must not absorb later field assignments: doing so
can move calls before a table is published globally and change their behavior.
The third-party checkout is not modified or redistributed by this adapter.
"""
from copy import copy
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import sys


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        raise SystemExit("Usage: ljd_driver.py PATH/TO/LJD/main.py [LJD arguments]")
    entry = Path(sys.argv[1]).absolute()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(entry.parent))
    import ljd.ast.nodes as nodes
    import ljd.ast.slotworks as slotworks
    import ljd.ast.builder as builder
    import ljd.ast.mutator as mutator
    import ljd.bytecode.instructions as instructions

    def distinct_literals(replace):
        def wrapped(holder, destination, source):
            if isinstance(source, (nodes.Primitive, nodes.Constant)):
                source = copy(source)
            return replace(holder, destination, source)
        return wrapped

    slotworks._replace_node_in_list = distinct_literals(slotworks._replace_node_in_list)
    slotworks._replace_node = distinct_literals(slotworks._replace_node)

    build_assignment = builder._build_var_assignment

    def preserve_empty_allocation(state, address, instruction):
        result = build_assignment(state, address, instruction)
        # LuaJIT emits TNEW with a zero allocation hint for an empty literal.
        # TDUP templates and sized TNEW constructors keep their normal handling.
        if instruction.opcode == instructions.TNEW.opcode and instruction.CD == 0:
            result[0].expressions.contents[0]._fs15_empty_allocation = True
        return result

    builder._build_var_assignment = preserve_empty_allocation
    fill_refs = slotworks._fill_simple_refs

    def preserve_table_references(info, data, ignore_ambiguous, safe_mode=True):
        source = info.assignment.expressions.contents[0]
        if getattr(source, '_fs15_empty_allocation', False):
            # Keep a referenced table slot while its element reads/writes exist.
            # Merely filtering data.tables after collection would let the final
            # read inline {}, orphaning earlier writes to the allocated table.
            for ref in info.references[1:]:
                holder = slotworks._get_holder(ref.path)
                if isinstance(holder, nodes.TableElement) and holder.table == ref.identifier:
                    return
        return fill_refs(info, data, ignore_ambiguous, safe_mode)

    slotworks._fill_simple_refs = preserve_table_references
    fill_constructor = mutator.MutatorVisitor._fill_constructor

    def preserve_later_stores(table, constructor, statements):
        if getattr(constructor, '_fs15_empty_allocation', False):
            return 0
        return fill_constructor(table, constructor, statements)

    mutator.MutatorVisitor._fill_constructor = staticmethod(preserve_later_stores)
    sys.argv = [str(entry)] + sys.argv[2:]
    runpy.run_path(str(entry), run_name="__main__")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/local_reference_assets.py`:
