```cpp
// Recovered GE6 animation algorithms; bounded guards/callback transport authored.
#include "animation.h"
#include "scene_math.h"
#include "scene_rsqrt.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>
namespace {
uint32_t bits(float f){uint32_t u;std::memcpy(&u,&f,4);return u;}
float value(uint32_t u){float f;std::memcpy(&f,&u,4);return f;}
float scalar(const void* p){float f;std::memcpy(&f,p,4);return f;}
void finite(float f){if(!std::isfinite(f))throw std::runtime_error("Nonfinite animation value");}
template<class T>size_t length(const FS15SceneVector& v) {
    if(v.end<v.begin||v.capacity<v.end||(v.end-v.begin)%sizeof(T)||
        (v.end!=v.begin&&!v.begin)||(v.end-v.begin)/sizeof(T)>1048576)
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid animation vector");
    return (v.end-v.begin)/sizeof(T);
}
template<class T>T& at(const FS15SceneVector& v,size_t i) {
    if(i>=length<T>(v))throw std::runtime_error("Animation index outside vector");
    return reinterpret_cast<T*>(v.begin)[i];
}
void normalize(float* q) {
    for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i)finite(q[i]);
    // Instruction grouping differs from decompiler's double-expression output.
    const float sum=((q[1]*q[1]+q[2]*q[2])+q[3]*q[3])+q[0]*q[0];finite(sum);
    const float inv=fs15_scene_math_detail::inverse_length(sum);
    for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i){q[i]=q[i]*inv;finite(q[i]);}
}
void nlerp(const float* a,const float* b,float t,float* out) {
    finite(t);for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i){finite(a[i]);finite(b[i]);}
    const float dot=((b[1]*a[1]+a[0]*b[0])+a[2]*b[2])+a[3]*b[3];finite(dot);
    for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i)out[i]=t*((dot>=0?b[i]:value(bits(b[i])^0x80000000u))-a[i])+a[i];
    normalize(out);
}
void decode(const FS15AnimationKey* key,float* q) {
    if(!key)throw std::runtime_error("No selected key");
    const auto* p=reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(key)+8+key->rotation_offset;
    int16_t packed[4];std::memcpy(packed,p,8);
    q[1]=static_cast<float>(packed[0])/32767.0f;q[2]=static_cast<float>(packed[1])/32767.0f;
    q[3]=static_cast<float>(packed[2])/32767.0f;q[0]=static_cast<float>(packed[3])/32767.0f;
    normalize(q);
}
void rotation(const FS15AnimationChannel& channel,float* out) {
    float a[4],b[4];decode(channel.first,a);decode(channel.second,b);
    nlerp(b,a,channel.weights[1],out);
}
struct Sample {FS15AnimationChannel* channel;const FS15AnimationKey* a;const FS15AnimationKey* b;float w[3];};
void sample(FS15AnimationClip& clip,float time,bool loop) {
    finite(time);finite(clip.duration);if(clip.duration<=0)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid clip duration");
    if(time>clip.duration)time=loop?std::fmod(time,clip.duration):clip.duration;
    else if(time<0){time=loop?std::fmod(time,clip.duration):0.0f;if(time<0)time=time+clip.duration;}
    std::vector<Sample> results;
    for(size_t i=0;i<length<FS15AnimationChannel*>(clip.channels);++i) {
        auto* c=at<FS15AnimationChannel*>(clip.channels,i);if(!c)throw std::runtime_error("Null channel");
        const size_t count=length<const FS15AnimationKey*>(c->keys);if(!count)throw std::runtime_error("Empty key vector");
        for(size_t j=0;j<count;++j) {
            auto* k=at<const FS15AnimationKey*>(c->keys,j);if(!k)throw std::runtime_error("Null key");
            finite(k->time);if(j&&k->time<at<const FS15AnimationKey*>(c->keys,j-1)->time)throw std::runtime_error("Unsorted keys");
        }
        const auto* first=at<const FS15AnimationKey*>(c->keys,0);Sample s{c,nullptr,nullptr,{1,1,1}};bool wrap=false;
        finite(c->last_time);finite(c->index_scale);
        if(time<first->time||count<2)s.a=s.b=first;
        else if(c->last_time<=time){s.a=at<const FS15AnimationKey*>(c->keys,count-1);s.b=loop?first:s.a;wrap=loop;}
        else {
            const float bucket=(time-first->time)*c->index_scale;
            if(!std::isfinite(bucket)||bucket<0||static_cast<double>(bucket)>=9223372036854775808.0)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid lookup coordinate");
            const uint32_t low=static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(bucket));
            const size_t start=c->lookup[std::min(low,uint32_t(63))];
            if(!start||start>=count)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid acceleration index");
            for(size_t j=start;j<count;++j) {
                s.b=at<const FS15AnimationKey*>(c->keys,j);
                if(time<=s.b->time){s.a=at<const FS15AnimationKey*>(c->keys,j-1);break;}
            }
            if(!s.a)throw std::runtime_error("No bracketing key");
        }
        const float end=wrap?s.b->time+clip.duration:s.b->time;
        const float w=end<=s.a->time?1.0f:(end-time)/(end-s.a->time);finite(w);
        for(float& f:s.w)f=w;
        const uint16_t flags=(w<=0.5f?s.b:s.a)->flags;
        const unsigned shift=w<=0.5f?4:7;
        if(flags&(7u<<shift)) {
            const float eased=(3.0f-w*2.0f)*(w*w);finite(eased);
            for(unsigned lane=0;lane<3;++lane)if(flags&(1u<<(shift+lane)))s.w[lane]=eased;
        }
        results.push_back(s);
    }
    for(const auto& s:results){s.channel->first=s.a;s.channel->second=s.b;std::memcpy(s.channel->weights,s.w,12);}
}
uint32_t word(const FS15CharacterSet& set,unsigned i){return bits(set.state[i]);}
void word(FS15CharacterSet& set,unsigned i,uint32_t u){set.state[i]=value(u);}
uint8_t dirty(const FS15CharacterSet& set){return static_cast<uint8_t>(set.flags>>8);}
void dirty(FS15CharacterSet& set,uint8_t d){set.flags=static_cast<uint16_t>((set.flags&255u)|(uint16_t(d)<<8));}
FS15AnimationClip& clip(const FS15CharacterSet& set,uint32_t index) {
    if(!set.data)throw std::runtime_error("No shared animation data");
    auto* p=at<FS15AnimationClip*>(set.data->clips,index);if(!p)throw std::runtime_error("Null clip");
    finite(p->duration);if(p->duration<=0)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid duration");return *p;
}
void blend_vector(const FS15AnimationChannel& c,unsigned lane,unsigned offset,float weight,const float* base,float* out) {
    if(!c.first||!c.second)throw std::runtime_error("Missing selected keys");
    const auto* a=reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(c.first)+8+(offset?c.first->scale_offset:0);
    const auto* b=reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(c.second)+8+(offset?c.second->scale_offset:0);
    for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i) {
        const float av=scalar(a+i*4),bv=scalar(b+i*4);finite(av);finite(bv);
        out[i]=out[i]+(((av-bv)*c.weights[lane]+bv)-base[i])*weight;finite(out[i]);
    }
}
void update(FS15CharacterSet& set,float dt,const FS15AnimationServices& services) {
    finite(dt);if(!(set.flags&255u))return;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i)if((word(set,i)&3u)==3) {
        const float speed=set.state[8+i];finite(speed);
        if(std::fabs(speed)>0) {
            const float old=set.state[12+i];finite(old);const float next=old+speed*dt;finite(next);
            set.state[12+i]=next;const float duration=clip(set,word(set,4+i)).duration;
            if((word(set,i)&4u)||(speed>0&&old<duration&&next>0)||(speed<0&&old>0&&next<duration))dirty(set,1);
        }
    }
    if(!dirty(set))return;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i)if((word(set,i)&3u)==3)sample(clip(set,word(set,4+i)),set.state[12+i],(word(set,i)&4u)!=0);
    if(!set.data)throw std::runtime_error("No shared data");
    const size_t count=length<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(set.transforms);
    if(length<float>(set.data->translation)<count*3||length<float>(set.data->scale)<count*3||
        set.data->visibility_count<count||length<uint32_t>(set.data->visibility_words)<(count+31)/32)
        throw std::runtime_error("Incomplete default pose");
    const auto* translation=reinterpret_cast<const float*>(set.data->translation.begin);
    const auto* scale=reinterpret_cast<const float*>(set.data->scale.begin);
    for(size_t n=0;n<count;++n) {
        float t[3],s[3],q[4]{};std::memcpy(t,translation+n*3,12);std::memcpy(s,scale+n*3,12);
        bool visible=(at<uint32_t>(set.data->visibility_words,n/32)&(1u<<(n%32)))!=0;
        uint16_t changed=0;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i)if((word(set,i)&3u)==3) {
            auto& current=clip(set,word(set,4+i));auto* c=at<FS15AnimationChannel*>(current.channels,n);
            const float w=set.state[16+i];finite(w);if(!c)throw std::runtime_error("Null channel");changed|=c->flags;
            if(c->flags&1u)blend_vector(*c,0,0,w,translation+n*3,t);
            if(c->flags&2u) {
                float r[4];rotation(*c,r);
                const float dot=((r[1]*q[1]+r[0]*q[0])+r[2]*q[2])+r[3]*q[3];
                for(unsigned j=0;j<4;++j){if(dot<0)r[j]=value(bits(r[j])^0x80000000u);q[j]=q[j]+r[j]*w;}
            }
            if(c->flags&4u)blend_vector(*c,2,1,w,scale+n*3,s);
            if(c->flags&8u){if(!c->first)throw std::runtime_error("No visibility key");if(w>0.5f)visible=(c->first->flags&0x8000u)!=0;}
        }
        auto* node=at<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(set.transforms,n);if(!node)throw std::runtime_error("Null transform");
        if(changed&7u) {
            float matrix[16];std::memcpy(matrix,node->local,64);
            if(changed&1u)std::memcpy(matrix+12,t,12);
            if(changed&2u){normalize(q);if(!fs15_quaternion_to_matrix(q,4,matrix,16))throw std::runtime_error("Invalid rotation matrix");}
            if(changed&4u) {
                if(!(changed&2u)) {
                    if(node->flags&0x80u)if(!services.refresh||!services.refresh(services.user,node))throw std::runtime_error("TRS refresh failed");
                    for(unsigned j=0;j<3;++j)if(node->scale[j]!=0)s[j]=s[j]/node->scale[j];
                }
                for(unsigned col=0;col<3;++col)for(unsigned row=0;row<3;++row)matrix[col*4+row]=matrix[col*4+row]*s[col];
            }
            for(float f:matrix)finite(f);
            if(!services.set_matrix||!services.set_matrix(services.user,node,matrix)||
                !services.propagate||!services.propagate(services.user,node,1,0))throw std::runtime_error("Matrix update failed");
        }
        if((changed&8u)&&bool(node->flags&1u)!=visible) {
            node->flags=(node->flags&~1u)|uint32_t(visible);
            if(!services.propagate||!services.propagate(services.user,node,2,0))throw std::runtime_error("Visibility update failed");
        }
    }
    dirty(set,0);
}
}

extern "C" int fs15_animation_set_time(FS15CharacterSet* set,uint32_t i,float time) {
    if(!set||i>=4||!std::isfinite(time))return 0;
    try {
        if((word(*set,i)&3u)==3) {
            const float duration=clip(*set,word(*set,4+i)).duration,old=set->state[12+i];finite(old);
            if(std::clamp(old,0.0f,duration)!=std::clamp(time,0.0f,duration))dirty(*set,dirty(*set)|1u);
        }
        set->state[12+i]=time;return 1;
    }catch(...){return 0;}
}
extern "C" int fs15_animation_set_weight(FS15CharacterSet* set,uint32_t i,float weight) {
    if(!set||i>=4||!std::isfinite(weight))return 0;
    dirty(*set,dirty(*set)==0&&set->state[16+i]==weight?0:1);set->state[16+i]=weight;return 1;
}

    if(!set||i>=4)return 0;
    if(!(word(*set,i)&1u)||word(*set,4+i)!=index)dirty(*set,dirty(*set)|1u);
    word(*set,i,word(*set,i)|1u);word(*set,4+i,index);return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_animation_find_clip(const FS15CharacterSet* set,const char* name,size_t bytes,uint32_t* result) {
    if(!set||!set->data||!name||!bytes||!result||!std::memchr(name,0,bytes))return 0;
    try {
        uint32_t found=UINT32_MAX;
        for(size_t i=0;i<length<FS15AnimationClip*>(set->data->clips);++i) {
            auto* c=at<FS15AnimationClip*>(set->data->clips,i);if(!c)throw std::runtime_error("Null named clip");
            size_t size,capacity;std::memcpy(&size,c->name+16,8);std::memcpy(&capacity,c->name+24,8);
            if(size>capacity||size>1048576)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid clip string");
            const char* text=reinterpret_cast<const char*>(c->name);if(capacity>15)std::memcpy(&text,c->name,8);
            if(!text||!std::memchr(text,0,size+1))throw std::runtime_error("Unterminated clip name");
            if(std::strcmp(text,name)==0){found=static_cast<uint32_t>(i);break;}
        }
        *result=found;return 1;
    }catch(...){return 0;}
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include "shared_scene.h"
#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {

/* Observed GE6 layouts. Keys have an eight-byte header followed by variable
 * payload: translation at +8, signed int16 XYZW at +8+rotation_offset,
 * scale at +8+scale_offset. The caller owns readable, correctly sized decoded
 * keys and all vectors/pointees; these are not untrusted-file parsers. */
typedef struct FS15AnimationKey {
    float time;uint16_t flags;uint8_t rotation_offset,scale_offset;
} FS15AnimationKey;
typedef struct FS15AnimationChannel {
    uint16_t node_index,flags;uint32_t unknown04;
    FS15SceneVector keys;uint64_t unknown20;
    uint16_t lookup[64];float index_scale,last_time,weights[3];uint32_t unknownbc;
    const FS15AnimationKey* first;const FS15AnimationKey* second;
} FS15AnimationChannel;
typedef struct FS15AnimationClip {
    float duration;uint32_t unknown04;uint8_t name[32];uint64_t unknown28;
    FS15SceneVector channels;
} FS15AnimationClip;
/* Recovered seed generation, fast normalization, shortest-path normalized
 * linear interpolation and compressed channel rotation. No original table
 * bytes are embedded. sqrt/fmod use the platform math library; original CRT
 * bodies are not recovered. Finite input/output is required. Results are
 * staged, may alias inputs, and remain unchanged on failure. Zero quaternion
 * normalization retains native zero output (it does not invent an identity). */
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_rsqrt_table(uint32_t*,size_t);
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_normalize(float*,size_t);
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_nlerp(const float*,const float*,float,float*,size_t);
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_rotation(const FS15AnimationChannel*,float*,size_t);
/* Select keys and interpolation weights in every channel. Exact duration
 * endpoints remain at duration even when looping. Only valid sorted keys and
 * acceleration indices are supported; malformed indices/empty channels reject
 * before committing any channel output. Positive finite duration is required. */
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_sample(FS15AnimationClip*,float,int);
/* Four-track native state controls. flags/clip indices retain their original
 * bit representations in CharacterSet.state[0..7]. Time stores the requested
 * value, while dirty detection compares clamped values, including on loops. */
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_set_time(FS15CharacterSet*,uint32_t,float);
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_set_weight(FS15CharacterSet*,uint32_t,float);
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_set_clip(FS15CharacterSet*,uint32_t,uint32_t);
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_find_clip(const FS15CharacterSet*,const char*,size_t,uint32_t*);
/* Authored transport for native virtual slots. Hosts serialize updates and
 * supply known TRS refresh, matrix setter and state propagation services.
 * No arbitrary native function pointers are executed. Callback side effects,
 * reentrancy and scheduling are outside this bounded reconstruction. A callback
 * failure preserves preceding native-order mutations; it is not a transaction.
 * Updates shared by multiple tracks preserve native last-sample-wins behavior. */
typedef struct FS15AnimationServices {
    void* user;
    int (*refresh)(void*,FS15SceneStateRecord*);
    int (*set_matrix)(void*,FS15SceneStateRecord*,const float*);
    int (*propagate)(void*,FS15SceneStateRecord*,uint32_t,int32_t);
} FS15AnimationServices;
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_update(FS15CharacterSet*,float,const FS15AnimationServices*);
#ifdef __cplusplus
}

static_assert(offsetof(FS15AnimationChannel,weights)==0xb0);
```

```cpp
bool valid(const FS15SceneVector& v) {
    return v.end>=v.begin&&v.capacity>=v.end&&(v.end-v.begin)%8==0&&(v.capacity-v.begin)%8==0&&
        (v.begin||(!v.end&&!v.capacity))&&(v.end-v.begin)/8<=65535;

bool append(FS15SceneVector& v,void* pointer,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices& s) {
    if(!valid(v))return false;
    const size_t count=(v.end-v.begin)/8,capacity=(v.capacity-v.begin)/8;
    if(count==65535)return false;
    if(count==capacity) {
        const size_t grown=std::max(count+1,capacity+capacity/2);
        void* next=s.allocate(s.user,grown*8);if(!next)return false;
        if(count)std::memcpy(next,reinterpret_cast<void*>(v.begin),count*8);
        if(v.begin)s.deallocate(s.user,reinterpret_cast<void*>(v.begin));
        v.begin=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(next);v.end=v.begin+count*8;v.capacity=v.begin+grown*8;
    }
    write(reinterpret_cast<void*>(v.end),0,reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(pointer));v.end+=8;return true;
}

    if(!fs15_compose_trs(rotation,scale,position,matrix,16)||!fs15_matrix_to_quaternion(matrix,16,out,4))

}
void free_channel(FS15AnimationChannel* channel,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices& s) {
    if(!channel)return;
    for(uintptr_t p=channel->keys.begin;p<channel->keys.end;p+=8)s.deallocate(s.user,reinterpret_cast<void*>(read<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(p),0)));
    if(channel->keys.begin)s.deallocate(s.user,reinterpret_cast<void*>(channel->keys.begin));
    s.deallocate(s.user,channel);
}

    for(uintptr_t p=clip->channels.begin;p<clip->channels.end;p+=8)free_channel(reinterpret_cast<FS15AnimationChannel*>(read<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(p),0)),s);

    if(read<size_t>(clip->name,24)>15)s.deallocate(s.user,reinterpret_cast<void*>(read<uintptr_t>(clip->name,0)));

                    for(uint32_t m=0;m<keys;++m) {
                        Key key{};key.time=number();key.flags=integer();
                        if(key.flags&1u)for(float& f:key.translation)f=number();
                        if(key.flags&2u)for(float& f:key.rotation)f=number();
                        if(key.flags&4u)for(float& f:key.scale)f=number();
                        if(m&&(key.time<=channel.keys.back().time||((key.flags^channel.keys.back().flags)&15u)))
                            throw std::runtime_error("Inconsistent animation keys");
                        channel.keys.push_back(key);
                    }
                    if(keys){nodes.insert(channel.node);if(nodes.size()>65535)throw std::runtime_error("Too many animated nodes");}
                    clip.channels.push_back(std::move(channel));
                }
                group.clips.push_back(std::move(clip));
            }
            groups.push_back(std::move(group));
        }
        return groups;
    }
};

}

    }

    if(!r||!out||count<4)return 0;

extern "C" int fs15_animation_key_create(float time,uint32_t flags,const float* t,const float* q,const float* scale,int visible,
    const FS15SceneLifecycleServices* s,FS15AnimationKey** out) {
    if(!allocator(s)||!out||((flags&1u)&&!t)||((flags&2u)&&!q)||((flags&4u)&&!scale))return 0;
    try {
        finite(time);uint8_t packed[40];const uint16_t header=static_cast<uint16_t>(flags)|(visible?uint16_t(0x8000):0);
        write(packed,0,time);write(packed,4,header);packed[6]=(flags&1u)?12:0;packed[7]=static_cast<uint8_t>(packed[6]+((flags&2u)?8:0));
        size_t used=8;
        if(flags&1u){for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i)finite(t[i]);std::memcpy(packed+used,t,12);used+=12;}
        if(flags&2u)for(unsigned i:{1u,2u,3u,0u}) {
            finite(q[i]);const float v=q[i]*32767.0f;const float rounded=(v<0?-0.5f:0.5f)+v;
            if(!std::isfinite(rounded)||double(rounded)<-2147483648.0||double(rounded)>=2147483648.0)return 0;
            const uint16_t quantized=static_cast<uint16_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(rounded)));
            write(packed,used,quantized);used+=2;
        }
        if(flags&4u){for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i)finite(scale[i]);std::memcpy(packed+used,scale,12);used+=12;}
        auto* key=static_cast<FS15AnimationKey*>(s->allocate(s->user,used));if(!key)return 0;
        std::memcpy(key,packed,used);*out=key;return 1;
    }catch(...){return 0;}
}
extern "C" int fs15_animation_channel_add_key(FS15AnimationChannel* c,FS15AnimationKey* key,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices* s,int* diagnostic) {
    if(!c||!key||!allocator(s)||!diagnostic||!valid(c->keys)||!std::isfinite(key->time))return 0;
    *diagnostic=0;const size_t count=(c->keys.end-c->keys.begin)/8;
    if(count) {
        const auto* last=reinterpret_cast<const FS15AnimationKey*>(read<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(c->keys.end-8),0));if(!last)return 0;
        if(key->time<=last->time){*diagnostic=1;return 1;}
        if((key->flags^last->flags)&15u){*diagnostic=2;return 1;}
    }else c->flags=key->flags&15u;
    if(!append(c->keys,key,*s))return 0;
    c->last_time=key->time;return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_animation_channel_finalize(FS15AnimationChannel* c) {
    if(!c||!valid(c->keys))return 0;
    const size_t count=(c->keys.end-c->keys.begin)/8;const auto* keys=reinterpret_cast<const FS15AnimationKey* const*>(c->keys.begin);
    for(size_t i=0;i<count;++i)if(!keys[i]||!std::isfinite(keys[i]->time))return 0;
    const float span=count?keys[count-1]->time-keys[0]->time:0;if(!std::isfinite(span))return 0;
    c->lookup[0]=0;c->index_scale=0;
    if(count&&span>0) {
        const float step=span*0.015625f;c->index_scale=64.0f/span;size_t next=0;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<64;++i){const float time=static_cast<float>(i)*step+keys[0]->time;while(next<count&&keys[next]->time<=time)++next;c->lookup[i]=static_cast<uint16_t>(next);}
    }
    return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_animation_clip_add_channel(FS15AnimationClip* c,FS15AnimationChannel* channel,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices* s) {
    return c&&allocator(s)&&append(c->channels,channel,*s);
}
extern "C" int fs15_animation_set_add_clip(FS15CharacterSet* set,FS15AnimationClip* clip,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices* s) {
    if(!set||!set->data||!clip||!allocator(s)||!valid(clip->channels))return 0;
    uint32_t mask=0;for(uintptr_t p=clip->channels.begin;p<clip->channels.end;p+=8) {
        auto* channel=reinterpret_cast<FS15AnimationChannel*>(read<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(p),0));if(!channel)return 0;mask|=channel->flags;
    }
    set->data->flags|=mask;return append(set->data->clips,clip,*s);
}
extern "C" int fs15_animation_load_binary(const void* input,size_t bytes,int has_version,const FS15AnimationResourceServices* services,FS15AnimationLoadStats* stats) {
    if(!input||!bytes||!services||!allocator(services->memory)||!services->context||!services->resolve||!services->loaded||!stats)return 0;
    Reader reader{static_cast<const uint8_t*>(input),bytes};std::vector<Group> groups;
    try{groups=reader.parse(has_version!=0);}catch(...){return 0;}
    FS15AnimationLoadStats result{reader.offset,static_cast<uint32_t>(groups.size()),0,0,0};const auto& s=*services->memory;
    for(const auto& group:groups) {
        FS15CharacterSet* set=nullptr;FS15AnimationClip* clip=nullptr;FS15AnimationChannel* channel=nullptr;FS15AnimationKey* key=nullptr;
        bool constructed=false,binding=false;
        try {
            set=static_cast<FS15CharacterSet*>(s.allocate(s.user,sizeof(FS15CharacterSet)));if(!set)throw std::bad_alloc();
            if(!fs15_character_set_construct(set,sizeof(*set),group.name.c_str(),group.name.size()+1,nullptr,services->context,&s))throw std::bad_alloc();
            constructed=true;
            std::vector<uint32_t> node_ids;std::map<uint32_t,size_t> ordinals;
            for(const auto& source:group.clips) {
                clip=clip_construct(source,s);
                for(const auto& track:source.channels)if(!track.keys.empty()) {
                    channel=channel_construct(s);
                    for(const auto& frame:track.keys) {
                        float q[4]{};if(frame.flags&2u)euler_quaternion(frame.rotation,q);
                        if(!fs15_animation_key_create(frame.time,frame.flags,frame.translation,q,frame.scale,(frame.flags&0x8000u)!=0,&s,&key))throw std::bad_alloc();
                        int diagnostic=0;if(!fs15_animation_channel_add_key(channel,key,&s,&diagnostic)||diagnostic)throw std::runtime_error("Key insertion failed");key=nullptr;
                    }
                    if(!fs15_animation_channel_finalize(channel))throw std::runtime_error("Lookup generation failed");
                    const auto inserted=ordinals.emplace(track.node,node_ids.size());
                    if(inserted.second)node_ids.push_back(track.node);
                    channel->node_index=static_cast<uint16_t>(inserted.first->second);
                    if(!fs15_animation_clip_add_channel(clip,channel,&s))throw std::bad_alloc();
                    channel=nullptr;
                }
                if(!fs15_animation_set_add_clip(set,clip,&s))throw std::bad_alloc();
                clip=nullptr;
            }
            std::vector<FS15SceneStateRecord*> nodes;bool missing=false;
            for(uint32_t id:node_ids){auto* node=services->resolve(services->user,id);if(!node){missing=true;break;}nodes.push_back(node);}
            if(missing) {
                if(!fs15_character_set_destruct(set,sizeof(*set),1,services->context,&s))throw std::runtime_error("Skipped group cleanup failed");
                set=nullptr;++result.skipped;services->loaded(services->user,nullptr,3);
            }else {
                binding=true;int diagnostic=0;
                if(!fs15_character_set_bind(set,nodes.data(),nodes.size(),services->context,&s,&diagnostic))throw std::runtime_error("Binding failed");
                ++result.loaded;if(diagnostic)++result.binding_warnings;services->loaded(services->user,set,static_cast<uint32_t>(diagnostic));set=nullptr;
            }
        }catch(...) {
            if(key)s.deallocate(s.user,key);
            free_channel(channel,s);free_clip(clip,s);
            if(set) {
                if(binding)services->loaded(services->user,set,4);
                else if(constructed)fs15_character_set_destruct(set,sizeof(*set),1,services->context,&s);
                else s.deallocate(s.user,set);
            }
            *stats=result;return 0;
        }
    }
    *stats=result;return 1;
}
```

```h
/* Recovered Euler-to-WXYZ conversion, variable-size key packing, ordered key
 * insertion, lookup generation, channel append and clip registration. These
 * use caller-owned valid native-layout graphs and host allocator services. */

    const float*,int,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices*,FS15AnimationKey**);
/* diagnostic=1: non-increasing time; =2: changed low-four control bits.
 * Rejected keys remain caller-owned, matching the original insertion boundary.
 * The original logger is replaced with an explicit diagnostic. */
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_channel_add_key(FS15AnimationChannel*,FS15AnimationKey*,
    const FS15SceneLifecycleServices*,int* diagnostic);

FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_set_add_clip(FS15CharacterSet*,FS15AnimationClip*,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices*);
/* Platform file access, XML dispatch and node-ID map integration are authored
 * transport. The binary payload algorithm is recovered from 0x1401ca840.
 * resolve() must return a valid live node or null. loaded() sees each group
 * immediately after binding: nodes own nonzero reference counts. A zero-node
 * group has count zero and is transferred to the host for explicit cleanup.
 * A pointer from an earlier group can be invalidated by later node rebinding;
 * retaining it requires an explicit external reference. Do not reenter loading.
 * diagnostic=0 success, 1/2 native binding warning, 3 missing node (set=null),
 * 4 incomplete bind after host allocation failure (preceding mutations remain).
 * Native exceptions, logger effects and a complete scene loader are not supplied. */
typedef struct FS15AnimationResourceServices {
    void* user;
    const FS15SceneLifecycleServices* memory;
    FS15SharedSceneContext* context;
    FS15SceneStateRecord* (*resolve)(void*,uint32_t);
    void (*loaded)(void*,FS15CharacterSet*,uint32_t);
} FS15AnimationResourceServices;
typedef struct FS15AnimationLoadStats {
    size_t consumed;
    uint32_t groups,loaded,skipped,binding_warnings;
} FS15AnimationLoadStats;
/* The file wrapper accepts the observed big-endian version 2/3 headers.
 * has_version=0 accepts the native entry's payload, starting at group count.
 * Truncation/count/finite/monotonic guards preflight the whole input before
 * engine allocation. Stats stay unchanged if preflight fails. Bytes following
 * the parsed payload are allowed and reported through consumed. */
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_animation_load_binary(const void*,size_t,int has_version,
    const FS15AnimationResourceServices*,FS15AnimationLoadStats*);
#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

```cpp
size_t text_length(const char* text,size_t bytes) {
    if(!text||!bytes||bytes>1048577)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid bounded animation attribute");
    const auto* end=static_cast<const char*>(std::memchr(text,0,bytes));if(!end)throw std::runtime_error("Unterminated animation attribute");
    return static_cast<size_t>(end-text);
}
bool digit(char c){return c>='0'&&c<='9';}
float parse(const char* text,size_t length,size_t& cursor) {
    size_t p=0;while(p<length&&text[p]==' ')++p;
    const bool negative=p<length&&text[p]=='-';if(negative)++p;
    float value=0;
    while(p<length&&digit(text[p])){value=static_cast<float>(double(text[p]-'0')+double(value)*10.0);++p;}
    if(p<length&&text[p]=='.') {
        ++p;double place=0.1;
        while(p<length&&digit(text[p])){const double part=double(text[p]-'0')*place;place=place*0.1;value=static_cast<float>(part+double(value));++p;}
    }
    if(p<length&&text[p]=='e') {
        ++p;const bool inverse=p<length&&text[p]=='-';if(p<length&&(text[p]=='-'||text[p]=='+'))++p;
        uint32_t exponent=0;
        while(p<length&&digit(text[p])){if(exponent>4096)throw std::runtime_error("Exponent work limit");exponent=exponent*10+uint32_t(text[p]-'0');++p;}
        if(exponent>4096)throw std::runtime_error("Exponent work limit");
        float power=1;for(uint32_t i=0;i<exponent;++i)power=static_cast<float>(double(power)*10.0);
        value=inverse?value/power:value*power;
    }
    if(negative){uint32_t bits;std::memcpy(&bits,&value,4);bits^=0x80000000u;std::memcpy(&value,&bits,4);}
    cursor=p;return value;
}
std::vector<float> parse_vector(const char* text,size_t length,size_t capacity) {
    std::vector<float> values;if(!length)return values;size_t start=0,unused=0;
    for(size_t i=0;i<length;++i)if(text[i]==' ') {
        if(values.size()==capacity)return values;
        values.push_back(parse(text+start,length-start,unused));start=i+1;
    }
    if(values.size()<capacity)values.push_back(parse(text+start,length-start,unused));
    return values;
}
struct Attributes {
    const FS15AnimationXmlAttribute* items;size_t count;
    Attributes(const FS15AnimationXmlAttribute* a,size_t n):items(a),count(n) {
        if((n&&!a)||n>4096)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid animation attributes");
        for(size_t i=0;i<n;++i){text_length(a[i].name,a[i].name_bytes);if(a[i].value)text_length(a[i].value,a[i].value_bytes);}
    }
    const FS15AnimationXmlAttribute* find(const char* key)const {for(size_t i=0;i<count;++i)if(std::strcmp(items[i].name,key)==0)return items+i;return nullptr;}
    const char* value(const char* key)const{const auto* a=find(key);return a?a->value:nullptr;}
    bool triple(const char* key,float* out)const {
        const auto* a=find(key);if(!a||!a->value)return false;
        const auto values=parse_vector(a->value,text_length(a->value,a->value_bytes),3);
        if(values.size()!=3)throw std::runtime_error("Incomplete native numeric vector");
        for(size_t i=0;i<3;++i){if(!std::isfinite(values[i]))throw std::runtime_error("Nonfinite animation vector");out[i]=values[i];}return true;
    }
    bool linear(const char* key)const{const char* v=value(key);return v&&std::strcmp(v,"linear")==0;}
};
bool is_false(const char* value) {
    const char* expected="false";
    for(size_t i=0;i<6;++i){unsigned char c=static_cast<unsigned char>(value[i]);if(c>='A'&&c<='Z')c=static_cast<unsigned char>(c+32);if(c!=static_cast<unsigned char>(expected[i]))return false;if(!c)return true;}return true;
}
struct State {
    FS15AnimationXmlServices services;FS15CharacterSet* set=nullptr;FS15AnimationClip* clip=nullptr;FS15AnimationChannel* channel=nullptr;
    uint32_t node_id=0;std::vector<uint32_t> ids;std::map<uint32_t,size_t> ordinals;std::vector<FS15AnimationKey*> rejected;
    explicit State(const FS15AnimationXmlServices& s):services(s){}
    const FS15SceneLifecycleServices& memory()const{return *services.resources.memory;}
    void pending() {
        fs15_animation_storage::destroy_channel(channel,memory());channel=nullptr;
        fs15_animation_storage::destroy_clip(clip,memory());clip=nullptr;
        if(set){if(!fs15_character_set_destruct(set,sizeof(*set),1,services.resources.context,&memory()))throw std::runtime_error("Pending XML set cleanup failed");set=nullptr;}
    }
    void event(unsigned operation,const Attributes& a,int& diagnostic) {
        const auto& m=memory();const auto& resources=services.resources;

        }
        if(operation==FS15_ANIMATION_XML_END_SET) {

            }
            auto* completed=set;set=nullptr;resources.loaded(resources.user,completed,static_cast<uint32_t>(diagnostic));return;
        }

            if(!duration||!services.duration||!services.duration(resources.user,duration,&value)||!std::isfinite(value))throw std::runtime_error("Invalid clip duration service");
            if(!name)name="";

        }

            if(!fs15_animation_set_add_clip(set,clip,&m))throw std::bad_alloc();

        }

            node_id=next;channel=fs15_animation_storage::channel(m);return;

            if(channel->keys.begin==channel->keys.end){fs15_animation_storage::destroy_channel(channel,m);channel=nullptr;return;}

        if(!std::isfinite(at))throw std::runtime_error("Nonfinite key time");

        if(a.triple("rotation",rotation)) {

        if(diagnostic){try{rejected.push_back(key);}catch(...){m.deallocate(m.user,key);throw;}}
```

```h
 * avoid the original undefined uninitialized-stack payloads.
```

`src/core/bit_operations.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "api.h"
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

// Recovered 32-bit scripting operations, native entries 0x1400dc960..0x1400dca20.
// Unsigned arithmetic and explicit shift masks preserve x64 wrapping on other CPUs.
extern "C" FS15_CORE_API int fs15_script_bit_operation(unsigned operation,void* frame_ptr,
    std::size_t bytes) noexcept {
    if(!frame_ptr || bytes<0x100 || operation>FS15_BIT_HIGHEST_SET) {
        return 0;
    }
    auto* frame=static_cast<unsigned char*>(frame_ptr);
    std::uint32_t a=0,b=0,result=0;
    std::memcpy(&a,frame,4);
    std::memcpy(&b,frame+16,4);
    switch(operation) {
        case FS15_BIT_AND: result=a&b; break;
        case FS15_BIT_OR: result=a|b; break;
        case FS15_BIT_NOT: result=~a; break;
        case FS15_BIT_XOR: result=a^b; break;
        case FS15_BIT_SHIFT_LEFT: result=a<<(b&31); break;
        case FS15_BIT_SHIFT_RIGHT: result=a>>(b&31); break;
        case FS15_BIT_HIGHEST_SET:
            while(a>1) {a>>=1;++result;}
            break;
    }
    const std::uint16_t integer_tag=1;
    std::memcpy(frame+0xf0,&result,4);
    std::memcpy(frame+0xf8,&integer_tag,2);
    return 1;
}
```

```cpp
#include "buffered_file.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

namespace {
uint32_t get(const void* p,size_t offset){uint32_t v;std::memcpy(&v,static_cast<const unsigned char*>(p)+offset,4);return v;}
void put(void* p,size_t offset,uint32_t v){std::memcpy(static_cast<unsigned char*>(p)+offset,&v,4);}
bool valid(const void* p,size_t bytes){return p&&bytes>=FS15_BUFFERED_FILE_BYTES&&get(p,0x8048)<=get(p,0x804c)&&get(p,0x804c)<=FS15_FILE_BUFFER_BYTES;}
}
uint32_t fs15_buffered_file_read(void* record,size_t bytes,void* output,size_t capacity,uint32_t count,const FS15_FileServices* services){
    if(!count||!valid(record,bytes)||!output||capacity<count||!services||!services->read)return 0;
    auto* p=static_cast<unsigned char*>(record);auto* target=static_cast<unsigned char*>(output);
    uint32_t total=0;bool short_read=false;
    while(count){
        if(short_read)return total;
        if(get(p,0x8048)==get(p,0x804c)){
            const auto read=fs15_file_read(record,bytes,p+0x48,FS15_FILE_BUFFER_BYTES,services);
            if(read>=0x80000000u){p[0x8054]=1;return total;}
            // A callback returning more than the requested buffer length is
            // outside the OS contract; stop before an invalid buffer access.
            if(read>FS15_FILE_BUFFER_BYTES){p[0x8054]=1;return total;}
            put(p,0x8048,0);put(p,0x804c,read);short_read=read!=FS15_FILE_BUFFER_BYTES;
        }
        const auto copied=std::min(count,get(p,0x804c)-get(p,0x8048));
        if(copied){
            std::memcpy(target+total,p+0x48+get(p,0x8048),copied);
            put(p,0x8048,get(p,0x8048)+copied);
            total+=copied;count-=copied;put(p,0x8050,get(p,0x8050)+copied);
        }
    }
    return total;
}
uint32_t fs15_buffered_file_seek(void* record,size_t bytes,uint32_t offset,int origin,const FS15_FileServices* services){
    if(!record)return 0;
    if(!valid(record,bytes)||!services||!services->seek||!services->size)return UINT32_MAX;
    auto* p=static_cast<unsigned char*>(record);
    auto position=get(p,0x8050);
    if(position==UINT32_MAX)position=fs15_file_tell(record,bytes,services);
    if(origin==1)offset+=position;
    else if(origin==2)offset=fs15_file_size(record,bytes,services)-offset;
    else if(origin!=0)return UINT32_MAX;
    if(get(p,0x8050)==UINT32_MAX){fs15_file_seek(record,bytes,offset,services);}
    else{
        const auto cursor=get(p,0x8048),base=position-cursor;
        if(offset<base+get(p,0x804c)&&base<=offset){put(p,0x8050,offset);put(p,0x8048,cursor-position+offset);}
        else{put(p,0x8048,0);put(p,0x804c,0);fs15_file_seek(record,bytes,offset,services);put(p,0x8050,offset);}
    }
    return 0;
}
uint32_t fs15_buffered_file_status(const void* record,size_t bytes){
    if(!record||bytes<FS15_BUFFERED_FILE_BYTES)return UINT32_MAX;
    const auto* p=static_cast<const unsigned char*>(record);uint64_t handle;std::memcpy(&handle,p+8,8);
    return p[0x8054]||handle==UINT64_MAX?UINT32_MAX:0;
}
```

`src/core/file_stream.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "file_stream.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>

namespace {
constexpr uint32_t failed=UINT32_MAX;
bool handle(const void* record,size_t length,uint64_t& value){
    if(!record||length<0x11)return false;
    std::memcpy(&value,static_cast<const unsigned char*>(record)+8,8);
    return value!=UINT64_MAX;
}
}
uint32_t fs15_file_read(void* record,size_t length,void* output,uint32_t count,const FS15_FileServices* services){
    uint64_t token;
    if(!handle(record,length,token)||!services||!services->read||(!output&&count))return failed;
    auto* eof=static_cast<unsigned char*>(record)+0x10;
    *eof=0;
    uint32_t consumed=0;
    const auto error=services->read(services->user,token,output,count,&consumed);
    if(error==0){
        *eof=consumed!=count;
        return consumed;
    }
    if((error==0x570||error==0x571)&&services->corrupt)services->corrupt(services->user,record,error);
    return failed;
}
int fs15_file_seek(void* record,size_t length,uint32_t position,const FS15_FileServices* services){
    uint64_t token;
    if(!handle(record,length,token)||!services||!services->seek)return 0;
    // SetFilePointer takes a signed LONG when its high-word pointer is null.
    // Preserve that interpretation instead of silently adding 64-bit seeking.
    const auto distance=position<=INT32_MAX?static_cast<int32_t>(position):
        static_cast<int32_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(position)-INT64_C(0x100000000));
    const auto actual=services->seek(services->user,token,distance,0);
    if(actual==failed)return 0;
    static_cast<unsigned char*>(record)[0x10]=actual<position;
    return 1;
}
uint32_t fs15_file_size(const void* record,size_t length,const FS15_FileServices* services){
    uint64_t token;
    return handle(record,length,token)&&services&&services->size?services->size(services->user,token):failed;
}
uint32_t fs15_file_tell(const void* record,size_t length,const FS15_FileServices* services){
    uint64_t token;
    return handle(record,length,token)&&services&&services->seek?services->seek(services->user,token,0,1):failed;
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include "export.h"
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif
/* Authored OS seams for recovered 0x14004f310/410/460/4b0. Records retain the
 * native x64 handle at +8 and EOF byte at +0x10. At least 0x11 bytes required.
 * UINT64_MAX is the invalid handle. Other bytes are never changed here.
 * Callbacks return the same DWORD/count conventions as the inspected APIs.
 * No native constructor, string ownership, destructor or full VFS is implied. */
typedef struct FS15_FileServices {
    void* user;
    uint32_t (*read)(void*,uint64_t,void*,uint32_t,uint32_t*);
    uint32_t (*seek)(void*,uint64_t,int32_t,uint32_t);
    uint32_t (*size)(void*,uint64_t);
    void (*corrupt)(void*,const void*,uint32_t);
} FS15_FileServices;
/* Read callback returns zero on success or a Windows-style error code.
 * Errors 0x570/0x571 emit an explicit corruption callback; original logger/
 * global-list behavior is outside this bounded component. */
FS15_CORE_API uint32_t fs15_file_read(void*,size_t,void*,uint32_t,const FS15_FileServices*);
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_file_seek(void*,size_t,uint32_t,const FS15_FileServices*);
FS15_CORE_API uint32_t fs15_file_size(const void*,size_t,const FS15_FileServices*);
FS15_CORE_API uint32_t fs15_file_tell(const void*,size_t,const FS15_FileServices*);
#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

```cpp
    if(!driver||n<0x190||!d||!create_ok(s)||!s->allocate)return nullptr;
    const auto count=get<uint32_t>(driver,0x138);
    if(count>(0x188-0x140)/sizeof(uintptr_t))return nullptr;
    put<uint32_t>(driver,8,0);
    auto* b=static_cast<FS15GLVertexBuffer*>(s->allocate(s->user,sizeof(FS15GLVertexBuffer)));
    if(b){
        b->vtable=0x1404bd480;s->gen(s->user,1,&b->name);s->bind(s->user,vertex_target,b->name);
        b->bytes=d->bytes;b->usage=usage(d->flags);b->flags=d->flags;
        s->data(s->user,vertex_target,b->bytes,d->data,b->usage);b->mapped=0;b->staged=0;s->vertex_bytes+=b->bytes;
    }
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<count;++i)if(get<uintptr_t>(driver,0x140+i*8)==reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(b)){
        put<uint32_t>(driver,0x138,0);put<uintptr_t>(driver,0x188,0);break;

extern "C" uintptr_t fs15_gl_index_map(FS15GLIndexBuffer* b,uint32_t offset,int mode,FS15GLBufferServices* s){

extern "C" uintptr_t fs15_gl_vertex_map(FS15GLVertexBuffer* b,uint32_t offset,uint32_t length,int mode,FS15GLBufferServices* s){
    if(!b||!map_ok(s))return 0;
    const bool staged=length<=0x1000000&&!s->scratch_busy&&mode!=2;
    if(staged&&(!s->scratch||s->scratch_bytes<length))return 0;
    b->mapped=1;
    if(staged){s->scratch_busy=1;b->staged=1;b->offset=offset;b->length=length;b->discard=mode==1;return s->scratch;}
    s->bind(s->user,vertex_target,b->name);
    if(mode==1)s->data(s->user,vertex_target,b->bytes,0,b->usage);
    return s->map(s->user,vertex_target,mode==2?0x88b8:0x88b9)+offset;
}
extern "C" int fs15_gl_vertex_upload(FS15GLVertexBuffer* b,uint32_t offset,uint32_t length,uint8_t discard,FS15GLBufferServices* s){
    if(!b||!s||!s->bind||!s->data||!s->subdata||!s->scratch||s->scratch_bytes<length)return 0;

    s->bind(s->user,vertex_target,b->name);if(discard)s->data(s->user,vertex_target,b->bytes,0,b->usage);
    s->subdata(s->user,vertex_target,offset,length,source);return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_gl_vertex_unmap(FS15GLVertexBuffer* b,FS15GLBufferServices* s){
    if(!b||!s||!s->bind||!s->unmap)return 0;
    if(b->staged){
        if(!s->data||!s->subdata||!s->scratch||s->scratch_bytes<b->length)return 0;
        b->staged=0;s->scratch_busy=0;
        if(!fs15_gl_vertex_upload(b,b->offset,b->length,b->discard,s))return 0;
    }else{s->bind(s->user,vertex_target,b->name);s->unmap(s->user,vertex_target);}
    b->mapped=0;return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_gl_index_unmap(FS15GLIndexBuffer* b,FS15GLBufferServices* s){
```

```h
/* Native x64 buffer layouts. Vtable values are identities, never executed. */

    uintptr_t vtable; uint32_t name,usage,flags;

/* Authored explicit transport for GE6's process-global GL dispatch/counters.
 * Own the current context on this thread. Callbacks must not throw/reenter.
 * Scratch is borrowed storage (native reserves 16 MiB), shared by all buffers.
 * Map modes: 1 discard/write, 2 read, all others write. A vertex staged map
 * returns the start of scratch, NOT scratch+offset. Unmap exactly once.
 * Original null-map+offset behavior is retained; caller checks GL errors.

    void* user;

    void (*data)(void*,uint32_t,size_t,uintptr_t,uint32_t);

    uintptr_t (*map)(void*,uint32_t,uint32_t);

} FS15GLBufferServices;

    }
```

```cpp
    const auto size=get(p,0x14),position=get(p,0x18);
    if(size>source_capacity||position>size||count>UINT32_MAX-position)return UINT32_MAX;

}

}
```

```cpp
#include "physics_dispatch.h"
#include <cmath>
namespace {
bool valid(FS15PhysicsDispatchState* p,size_t n){return p&&n>=sizeof(*p);}
bool backend(const FS15PhysicsDispatchServices* s){return s&&s->simulate&&s->world&&s->collect;}
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_step(FS15PhysicsDispatchState* p,size_t n,float seconds,const FS15PhysicsDispatchServices* s){
    if(!valid(p,n)||!backend(s)||!std::isfinite(seconds)||!std::isfinite(p->fixed_step))return 0;
    if(!s->simulate(s->user,p->scene,seconds,p->iterations,p->fixed_step))return 0;
    const uintptr_t world=s->world(s->user,p->scene);
    return s->collect(s->user,reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(p)+0x48,world)?1:0;
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_dispatch(FS15PhysicsDispatchState* p,size_t n,float milliseconds,const FS15PhysicsDispatchServices* s){
    if(!valid(p,n)||!std::isfinite(milliseconds))return 0;
    if(p->busy||milliseconds<=0||!p->active)return 1;
    if(!s||(p->asynchronous?!s->signal:!backend(s))||!std::isfinite(p->fixed_step)||!std::isfinite(p->elapsed_ms)||!std::isfinite(p->clamped_ms))return 0;
    float limit=(static_cast<float>(p->iterations)*p->fixed_step)*1000.f;
    if(milliseconds<=limit)limit=milliseconds;
    const float elapsed=milliseconds+p->elapsed_ms,clamped=limit+p->clamped_ms,seconds=milliseconds*0.001f;
    if(!std::isfinite(elapsed)||!std::isfinite(clamped)||!std::isfinite(seconds))return 0;
    p->elapsed_ms=elapsed;p->busy=1;p->clamped_ms=clamped;
    if(p->asynchronous){p->pending_seconds=seconds;return s->signal(s->user,p->request_event)?1:0;}
    return fs15_physics_step(p,n,seconds,s);
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_worker(FS15PhysicsDispatchState* p,size_t n,const uint8_t* stop,const FS15PhysicsDispatchServices* s){
    if(!valid(p,n)||!stop||!backend(s)||!s->wait||!s->signal)return 0;
    for(;;){
        if(s->wait(s->user,p->request_event,UINT32_MAX,0)!=0)return 0;
        if(*stop)return 1;
        if(!fs15_physics_step(p,n,p->pending_seconds,s))return 0;
        p->pending_seconds=0;
        if(!s->signal(s->user,p->completion_event))return 0;
    }
}
```

```h
typedef struct FS15PhysicsDispatchState {

    uint8_t unknown40[0x68];uint8_t active,unknowna9[7];
    float fixed_step;uint32_t iterations;

/* Authored services for native scene slots +0x60, scene backend +0x60/slot
 * +0x48, observation collection 0x140144ce0, and Win32 event APIs. Scene/world
 * tokens are identities and never executed. Callbacks must not throw/reenter.
 * Wait gets native INFINITE/alertable=0; zero means success. Native ignores
 * OS errors; authored guards stop on failed transport, retaining prior writes. */
typedef struct FS15PhysicsDispatchServices {
    void* user;
    int (*simulate)(void*,uintptr_t,float,uint32_t,float);
    uintptr_t (*world)(void*,uintptr_t);
    int (*collect)(void*,void*,uintptr_t);

 * capped step, seconds conversion and either worker signal or inline step.
 * Native post-step 0x1400c7b20, which clears busy, remains unrecovered. */

 * completion signal -> wait. stop points to caller-owned byte, synchronized
 * through the request event. One outstanding request; stop changes only after
 * completion or before initial wake. No unsynchronized concurrent field writes. */
FS15_CORE_API int fs15_physics_worker(FS15PhysicsDispatchState*,size_t,const uint8_t* stop,const FS15PhysicsDispatchServices*);

}
```

```cpp
#include "physics_post.h"

namespace {
template<class T>T get(const void* p,size_t o){T value;std::memcpy(&value,static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p)+o,sizeof(value));return value;}

FS15PhysicsTreeNode* tree(void* p,size_t offset){return get<FS15PhysicsTreeNode*>(p,offset);}
template<class F>bool visit(FS15PhysicsTreeNode* head,F callback){
    if(!head||!head->left)return false;
    auto* node=head->left;uint32_t visited=0;
    while(node!=head){
        if(!node||node->nil||++visited>bound||!callback(node->value))return false;
        if(!node->right||node->right==node||node->left==node||node->parent==node)return false;
        if(!node->right->nil){node=node->right;while(node->left&&!node->left->nil){node=node->left;if(++visited>bound)return false;}if(!node->left)return false;}
        else {auto* parent=node->parent;while(parent&&!parent->nil&&node==parent->right){node=parent;parent=parent->parent;if(++visited>bound)return false;}node=parent;}
    }
    return true;
}

}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_wheel_refresh(void* record,size_t bytes,const void* set,const FS15PhysicsPostServices* s){
    if(!record||bytes<0x160||!set||!s||!s->frame)return 0;
    float origin[3],axis[3];for(size_t i=0;i<3;++i){origin[i]=get<float>(record,0xa0+i*4);axis[i]=get<float>(record,0xb0+i*4);}
    const float distance=get<float>(record,0x148),angle=get<float>(record,0x150);
    if(!finite(origin,3)||!finite(axis,3)||!std::isfinite(distance)||!std::isfinite(angle))return 0;
    put(record,0x30,get<uint32_t>(record,0x108));
    const auto contact=get<uintptr_t>(record,0x28);put(record,0x38,uint32_t(0));put(record,0x34,uint8_t(contact!=0));
    if(contact){const auto metadata=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(contact),0x110);if(metadata){const uint32_t flags=get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(metadata),0);if((flags&1)&&!(flags&0x100)){const auto owner=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(metadata),8);if(!owner)return 0;put(record,0x38,get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(owner),0x18));}}}

    uint8_t point[16],normal[16];std::memcpy(point,static_cast<uint8_t*>(record)+0x10,16);std::memcpy(normal,record,16);
    std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(record)+0x40,point,16);std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(record)+0x60,normal,16);
    float p[4];for(size_t i=0;i<3;++i)p[i]=distance*axis[i]+origin[i];p[3]=0;
    float matrix[16];const int32_t index=get<int32_t>(record,0x138);
    if(index<0||!s->frame(s->user,set,index,matrix)||!finite(matrix,16)||!finite(p,3))return 0;
    const float x=p[0]-matrix[12],y=p[1]-matrix[13],z=p[2]-matrix[14];
    for(size_t i=0;i<3;++i)p[i]=(matrix[i]*x+matrix[4+i]*y)+matrix[8+i]*z;
    if(!finite(p,3))return 0;
    put(record,0x90,get<uint32_t>(record,0x10c));std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(record)+0x80,p,16);
    put(record,0x94,get<uint32_t>(record,0x154));const float result=s->arctangent?s->arctangent(s->user,angle):std::atan(angle);
    if(!std::isfinite(result))return 0;
    put(record,0x98,result);return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_wheels(FS15PhysicsDispatchState* p,size_t bytes,const FS15PhysicsPostServices* s){
    if(!p||bytes<sizeof(*p)||!s)return 0;
    return visit(tree(p,0x250),[&](uintptr_t value){auto* set=reinterpret_cast<fs15::WheelSet*>(value);if(!set||set->count<0||static_cast<uint32_t>(set->count)>bound||(set->count&&!set->records))return false;for(int32_t i=0;i<set->count;++i)if(!fs15_physics_wheel_refresh(set->records+i,sizeof(fs15::WheelRecord),set,s))return false;return true;})?1:0;
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_contact_notify(const void* pair,uint32_t mask,uint32_t event,const uintptr_t* listeners,size_t count,const FS15PhysicsPostServices* s){
    if(!pair||!s||count>bound||(count&&(!listeners||!s->observer)))return 0;
    const auto a=get<uintptr_t>(pair,0),b=get<uintptr_t>(pair,8);if(!a||!b)return 0;
    const auto ba=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(a),0),bb=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(b),0);if(!ba||!bb)return 0;
    const auto ma=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(ba),0x110),mb=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(bb),0x110);if(!ma||!mb)return 0;
    const uint32_t fa=get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(ma),0),fb=get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(mb),0);
    if((fa&0x100)||(fb&0x100)||(event==4&&!(fa&0x40)))return 1;
    const auto first=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(ma),8),second=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(mb),8);
    if(!(fb&0x80)){const uint32_t part=(fb&8)?get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(mb),0x18):UINT32_MAX;for(size_t i=0;i<count;++i)if(s->observer(s->user,listeners[i],first,second,second,event,part))break;}
    else {const auto parts=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(mb),0x10);for(size_t bit=0;mask;++bit,mask>>=1){if(!(mask&1))continue;if(bit>=s->part_limit||bit>=32||!parts)return 0;const auto target=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(parts),bit*16);for(size_t i=0;i<count;++i)if(s->observer(s->user,listeners[i],first,second,target,event,UINT32_MAX))break;}}
    return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_contacts_finish(FS15PhysicsContacts* c,size_t bytes,const uintptr_t* listeners,size_t count,const FS15PhysicsPostServices* s){
    if(!c||bytes<sizeof(*c)||!s||c->count>bound||c->previous_count>bound||c->count>c->capacity||c->previous_count>c->previous_capacity||(c->count&&(!c->current||!c->buckets||!c->capacity||(c->capacity&(c->capacity-1))))||(c->previous_count&&!c->previous))return 0;
    uint32_t i=0;
    while(i<c->previous_count){auto& old=c->previous[i];if(!old.first||!old.second)return 0;const uint32_t a=identity(old.first),b=identity(old.second);uint32_t h=(b<<16)|a;h+=~(h<<15);h=(h^(h>>10))*9;h^=h>>6;h+=~(h<<11);h^=h>>16;
        int32_t index=c->capacity&&c->buckets?c->buckets[h&(c->capacity-1)]:-1;FS15PhysicsPair* found=nullptr;uint32_t steps=0;
        while(index!=-1){if(index<0||static_cast<uint32_t>(index)>=c->count||++steps>c->count)return 0;auto& row=c->current[index];if(!row.first||!row.second)return 0;if(identity(row.first)==a&&identity(row.second)==b){if(row.mask)found=&row;break;}index=row.next;}
        if(found){const uint32_t now=found->mask,previous=old.mask;
            if((~previous&now)&&!fs15_physics_contact_notify(&old,~previous&now,1,listeners,count,s))return 0;
            if((~now&previous)&&!fs15_physics_contact_notify(&old,~now&previous,2,listeners,count,s))return 0;
            if((now&previous)&&!fs15_physics_contact_notify(&old,now&previous,4,listeners,count,s))return 0;
            old.mask=now;found->mask=0;++i;
        }else {if(!fs15_physics_contact_notify(&old,old.mask,2,listeners,count,s))return 0;--c->previous_count;if(i<c->previous_count)c->previous[i]=c->previous[c->previous_count];}
    }
    const uint32_t current_count=c->count;
    if(c->previous_capacity<current_count){if(!s->allocate||!s->release)return 0;auto* replacement=static_cast<FS15PhysicsPreviousPair*>(s->allocate(s->user,size_t(c->capacity)*sizeof(FS15PhysicsPreviousPair),16));if(!replacement)return 0;if(c->previous_count)std::memcpy(replacement,c->previous,size_t(c->previous_count)*sizeof(*replacement));if(c->previous)s->release(s->user,c->previous);c->previous=replacement;c->previous_capacity=c->capacity;}
    for(uint32_t n=0;n<current_count;++n){auto& row=c->current[n];if(!row.mask)continue;if(c->previous_count>=c->previous_capacity||!c->previous)return 0;if(!fs15_physics_contact_notify(&row,row.mask,1,listeners,count,s))return 0;std::memcpy(c->previous+c->previous_count,&row,sizeof(FS15PhysicsPreviousPair));++c->previous_count;row.mask=0;}
    return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_contacts_collect(FS15PhysicsContacts* c,size_t bytes,uintptr_t world,const FS15PhysicsPostServices* s){
    if(!c||bytes<sizeof(*c)||!s||!s->lookup||!s->groups||c->count>bound||(c->count&&!c->current))return 0;
    for(uint32_t i=0;i<c->count;++i){auto& row=c->current[i];row.mask=0;
        const auto found=s->lookup(s->user,world,row.first,row.second);if(!found)continue;
        const auto interface_token=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(found),0x10);if(!interface_token)continue;
        auto* vector=reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(c)+0x40;if(!s->groups(s->user,interface_token,vector))return 0;
        const int32_t count=get<int32_t>(vector,4);if(count<0||static_cast<uint32_t>(count)>bound)return 0;if(!count)continue;
        const auto groups=get<uintptr_t*>(vector,0x10);if(!groups||!row.second)return 0;
        const auto body=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(row.second),0);if(!body)return 0;
        const auto metadata=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(body),0x110);if(!metadata)return 0;
        if(!(get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(metadata),0)&0x80)){
            for(int32_t j=0;j<count;++j){if(!groups[j])return 0;if(get<int32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(groups[j]),0x320)>0){row.mask=1;break;}}
        }else {
            for(int32_t j=0;j<count;++j){const auto group=groups[j];if(!group)return 0;const uint32_t rows=get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(group),0x320);if(rows>s->contact_row_limit)return 0;
                const size_t selector=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(group),0x310)==body?0x78:0x7c;
                for(uint32_t k=0;k<rows;++k){const uint8_t bit=get<uint8_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(group),selector+size_t(k)*0xc0);row.mask|=uint32_t(1)<<(bit&31);}
            }
        }
        put(vector,4,uint32_t(0));
    }
    return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_post_step(FS15PhysicsDispatchState* p,size_t bytes,const FS15PhysicsPostServices* s){
    if(!p||bytes<sizeof(*p)||!s)return 0;
    if(!p->busy)return 1;
    if(!p->asynchronous)p->busy=0;else if(!s->wait||s->wait(s->user,p->completion_event,UINT32_MAX,0)!=0)return 0;
    if(!visit(tree(p,0x3a8),[&](uintptr_t value){return s->object&&s->object(s->user,value);})||!fs15_physics_wheels(p,bytes,s))return 0;
    auto* raw=reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(p);auto* contacts=reinterpret_cast<FS15PhysicsContacts*>(raw+0x48);
    const auto begin=get<uintptr_t>(p,0x198),end=get<uintptr_t>(p,0x1a0);if(end<begin||(end-begin)%sizeof(uintptr_t))return 0;
    if(!fs15_physics_contacts_finish(contacts,sizeof(*contacts),reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(begin),(end-begin)/sizeof(uintptr_t),s))return 0;
    uint32_t i=0,operations=0;
    for(;;){
        uint32_t count=get<uint32_t>(p,0x328);auto** pending=get<uint8_t**>(p,0x320);
        if(count>bound||(count&&!pending)||++operations>bound)return 0;
        if(i>=count)break;
        auto* item=pending[i];if(!item)return 0;
        if(item[0x1c]){++i;continue;}
        --count;put(p,0x328,count);if(i<count)pending[i]=pending[count];
        const auto owner=get<uintptr_t>(item,0x10);if(!owner)return 0;
        const auto callback=get<uintptr_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(owner),0x10);if(!callback)continue;
        if(!s->pending)return 0;
        uint8_t cancel=0;
        if(!s->pending(s->user,callback,get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(owner),4),get<float>(item,0x18),&cancel))return 0;
        // Native cancellation can remove other pending entries or replace the
        // array. Reload count/storage at the next iteration, and owner ID after
        // the callback, rather than retaining stale queue or identifier state.
        if(cancel&&(!s->cancel||!s->cancel(s->user,p,get<uint32_t>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(owner),4))))return 0;
    }
    p->busy=0;return 1;
}
```

```cpp
#include "physics_vehicle_sort.h"
#include <utility>
namespace {
void partition(uintptr_t* data,int first,int last,int (*key)(void*,uintptr_t),void* user){
    do{
        int left=first,right=last;const uintptr_t pivot=data[(first+last)/2];
        do{
            int pk=key(user,pivot);int current=key(user,data[left]);
            while(current<pk){++left;pk=key(user,pivot);current=key(user,data[left]);}
            current=key(user,data[right]);pk=key(user,pivot);
            while(pk<current){--right;current=key(user,data[right]);pk=key(user,pivot);}
            if(right<left)break;
            std::swap(data[left],data[right]);++left;--right;
        }while(left<=right);
        if(first<right)partition(data,first,right,key,user);
        if(last<=left)return;
        first=left;
    }while(true);
}
}
extern "C" int fs15_physics_vehicle_sort(uintptr_t* data,size_t count,int (*key)(void*,uintptr_t),void* user){
    if(count>1000000||(!data&&count)||(!key&&count>1))return 0;
    if(count>1)partition(data,0,static_cast<int>(count)-1,key,user);
    return 1;
}
```

`src/core/rle16.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>

// Reconstructed from the native GE6 leaf 0x14028f770. Unlike the unchecked
// original, input/value/output limits are enforced before any write.
inline std::size_t decode_rle16(const std::uint16_t* input,std::size_t words,unsigned stride,unsigned bits,std::uint8_t* output,std::size_t bytes){
    constexpr auto failure=std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
    if((!input&&words)||!output||!bits||bits>16||stride<bits||stride>32||bytes>failure/8) {
        return failure;
    }
    std::size_t count=0,cursor=0;
    std::uint16_t previous=0;
    bool have_previous=false;
    const unsigned mask=(1u<<bits)-1;
    auto write=[&](std::uint16_t value){
        if(value>mask||count>failure/stride) { return false; }
        const auto start=count*stride;
        if(start>failure-bits||(start+bits-1)/8>=bytes) { return false; }
        if(stride==16&&bits==16) {
            output[count*2]=std::uint8_t(value);
            output[count*2+1]=std::uint8_t(value>>8);
        } else {
            for(unsigned b=0;b<bits;++b) {
                const auto bit=start+b;
                const auto mask_bit=std::uint8_t(1u<<(bit&7));
                auto& target=output[bit>>3];
                target=std::uint8_t((target&~mask_bit)|(((value>>b)&1u)?mask_bit:0));
            }
        }
        ++count;
        return true;
    };
    while(cursor<words) {
        const auto value=input[cursor++];
        if(!write(value)) { return failure; }
        if(have_previous&&value==previous) {
            if(cursor<words) {
                std::size_t repeats=0;
                std::uint16_t extension;
                do {
                    extension=input[cursor++];
                    if(repeats>failure-extension) { return failure; }
                    repeats+=extension;
                } while(extension==65535&&cursor<words);
                if(repeats>(bytes*8)/stride-count) { return failure; }
                for(std::size_t i=0;i<repeats;++i) {
                    if(!write(value)) { return failure; }
                }
                have_previous=false;
            }
        } else {
            have_previous=true;
        }
        previous=value;
    }
    return count;
}
```

`src/core/rle8.cpp`:

```cpp
// Reconstructed from x64 FS15 1.4.2.0, function 0x14028f430.
// See recovered/decompiled/game-focus/ and analysis/rle8-reference.*.
// Domain: 1..8 value bits, stride >= value bits, bounded caller-owned output.
// Unlike the original unchecked routine, invalid input/capacity returns SIZE_MAX.
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include "api.h"

static constexpr auto failure = (std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max)();

extern "C" FS15_CORE_API std::size_t fs15_decode_rle8(
    const std::uint8_t* input, std::size_t input_size,
    unsigned stride_bits, unsigned value_bits,
    std::uint8_t* output, std::size_t output_bytes) noexcept {
    if ((!input && input_size) || !output || !value_bits || value_bits > 8 ||
        stride_bits < value_bits || stride_bits > 32) return failure;
    std::size_t count = 0, cursor = 0;
    std::uint8_t previous = 0;
    bool have_previous_literal = false;
    const unsigned mask = (1u << value_bits) - 1;
    auto write = [&](std::uint8_t value) -> bool {
        if (value > mask || count > failure / stride_bits) return false;
        const auto bit_offset = count * stride_bits;
        if (bit_offset > failure - value_bits ||
            (bit_offset + value_bits - 1) / 8 >= output_bytes) return false;
        for (unsigned bit = 0; bit < value_bits; ++bit) {
            const auto position = bit_offset + bit;
            const auto bit_mask = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(1u << (position & 7));
            auto& byte = output[position >> 3];
            byte = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((byte & ~bit_mask) | (((value >> bit) & 1u) ? bit_mask : 0));
        }
        ++count;
        return true;
    };
    while (cursor < input_size) {
        const auto value = input[cursor++];
        if (!write(value)) return failure;
        if (have_previous_literal && previous == value) {
            if (cursor < input_size) {
                std::size_t repeats = 0;
                std::uint8_t extension;
                do {
                    extension = input[cursor++];
                    if (repeats > failure - extension) return failure;
                    repeats += extension;
                } while (extension == 255 && cursor < input_size);
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < repeats; ++i) {
                    if (!write(value)) return failure;
                }
                have_previous_literal = false;
            }
        } else {
            have_previous_literal = true;
        }
        previous = value;
    }
    return count;
}
```

```cpp
        free_nodes(map.head->parent,map.head,*s);
        map.head->parent=map.head->left=map.head->right=map.head;map.record.attribute_count=0;
        if(release_header)s->deallocate(s->user,map.head);
        return 1;
    }catch(...){return 0;}
}
extern "C" FS15_CORE_API int fs15_scene_attribute_frame(void* object,size_t bytes,unsigned operation,
    const FS15SceneAttributeStrings* strings,void* frame,size_t frame_bytes,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices* s) {
    if(operation>1)return 0;
    if(operation==1&&!object)return 1;
    if(!frame||frame_bytes<(operation?0x2a:0xfa))return 0;
    if(!object){write<uint16_t>(frame,0xf8,0);return 1;}
    if(!strings||read<uintptr_t>(frame,0)!=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(strings->key))return 0;
    try {
        Map map(object,bytes);const size_t key_length=length(strings->key,strings->key_bytes);
        if(!operation) {
            Node* found=map.find(strings->key,key_length);Value* value=found?found->value:nullptr;
            uint16_t tag=0;size_t size=0;
            if(value) {
                if(value->kind==0){tag=2;size=1;}else if(value->kind==1){tag=1;size=4;}
                else if(value->kind==2){tag=3;size=4;}else if(value->kind==3||value->kind==4){tag=4;size=8;}
            }
            if(size)std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(frame)+0xf0,&value->bits,size);
            write(frame,0xf8,tag);return 1;
        }
        if(!allocator(s)||read<uintptr_t>(frame,0x10)!=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(strings->type))return 0;
        const size_t type_length=length(strings->type,strings->type_bytes);
        uint32_t kind=99;
        const char* names[]={"Boolean","Integer","Float","String"};
        for(uint32_t i=0;i<4;++i)if(type_length==std::strlen(names[i])&&!std::memcmp(strings->type,names[i],type_length)){kind=i;break;}
        if(kind==99)return 1;
        size_t string_length=0;
        if(kind==3) {
            if(read<uintptr_t>(frame,0x20)!=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(strings->value))return 0;
            string_length=length(strings->value,strings->value_bytes);
            if(Node* previous=map.find(strings->key,key_length))if(previous->value&&(previous->value->kind==3||previous->value->kind==4)) {
                const auto old=static_cast<uintptr_t>(previous->value->bits),input=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(strings->value);
                if(old&&input>=old&&input-old<=std::strlen(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(old)))return 0;
            }
        }
        map.ordered();Value* value=ensure(map,strings->key,key_length,kind,*s);if(!value)return 0;
        if(kind==3) {
            if(value->kind==3||value->kind==4)s->deallocate(s->user,reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(value->bits)));
            auto* copied=s->allocate(s->user,string_length+1);
            if(!copied){value->bits=0;value->kind=3;return 0;}
            std::memcpy(copied,strings->value,string_length+1);value->bits=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(copied);
        }else if(kind==0)std::memcpy(&value->bits,static_cast<uint8_t*>(frame)+0x20,1);
        else if(kind==1&&read<uint16_t>(frame,0x28)!=1) {
            const float input=read<float>(frame,0x20);
            const int32_t result=std::isfinite(input)&&input>=-2147483648.0f&&input<2147483648.0f?static_cast<int32_t>(input):std::numeric_limits<int32_t>::min();
            std::memcpy(&value->bits,&result,4);
        }else std::memcpy(&value->bits,static_cast<uint8_t*>(frame)+0x20,4);
        value->kind=kind;return 1;
    }catch(...){return 0;}
}
extern "C" int fs15_scene_attribute_value_clone(const Value* source,size_t bytes,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices* s,Value** out) {
    if(!source||bytes<sizeof(*source)||!allocator(s)||!out||((source->kind==3||source->kind==4)&&!source->bits))return 0;
    auto* result=static_cast<Value*>(s->allocate(s->user,sizeof(Value)));if(!result)return 0;
    result->bits=0;result->kind=source->kind;
    if(source->kind==0)std::memcpy(&result->bits,&source->bits,1);
    else if(source->kind==1||source->kind==2)std::memcpy(&result->bits,&source->bits,4);
    else if(source->kind==3||source->kind==4) {
        const auto* text=reinterpret_cast<const char*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(source->bits));const size_t length=std::strlen(text);
        auto* copied=s->allocate(s->user,length+1);if(!copied){s->deallocate(s->user,result);return 0;}
        std::memcpy(copied,text,length+1);result->bits=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(copied);
    }
    *out=result;return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_scene_attributes_copy(void* target,size_t target_bytes,const void* source,size_t source_bytes,const FS15SceneLifecycleServices* s) {
    if(!allocator(s))return 0;
    try {
        Map destination(target,target_bytes),origin(const_cast<void*>(source),source_bytes);
        destination.ordered();auto source_nodes=origin.ordered();
        if(target!=source&&destination.head==origin.head)return 0;
        for(const auto* n:source_nodes)if(!n->value||((n->value->kind==3||n->value->kind==4)&&!n->value->bits))return 0;
        if(!fs15_scene_attributes_clear(target,target_bytes,0,s))return 0;
        if(target==source)return 1;
        for(const auto* n:source_nodes) {
            Value* cloned=nullptr;if(!fs15_scene_attribute_value_clone(n->value,sizeof(Value),s,&cloned))return 0;
            if(!insert_value(destination,key(n),n->key_length,cloned,*s)) {
                if(cloned->kind==3||cloned->kind==4)s->deallocate(s->user,reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(cloned->bits)));
                s->deallocate(s->user,cloned);return 0;
            }
        }
        return 1;
    }catch(...){return 0;}
}
```

```h
/* Valid owned native-layout trees only; member pointers are trusted, not
 * arbitrary untrusted input. Strings are bounded NUL-terminated byte strings.
 * Platform allocation is supplied through lifecycle services. Lookup/ensure
 * preserve case-sensitive unsigned-byte ordering and original value storage.
 * Existing ensure entries retain their type even when a new kind is requested.
 * New keys preserve the observed inline-15/heap capacity and RB tree layout. */

 * match the bounded strings where applicable. Getter writes only +0xf0 and tag
 * +0xf8. Setter type names are exactly Boolean/Integer/Float/String. Integer
 * conversion reproduces CVTTSS2SI (INT_MIN for NaN/out-of-range). Null-node
 * setter is a no-op; null/missing getter clears only its result tag.
 * Native ownership quirks are retained: String->scalar overwrites without
 * freeing its former text, and map cleanup frees text only for kind 3, not 4.
 * The owning allocator/context must track such orphaned allocations separately.
 * Self-aliasing string replacement is rejected before freeing its source. */

 * Distinct owners must not share map/member allocations. */
```

```cpp
extern "C" int fs15_scene_normalize3(float* vector,size_t count) {
    if(count<3||!finite(vector,3))return 0;
    const float sum=(vector[0]*vector[0]+vector[1]*vector[1])+vector[2]*vector[2];if(!std::isfinite(sum))return 0;
    const float inv=fs15_scene_math_detail::inverse_length(sum);
    float out[3];for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i)out[i]=vector[i]*inv;
    if(!finite(out,3))return 0;
    std::memcpy(vector,out,12);return 1;
}
extern "C" int fs15_scene_camera_pose(FS15SceneCameraRecord* n,const float* matrix,size_t count,const FS15SceneCameraServices* s) {
    if(!camera(n)||count<16||!finite(matrix,16)||!services(s))return 0;
    float relative[16];std::memcpy(relative,matrix,64);float rotation[3];
    if(n->node.parent) {
        float inverse[16],parent[16],local[16];identity(inverse);identity(local);
        if(!s->world(s->user,reinterpret_cast<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(n->node.parent),parent)||!finite(parent,16))return 0;
        fs15_affine_inverse(parent,16,inverse,16); // Native ignores singular failure.
        if(!fs15_affine_multiply(inverse,16,relative,16,local,16))return 0;
        std::memcpy(relative,local,64);
    }
    if(!fs15_matrix_euler(relative,16,nullptr,rotation,3))return 0;
    if((n->node.flags&0x80u)&&!s->refresh(s->user,&n->node))return 0;
    std::memcpy(n->node.rotation,rotation,12);if(!s->rebuild(s->user,&n->node))return 0;
    if((n->node.flags&0x80u)&&!s->refresh(s->user,&n->node))return 0;
    std::memcpy(n->node.translation,relative+12,12);return s->rebuild(s->user,&n->node)!=0;
}
extern "C" int fs15_scene_camera_follow(FS15SceneCameraRecord* n,const float* target,size_t count,float distance,const FS15SceneCameraServices* s) {
    if(!camera(n)||count<3||!finite(target,3)||!std::isfinite(distance)||!services(s))return 0;
    float world[16],axis[3];if(!s->world(s->user,&n->node,world)||!finite(world,16))return 0;
    std::memcpy(axis,world+8,12);if(!fs15_scene_normalize3(axis,3))return 0;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i)world[12+i]=axis[i]*distance+target[i];
    return fs15_scene_camera_pose(n,world,16,s);
}
extern "C" int fs15_scene_camera_smooth(FS15SceneCameraRecord* n,const float* target,size_t count,float distance,float alpha,float factor,const FS15SceneCameraServices* s) {
    const float parameters[]={distance,alpha,factor};if(!camera(n)||count<3||!finite(target,3)||!finite(parameters,3)||!services(s))return 0;
    float world[16],point[3],delta[3];if(!s->world(s->user,&n->node,world)||!finite(world,16))return 0;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i){point[i]=((world[4+i]*0.0f+world[i]*0.0f)+world[8+i]*0.0f)+world[12+i];delta[i]=point[i]-target[i];}
    const float squared=(delta[1]*delta[1]+delta[0]*delta[0])+delta[2]*delta[2];if(!std::isfinite(squared))return 0;
    // Constants verified against the pinned native image by the differential suite.
    if(squared>0.001f){const float reciprocal=1.0f/squared;alpha=((squared*factor+reciprocal*0.00065f)*reciprocal)*alpha;for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i)point[i]=point[i]-delta[i]*alpha;}
    return fs15_scene_camera_follow(n,point,3,distance,s);
}
extern "C" int fs15_scene_camera_script_follow(FS15SceneCameraRecord* n,const void* frame,size_t bytes,const FS15SceneCameraServices* s) {
    if(!n)return 1;
    if(!frame||bytes<0x54)return 0;

    return fs15_scene_camera_smooth(n,target,3,scalar(p+0x30),scalar(p+0x40),scalar(p+0x50),s);
}
```

```cpp
    target->flags=(target->flags&~uint32_t(0x20))|(source->flags&0x20u);
    void* copied=nullptr;
    if(!fs15_scene_property_clone_owned(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(source->properties),target,s->scene.memory,&copied))return 0;
    if(!fs15_scene_property_replace(target,sizeof(*target),static_cast<FS15ScenePropertyView*>(copied),s->scene.memory)) {

        else fs15_scene_property_destruct_detached(copied,1,s->scene.memory);
        return 0;
    }
    for(unsigned i=0;i<2;++i)if(target->local_clip[i]!=source->local_clip[i]){target->local_clip[i]=source->local_clip[i];if(!s->scene.propagate(s->scene.user,target,8,0))return 0;}
    for(unsigned i=0;i<2;++i)if(target->local_masks[i]!=source->local_masks[i]){target->local_masks[i]=source->local_masks[i];if(!s->scene.propagate(s->scene.user,target,0x10u<<i,0))return 0;}
    if((target->flags&1u)!=(source->flags&1u)){target->flags=(target->flags&~uint32_t(1))|(source->flags&1u);if(!s->scene.propagate(s->scene.user,target,2,0))return 0;}
    target->flags=(target->flags&~uint32_t(4))|(source->flags&4u);
    return fs15_scene_attributes_copy(target,sizeof(*target),source,sizeof(*source),s->scene.memory);
}
extern "C" int fs15_scene_clone_node(FS15SceneStateRecord* source,const FS15SceneCloneServices* s,FS15SceneGroupResult* result) {
    if(!known(source)||!s||!result||!memory(s->scene.memory)||!s->constructed)return 0;
    *result={nullptr,0,0};const unsigned kind=source->vtable==0x1404c1d98?3u:source->vtable==0x1404c1c48?2u:1u;
    const size_t bytes=kind==3?sizeof(FS15SceneLightRecord):source->vtable==0x1404c1078?sizeof(FS15SceneCameraRecord):kind==2?sizeof(FS15SceneLodRecord):sizeof(FS15SceneStateRecord);
    const char* name=source->name?reinterpret_cast<const char*>(source->name):"";const size_t name_bytes=std::strlen(name)+1;
    const auto* m=s->scene.memory;auto* target=static_cast<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(m->allocate(m->user,bytes));if(!target)return 0;
    int ok=0;
    if(kind==3) {
        const auto& light=*reinterpret_cast<const FS15SceneLightRecord*>(source);FS15SceneLightParameters p{};

        ok=fs15_scene_light_construct(reinterpret_cast<FS15SceneLightRecord*>(target),bytes,name,name_bytes,&p,nullptr,m);
        if(ok)reinterpret_cast<FS15SceneLightRecord*>(target)->light_flags=light.light_flags;
    }else if(source->vtable==0x1404c1078) {
        const auto* camera=reinterpret_cast<const FS15SceneCameraRecord*>(source);
        ok=fs15_scene_camera_construct(reinterpret_cast<FS15SceneCameraRecord*>(target),bytes,name,name_bytes,camera->fov,camera->near_clip,camera->far_clip,camera->orthographic,camera->orthographic_height,m);
    }else if(kind==2) {
        const auto* lod=reinterpret_cast<const FS15SceneLodRecord*>(source);uint32_t count=1;float previous=0;
        for(;count<4;++count){const float distance=lod->distances[count];if(previous==distance)break;previous=distance;}
        if(count==4)count=3;
        ok=fs15_scene_lod_construct(reinterpret_cast<FS15SceneLodRecord*>(target),bytes,name,name_bytes,lod->distances,count,m);
    }else ok=fs15_scene_construct(target,bytes,FS15_OBJECT_TRS,name,name_bytes,0,1,m);
    if(!ok){m->deallocate(m->user,target);return 0;}
    *result={target,bytes,kind};
    if(!s->constructed(s->scene.user,target,kind,bytes))return 0;
    return fs15_scene_trs_copy(target,source,s);
}
```
