```cpp
    static int set_rotation(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);auto r=s.node(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1)));if(r.scene==&s.terrain)throw std::runtime_error("Map transforms are read-only");for(int k=0;k<3;++k)r.scene->nodes[r.index].rotation[k]=float(luaL_checknumber(l,k+2));return 0;}
    static int transform(lua_State* l){
        auto& s=self(l);auto r=s.node(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1)));const auto* w=r.scene->nodes[r.index].world;
        // Authored layout adapter for affine DirectX row-vector world matrices.
        std::uint8_t object[0xa0]{};float rows[16]={w[0],w[4],w[8],0,w[1],w[5],w[9],0,w[2],w[6],w[10],0,w[12],w[13],w[14],0};
        if(lua_toboolean(l,lua_upvalueindex(2)))rows[12]=rows[13]=rows[14]=0;
        std::memcpy(object+0x60,rows,sizeof(rows));float point[4]={float(luaL_optnumber(l,2,0)),float(luaL_optnumber(l,3,0)),float(luaL_optnumber(l,4,0)),0};
        if(!fs15_transform_point(object,sizeof(object),point,point,4))throw std::runtime_error("Recovered point transform rejected its input");
        for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i)lua_pushnumber(l,point[i]);return 3;
    }
    static int scene_transform(lua_State* l,unsigned operation){
        auto& s=self(l);auto r=s.node(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1)));
        // Authored bridge: the existing host world matrix has the same affine
        // lane order as GE6. A cached synthetic node avoids claiming that the
        // host's object ownership/hierarchy is the original scene lifecycle.
        unsigned char node_bytes[0x118]{},frame[0x120]{};
        std::memcpy(node_bytes+0xd8,r.scene->nodes[r.index].world,64);
        for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i){const float value=float(luaL_checknumber(l,i+2));std::memcpy(frame+i*16,&value,4);}
        if(!fs15_scene_transform_frame(operation,node_bytes,sizeof(node_bytes),sizeof(node_bytes),0,frame,sizeof(frame)))throw std::runtime_error("Recovered scene transform rejected a nonfinite or singular input");
        for(unsigned i=0;i<3;++i){float value=0;std::memcpy(&value,frame+0xf0+i*16,4);lua_pushnumber(l,value);}return 3;
    }
    static int local_to_world(lua_State* l){return scene_transform(l,FS15_LOCAL_TO_WORLD);}
    static int direction(lua_State* l){return scene_transform(l,FS15_LOCAL_DIRECTION_TO_WORLD);}
    static int world_to_local(lua_State* l){return scene_transform(l,FS15_WORLD_TO_LOCAL);}
    static int world_direction_to_local(lua_State* l){return scene_transform(l,FS15_WORLD_DIRECTION_TO_LOCAL);}
    static int attribute(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);auto r=s.node(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1)));const auto& node=r.scene->nodes[r.index];const std::string key=luaL_checkstring(l,2);auto at=node.attributes.find(key);if(at==node.attributes.end()){lua_pushnil(l);return 1;}
        auto type=node.attribute_types.find(key);const std::string kind=type==node.attribute_types.end()?"string":type->second;
        if(kind=="boolean"){if(at->second!="true"&&at->second!="false")throw std::runtime_error("Invalid original boolean user attribute");lua_pushboolean(l,at->second=="true");}
        else if(kind=="float"||kind=="integer"){size_t end=0;double value=std::stod(at->second,&end);if(end!=at->second.size()||!std::isfinite(value)||(kind=="integer"&&std::floor(value)!=value))throw std::runtime_error("Invalid original numeric user attribute");lua_pushnumber(l,value);}
        else lua_pushstring(l,at->second.c_str());return 1;
    }
    static int height(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);lua_pushnumber(l,fs15world::terrain_height(s.terrain,float(luaL_checknumber(l,1)),float(luaL_checknumber(l,2))));return 1;}
    static int pose(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);int i=int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1))-1;if(i<0||size_t(i)>=s.bodies.size())throw std::runtime_error("Invalid vehicle index");auto& b=s.bodies[i];b.position={float(luaL_checknumber(l,2)),float(luaL_checknumber(l,3)),float(luaL_checknumber(l,4))};b.yaw=float(luaL_checknumber(l,6));
        const float rotation[]={float(luaL_checknumber(l,5)),b.yaw,float(luaL_checknumber(l,7))},scale[]={1,1,1},translation[]={b.position.x,b.position.y,b.position.z};
        fs15world::Matrix m;if(!fs15_compose_trs(rotation,scale,translation,m.value,16))throw std::runtime_error("Recovered vehicle pose composition failed");fs15world::update_transforms(b.scene,m);return 0;}
    static int find_callbacks(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);std::string callback=luaL_checkstring(l,1);lua_newtable(l);int count=0;for(size_t i=0;i<s.terrain.nodes.size();++i){auto at=s.terrain.nodes[i].attributes.find("onCreate");if(at!=s.terrain.nodes[i].attributes.end()&&at->second==callback){lua_pushinteger(l,s.map_handle(int(i)));lua_rawseti(l,-2,++count);}}return 1;}
    static BoundingBox box(const Ref& r){const auto& node=r.scene->nodes[r.index];if(node.mesh<0)throw std::runtime_error("Trigger needs an original mesh");const auto& vertices=r.scene->meshes[node.mesh].vertices;BoundingBox local,world;BoundingBox::CreateFromPoints(local,vertices.size(),reinterpret_cast<const XMFLOAT3*>(vertices.data()),sizeof(fs15world::Vertex));XMFLOAT4X4 w;std::copy(node.world,node.world+16,&w._11);local.Transform(world,XMLoadFloat4x4(&w));return world;}
    static int overlap(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);auto a=s.node(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1))),b=s.node(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,2)));lua_pushboolean(l,box(a).Intersects(box(b)));return 1;}
    static int bounds(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);auto b=box(s.node(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1))));for(float v:{b.Center.x,b.Center.y,b.Center.z,b.Extents.x,b.Extents.y,b.Extents.z})lua_pushnumber(l,v);return 6;}
    static int raycast(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);XMFLOAT3 origin{float(luaL_checknumber(l,1)),float(luaL_checknumber(l,2)),float(luaL_checknumber(l,3))},direction{float(luaL_checknumber(l,4)),float(luaL_checknumber(l,5)),float(luaL_checknumber(l,6))};const std::string callback=luaL_checkstring(l,7);float limit=float(luaL_checknumber(l,8));auto ray=XMVector3Normalize(XMLoadFloat3(&direction));
        std::vector<std::pair<float,int>> hits;lua_getglobal(l,"g_currentMission");lua_getfield(l,-1,"nodeToVehicle");
        for(const auto& body:s.bodies)for(size_t i=0;i<body.handles.size();++i){lua_rawgeti(l,-1,body.handles[i]);bool registered=!lua_isnil(l,-1);lua_pop(l,1);if(!registered||body.scene.nodes[i].mesh<0)continue;float distance=0;if(box(s.node(body.handles[i])).Intersects(XMLoadFloat3(&origin),ray,distance)&&distance<=limit)hits.emplace_back(distance,body.handles[i]);}
        lua_pop(l,2);std::sort(hits.begin(),hits.end());
        for(const auto& hit:hits){XMFLOAT3 p;XMStoreFloat3(&p,XMLoadFloat3(&origin)+ray*hit.first);lua_getfield(l,9,callback.c_str());lua_pushvalue(l,9);lua_pushinteger(l,hit.second);lua_pushnumber(l,p.x);lua_pushnumber(l,p.y);lua_pushnumber(l,p.z);lua_pushnumber(l,hit.first);s.call("vehicle raycast callback",6,1);bool keep=lua_toboolean(l,-1)!=0;lua_pop(l,1);if(!keep)break;}return 0;
    }
    static int select(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);s.controlled=int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1));return 0;}
    static int move(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);float x=float(luaL_checknumber(l,1)),z=float(luaL_checknumber(l,2)),tx=float(luaL_checknumber(l,3)),tz=float(luaL_checknumber(l,4)),radius=float(luaL_optnumber(l,5,0.85));float distance=std::hypot(tx-x,tz-z);if(!std::isfinite(distance)||distance>100)throw std::runtime_error("Vehicle move exceeds collision service limit");unsigned steps=std::max(1u,unsigned(std::ceil(distance/0.25f)));bool blocked=false;float dx=(tx-x)/steps,dz=(tz-z)/steps;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<steps;++i){float nx=x+dx,nz=z+dz;float ground=fs15world::terrain_height(s.terrain,nx,nz);if(s.collision->blocked(nx,nz,ground,radius)){blocked=true;break;}x=nx;z=nz;}
        lua_pushnumber(l,x);lua_pushnumber(l,z);lua_pushboolean(l,blocked);return 3;
    }
    static int crop_info(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);float x=float(luaL_checknumber(l,1)),z=float(luaL_checknumber(l,2));int px=int((x/s.terrain.width+0.5f)*s.fruit.width),pz=int((z/s.terrain.depth+0.5f)*s.fruit.height);unsigned value=0;if(px>=0&&pz>=0&&px<int(s.fruit.width)&&pz<int(s.fruit.height))value=s.fruit.values[size_t(pz)*s.fruit.width+px];for(const auto& layer:s.terrain.foliage)if(layer.offset==4&&layer.type==(value&15)){lua_pushstring(l,layer.name.c_str());lua_pushinteger(l,(value>>4)&15);return 2;}lua_pushnil(l);lua_pushinteger(l,0);return 2;}
    static int crop_layers(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);lua_newtable(l);int n=0;for(const auto& layer:s.terrain.foliage)if(layer.offset==4){lua_newtable(l);lua_pushstring(l,layer.name.c_str());lua_setfield(l,-2,"name");lua_pushinteger(l,100+layer.type);lua_setfield(l,-2,"id");lua_rawseti(l,-2,++n);}return 1;}
    DensityView& density(int id){auto at=density_views.find(id);if(at==density_views.end())throw std::runtime_error("Unknown density layer");return at->second;}
    static bool matches(const Filter& f,int v){if(f.exclude&&(v&f.exclude))return false;if(f.include)v&=f.include;if(f.op=="between")return v>=f.minimum&&v<=f.maximum;if(f.op=="equals")return v==f.minimum;if(f.op=="greater")return v>f.minimum;if(f.op=="less")return v<f.minimum;throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported density comparison");}
    static int density_compare(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);auto& v=s.density(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1)));v.compare={luaL_checkstring(l,2),int(luaL_checkinteger(l,3)),int(luaL_optinteger(l,4,0)),int(luaL_optinteger(l,5,0)),int(luaL_optinteger(l,6,0))};return 0;}
    static int density_mask(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);auto& v=s.density(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1)));v.mask={luaL_checkstring(l,2),int(luaL_checkinteger(l,3)),int(luaL_optinteger(l,4,0)),int(luaL_optinteger(l,5,0)),int(luaL_optinteger(l,6,0))};return 0;}
    static int density_shift(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);s.density(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1))).shift=int(luaL_checkinteger(l,2));return 0;}
    static int type_compare(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);s.density(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1))).type_compare=int(luaL_checkinteger(l,2));return 0;}
    static int new_type(lua_State* l){auto& s=self(l);s.density(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1))).new_type=int(luaL_checkinteger(l,2));return 0;}
    static int density_area(lua_State* l){
        auto& s=self(l);auto& v=s.density(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,1)));const bool write=lua_toboolean(l,lua_upvalueindex(2))!=0,masked=lua_toboolean(l,lua_upvalueindex(3))!=0;
        double x=luaL_checknumber(l,2),z=luaL_checknumber(l,3),wx=luaL_checknumber(l,4),wz=luaL_checknumber(l,5),hx=luaL_checknumber(l,6),hz=luaL_checknumber(l,7);
        unsigned start=unsigned(luaL_checkinteger(l,8))+v.offset,bits=unsigned(luaL_checkinteger(l,9));
        if(!bits||bits>16||start+bits>16)throw std::runtime_error("Density channel range exceeds supported grid");
        auto mask=(1u<<bits)-1;double det=wx*hz-wz*hx,sum=0,count=0,total=0;
        if(std::abs(det)<1e-9){lua_pushnumber(l,0);lua_pushnumber(l,0);lua_pushnumber(l,0);return 3;}
        DensityView* mv=nullptr;unsigned ms=0,mb=0;int value=0;
        if(masked){mv=&s.density(int(luaL_checkinteger(l,10)));ms=unsigned(luaL_checkinteger(l,11))+mv->offset;mb=unsigned(luaL_checkinteger(l,12));if(!mb||ms+mb>16)throw std::runtime_error("Density mask channel range");value=int(luaL_checkinteger(l,13));}
        else if(write)value=int(luaL_checkinteger(l,10));
        if(write&&(value<0||unsigned(value)>mask))throw std::runtime_error("Density value exceeds channel range");
        const auto& g=*v.grid;double scale_x=g.width/s.terrain.width,scale_z=g.height/s.terrain.depth;
        int min_x=std::max(0,int(std::floor((std::min({x,x+wx,x+hx,x+wx+hx})+s.terrain.width/2)*scale_x))),max_x=std::min(int(g.width)-1,int(std::ceil((std::max({x,x+wx,x+hx,x+wx+hx})+s.terrain.width/2)*scale_x)));
        int min_z=std::max(0,int(std::floor((std::min({z,z+wz,z+hz,z+wz+hz})+s.terrain.depth/2)*scale_z))),max_z=std::min(int(g.height)-1,int(std::ceil((std::max({z,z+wz,z+hz,z+wz+hz})+s.terrain.depth/2)*scale_z)));
        for(int zz=min_z;zz<=max_z;++zz)for(int xx=min_x;xx<=max_x;++xx){double dx=(xx+0.5)/scale_x-s.terrain.width/2-x,dz=(zz+0.5)/scale_z-s.terrain.depth/2-z;double u=(dx*hz-dz*hx)/det,t=(wx*dz-wz*dx)/det;if(u<0||u>=1||t<0||t>=1)continue;++total;
            auto& raw=v.grid->values[size_t(zz)*g.width+xx];int old=(raw>>start)&mask;bool same=!v.type||unsigned(raw&15)==v.type;
            if(v.type_compare==0&&!same&&(raw&15))continue;if(v.type_compare==1&&same)continue;
            if(!same&&v.type)old=0;
            if(!matches(v.compare,old))continue;
            if(mv){unsigned mx=unsigned(xx)*mv->grid->width/g.width,mz=unsigned(zz)*mv->grid->height/g.height;auto mraw=mv->grid->values[size_t(mz)*mv->grid->width+mx];int mvalue=(mraw>>ms)&((1u<<mb)-1);if(mv->type&&unsigned(mraw&15)!=mv->type)mvalue=0;if(!matches(v.mask,mvalue))continue;}
            sum+=old+v.shift;++count;
            if(write){raw=std::uint16_t((raw&~(mask<<start))|(unsigned(value)<<start));if(v.type){unsigned type=v.new_type==2?0:v.new_type==1?(raw&15):v.type;raw=std::uint16_t((raw&~15)|type);}}
        }
        if(write&&count>0)++s.revision;lua_pushnumber(l,sum);lua_pushnumber(l,count);lua_pushnumber(l,total);return 3;
    }
    void bind_area(const char* name,bool write,bool masked){lua_pushlightuserdata(lua,this);lua_pushboolean(lua,write);lua_pushboolean(lua,masked);lua_pushcclosure(lua,safe<density_area>,3);lua_setglobal(lua,name);}
    Impl(const fs::path& r,const fs15world::Terrain& t,int difficulty,bool reference):root(r),terrain(t),reference_bytecode(reference){
        bodies.reserve(64);lua=luaL_newstate();if(!lua)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot create mission Lua VM");luaL_openlibs(lua);
        fs15menu::register_xml(lua,[this](const std::string& name){return resolve(name);});
        bind("source",safe<source>);bind("worldReadSource",safe<read_source>);bind("delete",safe<destroy_xml>);bind("worldLoadVehicle",safe<load_vehicle>);bind("getNumOfChildren",safe<children>);bind("getChildAt",safe<child>);bind("getTranslation",safe<translation>);bind("getRotation",safe<rotation>);bind("setRotation",safe<set_rotation>);bind("getWorldTranslation",safe<transform>);bind("localToWorld",safe<local_to_world>);bind("localDirectionToWorld",safe<direction>);bind("worldToLocal",safe<world_to_local>);bind("worldDirectionToLocal",safe<world_direction_to_local>);bind("getUserAttribute",safe<attribute>);bind("worldHeight",safe<height>);bind("worldSetPose",safe<pose>);bind("worldFindCallbacks",safe<find_callbacks>);bind("worldOverlap",safe<overlap>);bind("worldSelect",safe<select>);
        collision=std::make_unique<CollisionWorld>(t);bind("raycastAll",safe<raycast>);bind("worldMove",safe<move>);bind("worldBounds",safe<bounds>);bind("getParent",safe<parent>);bind("getName",safe<name>);bind("setTranslation",safe<set_translation>);
        bind("getScale",safe<scale>);bind("setScale",safe<set_scale>);bind("getVisibility",safe<visibility>);bind("setVisibility",safe<set_visibility>);
        auto map_dir=fs::path("data/maps")/(t.map_id=="Map01"?"map01":"map02");fruit=fs15world::load_grle(resolve((map_dir/"fruit_density.grle").generic_u8string()));soil=fs15world::load_grle(resolve((map_dir/"cultivator_density.grle").generic_u8string()));density_views[1].grid=&soil;
        for(const auto& layer:t.foliage){auto& v=density_views[int((layer.offset==4?100:200)+layer.type)];v.grid=&fruit;v.offset=layer.offset;v.type=layer.type;v.mask.minimum=0;}
        bind("worldCropInfo",safe<crop_info>);bind("worldCropLayers",safe<crop_layers>);bind("setDensityCompareParams",safe<density_compare>);bind("setDensityMaskParams",safe<density_mask>);bind("setDensityReturnValueShift",safe<density_shift>);bind("setDensityTypeIndexCompareMode",safe<type_compare>);bind("setDensityNewTypeIndexMode",safe<new_type>);bind_area("getDensityParallelogram",false,false);bind_area("setDensityParallelogram",true,false);bind_area("setDensityMaskedParallelogram",true,true);
        lua_pushinteger(lua,difficulty);lua_setglobal(lua,"worldDifficulty");lua_pushstring(lua,t.map_id.c_str());lua_setglobal(lua,"worldMap");
        try{execute(resolve("src/engine/mission.lua"));fs15world::update_visibility(const_cast<fs15world::Terrain&>(terrain));resources.assign(used.begin(),used.end());}catch(...){lua_close(lua);lua=nullptr;throw;}
    }
    ~Impl(){if(lua)lua_close(lua);}
};
MissionRuntime::MissionRuntime(const fs::path& r,const fs15world::Terrain& t,int difficulty,bool reference):impl(std::make_unique<Impl>(r,t,difficulty,reference)){}
MissionRuntime::~MissionRuntime()=default;
void MissionRuntime::initialize_graphics(ID3D11Device* d,ID3D11DeviceContext* c){for(auto& b:impl->bodies)b.renderer=std::make_unique<SceneRenderer>(d,c,b.scene,impl->root);impl->foliage=std::make_unique<FoliageRenderer>(d,c,impl->terrain,impl->fruit,impl->root);auto resources=impl->foliage->resources();impl->resources.insert(impl->resources.end(),resources.begin(),resources.end());}
void MissionRuntime::update(double dt,float throttle,float steering,bool handbrake){
    const auto steps=impl->clock.advance(dt);auto l=impl->lua;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<steps;++i){lua_getglobal(l,"missionUpdate");lua_pushnumber(l,1.0f/60);lua_pushnumber(l,throttle);lua_pushnumber(l,steering);lua_pushboolean(l,handbrake);impl->call("missionUpdate",4);}
    for(auto& b:impl->bodies)if(b.renderer)b.renderer->update_instances(b.scene);
}
void MissionRuntime::set_paused(bool value){impl->clock.set_paused(value);}
bool MissionRuntime::paused()const{return impl->clock.paused();}
void MissionRuntime::action(const char* action){
    if(std::string(action)=="pause"){set_paused(!paused());return;}
    if(paused())return;
    auto l=impl->lua;lua_getglobal(l,"missionAction");lua_pushstring(l,action);impl->call("missionAction",1);if(std::string(action)=="scenario-tip"){impl->orbit_yaw=1.0f;impl->camera_distance=16;}
}
void MissionRuntime::draw(const XMMATRIX& vp,const XMFLOAT3& eye,bool shadow,bool measure){for(auto& b:impl->bodies)if(b.renderer)b.renderer->draw(vp,eye,measure,shadow);if(impl->foliage){impl->foliage->update(eye,impl->revision!=impl->rendered_revision);impl->rendered_revision=impl->revision;impl->foliage->draw(vp,eye,shadow);}}
bool MissionRuntime::camera(XMFLOAT3& eye,XMFLOAT3& target)const{if(impl->controlled<=0)return false;const auto& b=impl->bodies.at(impl->controlled-1);target={b.position.x,b.position.y+1.6f,b.position.z};float yaw=b.yaw+impl->orbit_yaw,pitch=impl->orbit_pitch,distance=impl->camera_distance;XMFLOAT3 desired{target.x-std::sin(yaw)*std::cos(pitch)*distance,target.y+std::sin(pitch)*distance,target.z-std::cos(yaw)*std::cos(pitch)*distance};eye=target;
    for(int i=1;i<=40;++i){float t=i/40.0f;XMFLOAT3 p{target.x+(desired.x-target.x)*t,target.y+(desired.y-target.y)*t,target.z+(desired.z-target.z)*t};p.y=std::max(p.y,fs15world::terrain_height(impl->terrain,p.x,p.z)+0.4f);if(impl->collision->blocked(p.x,p.z,p.y-1.3f,0.2f))break;eye=p;}if(std::hypot(eye.x-target.x,eye.z-target.z)<0.2f){eye=desired;eye.y=std::max(eye.y,target.y+1);}return true;}
void MissionRuntime::orbit(float yaw,float pitch){impl->orbit_yaw+=yaw;impl->orbit_pitch=std::clamp(impl->orbit_pitch+pitch,0.05f,1.25f);}
void MissionRuntime::zoom(float amount){impl->camera_distance=std::clamp(impl->camera_distance+amount,4.0f,35.0f);}
std::wstring MissionRuntime::status()const{auto l=impl->lua;lua_getglobal(l,"missionStatus");impl->call("missionStatus",0,1);std::string s=lua_tostring(l,-1);lua_pop(l,1);if(paused())s="PAUSED - P to resume\n"+s;return std::wstring(s.begin(),s.end());}
std::string MissionRuntime::report()const{auto l=impl->lua;lua_getglobal(l,"missionReport");impl->call("missionReport",0,1);std::string s=lua_tostring(l,-1);lua_pop(l,1);s.pop_back();s+=",\"collision_triangles\":"+std::to_string(impl->collision->triangle_count())+",\"foliage_instances\":"+std::to_string(impl->foliage?impl->foliage->instances():0)+",\"density_width\":"+std::to_string(impl->fruit.width)+",\"density_revision\":"+std::to_string(impl->revision)+",\"simulation_ticks\":"+std::to_string(impl->clock.ticks())+",\"discarded_time_s\":"+std::to_string(impl->clock.discarded_seconds())+",\"paused\":"+(paused()?"true":"false")+",\"reference_bytecode_chunks\":"+std::to_string(impl->reference_chunks)+"}";return s;}
std::uint64_t MissionRuntime::visible_samples(){std::uint64_t n=0;for(auto& b:impl->bodies)if(b.renderer)n+=b.renderer->visible_samples(false);return n;}
unsigned MissionRuntime::vehicle_count()const{return unsigned(impl->bodies.size());}
const std::vector<fs::path>& MissionRuntime::resources()const{return impl->resources;}
```

```h
    bool paused()const;
```

```lua
local function selectVehicle()

        selection=selection%#vehicles+1
        if vehicles[selection].motor then
            g_currentMission.controlledVehicle=vehicles[selection]

        end
    end

local contacts={}
local function updateSilos(dt)
    for _,silo in ipairs(silos) do
        for _,trailer in ipairs(vehicles) do if trailer.fillNode then
            for _,trigger in ipairs(silo.triggerIds) do
                local key=trigger..':'..trailer.id
                local inside=worldOverlap(trigger,trailer.fillNode)
                if inside~=not not contacts[key] then
                    silo:triggerCallback(trigger,trailer.rootNode,inside,not inside,false,trailer.fillNode)
                    contacts[key]=inside
                end
            end
        end end
        local before=silo.siloTrailer and silo.siloTrailer.fillLevel or 0
        silo:update(dt*1000)
        local after=silo.siloTrailer and silo.siloTrailer.fillLevel or before
        transferred=transferred+math.max(0,after-before)
    end
    for _,trigger in ipairs(fillTriggers) do for _,tool in ipairs(vehicles) do if tool.fillNode then
        local key='supply:'..trigger.triggerId..':'..tool.id
        local inside=worldOverlap(trigger.triggerId,tool.fillNode)
        if inside~=not not contacts[key] then
            trigger:triggerCallback(trigger.triggerId,tool.rootNode,inside,not inside,false,tool.fillNode)
            contacts[key]=inside
        end
    end end end
end
local function updateWheels(v,dt)
    for _,w in ipairs(v.wheels) do
        w.spin=w.spin+v.speed*dt/w.radius
        local a=w.baseRotation
        if w.drive==w.repr then setRotation(w.drive,a[1]+w.spin,a[2]+w.steeringAngle,a[3])
        else setRotation(w.drive,a[1]+w.spin,a[2],a[3]);local b=w.reprRotation;setRotation(w.repr,b[1],b[2]+w.steeringAngle,b[3]) end
    end
end
local function owned(x,z)
    for _,field in ipairs(g_currentMission.fields) do if field.owned then
        local wx,wz,hx,hz=field[3]-field[1],field[4]-field[2],field[5]-field[1],field[6]-field[2]
        local det=wx*hz-wz*hx
        if math.abs(det)>0.001 then
            local dx,dz=x-field[1],z-field[2]
            local u,t=(dx*hz-dz*hx)/det,(wx*dz-wz*dx)/det
            if u>=0 and u<=1 and t>=0 and t<=1 then return true end
        end
    end end
    return false
end
local function work(v)
    local tool=v.implement
    if not tool or not tool.working or math.abs(v.speed)<0.1 then return end
    for _,area in ipairs(tool.workAreas) do
        local x,_,z=getWorldTranslation(area.start)
        local x1,_,z1=getWorldTranslation(area.width)
        local x2,_,z2=getWorldTranslation(area.height)
        if owned((x1+x2)/2,(z1+z2)/2) then
            message='Working '..area.kind
            if area.kind=='cutter' then
                local name=worldCropInfo((x1+x2)/2,(z1+z2)/2)
                local desc=name and FruitUtil.fruitTypes[name]
                local fill=name and Fillable.fillTypeNameToInt[name]
                if desc and tool.acceptedFruits[name] and v.capacity>v.fillLevel+20 and v:allowFillType(fill,false) then
                    local pixels=Utils.cutFruitArea(desc.index,x,z,x1,z1,x2,z2,true,true)
                    local liters=pixels*0.25*desc.literPerSqm
                    local before=v.fillLevel;v:setFillLevel(v.fillLevel+liters,fill)
                    harvested=harvested+v.fillLevel-before
                end
            elseif area.kind=='cultivator' then
                local _,pixels=Utils.updateCultivatorArea(x,z,x1,z1,x2,z2,false,false,0)
                worked=worked+pixels*0.25
            elseif area.kind=='sowingMachine' and tool.fillLevel>0 then
                local pixels=Utils.updateSowingArea(FruitUtil.FRUITTYPE_WHEAT,x,z,x1,z1,x2,z2,0,false)
                local used=pixels*0.25*FruitUtil.fruitIndexToDesc[FruitUtil.FRUITTYPE_WHEAT].seedUsagePerSqm
                tool:setFillLevel(tool.fillLevel-used,Fillable.FILLTYPE_SEEDS);seeded=seeded+pixels*0.25
            end
        else message='This field is not owned' end
    end
end
function missionUpdate(dt,throttle,steering,handbrake)
    for _,v in ipairs(vehicles) do if v.motor then
        local selected=v==g_currentMission.controlledVehicle and not freeCamera
        local throttle,steering,handbrake=selected and throttle or 0,selected and steering or 0,not selected or handbrake
        v.rotatedTime=Utils.clamp(v.rotatedTime+steering*dt*1.5,-math.rad(42),math.rad(42))
        if math.abs(steering)<0.01 then v.rotatedTime=v.rotatedTime*math.max(0,1-dt*3) end
        v.lastSpeedReal=math.abs(v.speed)*0.001;v.movingDirection=v.speed<0 and -1 or 1
        for _,w in ipairs(v.wheels) do WheelsUtil.updateWheelSteeringAngle(v,w,dt*1000) end
        WheelsUtil.updateWheelsPhysics(v,dt*1000,math.abs(v.speed)*0.001,throttle,handbrake,0)
        -- Temporary engine primitive: planar force integration in tonnes/kN.
        -- Original WheelUtil/VehicleMotor choose torque, ratios and braking.
        local force,brake,angle,n=0,0,0,0
        for _,w in ipairs(v.wheels) do force=force+(w.torque or 0)/w.radius;brake=brake+(w.brake or 0);if w.rotSpeed~=0 then angle=angle+w.steeringAngle;n=n+1 end end
        local mass=v.mass+(v.implement and (v.implement.mass+v.implement.fillLevel*0.0004) or 0)
        v.speed=v.speed+force/math.max(mass,1)*dt
        local drag=(brake/math.max(mass,1)+0.08)*dt
        v.speed=math.max(0,math.abs(v.speed)-drag)*(v.speed<0 and -1 or 1)
        v.speed=Utils.clamp(v.speed,-v.motor.maxBackwardSpeed,v.motor.maxForwardSpeed)
        v.yaw=v.yaw+(n>0 and math.tan(angle/n) or 0)*v.speed/v.wheelbase*dt
        local step=v.speed*dt
        local nx,nz,blocked=worldMove(v.x,v.z,Utils.clamp(v.x+math.sin(v.yaw)*step,-1020,1020),Utils.clamp(v.z+math.cos(v.yaw)*step,-1020,1020),0.85)
        totalDistance=totalDistance+math.sqrt((nx-v.x)^2+(nz-v.z)^2);v.x,v.z=nx,nz
        if blocked then v.speed=0;message='Static obstacle' end
        v.y=worldHeight(v.x,v.z)+v.restHeight
        updateWheels(v,dt);pose(v)
        if v.implement then
            local t=v.implement
            local jx,jy,jz=getWorldTranslation(v.hitch)
            local tx,ty,tz=getWorldTranslation(t.inputJoint)
            t.yaw=v.yaw;pose(t);tx,ty,tz=getWorldTranslation(t.inputJoint)
            t.x=t.x+jx-tx;t.z=t.z+jz-tz;t.y=#t.wheels>0 and worldHeight(t.x,t.z)+t.restHeight or t.y+jy-ty;t.speed=v.speed
            updateWheels(t,dt);pose(t)
        end
        work(v)
    end end
    updateSilos(dt)
    for _,body in ipairs(vehicles) do
        Fillable.updateTick(body,dt*1000)
        AnimatedVehicle.update(body,dt*1000)
        pose(body) -- Publish original animated local transforms before trigger queries.
        if body.hasPipe then
            if not body:getIsAnimationPlaying(body.pipeAnimation) then body.currentPipeState=body.targetPipeState end
            Overloading.updateTick(body,dt*1000)
        end
        if body.tipState then
            local before=body.fillLevel
            Trailer.updateTick(body,dt*1000)
            unloaded=unloaded+math.max(0,before-body.fillLevel)
        end
    end
end
function missionAction(action)
    local v=g_currentMission.controlledVehicle
    if action=='selfcheck' then missionSelfcheck()
    elseif action=='scenario-harvest' or action=='scenario-silo' or action=='scenario-tip' then missionScenario(action)
    elseif action=='next' then selectVehicle()
    elseif action=='camera' then freeCamera=not freeCamera;worldSelect(freeCamera and 0 or selection)
    elseif action=='work' and v and v.implement then v.implement.working=not v.implement.working;message=v.implement.working and 'Tool working' or 'Tool stopped'
    elseif action=='pipe' and v and v.hasPipe then v:setPipeState(v.targetPipeState==1 and 2 or 1);message='Pipe moving'
    elseif action=='attach' and v then
        if v.implement then v.implement.attacherVehicle=nil;v.implement=nil;message='Detached'
        else
            local best,distance,joint
            for _,t in ipairs(vehicles) do if t~=v and t.inputJoint and not t.attacherVehicle then
                local tx,_,tz=getWorldTranslation(t.inputJoint)
                for _,j in ipairs(v.joints) do if j.node and j.type==t.jointType then
                    local x,_,z=getWorldTranslation(j.node);local d=(x-tx)^2+(z-tz)^2
                    if d<9 and (not distance or d<distance) then best,distance,joint=t,d,j.node end
                end end
            end end
            if best then v.implement=best;v.hitch=joint;best.attacherVehicle=v;message='Attached '..best.name else message='Move a compatible hitch within 3 m' end
        end
    elseif action=='fill' then
        message='Place the trailer under the farm silo'
        local tool=v and v.implement
        if tool and #tool.fillTriggers>0 then
            tool:setIsFilling(not tool.isFilling);message=tool.isFilling and 'Refilling tool' or 'Refilling stopped'
        end
        for _,silo in ipairs(silos) do if silo:getIsActivatable() then
            silo:setIsFilling(not silo.isFilling,silo.siloTrailer.fillLevel>0 and silo.siloTrailer.currentFillType or Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)
            message=silo.isFilling and 'Filling wheat' or 'Filling stopped'
        end end
    elseif action=='tip' and v and v.implement then
        local t=v.implement
        if t.tipState==Trailer.TIPSTATE_OPENING or t.tipState==Trailer.TIPSTATE_OPEN then t:onEndTip();message='Unloading closing'
        elseif t.fillLevel>0 and #t.tipReferencePoints>0 then
            local best,distance,pointIndex
            for _,trigger in ipairs(tipTriggers) do
                local allowed,d,p=trigger:getTipInfoForTrailer(t)
                if allowed and d<g_currentMission.tipTriggerRangeThreshold and (not distance or d<distance) then best,distance,pointIndex=trigger,d,p end
            end
            if best then t:toggleTipState(best,pointIndex,true);message='Unloading at '..best.stationName
            else message='Move a tipping point to a compatible unloading station' end
        end
    end
end
function missionScenario(kind)
    local v,tool,joint
    if kind=='scenario-harvest' then
        for _,candidate in ipairs(vehicles) do if candidate.hasPipe then v=candidate;break end end
        for _,candidate in ipairs(vehicles) do if candidate.jointType=='cutter' then tool=candidate;break end end
    else
        for _,candidate in ipairs(vehicles) do if candidate.fillNode and #candidate.tipReferencePoints>0 then tool=candidate;break end end
        for _,candidate in ipairs(vehicles) do if candidate.motor then for _,j in ipairs(candidate.joints) do if j.type==tool.jointType then v=candidate;break end end;if v then break end end end
    end
    assert(v and tool,'Scenario needs original vehicle and implement')
    for _,j in ipairs(v.joints) do if j.type==tool.jointType then joint=j.node;break end end
    assert(joint,'Scenario hitch type missing')
    for _,body in ipairs(vehicles) do body.speed=0 end
    if kind=='scenario-harvest' then
        local px,pz,heading
        for _,field in ipairs(g_currentMission.fields) do if field.owned and not px then
            for u=0.15,0.85,0.05 do for t=0.15,0.85,0.05 do
                local x=field[1]+u*(field[3]-field[1])+t*(field[5]-field[1])
                local z=field[2]+u*(field[4]-field[2])+t*(field[6]-field[2])
                local name,state=worldCropInfo(x,z);local desc=name and FruitUtil.fruitTypes[name]
                if desc and tool.acceptedFruits[name] and state>=desc.minHarvestingGrowthState+1 and state<=desc.maxHarvestingGrowthState+1 then
                    px,pz=x,z;local dx,dz=field[3]-field[1],field[4]-field[2];local hx,hz=field[5]-field[1],field[6]-field[2]
                    if hx*hx+hz*hz>dx*dx+dz*dz then dx,dz=hx,hz;if t>0.5 then dx,dz=-dx,-dz end elseif u>0.5 then dx,dz=-dx,-dz end
                    heading=math.atan2(dx,dz);break
                end
            end;if px then break end end
        end end
        assert(px,'No mature supported crop found in an originally owned field')
        v.x,v.z,v.yaw=px-math.sin(heading)*8,pz-math.cos(heading)*8,heading;v.y=worldHeight(v.x,v.z)+v.restHeight;pose(v)
        tool.yaw=v.yaw;pose(tool)
        local x,y,z=getWorldTranslation(joint);local tx,ty,tz=getWorldTranslation(tool.inputJoint)
        tool.x,tool.y,tool.z=tool.x+x-tx,tool.y+y-ty,tool.z+z-tz;pose(tool);tool.working=true
        message='Harvest test scenario on an original owned field'
    elseif kind=='scenario-silo' then
        local silo=assert(silos[1]);tool.yaw=0;pose(tool)
        local x,z=0,0
        for _,id in ipairs(silo.triggerIds) do local cx,_,cz=worldBounds(id);x,z=x+cx,z+cz end
        x,z=x/#silo.triggerIds,z/#silo.triggerIds
        local tx,_,tz=worldBounds(tool.fillNode)
        tool.x,tool.z=tool.x+x-tx,tool.z+z-tz;tool.y=worldHeight(tool.x,tool.z)+tool.restHeight;pose(tool)
        v.yaw=tool.yaw;pose(v)
        local x,_,z=getWorldTranslation(tool.inputJoint);local hx,_,hz=getWorldTranslation(joint)
        v.x,v.z=v.x+x-hx,v.z+z-hz;v.y=worldHeight(v.x,v.z)+v.restHeight;pose(v)
        message='Silo test scenario: R starts/stops filling wheat'
    else
        local farm
        for _,trigger in ipairs(tipTriggers) do if trigger.isFarmTrigger and trigger.acceptedFillTypes[Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT] then farm=trigger;break end end
        assert(farm,'Tipping scenario needs an original farm trigger')
        tool.yaw=0;pose(tool)
        local x,_,z=getWorldTranslation(farm.triggerStartId)
        local tx,_,tz=getWorldTranslation(tool.tipReferencePoints[1].node)
        tool.x,tool.z=tool.x+x-tx,tool.z+z-tz;tool.y=worldHeight(tool.x,tool.z)+tool.restHeight;pose(tool)
        v.yaw=tool.yaw;pose(v)
        local x,_,z=getWorldTranslation(tool.inputJoint);local hx,_,hz=getWorldTranslation(joint)
        v.x,v.z=v.x+x-hx,v.z+z-hz;v.y=worldHeight(v.x,v.z)+v.restHeight;pose(v)
        tool:setFillLevel(tool.capacity,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,true)
        tool:onStartTip(farm,1,true,true)
        message='Original trailer animation and farm discharge test scenario'
    end
    v.hitch=joint;v.implement=tool;tool.attacherVehicle=v
    selection=v.id;g_currentMission.controlledVehicle=v;freeCamera=false;worldSelect(selection);updateSilos(0)
end
function missionSelfcheck()
    local function check(value,name)
        assert(value,'Mission check failed: '..name)
        checks[#checks+1]=name
    end
    check(totalDistance>10,'original motor/wheel control produces travel')
    local v=g_currentMission.controlledVehicle
    for _=1,180 do missionUpdate(1/60,0,0,true) end
    check(math.abs(v.speed)<0.05,'handbrake stops vehicle')
    local heading=v.yaw
    for _=1,120 do missionUpdate(1/60,1,0.6,false) end
    check(math.abs(v.yaw-heading)>0.01,'steering changes heading')
    local t
    for _,candidate in ipairs(vehicles) do if candidate.fillNode and #candidate.tipReferencePoints>0 then t=candidate;break end end
    check(t~=nil,'original fillable trailer loaded')
    local silo=assert(silos[1])
    local old={t.x,t.y,t.z,t.yaw,t.fillLevel,t.currentFillType}
    local stock=g_currentMission:getSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)
    local oldControlled=g_currentMission.controlledVehicle
    t.attacherVehicle=v;v.implement=t
    t.yaw=0;pose(t)
    local cx,cz=0,0
    for _,trigger in ipairs(silo.triggerIds) do local x,_,z=worldBounds(trigger);cx,cz=cx+x,cz+z end
    cx,cz=cx/#silo.triggerIds,cz/#silo.triggerIds
    local x,_,z=worldBounds(t.fillNode)
    t.x=t.x+cx-x;t.z=t.z+cz-z;t.y=worldHeight(t.x,t.z)+t.restHeight;pose(t)
    updateSilos(0)
    check(silo.fill==4,'four original silo trigger meshes overlap trailer (got '..silo.fill..')')
    check(silo:getIsActivatable(),'controlled attached trailer can activate silo')
    silo:setIsFilling(true,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)
    updateSilos(1)
    check(math.abs(t.fillLevel-1500)<0.001,'original silo fills 1500 L in one second (level '..t.fillLevel..', stock '..stock..', rate '..silo.fillLitersPerSecond..')')
    check(math.abs(g_currentMission:getSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)+t.fillLevel-stock)<0.001,'silo/trailer inventory conserved')
    t:setFillLevel(t.fillLevel,Fillable.FILLTYPE_BARLEY)
    check(t.currentFillType==Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,'mixed grain rejected')
    g_currentMission:setSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,20000)
    t:setFillLevel(t.capacity-10,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)
    updateSilos(1)
    check(t.fillLevel==t.capacity and g_currentMission:getSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)==19990,'capacity overflow consumes only available space')
    updateSilos(1)
    check(not silo.isFilling,'full trailer stops filling')
    t:setFillLevel(0,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,true)
    g_currentMission:setSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,100)
    silo:setIsFilling(true,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT);updateSilos(1);updateSilos(1)
    check(t.fillLevel==100 and g_currentMission:getSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)==0 and not silo.isFilling,'empty silo stops without inventing grain')
    g_currentMission:setSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,1000)
    silo:setIsFilling(true,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)
    t.x=t.x+20;pose(t);updateSilos(1)
    check(not silo.isFilling and silo.siloTrailer==nil,'leaving trigger stops filling')
    local farm
    for _,trigger in ipairs(tipTriggers) do if trigger.isFarmTrigger and trigger.acceptedFillTypes[Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT] then farm=trigger;break end end
    check(farm~=nil,'original farm unloading trigger loaded')
    local fx,_,fz=getWorldTranslation(farm.triggerStartId)
    local px,_,pz=getWorldTranslation(t.tipReferencePoints[1].node)
    t.x=t.x+fx-px;t.z=t.z+fz-pz;t.y=worldHeight(t.x,t.z)+t.restHeight;pose(t)
    t:setFillLevel(1000,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,true)
    t:onStartTip(farm,1,true,true)
    check(t.tipState==Trailer.TIPSTATE_OPENING,'original trailer enters opening state')
    local tipName=t.tipAnimations[1].animationName
    local firstPart=t.animations[tipName].parts[1]
    local initialRotation={getRotation(firstPart.node)}
    AnimatedVehicle.update(t,1000);Trailer.updateTick(t,1000)
    check(t.fillLevel==1000,'grain stays inside before original discharge start time')
    local rx,ry,rz=getRotation(firstPart.node)
    check(math.abs(rx-initialRotation[1])+math.abs(ry-initialRotation[2])+math.abs(rz-initialRotation[3])>0.001,'original XML tip animation moves the door before discharge')
    t:setCurrentTipAnimationTime(3000)
    check(farm:getTipInfoForTrailer(t,1),'unloading accepts configured grain')
    local before=g_currentMission:getSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)+t.fillLevel
    Trailer.updateTipping(t,1000)
    unloaded=unloaded+1000-t.fillLevel
    check(t.fillLevel<1000,'original trailer update discharges into farm trigger')
    check(math.abs(g_currentMission:getSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT)+t.fillLevel-before)<0.001,'original unloading preserves farm inventory')
    check(t.fillLevel==0 and t.currentFillType==Fillable.FILLTYPE_UNKNOWN,'empty trailer clears fill type')
    t.x,t.y,t.z,t.yaw,t.fillLevel,t.currentFillType=unpack(old)
    Trailer.updateTick(t,0)
    check(t.tipState==Trailer.TIPSTATE_CLOSING,'empty trailer automatically enters original closing state')
    for _=1,600 do AnimatedVehicle.update(t,16);Trailer.updateTick(t,16) end
    check(t.tipState==Trailer.TIPSTATE_CLOSED and t.currentTipReferencePointIndex==nil,'original tipping cycle closes and releases animation reference')
    local rx,ry,rz=getRotation(firstPart.node)
    check(math.abs(rx-firstPart.startRot[1])+math.abs(ry-firstPart.startRot[2])+math.abs(rz-firstPart.startRot[3])<0.0001,'tip door returns to original closed pose')
    local support=t.animations.moveSupport
    check(support and #support.parts==5,'original support-wheel visibility sequence is loaded')
    local n1,n2
    for _,part in ipairs(support.parts) do if part.startTime==0 then
        if part.visibility==false then n1=part.node elseif part.visibility==true then n2=part.node end
    end end
    assert(n1 and n2,'Original support visibility parts missing')
    local visible1,visible2=getVisibility(n1),getVisibility(n2)
    t:setRealAnimationTime('moveSupport',25,true)
    check(not getVisibility(n1) and getVisibility(n2),'recovered support animation swaps original visible wheel nodes')
    t:setRealAnimationTime('moveSupport',75,true)
    check(getVisibility(n1) and not getVisibility(n2),'recovered support animation restores opposite visibility state')
    t:setAnimationTime('moveSupport',0,true);setVisibility(n1,visible1);setVisibility(n2,visible2)
    t.currentTipTrigger=nil;t.attacherVehicle=nil;v.implement=nil;pose(t)
    g_currentMission.controlledVehicle=oldControlled;g_currentMission:setSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,stock)
    updateSilos(0)
    local field
    for _,candidate in ipairs(g_currentMission.fields) do if candidate.owned then field=candidate;break end end
    check(field~=nil,'original owned field loaded')
    local x,z=(field[3]+field[5])/2,(field[4]+field[6])/2
    local id=g_currentMission.fruits[FruitUtil.FRUITTYPE_WHEAT].id
    setDensityTypeIndexCompareMode(id,2)
    setDensityParallelogram(id,x,z,4,0,0,4,0,8,6)
    setDensityTypeIndexCompareMode(id,0)
    setDensityParallelogram(1,x,z,4,0,0,4,0,4,1)
    local cut=Utils.cutFruitArea(FruitUtil.FRUITTYPE_WHEAT,x,z,x+4,z,x,z+4,true,true)
    check(cut==64,'recovered harvest cuts 64 density cells in 16 square metres')
    local name,state=worldCropInfo(x+2,z+2)
    check(name=='wheat' and state==9,'harvest writes the original cut growth state')
    check(Utils.cutFruitArea(FruitUtil.FRUITTYPE_WHEAT,x,z,x+4,z,x,z+4,true,true)==0,'harvested area cannot yield twice')
    Utils.updateCultivatorArea(x,z,x+4,z,x,z+4,false,false,0)
    check(worldCropInfo(x+2,z+2)==nil,'recovered cultivation clears crop type')
    local planted=Utils.updateSowingArea(FruitUtil.FRUITTYPE_WHEAT,x,z,x+4,z,x,z+4,0,false)
    name,state=worldCropInfo(x+2,z+2)
    check(planted==64 and name=='wheat' and state==1,'recovered sowing plants only prepared soil')
    check(Utils.updateSowingArea(FruitUtil.FRUITTYPE_WHEAT,x,z,x+4,z,x,z+4,0,false)==0,'sowing same area twice does not duplicate seed consumption')
    local combine
    for _,candidate in ipairs(vehicles) do if candidate.hasPipe then combine=candidate;break end end
    check(combine~=nil,'original combine pipe services loaded')
    local saved={combine.fillLevel,combine.currentFillType}
    combine:setFillLevel(600,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,true)
    combine.targetPipeState,combine.currentPipeState=2,2
    modelAnimation(combine,combine.pipeAnimation,1);pose(combine)
    local px,_,pz=getWorldTranslation(combine.pipeRaycastNode)
    local tx,_,tz=worldBounds(t.fillNode)
    t.x=t.x+px-tx;t.z=t.z+pz-tz;t.y=worldHeight(t.x,t.z)+t.restHeight;pose(t)
    t:setFillLevel(0,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,true)
    Overloading.updateTick(combine,1000)
    check(t.fillLevel==150 and combine.fillLevel==450,'recovered pipe/raycast transfers original 150 L per second')
    check(t.fillLevel+combine.fillLevel==600,'combine/trailer transfer conserves grain')
    t:setFillLevel(t.capacity-10,Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT,true)
    Overloading.updateTick(combine,1000)
    check(t.fillLevel==t.capacity and combine.fillLevel==440,'combine transfer respects trailer capacity')
    t:setFillLevel(1000,Fillable.FILLTYPE_BARLEY,true)
    Overloading.updateTick(combine,1000)
    check(combine.fillLevel==440 and t.fillLevel==1000,'pipe rejects incompatible grain')
    combine.fillLevel,combine.currentFillType=unpack(saved)
    combine.targetPipeState,combine.currentPipeState=1,1;modelAnimation(combine,combine.pipeAnimation,0);pose(combine)
    t.x,t.y,t.z,t.yaw,t.fillLevel,t.currentFillType=unpack(old);pose(t)
    local seedTool,seedTrigger
    for _,candidate in ipairs(vehicles) do if candidate.fillTypes[Fillable.FILLTYPE_SEEDS] then seedTool=candidate;break end end
    for _,candidate in ipairs(fillTriggers) do if candidate.fillType==Fillable.FILLTYPE_SEEDS then seedTrigger=candidate;break end end
    check(seedTool and seedTrigger,'original seed tool and supply trigger loaded')
    local sx,sy,sz=seedTool.x,seedTool.y,seedTool.z
    local x,_,z=worldBounds(seedTrigger.triggerId);local tx,_,tz=worldBounds(seedTool.fillNode)
    seedTool.x=seedTool.x+x-tx;seedTool.z=seedTool.z+z-tz;seedTool.y=worldHeight(seedTool.x,seedTool.z)+seedTool.restHeight;pose(seedTool);updateSilos(0)
    check(#seedTool.fillTriggers>0,'native supply overlap reaches recovered fill callback')
    local cash=g_currentMission.money
    seedTool:setIsFilling(true);Fillable.updateTick(seedTool,1000)
    check(seedTool.fillLevel==100,'recovered supply uses original 100 L per second semoir configuration')
    check(math.abs(g_currentMission.money-(cash-60))<0.001,'seed refill charges original fill-type price')
    seedTool:setIsFilling(false);seedTool:setFillLevel(0,Fillable.FILLTYPE_SEEDS,true)
    seedTool.x,seedTool.y,seedTool.z=sx,sy,sz;pose(seedTool);updateSilos(0);g_currentMission.money=cash
end
function missionStatus()
    local v=g_currentMission.controlledVehicle
    local trailer=v and v.implement
    return string.format('%s | %.1f km/h | Tank %.0f/%.0f L%s\nWASD/ZQSD/arrows | TAB vehicle | E attach | B work | O pipe | R fill | I unload | F8 camera | Space brake | P pause\nWheat silo: %.0f L | Harvested %.0f L | Money %.0f | %s',
        v and v.name or 'Free camera',v and math.abs(v.speed)*3.6 or 0,
        v and v.fillLevel or 0,v and v.capacity or 0,trailer and string.format(' | %s %.0f/%.0f L',trailer.name,trailer.fillLevel,trailer.capacity) or '',g_currentMission:getSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT),harvested,g_currentMission.money,message)
end
function missionReport()
    local animations,active=0,0
    for _,v in ipairs(vehicles) do for _ in pairs(v.animations) do animations=animations+1 end;for _ in pairs(v.activeAnimations) do active=active+1 end end
    local states={}
    for _,body in ipairs(vehicles) do
        local names,times,wheels={},{},{}
        for name in pairs(body.animations) do names[#names+1]=name end
        table.sort(names)
        for _,name in ipairs(names) do times[#times+1]=string.format('%.9f',body:getAnimationTime(name)) end
        for _,wheel in ipairs(body.wheels) do wheels[#wheels+1]=string.format('[%.9f,%.9f]',wheel.spin,wheel.steeringAngle) end
        states[#states+1]=string.format('{"id":%d,"x":%.9f,"y":%.9f,"z":%.9f,"yaw":%.9f,"speed":%.9f,"fill_l":%.9f,"fill_type":%d,"attached_to":%d,"working":%s,"pipe_state":%d,"tip_state":%d,"animation_times":[%s],"wheels":[%s]}',
            body.id,body.x,body.y,body.z,body.yaw,body.speed,body.fillLevel,body.currentFillType,body.attacherVehicle and body.attacherVehicle.id or 0,body.working and 'true' or 'false',body.currentPipeState or 0,body.tipState or 0,table.concat(times,','),table.concat(wheels,','))
    end
    local v=g_currentMission.controlledVehicle;local t=v and v.implement
    return string.format('{"vehicles":%d,"silos":%d,"tip_triggers":%d,"fields":%d,"field_parallelograms":%d,"distance_m":%.6f,"silo_transfer_l":%.6f,"unloaded_l":%.6f,"harvested_l":%.6f,"worked_sqm":%.6f,"seeded_sqm":%.6f,"checks":%d,"recovered_animations":%d,"active_animations":%d,"implement_fill_l":%.6f,"implement_capacity_l":%.6f,"implement_tip_state":%d,"farm_wheat_l":%.6f,"money":%.9f,"controlled_vehicle":%d,"vehicle_states":[%s],"physics":"temporary planar host; original motor and wheel control Lua"}',
        #vehicles,#silos,#tipTriggers,g_currentMission.fieldDefinitionBase and g_currentMission.fieldDefinitionBase.numberOfFields or 0,#g_currentMission.fields,totalDistance,transferred,unloaded,harvested,worked,seeded,#checks,animations,active,t and t.fillLevel or 0,t and t.capacity or 0,t and t.tipState or 0,g_currentMission:getSiloAmount(Fillable.FILLTYPE_WHEAT),g_currentMission.money,selection,table.concat(states,','))
end
```

`src/engine/render_shared.h`:

```h
#pragma once
// Authored host shader services. Original GIANTS shader injections are appended
// at runtime from the local game XML, not copied into the repository.
static constexpr const char* world_shader_services=R"(
cbuffer WorldLighting:register(b2){row_major float4x4 shadowVP;float4 sunDirection;float4 sunDiffuse;float4 ambientColor;float4 distanceFog;float4 frameInfo;};
Texture2D<float> shadowTexture:register(t10);SamplerComparisonState shadowSampler:register(s2);
float shadowVisibility(float3 world){

 if(any(uv<0)||any(uv>1)||q.z<0||q.z>1)return 1;
 float visible=0;
 [unroll]for(int y=-1;y<=1;++y)[unroll]for(int x=-1;x<=1;++x)visible+=shadowTexture.SampleCmpLevelZero(shadowSampler,uv+float2(x,y)*frameInfo.z,q.z-frameInfo.w);
 return visible/9;
}
float3 applyDistanceFog(float3 color,float3 world,float3 eye){float transmission=exp(-distanceFog.w*distance(world,eye));return lerp(distanceFog.xyz,color,transmission);}
)";
```

```cpp
static void check(HRESULT result,const char* operation) {
    if(FAILED(result)) throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation)+" failed: "+std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned long>(result)));
}
static std::string utf8(const wchar_t* value,UINT count) {
    if(!count)return {};
    int size=WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8,WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS,value,count,nullptr,0,nullptr,nullptr);
    if(!size)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid I3D Unicode");
    std::string text(size,'\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8,WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS,value,count,text.data(),size,nullptr,nullptr);
    return text;
}
static std::string name(IXmlReader* reader) {
    const wchar_t* text=nullptr;UINT count=0;check(reader->GetLocalName(&text,&count),"I3D name");return utf8(text,count);
}
using Attributes=std::map<std::string,std::string>;
static Attributes attributes(IXmlReader* reader) {
    Attributes out;HRESULT result=reader->MoveToFirstAttribute();check(result,"I3D attributes");
    if(result==S_OK) {
        do {auto key=name(reader);const wchar_t* text=nullptr;UINT count=0;
            check(reader->GetValue(&text,&count),"I3D attribute value");out.emplace(key,utf8(text,count));
            result=reader->MoveToNextAttribute();
        }while(result==S_OK);
        check(result,"I3D next attribute");check(reader->MoveToElement(),"I3D element");
    }
    return out;
}
static std::string value(const Attributes& a,const char* key,std::string fallback={}) {
    auto it=a.find(key);return it==a.end()?fallback:it->second;
}
static float number(const Attributes& a,const char* key,float fallback) {
    auto text=value(a,key);if(text.empty())return fallback;
    size_t end=0;float out=std::stof(text,&end);
    if(end!=text.size()||!std::isfinite(out))throw std::runtime_error(std::string("Invalid I3D number: ")+key);
    return out;
}
static std::array<float,3> vector3(const Attributes& a,const char* key,std::array<float,3> fallback={0,0,0}) {
    auto text=value(a,key);if(text.empty())return fallback;
    std::istringstream stream(text);std::array<double,3> precise{};std::array<float,3> out{};
    if(!(stream>>precise[0]>>precise[1]>>precise[2]))
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string("Invalid I3D vector ")+key+": "+text);
    for(size_t i=0;i<3;++i){if(!std::isfinite(precise[i])||std::abs(precise[i])>std::numeric_limits<float>::max())throw std::runtime_error("I3D vector outside float range");out[i]=static_cast<float>(precise[i]);}
    return out;
}
static std::filesystem::path resource(const std::filesystem::path& root,const std::filesystem::path& relative) {
    if(relative.is_absolute()||relative.has_root_name())throw std::runtime_error("Absolute I3D resource path");
    for(auto& part:relative)if(part=="..")throw std::runtime_error("I3D resource traversal");
    for(auto& prefix:{root/"assets",root/"recovered/gar"}) {
        auto path=prefix/relative;if(std::filesystem::is_regular_file(path))return path;
    }
    throw std::runtime_error("Missing prepared engine resource: "+relative.generic_u8string());
}

std::string shader_injection(const std::filesystem::path& root,const std::filesystem::path& relative,const std::string& position){
    const auto path=resource(root,relative);if(std::filesystem::file_size(path)>1024*1024)throw std::runtime_error("Shader XML exceeds limit");

    bool active=false;std::string code;XmlNodeType kind;HRESULT result;

        else if(kind==XmlNodeType_EndElement&&name(xml.Get())=="CodeInjection")active=false;
        else if(active&&(kind==XmlNodeType_Text||kind==XmlNodeType_CDATA||kind==XmlNodeType_Whitespace)){const wchar_t* text;UINT count;check(xml->GetValue(&text,&count),"Shader text");code+=utf8(text,count);}
    }

std::vector<Mesh> load_meshes(const std::filesystem::path& root,const std::filesystem::path& relative) {
    std::filesystem::path path;
    for(auto& prefix:{root/"assets",root/"recovered/gar"})if(std::filesystem::is_regular_file(prefix/relative))path=prefix/relative;
    if(path.empty())return {}; // Terrain-only packages and authored terrain fixtures.
    std::ifstream input(path,std::ios::binary);
    auto read=[&](void* data,size_t count){if(!input.read(static_cast<char*>(data),count))throw std::runtime_error("Truncated original mesh cache");};
    auto integer=[&](){std::uint32_t value;read(&value,4);return value;};
    char magic[8];read(magic,8);if(std::string(magic,8)!=std::string("FS15MSH\1",8))throw std::runtime_error("Invalid mesh cache version");
    unsigned count=integer();if(count>10000)throw std::runtime_error("Mesh cache count limit");
    std::vector<Mesh> meshes;meshes.reserve(count);
    for(unsigned i=0;i<count;++i){Mesh mesh;mesh.id=integer();unsigned nv=integer(),ni=integer(),ns=integer();
        if(nv>2000000||ni>6000000||ns>1000||ni%3)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid mesh buffer size");
        for(unsigned s=0;s<ns;++s){Subset part{integer(),integer()};if(part.first>ni||part.count>ni-part.first||part.count%3)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid original subset");mesh.subsets.push_back(part);}
        mesh.vertices.resize(nv);mesh.indices.resize(ni);read(mesh.vertices.data(),size_t(nv)*sizeof(Vertex));read(mesh.indices.data(),size_t(ni)*4);
        for(auto index:mesh.indices)if(index>=nv)throw std::runtime_error("Original mesh index outside vertices");
        for(const auto& v:mesh.vertices)for(float x:{v.x,v.y,v.z,v.nx,v.ny,v.nz,v.u,v.v})if(!std::isfinite(x))throw std::runtime_error("Non-finite mesh vertex");
        if(mesh.subsets.empty())mesh.subsets.push_back({0,ni});meshes.push_back(std::move(mesh));
    }
    if(input.peek()!=std::char_traits<char>::eof())throw std::runtime_error("Trailing mesh cache bytes");return meshes;
}
static bool lower_lod(std::string text) {
    for(char& c:text)c=static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    auto at=text.find("lod");return at!=std::string::npos&&at+3<text.size()&&text[at+3]>='1'&&text[at+3]<='9';
}
static ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> wic() {

static std::vector<std::uint16_t> height_pixels(const std::filesystem::path& path,unsigned& width,unsigned& height) {
    auto factory=wic();ComPtr<IWICBitmapDecoder> decoder;ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameDecode> frame;
    check(factory->CreateDecoderFromFilename(path.c_str(),nullptr,GENERIC_READ,WICDecodeMetadataCacheOnLoad,&decoder),"Height PNG decoder");
    check(decoder->GetFrame(0,&frame),"Height PNG frame");check(frame->GetSize(&width,&height),"Height PNG size");
    if(width<3||height<3||width>4097||height>4097)throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported height map dimensions");
    WICPixelFormatGUID format;check(frame->GetPixelFormat(&format),"Height PNG pixel format");
    std::vector<std::uint16_t> out(size_t(width)*height);
    if(IsEqualGUID(format,GUID_WICPixelFormat16bppGray)) {
        check(frame->CopyPixels(nullptr,width*2,static_cast<UINT>(out.size()*2),reinterpret_cast<BYTE*>(out.data())),"16-bit height pixels");
    }else if(IsEqualGUID(format,GUID_WICPixelFormat24bppRGB)||IsEqualGUID(format,GUID_WICPixelFormat24bppBGR)) {
        std::vector<BYTE> rgb(size_t(width)*height*3);
        check(frame->CopyPixels(nullptr,width*3,static_cast<UINT>(rgb.size()),rgb.data()),"Packed RG height pixels");
        // The local FS15 base maps are RGB8: R is the high byte, G the low
        // byte, and B is zero. Preserve all 16 bits rather than gray conversion.
        const unsigned red=IsEqualGUID(format,GUID_WICPixelFormat24bppBGR)?2:0,blue=2-red;
        for(size_t i=0;i<out.size();++i) {
            if(rgb[i*3+blue])throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported RGB DEM encoding (B must be zero)");
            out[i]=static_cast<std::uint16_t>((rgb[i*3+red]<<8)|rgb[i*3+1]);
        }
    }else throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported DEM PNG format; expected packed RG16 or Gray16");
    return out;
}

}
static Terrain load_scene_impl(const std::filesystem::path& root,const std::string& map_id,const std::filesystem::path& relative,bool require_terrain,bool dynamic_visibility=false) {
    Terrain out;out.map_id=map_id;

        }
        if(kind!=XmlNodeType_Element)continue;

            auto shapes=list("blockShapeId");for(float v:shapes)layer.shapes.push_back(unsigned(v));layer.widths=list("width");layer.heights=list("height");layer.states=unsigned(number(a,"numStates",1));
            if(layer.type&&layer.offset<16&&layer.channels<=8)out.foliage.push_back(std::move(layer));continue;
        }
        if(tag=="UserAttribute"){auto a=attributes(xml.Get());auto at=node_ids.find(std::stoi(value(a,"nodeId","0")));user_node=at==node_ids.end()?-1:at->second;continue;}
        if(tag=="Attribute"&&user_node>=0){auto a=attributes(xml.Get());out.nodes[user_node].attributes[value(a,"name")]=value(a,"value");out.nodes[user_node].attribute_types[value(a,"name")]=value(a,"type","string");continue;}
        if(tag=="Scene"){scene=true;scene_depth=depth;continue;}
        if(tag=="File") {

        }
        if(tag=="Material") {

    out.width=(out.source_width-1)*out.units_per_pixel;out.depth=(out.source_height-1)*out.units_per_pixel;
    auto extrema=std::minmax_element(heights.begin(),heights.end());
    out.min_height=*extrema.first*out.height_scale/65535.0f;out.max_height=*extrema.second*out.height_scale/65535.0f;
    // Fixed two-source-pixel spacing bounds GPU buffers without inventing relief.
    const unsigned step=2,nx=(out.source_width-1)/step+1,nz=(out.source_height-1)/step+1;
    if((out.source_width-1)%step||(out.source_height-1)%step)throw std::runtime_error("DEM grid must have an even interval count");
    auto sample=[&](int x,int z){x=std::clamp(x,0,int(out.source_width)-1);z=std::clamp(z,0,int(out.source_height)-1);return heights[size_t(z)*out.source_width+x]*out.height_scale/65535.0f;};
    std::vector<float> road_errors,flipped_errors;
    auto bilinear=[&](float x,float z){float px=x/out.units_per_pixel+(out.source_width-1)*0.5f,pz=z/out.units_per_pixel+(out.source_height-1)*0.5f;
        int ix=static_cast<int>(std::floor(px)),iz=static_cast<int>(std::floor(pz));float a=px-ix,b=pz-iz;
        return (1-b)*((1-a)*sample(ix,iz)+a*sample(ix+1,iz))+b*((1-a)*sample(ix,iz+1)+a*sample(ix+1,iz+1));};
    for(const auto& node:out.nodes)if(node.mesh>=0&&node.visible&&(node.name.find("mainRoad")!=std::string::npos||node.name.find("roadShape")!=std::string::npos)){
        const auto& mesh=out.meshes[node.mesh];DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 w;std::copy(node.world,node.world+16,&w._11);auto matrix=DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&w);
        for(size_t i=0;i<mesh.vertices.size();i+=std::max(size_t(1),mesh.vertices.size()/32)){
            const auto& v=mesh.vertices[i];DirectX::XMFLOAT3 p;DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&p,DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(DirectX::XMVectorSet(v.x,v.y,v.z,1),matrix));
            if(std::abs(p.x)>=out.width/2||std::abs(p.z)>=out.depth/2)continue;
            road_errors.push_back(std::abs(p.y-bilinear(p.x,p.z)));flipped_errors.push_back(std::abs(p.y-bilinear(p.x,-p.z)));
        }
    }
    if(!road_errors.empty()){out.road_alignment_samples=static_cast<unsigned>(road_errors.size());std::sort(road_errors.begin(),road_errors.end());std::sort(flipped_errors.begin(),flipped_errors.end());out.road_median_error=road_errors[road_errors.size()/2];out.road_flipped_z_error=flipped_errors[flipped_errors.size()/2];}
    out.vertices.reserve(size_t(nx)*nz);
    for(unsigned z=0;z<nz;++z)for(unsigned x=0;x<nx;++x) {
        const int px=x*step,pz=z*step;float dx=sample(px+step,pz)-sample(px-step,pz),dz=sample(px,pz+step)-sample(px,pz-step);
        float ny=2*step*out.units_per_pixel,length=std::sqrt(dx*dx+ny*ny+dz*dz);
        float u=float(px)/(out.source_width-1),v=float(pz)/(out.source_height-1);
        out.vertices.push_back({(u-0.5f)*out.width,sample(px,pz),(v-0.5f)*out.depth,-dx/length,ny/length,-dz/length,u,v});
    }
    out.indices.reserve(size_t(nx-1)*(nz-1)*6);
    for(unsigned z=0;z<nz-1;++z)for(unsigned x=0;x<nx-1;++x) {
        unsigned a=z*nx+x,b=a+1,c=a+nx,d=c+1;out.indices.insert(out.indices.end(),{a,c,b,b,c,d});
    }
    used.insert((relative.parent_path()/std::filesystem::u8path(files.at(height_id))).lexically_normal());used.insert(relative.parent_path()/stem/"pda_map_H.dds");
    }
    if(!out.meshes.empty())used.insert(mesh_relative);
    for(const auto& group:out.groups)for(int id:group.materials){auto found=out.materials.find(id);if(found!=out.materials.end()){if(!found->second.texture.empty())used.insert(found->second.texture);if(!found->second.original_shader.empty())used.insert(found->second.original_shader);}}
    for(const auto& layer:out.layers){used.insert(layer.detail);used.insert(layer.weight);}
    out.used_resources.assign(used.begin(),used.end());
    return out;
}
Terrain load_terrain(const std::filesystem::path& root,const std::string& map_id){
    if(map_id!="Map01"&&map_id!="Map02")throw std::runtime_error("Only Map01 and Map02 are currently supported");
    return load_scene_impl(root,map_id,std::filesystem::path("data/maps")/(map_id=="Map01"?"map01.i3d":"map02.i3d"),true);
}
Terrain load_scene(const std::filesystem::path& root,const std::filesystem::path& relative,bool dynamic_visibility){return load_scene_impl(root,"",relative,false,dynamic_visibility);}
void update_transforms(Terrain& scene,const Matrix& root){
    for(auto& node:scene.nodes){float local[16];
        if(!fs15_compose_trs(node.rotation,node.scale,node.translation,local,16))throw std::runtime_error("Recovered animated TRS composition failed");
        const float* parent=node.parent>=0?scene.nodes[node.parent].world:root.value;
        if(!fs15_affine_multiply(parent,16,local,16,node.world,16))throw std::runtime_error("Recovered animated hierarchy composition failed");
    }
    update_visibility(scene);
}
void update_visibility(Terrain& scene){
    for(auto& node:scene.nodes)node.visible=node.local_visible&&node.lod_visible&&(node.parent<0||scene.nodes[node.parent].visible);
    for(auto& group:scene.groups){group.instances.clear();for(int index:group.nodes)if(scene.nodes[index].visible){Matrix matrix;std::copy(scene.nodes[index].world,scene.nodes[index].world+16,matrix.value);group.instances.push_back(matrix);}}
}
float terrain_height(const Terrain& t,float x,float z){
    if(t.heights.empty())throw std::runtime_error("Terrain height service unavailable");
    const float px=std::clamp(x/t.units_per_pixel+(t.source_width-1)*0.5f,0.0f,float(t.source_width-1)),pz=std::clamp(z/t.units_per_pixel+(t.source_height-1)*0.5f,0.0f,float(t.source_height-1));
    const unsigned ix=unsigned(px),iz=unsigned(pz);const float a=px-ix,b=pz-iz;
    auto at=[&](unsigned xx,unsigned zz){return t.heights[size_t(std::min(zz,t.source_height-1))*t.source_width+std::min(xx,t.source_width-1)]*t.height_scale/65535.0f;};
    return (1-b)*((1-a)*at(ix,iz)+a*at(ix+1,iz))+b*((1-a)*at(ix,iz+1)+a*at(ix+1,iz+1));
}
static std::uint32_t u32(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes,size_t offset) {
    if(offset+4>bytes.size())throw std::runtime_error("Truncated DDS header");
    return bytes[offset]|(bytes[offset+1]<<8)|(bytes[offset+2]<<16)|(std::uint32_t(bytes[offset+3])<<24);
}
Texture load_dds(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream file(path,std::ios::binary);if(!file)throw std::runtime_error("Missing terrain overview DDS");
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file)),{});
    if(bytes.size()<128||u32(bytes,0)!=0x20534444||u32(bytes,4)!=124||u32(bytes,76)!=32)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid terrain DDS");
    Texture out;out.width=u32(bytes,16);out.height=u32(bytes,12);auto fourcc=u32(bytes,84);
    if(!out.width||!out.height||out.width>8192||out.height>8192)throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported terrain texture dimensions");
    if(fourcc==0x31545844)out.compression=1;else if(fourcc==0x33545844)out.compression=2;else if(fourcc==0x35545844)out.compression=3;
    else throw std::runtime_error("Terrain overview must be DXT1/DXT3/DXT5");
    unsigned mip_count=std::max(1u,u32(bytes,28)),w=out.width,h=out.height;size_t size=0;
    if(mip_count>14)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid DDS mip count");
    for(unsigned mip=0;mip<mip_count;++mip) {
        unsigned pitch=((w+3)/4)*(out.compression==1?8:16);
        out.mip_offsets.push_back(static_cast<unsigned>(size));out.mip_pitches.push_back(pitch);
        size+=size_t(pitch)*((h+3)/4);w=std::max(1u,w/2);h=std::max(1u,h/2);
    }
    out.row_pitch=out.mip_pitches[0];
    if(bytes.size()<128+size)throw std::runtime_error("Truncated terrain DDS mip");
    out.bytes.assign(bytes.begin()+128,bytes.begin()+128+size);return out;
}
void save_png(const std::filesystem::path& path,unsigned width,unsigned height,const std::uint8_t* bgra,unsigned pitch) {
    auto factory=wic();ComPtr<IWICStream> stream;ComPtr<IWICBitmapEncoder> encoder;ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameEncode> frame;
    check(factory->CreateStream(&stream),"PNG stream");check(stream->InitializeFromFilename(path.c_str(),GENERIC_WRITE),"PNG output");
    check(factory->CreateEncoder(GUID_ContainerFormatPng,nullptr,&encoder),"PNG encoder");check(encoder->Initialize(stream.Get(),WICBitmapEncoderNoCache),"PNG init");
    check(encoder->CreateNewFrame(&frame,nullptr),"PNG frame");check(frame->Initialize(nullptr),"PNG frame init");check(frame->SetSize(width,height),"PNG size");
    auto format=GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA;check(frame->SetPixelFormat(&format),"PNG format");
    if(!IsEqualGUID(format,GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA))throw std::runtime_error("PNG output format changed");
    check(frame->WritePixels(height,pitch,pitch*height,const_cast<BYTE*>(bgra)),"PNG pixels");check(frame->Commit(),"PNG frame commit");check(encoder->Commit(),"PNG commit");
}
}
```

```cpp
cbuffer Material:register(b1){float4 tint;float4 animationParams;float4 effectInfo;};

    }
};
```

```cpp
XMMATRIX ShadowRenderer::update(ID3D11DeviceContext* c,const EnvironmentSample& e,const XMFLOAT3& eye,const XMFLOAT3& forward,float time,bool enabled){
    impl->enabled=enabled&&impl->sun.shadows;
    const float distance=impl->sun.distance,extrusion=impl->sun.extrusion;
    auto center=XMVectorSet(eye.x+forward.x*distance*0.5f,eye.y+forward.y*distance*0.5f,eye.z+forward.z*distance*0.5f,1);
    auto light=XMVector3Normalize(XMLoadFloat3(&e.light));auto position=center+light*(extrusion+distance);
    auto up=std::abs(e.light.y)>0.98f?XMVectorSet(1,0,0,0):XMVectorSet(0,1,0,0);
    auto vp=XMMatrixLookAtRH(position,center,up)*XMMatrixOrthographicRH(distance*2,distance*2,1,(extrusion+distance)*2);
    struct Data{XMFLOAT4X4 matrix;XMFLOAT4 light,diffuse,ambient,fog,frame;} data;
    XMStoreFloat4x4(&data.matrix,vp);data.light={e.light.x,e.light.y,e.light.z,0};data.diffuse=e.diffuse;data.ambient=e.ambient;data.fog=e.fog;
    // Original bias is adapted to this single-map D3D depth range; its exact
    // GIANTS cascade/bias mapping has not been recovered.
    data.frame={time,impl->enabled?1.0f:0.0f,1.0f/impl->sun.resolution,std::clamp(impl->sun.bias*0.02f,0.00001f,0.0001f)};
    c->UpdateSubresource(impl->constants.Get(),0,nullptr,&data,0,0);auto b=impl->constants.Get();c->VSSetConstantBuffers(2,1,&b);c->PSSetConstantBuffers(2,1,&b);return vp;
}
```

`src/engine/simulation_clock.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <stdexcept>

// Authored host scheduling, not a recovered GE6 physics tick implementation.
// Rendering may vary; every gameplay update receives the same time quantum.
class SimulationClock {
    double remainder_=0, discarded_=0;
    std::uint64_t ticks_=0;
    bool paused_=false;
public:
    static constexpr double step_seconds=1.0/60.0;
    static constexpr double maximum_frame_seconds=0.25;
    unsigned advance(double elapsed) {
        if(!std::isfinite(elapsed)||elapsed<0)throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid simulation elapsed time");
        if(paused_)return 0;
        const double accepted=std::min(elapsed,maximum_frame_seconds);
        discarded_+=elapsed-accepted;
        remainder_+=accepted;
        // Tolerate rounding of repeated fractions (e.g. 1/144), not a missing tick.
        const auto steps=unsigned(std::floor((remainder_+step_seconds*1e-9)/step_seconds));
        remainder_=std::max(0.0,remainder_-steps*step_seconds);
        ticks_+=steps;
        return steps;
    }
    void set_paused(bool value) {
        if(value!=paused_)remainder_=0; // No suspended time or fractional debt on resume.
        paused_=value;
    }
    bool paused()const{return paused_;}
    std::uint64_t ticks()const{return ticks_;}
    double discarded_seconds()const{return discarded_;}
};
```

`src/ge6/physics_world.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "physics_world.h"
#include "physics_vehicle_sort.h"
#include <BulletCollision/CollisionDispatch/btCollisionObjectWrapper.h>
#include <BulletCollision/BroadphaseCollision/btCollisionAlgorithm.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>
namespace fs15::ge6 {
// 0x14027f620 / 0x14027f590: GE6 removes ordinary sleeping pairs. Retaining
// stock Bullet's callback leaves stale manifolds after bodies go to sleep.
void Dispatcher::dispatchAllCollisionPairs(btOverlappingPairCache* cache,const btDispatcherInfo& info,btDispatcher* dispatcher){
    struct Callback final:btOverlapCallback {
        Dispatcher& owner;const btDispatcherInfo& info;
        Callback(Dispatcher& d,const btDispatcherInfo& i):owner(d),info(i){}
        bool processOverlap(btBroadphasePair& pair) override{
            auto* a=static_cast<btCollisionObject*>(pair.m_pProxy0->m_clientObject);
            auto* b=static_cast<btCollisionObject*>(pair.m_pProxy1->m_clientObject);
            if(!a->isActive()&&!b->isActive())return a->hasContactResponse()&&b->hasContactResponse();
            near_callback(pair,owner,info);return false;
        }
    } callback(*this,info);
    cache->processAllOverlappingPairs(&callback,dispatcher);
}
void near_callback(btBroadphasePair& pair,btCollisionDispatcher& dispatcher,const btDispatcherInfo& info){
    auto* a=static_cast<btCollisionObject*>(pair.m_pProxy0->m_clientObject);
    auto* b=static_cast<btCollisionObject*>(pair.m_pProxy1->m_clientObject);
    if((!a->isActive()&&!b->isActive())||!a->checkCollideWith(b)||!b->checkCollideWith(a))return;
    btCollisionObjectWrapper wa(nullptr,a->getCollisionShape(),a,a->getWorldTransform(),-1,-1);
    btCollisionObjectWrapper wb(nullptr,b->getCollisionShape(),b,b->getWorldTransform(),-1,-1);
    if(!pair.m_algorithm)pair.m_algorithm=dispatcher.findAlgorithm(&wa,&wb);
    if(!pair.m_algorithm)return;
    btManifoldResult result(&wa,&wb);
    btDispatcherInfo current=info;
    if(!a->hasContactResponse()||!b->hasContactResponse())current.m_enableSatConvex=false;
    pair.m_algorithm->processCollision(&wa,&wb,current,&result);
}
// 0x14027e570: retain the inclusive interval selected by first/last body island.
btScalar Solver::solveGroupCacheFriendlySetup(btCollisionObject** bodies,int nb,btPersistentManifold** m,int nm,btTypedConstraint** c,int nc,const btContactSolverInfo& info,btIDebugDraw* debug){
    const btScalar result=btSequentialImpulseConstraintSolver::solveGroupCacheFriendlySetup(bodies,nb,m,nm,c,nc,info,debug);
    count_=0;
    const int total=vehicles_->size();if(nb<1||total<1)return result;
    const int first=bodies[0]->getIslandTag(),last=bodies[nb-1]->getIslandTag();start_=total;
    for(int i=0;i<total;++i){const int tag=(*vehicles_)[i]->island();if(first<=tag&&tag<=last){start_=i;break;}}
    for(int i=start_;i<total;++i){auto* v=(*vehicles_)[i];const int tag=v->island();if(tag<first||last<tag)break;++count_;v->setup(m_tmpSolverBodyPool,info);}
    return result;
}
// 0x14027e6e0 and 0x14027e7e0: vehicle constraints run before base solver work.
btScalar Solver::solveSingleIteration(int iteration,btCollisionObject** b,int nb,btPersistentManifold** m,int nm,btTypedConstraint** c,int nc,const btContactSolverInfo& info,btIDebugDraw* debug){
    for(int i=0;i<count_;++i)(*vehicles_)[start_+i]->velocity(m_tmpSolverBodyPool,info.m_timeStep);
    return btSequentialImpulseConstraintSolver::solveSingleIteration(iteration,b,nb,m,nm,c,nc,info,debug);
}
btScalar Solver::solveGroupCacheFriendlyFinish(btCollisionObject** b,int n,const btContactSolverInfo& info){
    for(int i=0;i<count_;++i)(*vehicles_)[start_+i]->finish(m_tmpSolverBodyPool,info.m_timeStep);
    return btSequentialImpulseConstraintSolver::solveGroupCacheFriendlyFinish(b,n,info);
}
// 0x14027e890. One base iteration per native outer iteration, with the vehicle
// penetration callbacks interleaved; stock Bullet's complete loop would reorder them.
void Solver::solveGroupCacheFriendlySplitImpulseIterations(btCollisionObject** b,int nb,btPersistentManifold** m,int nm,btTypedConstraint** c,int nc,const btContactSolverInfo& info,btIDebugDraw* debug){
    if(!info.m_splitImpulse)return;
    auto one=info;one.m_numIterations=1;
    for(int j=0;j<info.m_numIterations;++j){
        for(int i=0;i<count_;++i)(*vehicles_)[start_+i]->penetration(m_tmpSolverBodyPool,info.m_timeStep);
        btSequentialImpulseConstraintSolver::solveGroupCacheFriendlySplitImpulseIterations(b,nb,m,nm,c,nc,one,debug);
    }
}
World::World(btDispatcher* d,btBroadphaseInterface* b,Solver* s,btCollisionConfiguration* c):btDiscreteDynamicsWorld(d,b,s,c){}
// 0x14027ea00; profiling transport is intentionally excluded.
void World::performDiscreteCollisionDetection(){for(int i=0,n=vehicles_.size();i<n;++i)vehicles_[i]->collide(*this);btDiscreteDynamicsWorld::performDiscreteCollisionDetection();}
// 0x14027eb00. GE6 additionally requires an active endpoint for both joins.
void World::calculateSimulationIslands(){
    auto* islands=getSimulationIslandManager();islands->updateActivationState(this,getDispatcher());
    auto join=[&](const btCollisionObject* a,const btCollisionObject* b){
        if(a&&b&&!a->isStaticOrKinematicObject()&&!b->isStaticOrKinematicObject()&&(a->isActive()||b->isActive()))islands->getUnionFind().unite(a->getIslandTag(),b->getIslandTag());
    };
    for(int i=0;i<m_predictiveManifolds.size();++i){auto* m=m_predictiveManifolds[i];join(m->getBody0(),m->getBody1());}
    for(int i=0,n=m_constraints.size();i<n;++i){auto* c=m_constraints[i];if(c->isEnabled())join(&c->getRigidBodyA(),&c->getRigidBodyB());}
    for(int i=0,n=vehicles_.size();i<n;++i)vehicles_[i]->unite_islands(*islands);
    islands->storeIslandActivationState(this);
}
// 0x14027ed40, including native equal-key swap order.
void World::solveConstraints(btContactSolverInfo& info){
    if(vehicles_.size()>1){
        // Explicit token staging avoids aliasing a C++ array of derived pointers.
        std::vector<uintptr_t> tokens;tokens.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(vehicles_.size()));
        for(int i=0;i<vehicles_.size();++i)tokens.push_back(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(vehicles_[i]));
        if(!fs15_physics_vehicle_sort(tokens.data(),tokens.size(),[](void*,uintptr_t token){return reinterpret_cast<VehicleSolver*>(token)->island();},nullptr))throw std::runtime_error("Invalid GE6 vehicle solver list");
        for(int i=0;i<vehicles_.size();++i)vehicles_[i]=reinterpret_cast<VehicleSolver*>(tokens[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
    }
    btDiscreteDynamicsWorld::solveConstraints(info);
}
void World::add_vehicle_solver(VehicleSolver& v){if(vehicles_.findLinearSearch(&v)!=vehicles_.size())throw std::runtime_error("Duplicate GE6 vehicle solver");vehicles_.push_back(&v);}
void World::remove_vehicle_solver(VehicleSolver& v){vehicles_.remove(&v);}
PhysicsWorld::PhysicsWorld(const btVector3& gravity){
    btDefaultCollisionConstructionInfo ci;ci.m_customCollisionAlgorithmMaxElementSize=0x30;
    configuration_=std::make_unique<btDefaultCollisionConfiguration>(ci);
    dispatcher_=std::make_unique<Dispatcher>(configuration_.get());dispatcher_->setNearCallback(near_callback);
    broadphase_=std::make_unique<btDbvtBroadphase>();
    solver_=std::make_unique<Solver>();
    world_=std::make_unique<World>(dispatcher_.get(),broadphase_.get(),solver_.get(),configuration_.get());
    // Rebind without exposing a partially constructed world through callbacks.
    solver_->vehicles_=&world_->vehicle_solvers();
    world_->setGravity(gravity);
}
PhysicsWorld::~PhysicsWorld(){
    // Objects/constraints belong to the scene owner and must be detached first.
    // A nonempty world is a caller contract error, not ownership of its bodies.
}
```
