```cpp
#include "raycast_vehicle.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace fs15::ge6 {
namespace {
btVector3 rotate(const btMatrix3x3& m,const btVector3& v){return btVector3((v.x()*m[0][0]+v.y()*m[0][1])+v.z()*m[0][2],(v.x()*m[1][0]+v.y()*m[1][1])+v.z()*m[1][2],(v.x()*m[2][0]+v.y()*m[2][1])+v.z()*m[2][2]);}
void zero_fixed(btSolverBody& s){const btVector3 z(0,0,0);s.m_worldTransform.setIdentity();s.m_deltaLinearVelocity=z;s.m_deltaAngularVelocity=z;s.m_angularFactor=z;s.m_linearFactor=z;s.m_invMass=z;s.m_pushVelocity=z;s.m_turnVelocity=z;s.m_linearVelocity=z;s.m_angularVelocity=z;s.m_externalForceImpulse=z;s.m_externalTorqueImpulse=z;s.m_originalBody=nullptr;}
}
btVector3 steered_wheel_axle(const btVector3& direction,const btVector3& axle,float angle){
    const float half=angle*.5f,x=-direction.x(),y=-direction.y(),z=-direction.z();
    const float scale=std::sin(half)/std::sqrt((x*x+y*y)+z*z),qx=scale*x,qy=scale*y,qz=scale*z,qw=std::cos(half);
    const float tx=(axle.z()*qy+axle.x()*qw)-axle.y()*qz,ty=(axle.x()*qz+axle.y()*qw)-axle.z()*qx,tz=(axle.y()*qx+axle.z()*qw)-axle.x()*qy;
    const float tw=((-axle.x()*qx)-axle.y()*qy)-axle.z()*qz;
    return btVector3(((-qx*tw+tx*qw)+(-qz)*ty)-tz*(-qy),
                     (((-qy)*tw+ty*qw)+tz*(-qx))-(-qz)*tx,
                     (((-qz)*tw+tz*qw)+(-qy)*tx)-ty*(-qx));
}
void wheel_tangent_frame(const btVector3& n,const btVector3& axle,btVector3& longitudinal,btVector3& lateral){
    longitudinal.setValue(axle.y()*n.z()-axle.z()*n.y(),n.x()*axle.z()-axle.x()*n.z(),axle.x()*n.y()-n.x()*axle.y());
    float inverse=1.f/std::sqrt((longitudinal.x()*longitudinal.x()+longitudinal.y()*longitudinal.y())+longitudinal.z()*longitudinal.z());
    longitudinal.setValue(inverse*longitudinal.x(),inverse*longitudinal.y(),inverse*longitudinal.z());
    lateral.setValue(n.y()*longitudinal.z()-n.z()*longitudinal.y(),n.z()*longitudinal.x()-longitudinal.z()*n.x(),longitudinal.y()*n.x()-n.y()*longitudinal.x());
    inverse=1.f/std::sqrt((lateral.x()*lateral.x()+lateral.y()*lateral.y())+lateral.z()*lateral.z());lateral.setValue(lateral.x()*inverse,lateral.y()*inverse,lateral.z()*inverse);
}
RaycastVehicle::RaycastVehicle(World& world,std::vector<btRigidBody*> bodies):world_(world),bodies_(std::move(bodies)){
    if(bodies_.empty()||bodies_.size()>6)throw std::invalid_argument("GE6 vehicle needs 1..6 dynamic bodies");
    for(auto* b:bodies_){if(!b||b->isStaticOrKinematicObject())throw std::invalid_argument("GE6 vehicle body is not dynamic");
        if(world.getCollisionObjectArray().findLinearSearch(b)==world.getCollisionObjectArray().size())throw std::invalid_argument("Add GE6 vehicle bodies to this world before registration");}
    zero_fixed(fixed_);
}
unsigned RaycastVehicle::add_wheel(const RaycastWheelConfig& c){
    if(config_.size()>=20||c.body>=bodies_.size()||c.suspension.direction.length2()==0||c.suspension.direction.cross(c.axle).length2()==0||c.suspension.radius<=0||c.inverse_inertia<=0)throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid GE6 wheel configuration");
    // The native record has one shared radius/rest/compression field. Normalize
    // their typed adapter views once rather than permit inconsistent copies.
    auto normalized=c;normalized.tire.radius=c.suspension.radius;normalized.spring.rest=c.suspension.rest;normalized.spring.compression=c.suspension.compression;
    const auto index=static_cast<unsigned>(config_.size());config_.push_back(normalized);return index;
}
void RaycastVehicle::set_differentials(std::vector<Differential> nodes){
    if(nodes.size()>20)throw std::invalid_argument("GE6 differential scratch limit is 20");
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<nodes.size();++i)for(auto child:{nodes[i].a,nodes[i].b})if(child<20?child>=config_.size():child-20>=i)throw std::invalid_argument("GE6 differential child must be an existing wheel or earlier node");
    differentials_=std::move(nodes);
}
int RaycastVehicle::island()const{return bodies_[0]->getIslandTag();}
void RaycastVehicle::unite_islands(btSimulationIslandManager& manager){
    auto& uf=manager.getUnionFind();for(std::size_t i=1;i<bodies_.size();++i)uf.unite(bodies_[0]->getIslandTag(),bodies_[i]->getIslandTag());
    if(active_)for(std::size_t i=0;i<config_.size();++i)if(contacts_[i].body&&!contacts_[i].body->isStaticOrKinematicObject())uf.unite(bodies_[config_[i].body]->getIslandTag(),contacts_[i].body->getIslandTag());
}
void RaycastVehicle::collide(World& world){
    bool wake=motor_.torque!=0;for(const auto& c:config_)if(c.drive_mode<0&&c.direct_torque!=0)wake=true;
    if(wake)for(auto* b:bodies_)b->activate();
    else{bool sleeping=true;for(auto* b:bodies_)if(b->getActivationState()!=ISLAND_SLEEPING)sleeping=false;if(sleeping){active_=false;return;}}
    active_=true;for(std::size_t i=0;i<config_.size();++i)contacts_[i]=raycast_wheel(config_[i].suspension,*bodies_[config_[i].body],world);
}
void RaycastVehicle::sync_drive(){for(std::size_t i=0;i<config_.size();++i){driven_[i].radius=config_[i].tire.radius;driven_[i].inverse_inertia=config_[i].inverse_inertia;driven_[i].speed=wheels_[i].speed;}}
void RaycastVehicle::drive(float dt){sync_drive();solve_drivetrain(driven_.data(),differentials_.data(),differentials_.size(),motor_,dt);for(std::size_t i=0;i<config_.size();++i)wheels_[i].speed=driven_[i].speed;}
void RaycastVehicle::setup(btAlignedObjectArray<btSolverBody>& pool,const btContactSolverInfo& info){
    if(bodies_[0]->getActivationState()==ISLAND_SLEEPING)return;
    const bool refresh=!active_;if(refresh){for(std::size_t i=0;i<config_.size();++i)contacts_[i]=raycast_wheel(config_[i].suspension,*bodies_[config_[i].body],world_);active_=true;}
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<config_.size();++i){const auto& c=config_[i];auto& w=wheels_[i];auto& hit=contacts_[i];
        w.slip_longitudinal=0;w.slip_lateral=0;w.friction_floor=.25f;w.suspension.impulse=0;w.correction_impulse=0;w.suspension.push_impulse=0;w.lateral.impulse=0;w.longitudinal.impulse=0;w.brake_impulse=0;
        const float factor=info.m_timeStep*c.inverse_inertia;if(c.drive_mode<0)w.speed=factor*c.direct_torque+w.speed;w.speed/=factor*c.damping+1.f;
        w.tire=c.tire;w.inverse_inertia=c.inverse_inertia;w.brake=c.brake;w.mass_load=c.mass_load;w.contact=hit.body!=nullptr;hit.length=c.suspension.rest+c.suspension.droop;
        if(!hit.body)continue;
        auto& body=*bodies_[c.body];const auto* other=btRigidBody::upcast(hit.body);auto& a=pool[body.getCompanionId()];auto& b=other->getCompanionId()<0||refresh?fixed_:pool[other->getCompanionId()];w.a=&a;w.b=&b;w.normal=hit.normal;
        btVector3 from,direction;wheel_ray_frame(c.suspension,a.m_worldTransform,from,direction);
        const auto axle=rotate(a.m_worldTransform.getBasis(),steered_wheel_axle(c.suspension.direction,c.axle,c.steering));const auto lever=rotate(a.m_worldTransform.getBasis(),c.force_lever);
        const float length=(((hit.point.x()-from.x())*direction.x()+direction.y()*(hit.point.y()-from.y()))+direction.z()*(hit.point.z()-from.z()))-c.tire.radius;
        float limit=c.suspension.rest-c.suspension.compression;if(limit<=length){limit=c.suspension.rest+c.suspension.droop;if(length<=limit)limit=length;}hit.length=limit;
        setup_suspension_constraint(w.suspension,direction,hit.point,hit.normal,lever,length,c.spring,body,*other,a,b,info);
        btVector3 longitudinal,lateral;wheel_tangent_frame(hit.normal,axle,longitudinal,lateral);
        const auto lat=setup_wheel_jacobian(w.lateral.jacobian,lateral,hit.point,lateral,lever,body,*other,a,b);
        w.lateral.diagonal=1.f/(lat.denominator_a+lat.denominator_b);w.lateral.rhs=(lat.velocity_b-lat.velocity_a)*w.lateral.diagonal;
        const auto lon=setup_wheel_jacobian(w.longitudinal.jacobian,longitudinal,hit.point,longitudinal,lever,body,*other,a,b);
        w.longitudinal.diagonal=1.f/(((c.tire.radius*c.inverse_inertia)*c.tire.radius+lon.denominator_a)+lon.denominator_b);w.longitudinal.rhs=(lon.velocity_b-lon.velocity_a)*w.longitudinal.diagonal;
        const float lateral_speed=lat.velocity_a-lat.velocity_b,abs_lateral=std::abs(lateral_speed),signed_speed=lon.velocity_a-lon.velocity_b;
        float speed=std::abs(signed_speed),rim=c.tire.radius*w.speed;if(signed_speed<0)rim=-rim;
        w.slip_lateral=abs_lateral<speed*570.f?lateral_speed/speed:(lateral_speed<0?-570.f:570.f);
        if(speed<rim)w.slip_longitudinal=rim-speed<rim?(rim-speed)/rim:1.f;else w.slip_longitudinal=speed-rim<speed?(speed-rim)/speed:1.f;
        if(.2f<=speed){if(abs_lateral<.05f){const float bias=0<=w.slip_lateral?.36f:-.36f;w.slip_lateral=(w.slip_lateral-bias)*(abs_lateral/.05f)+bias;}}
        else{const float bias=0<=w.slip_longitudinal?.2f:-.2f,latbias=0<=w.slip_lateral?.36f:-.36f;w.slip_lateral=(w.slip_lateral-latbias)*(speed/.2f)+latbias;w.slip_longitudinal=(w.slip_longitudinal-bias)*(speed/.2f)+bias;}
        if(speed<abs_lateral)speed=abs_lateral;if(speed<.05f)w.friction_floor=.9f-(speed/.05f)*.65f;
        penetration_[i].constraint=&w.suspension;penetration_[i].a=&a;penetration_[i].b=&b;penetration_[i].normal=hit.normal;
    }
    motor_.torque_impulse=0;motor_.clutch_impulse=0;const float damping=motor_.torque==0||motor_.target_speed<=motor_.speed?motor_.damping:0.f;
    motor_.speed/=((damping*motor_.inverse_inertia)*info.m_timeStep)+1.f;sync_drive();prepare_differentials(driven_.data(),differentials_.data(),differentials_.size(),motor_);
}
void RaycastVehicle::velocity(btAlignedObjectArray<btSolverBody>&,btScalar dt){
    WheelVelocityServices services;services.context=this;services.drive=[](void* p,float t){static_cast<RaycastVehicle*>(p)->drive(t);};services.gravity=[](void* p){return static_cast<RaycastVehicle*>(p)->world_.getGravity();};solve_wheel_velocity(wheels_.data(),config_.size(),bodies_[0]->getActivationState(),active_,dt,services);
}
void RaycastVehicle::penetration(btAlignedObjectArray<btSolverBody>&,btScalar){
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<config_.size();++i)penetration_[i].contact=contacts_[i].body!=nullptr;solve_wheel_penetration(penetration_.data(),config_.size(),bodies_[0]->getActivationState(),active_);
}
void RaycastVehicle::finish(btAlignedObjectArray<btSolverBody>&,btScalar dt){
    // The earlier finish transport's inferred names precede recovery of the
    // velocity phase: native public slip[0] reads record +0x10 (lateral),
    // while slip[1] reads +0x14 (longitudinal). Preserve those native lanes.
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<config_.size();++i){finished_[i].speed=wheels_[i].speed;finished_[i].normal_impulse=wheels_[i].suspension.impulse;finished_[i].longitudinal_slip=wheels_[i].slip_lateral;finished_[i].lateral_slip=wheels_[i].slip_longitudinal;}
    finish_wheels(finished_.data(),config_.size(),bodies_[0]->getActivationState(),active_,dt,motor_.torque_impulse,motor_.inverse_inertia,motor_output_);
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include "physics_world.h"
#include "vehicle_wheel.h"
#include "vehicle_velocity.h"
#include "vehicle_drive.h"
#include <array>
#include <vector>
namespace fs15::ge6 {
struct RaycastWheelConfig {
    WheelSuspension suspension;
    btVector3 axle{1,0,0},force_lever{0,0,0};
    SuspensionSpring spring;
    fs15::TireParameters tire{.5f,5,1,5,1};
    float inverse_inertia=1,damping=0,mass_load=0,steering=0,brake=0,direct_torque=0,drive_mode=0;
    unsigned body=0;
};
// Bt2RaycastVehicle's inspected phases over typed Bullet bodies. Ownership,
// storage and configuration are authored adapters; original XML/script body,
// wheel and joint creation must still feed this class. Stop the worker and
// unregister from World before destruction/configuration changes.
class RaycastVehicle final:public VehicleSolver {
    World& world_;std::vector<btRigidBody*> bodies_;std::vector<RaycastWheelConfig> config_;
    std::vector<Differential> differentials_;
    std::array<WheelVelocity,20> wheels_{};std::array<WheelContact,20> contacts_{};
    std::array<PenetrationWheel,20> penetration_{};std::array<WheelFinish,20> finished_{};
    std::array<DriveWheel,20> driven_{};btSolverBody fixed_{};
    VehicleMotor motor_;bool active_=false;float motor_output_=0;
    void sync_drive();void drive(float);
public:
    explicit RaycastVehicle(World&,std::vector<btRigidBody*>);
    unsigned add_wheel(const RaycastWheelConfig&);
    void set_differentials(std::vector<Differential>);
    RaycastWheelConfig& wheel_config(unsigned i){return config_.at(i);}
    const WheelVelocity& wheel_state(unsigned i)const{return wheels_.at(i);}
    const WheelContact& contact(unsigned i)const{return contacts_.at(i);}
    const WheelFinish& readback(unsigned i)const{return finished_.at(i);}
    VehicleMotor& motor(){return motor_;}
    float motor_output()const{return motor_output_;}
    std::size_t wheel_count()const{return config_.size();}
    void unite_islands(btSimulationIslandManager&)override;
    int island()const override;
    void collide(World&)override;
    void setup(btAlignedObjectArray<btSolverBody>&,const btContactSolverInfo&)override;

    void penetration(btAlignedObjectArray<btSolverBody>&,btScalar)override;
    void finish(btAlignedObjectArray<btSolverBody>&,btScalar)override;
};
```

```cpp
#include "vehicle_constraint.h"

namespace fs15::ge6 {
namespace {
btVector3 inertia_component(const btRigidBody& b,const btVector3& v,bool first_row_xy){
    const auto& m=b.getInvInertiaTensorWorld();const auto& f=b.getAngularFactor();
    return btVector3(f.x()*(first_row_xy?((m[0][0]*v.x()+m[0][1]*v.y())+m[0][2]*v.z()):((v.y()*m[0][1]+v.x()*m[0][0])+v.z()*m[0][2])),
                    f.y()*((v.y()*m[1][1]+v.x()*m[1][0])+v.z()*m[1][2]),
                    f.z()*((v.y()*m[2][1]+v.x()*m[2][0])+v.z()*m[2][2]));
}
}
WheelJacobianStats setup_wheel_jacobian(WheelJacobian& j,const btVector3& n,const btVector3& p,const btVector3& application,const btVector3& lever,
    const btRigidBody& a,const btRigidBody& b,const btSolverBody& sa,const btSolverBody& sb){
    const auto ra=p-sa.m_worldTransform.getOrigin(),rb=p-sb.m_worldTransform.getOrigin();
    const btVector3 aa(n.z()*ra.y()-n.y()*ra.z(),n.x()*ra.z()-n.z()*ra.x(),n.y()*ra.x()-n.x()*ra.y());
    const btVector3 ab(n.y()*rb.z()-n.z()*rb.y(),n.z()*rb.x()-n.x()*rb.z(),n.x()*rb.y()-n.y()*rb.x());
    const auto ia=inertia_component(a,aa,true),ib=inertia_component(b,ab,false);
    WheelJacobianStats s;
    s.denominator_a=((n.y()*(ia.z()*ra.x()-ra.z()*ia.x())+n.x()*(ia.y()*ra.z()-ia.z()*ra.y()))+n.z()*(ra.y()*ia.x()-ia.y()*ra.x()))+a.getInvMass();
    s.denominator_b=b.getInvMass()-((n.y()*(ib.z()*rb.x()-rb.z()*ib.x())+n.x()*(ib.y()*rb.z()-ib.z()*rb.y()))+n.z()*(rb.y()*ib.x()-ib.y()*rb.x()));
    s.velocity_a=((((aa.y()*sa.m_angularVelocity.y()+aa.x()*sa.m_angularVelocity.x())+aa.z()*sa.m_angularVelocity.z())
        +n.y()*(sa.m_externalForceImpulse.y()+sa.m_linearVelocity.y()))+n.x()*(sa.m_externalForceImpulse.x()+sa.m_linearVelocity.x()))
        +(sa.m_externalForceImpulse.z()+sa.m_linearVelocity.z())*n.z();
    s.velocity_b=((n.y()*(sb.m_linearVelocity.y()+sb.m_externalForceImpulse.y())+n.x()*(sb.m_linearVelocity.x()+sb.m_externalForceImpulse.x()))
        +(sb.m_linearVelocity.z()+sb.m_externalForceImpulse.z())*n.z())-((ab.y()*sb.m_angularVelocity.y()+ab.x()*sb.m_angularVelocity.x())+ab.z()*sb.m_angularVelocity.z());
    j.component_a=inertia_component(a,lever.cross(application),true);
    j.component_b=inertia_component(b,rb.cross(application),false);
    j.angular_a=aa;j.angular_b=ab;j.axis=n;
    j.projection=(n.x()*application.x()+application.y()*n.y())+application.z()*n.z();
    return s;
}
void setup_suspension_constraint(SuspensionConstraint& c,const btVector3& axis,const btVector3& point,const btVector3& contact_normal,const btVector3& lever,float length,const SuspensionSpring& spring,
    const btRigidBody& a,const btRigidBody& b,const btSolverBody& sa,const btSolverBody& sb,const btContactSolverInfo& info){
    const auto s=setup_wheel_jacobian(c.jacobian,axis,point,contact_normal,lever,a,b,sa,sb);
    float relative=s.velocity_a-s.velocity_b;
    const float damping=relative<=0?spring.nonpositive_velocity_damping:spring.positive_velocity_damping;
    const float spring_dt=info.m_timeStep*spring.stiffness;
    float damping_force=damping*relative;
    const float softness=1.f/((spring_dt+damping)*info.m_timeStep);
    // The instruction stream sums the two body terms before adding softness;
    // Ghidra's expression loses that association near cancelling terms.
    const float body_sum=s.denominator_a+s.denominator_b;
    const float diagonal=1.f/(softness+body_sum);
    c.diagonal=diagonal;c.cfm=diagonal*softness;
    length-=spring.rest;relative=-relative;
    c.rhs=(length*(spring_dt*softness))*diagonal+diagonal*relative;
    if(damping_force<0)damping_force=0;
    c.lower_limit=-((spring.stiffness*spring.compression+damping_force)*info.m_timeStep);
    length+=spring.compression;
    if(.03999999910593033f<=length){c.push_diagonal=0;c.correction_rhs=0;c.push_rhs=0;}
    else{
        c.push_diagonal=1.f/body_sum;
        if(!info.m_splitImpulse||(info.m_splitImpulsePenetrationThreshold<=length&&length!=info.m_splitImpulsePenetrationThreshold)){
            c.push_rhs=0;c.correction_rhs=((length*info.m_erp)/info.m_timeStep+relative)*c.push_diagonal;
        }else{
            c.correction_rhs=c.push_diagonal*relative;c.push_rhs=((length*info.m_erp2)/info.m_timeStep)*c.push_diagonal;
        }
    }
}
void solve_wheel_penetration(PenetrationWheel* wheels,std::size_t count,int activation,bool active){
    if(activation==ISLAND_SLEEPING||!active)return;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){auto& w=wheels[i];if(!w.contact)continue;auto& c=*w.constraint;if(c.push_rhs==0)continue;
        auto& a=*w.a;auto& b=*w.b;const auto& j=c.jacobian;
        float relative=(((j.angular_b.y()*b.m_turnVelocity.y()+b.m_turnVelocity.x()*j.angular_b.x())+j.angular_b.z()*b.m_turnVelocity.z())
            -((j.axis.x()*b.m_pushVelocity.x()+j.axis.y()*b.m_pushVelocity.y())+j.axis.z()*b.m_pushVelocity.z()));
        relative+=j.angular_a.y()*a.m_turnVelocity.y();relative+=a.m_turnVelocity.x()*j.angular_a.x();relative+=j.angular_a.z()*a.m_turnVelocity.z();
        relative+=j.axis.y()*a.m_pushVelocity.y();relative+=j.axis.x()*a.m_pushVelocity.x();relative+=j.axis.z()*a.m_pushVelocity.z();
        float impulse=c.push_rhs-relative*c.push_diagonal;const float accumulated=c.push_impulse+impulse;
        if(accumulated<=0)c.push_impulse=accumulated;else{impulse=0.f-c.push_impulse;c.push_impulse=0;}
        impulse*=j.projection;
        // These explicit associations retain GE6's application order. Using
        // Bullet's convenience applyPushImpulse would reorder products.
        if(a.m_originalBody){
            a.m_pushVelocity[0]=((w.normal.x()*a.m_linearFactor.x())*impulse)*a.m_invMass.x()+a.m_pushVelocity.x();
            a.m_pushVelocity[1]=((a.m_linearFactor.y()*w.normal.y())*impulse)*a.m_invMass.y()+a.m_pushVelocity.y();
            a.m_pushVelocity[2]=((a.m_linearFactor.z()*w.normal.z())*impulse)*a.m_invMass.z()+a.m_pushVelocity.z();
            for(int k=0;k<3;++k)a.m_turnVelocity[k]=(impulse*a.m_angularFactor[k])*j.component_a[k]+a.m_turnVelocity[k];
        }
        impulse=-impulse;
        if(b.m_originalBody){
            b.m_pushVelocity[0]=((w.normal.x()*b.m_linearFactor.x())*impulse)*b.m_invMass.x()+b.m_pushVelocity.x();
            b.m_pushVelocity[1]=((b.m_linearFactor.y()*w.normal.y())*impulse)*b.m_invMass.y()+b.m_pushVelocity.y();
            b.m_pushVelocity[2]=((b.m_linearFactor.z()*w.normal.z())*impulse)*b.m_invMass.z()+b.m_pushVelocity.z();
            // Native writes z,x,y; preserve that even when A and B alias.
            b.m_turnVelocity[2]=(impulse*b.m_angularFactor.z())*j.component_b.z()+b.m_turnVelocity.z();
            b.m_turnVelocity[0]=(impulse*b.m_angularFactor.x())*j.component_b.x()+b.m_turnVelocity.x();
            b.m_turnVelocity[1]=(impulse*b.m_angularFactor.y())*j.component_b.y()+b.m_turnVelocity.y();
        }
    }
}
}
```

```h
namespace fs15::ge6 {
// Authored typed storage for inspected GE6 constraint fields, never a cast of
// a Windows Bullet/vehicle record. Original body and solver fields stay typed.
struct WheelJacobian {
    btVector3 angular_a{0,0,0},angular_b{0,0,0},axis{0,0,0};
    btVector3 component_a{0,0,0},component_b{0,0,0};
    float projection=0;
};
struct WheelJacobianStats {float denominator_a=0,denominator_b=0,velocity_a=0,velocity_b=0;};
// 0x1401511a0. Distinct query and application axes are intentional in GE6.
WheelJacobianStats setup_wheel_jacobian(WheelJacobian&,const btVector3& query_axis,
    const btVector3& contact_point,const btVector3& application_axis,const btVector3& lever,
    const btRigidBody&,const btRigidBody&,const btSolverBody&,const btSolverBody&);
struct SuspensionSpring {
    float rest=0,compression=0,stiffness=0,positive_velocity_damping=0,nonpositive_velocity_damping=0;
};
struct SuspensionConstraint {
    WheelJacobian jacobian;
    float diagonal=0,rhs=0,cfm=0,impulse=0,lower_limit=0;
    float push_diagonal=0,correction_rhs=0,push_rhs=0,push_impulse=0;
};
// 0x140150f50. The caller owns accumulated impulses and their setup reset.
void setup_suspension_constraint(SuspensionConstraint&,const btVector3& query_axis,
    const btVector3& point,const btVector3& contact_normal,const btVector3& lever,float length,const SuspensionSpring&,
    const btRigidBody&,const btRigidBody&,const btSolverBody&,const btSolverBody&,const btContactSolverInfo&);
struct PenetrationWheel {
    SuspensionConstraint* constraint=nullptr;
    btSolverBody* a=nullptr;btSolverBody* b=nullptr;
    btVector3 normal{0,0,0};bool contact=false;
};
// 0x140154d70. A complete split-penetration vehicle phase; setup, normal
// velocity/friction, drivetrain and complete vehicle registration are separate.
void solve_wheel_penetration(PenetrationWheel*,std::size_t count,int activation,bool active);
```

`src/ge6/vehicle_drive.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vehicle_drive.h"
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
namespace fs15::ge6 {
void prepare_differentials(DriveWheel* wheels,const Differential* nodes,std::size_t count,const VehicleMotor& m){
    if(!count)return;
    std::array<float,20> speeds{},wa{},wb{};
    const float direction=0<=m.ratio*m.torque?1.f:-1.f;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){const auto& n=nodes[i];
        const float radius_a=n.a<20?wheels[n.a].radius:1.f,radius_b=n.b<20?wheels[n.b].radius:1.f;
        float a=n.a<20?radius_a*wheels[n.a].speed:speeds[n.a-20],b=n.b<20?radius_b*wheels[n.b].speed:speeds[n.b-20];
        speeds[i]=(b+a)*.5f;float left=n.ratio,right=1.f-left;
        if(left<.9999f&&.0001f<left){
            a*=direction;b*=direction;const float high=b<=a?a:b,low=a<=b?a:b;bool normalize=false;
            if(high<0||low<0){
                if(0<high||0<low){if(a<b){right=0;left=1;}else{left=0;right=1;}}
                else{
                    float error=low*n.bias-high;
                    if(0<error){const float adjustment=-(error/high);left*=a<b?adjustment+1.f:1.f-adjustment;right*=a<b?1.f-adjustment:adjustment+1.f;normalize=true;}
                }
            }else{
                float error=high-low*n.bias;
                if(0<error){const float adjustment=error/high;left*=a<b?adjustment+1.f:1.f-adjustment;right*=a<b?1.f-adjustment:adjustment+1.f;normalize=true;}
            }
            if(normalize){const float inverse=1.f/(right+left);left*=inverse;right*=inverse;}
        }
        wa[i]=left*radius_a;wb[i]=right*radius_b;
    }
    for(std::size_t i=count;i-->0;){const auto& n=nodes[i];
        if(n.a<20)wheels[n.a].weight=wa[i];else{wa[n.a-20]*=wa[i];wb[n.a-20]*=wa[i];}
        if(n.b<20)wheels[n.b].weight=wb[i];else{wa[n.b-20]=wb[i]*wa[n.b-20];wb[n.b-20]=wb[i]*wb[n.b-20];}
    }
}
void solve_drivetrain(DriveWheel* wheels,const Differential* nodes,std::size_t count,VehicleMotor& m,float dt){
    if(!count||m.ratio==0)return;
    std::array<float,20> speeds{},effective{},coast_effective{},weights{},coast_weights{};
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){const auto& n=nodes[i];float a,b,ia,ib,ca,cb;
        if(n.a<20){const auto& w=wheels[n.a];a=w.radius*w.speed;ia=(w.radius*w.inverse_inertia)*w.radius;ca=ia;}else{a=speeds[n.a-20];ia=effective[n.a-20];ca=coast_effective[n.a-20];}
        if(n.b<20){const auto& w=wheels[n.b];b=w.radius*w.speed;ib=(w.radius*w.inverse_inertia)*w.radius;cb=ib;}else{b=speeds[n.b-20];ib=effective[n.b-20];cb=coast_effective[n.b-20];}
        float ratio=n.ratio,drive=ratio,aa=std::abs(a),ab=std::abs(b),high=ab<=aa?aa:ab,low=ab<aa?ab:aa;
        if(.01f<high){
            if((0<a)==(0<b)){
                const float excess=high-low*n.bias;
                if(0<excess){float blend=1;const float width=(low*n.bias)*.3f;if(excess<width)blend=excess/width;
                    float numerator,other;
                    if(a<=b){drive=(blend+1.f)*ratio;drive=.0001f<=drive?drive/((1.f-blend)*(1.f-ratio)+drive):0.f;numerator=(1.f-blend)*ratio;other=blend+1.f;
                        ratio=.0001<=double(numerator)?numerator/((1.f-ratio)*other+numerator):0.f;
                    }else{drive=(1.f-blend)*ratio;drive=.0001f<=drive?drive/((1.f-ratio)*(blend+1.f)+drive):0.f;numerator=(blend+1.f)*ratio;other=1.f-blend;
                        ratio=.0001f<=numerator?numerator/((1.f-ratio)*other+numerator):0.f;
                    }
                }
            }else{drive=b<a?.001f:.999f;ratio=1.f-drive;}
        }
        weights[i]=drive;coast_weights[i]=ratio;speeds[i]=(b+a)*.5f;
        effective[i]=((1.f-drive)*ib+drive*ia)*.5f;coast_effective[i]=((1.f-ratio)*cb+ratio*ca)*.5f;
    }
    if(m.speed<m.target_speed&&0<m.torque){
        const float limit=(m.torque*m.inverse_inertia)*dt;float delta=m.target_speed-m.speed;if(limit<=delta)delta=limit;
        const float next=m.torque_impulse+delta;
        if(next<=limit){if(0<=next)m.torque_impulse=next;else{delta=-m.torque_impulse;m.torque_impulse=0;}}
        else{delta=limit-m.torque_impulse;m.torque_impulse=limit;}m.speed+=delta;
    }
    const auto root=count-1;const float root_speed=speeds[root];float delta=m.speed-root_speed*m.ratio;
    if(m.ratio*delta<0){effective=coast_effective;weights=coast_weights;}
    const float root_effective=effective[root],bound=dt*m.clutch_torque;
    delta=(1.f/(((root_effective*m.ratio)*m.ratio)+m.inverse_inertia))*delta;
    const float next=m.clutch_impulse+delta;
    if(bound<next){delta=bound-m.clutch_impulse;m.clutch_impulse=bound;}
    else if(next<-bound){delta=-bound-m.clutch_impulse;m.clutch_impulse=-bound;}
    else m.clutch_impulse=next;
    m.speed=-(m.inverse_inertia*delta)+m.speed;
    float clamped=0;if(0<=m.speed){clamped=m.speed;if(m.target_speed<m.speed)clamped=m.target_speed;}m.speed=clamped;
    effective[root]=m.ratio*delta;m.driven_speed=((root_effective*m.ratio)*delta+root_speed)*m.ratio;
    for(std::size_t i=count;i-->0;){const auto& n=nodes[i];const float a=weights[i]*effective[i],b=(1.f-weights[i])*effective[i];
        if(n.a<20){auto& w=wheels[n.a];w.speed=(a*w.radius)*w.inverse_inertia+w.speed;}else effective[n.a-20]=a;
        if(n.b<20){auto& w=wheels[n.b];w.speed=(b*w.radius)*w.inverse_inertia+w.speed;}else effective[n.b-20]=b;
    }
}
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
namespace fs15::ge6 {
// Typed transport for GE6 wheel/differential records. Native child IDs below
// 20 name wheels; IDs 20+ name an earlier differential. Native scratch storage
// has 20 slots. Configuration/ownership validation belongs to the caller.
struct DriveWheel {float radius=0,speed=0,inverse_inertia=0,weight=0;};
struct Differential {float ratio=.5f,bias=1;std::uint16_t a=0,b=0;};
struct VehicleMotor {
    float inverse_inertia=1000,speed=0,target_speed=300,damping=.002f,torque=0,ratio=1;
    float clutch_torque=10,driven_speed=0,torque_impulse=0,clutch_impulse=0;
};
// 0x140155940: differential distribution weights, including coast/reverse.
void prepare_differentials(DriveWheel*,const Differential*,std::size_t,const VehicleMotor&);
// 0x140155d50: complete motor/clutch/differential velocity update.
void solve_drivetrain(DriveWheel*,const Differential*,std::size_t,VehicleMotor&,float dt);
```

`src/ge6/vehicle_velocity.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vehicle_velocity.h"
#include <cmath>
namespace fs15::ge6 {
namespace {
float normal_relative(const WheelJacobian& j,const btSolverBody& a,const btSolverBody& b){
    float r=((j.angular_b.y()*b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.y()+b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.x()*j.angular_b.x())+j.angular_b.z()*b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.z())
        -((j.axis.x()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.x()+j.axis.y()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.y())+j.axis.z()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.z());
    r+=j.angular_a.y()*a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.y();r+=a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.x()*j.angular_a.x();r+=j.angular_a.z()*a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.z();
    r+=j.axis.x()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.x();r+=j.axis.y()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.y();r+=j.axis.z()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.z();return r;
}
void apply(btSolverBody& a,btSolverBody& b,const btVector3& axis,const WheelJacobian& j,float impulse){
    if(a.m_originalBody){
        for(int k=0;k<3;++k)a.m_deltaLinearVelocity[k]=((axis[k]*a.m_linearFactor[k])*impulse)*a.m_invMass[k]+a.m_deltaLinearVelocity[k];
        for(int k=0;k<3;++k)a.m_deltaAngularVelocity[k]=(impulse*a.m_angularFactor[k])*j.component_a[k]+a.m_deltaAngularVelocity[k];
    }
    impulse=-impulse;
    if(b.m_originalBody){
        for(int k=0;k<3;++k)b.m_deltaLinearVelocity[k]=((axis[k]*b.m_linearFactor[k])*impulse)*b.m_invMass[k]+b.m_deltaLinearVelocity[k];
        b.m_deltaAngularVelocity[2]=(impulse*b.m_angularFactor.z())*j.component_b.z()+b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.z();
        b.m_deltaAngularVelocity[0]=(impulse*b.m_angularFactor.x())*j.component_b.x()+b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.x();
        b.m_deltaAngularVelocity[1]=(impulse*b.m_angularFactor.y())*j.component_b.y()+b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.y();
    }
}
float longitudinal_relative(const WheelJacobian& j,const btSolverBody& a,const btSolverBody& b){
    float r=j.axis.y()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.y()+j.axis.x()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.x();r+=j.axis.z()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.z();
    r+=j.angular_a.x()*a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.x();r+=j.angular_a.y()*a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.y();r+=a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.z()*j.angular_a.z();
    r-=((j.axis.x()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.x()+j.axis.y()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.y())+j.axis.z()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.z());
    r+=j.angular_b.x()*b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.x();r+=j.angular_b.y()*b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.y();r+=j.angular_b.z()*b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.z();return r;
}
float lateral_relative(const WheelJacobian& j,const btSolverBody& a,const btSolverBody& b){
    float r=j.angular_a.y()*a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.y()+j.angular_a.x()*a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.x();r+=j.angular_a.z()*a.m_deltaAngularVelocity.z();
    r+=j.axis.x()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.x();r+=j.axis.y()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.y();r+=j.axis.z()*a.m_deltaLinearVelocity.z();
    r-=((j.axis.x()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.x()+j.axis.y()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.y())+j.axis.z()*b.m_deltaLinearVelocity.z());
    r+=j.angular_b.y()*b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.y();r+=b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.x()*j.angular_b.x();r+=j.angular_b.z()*b.m_deltaAngularVelocity.z();return r;
}
float clamp_impulse(float delta,float& accumulated,float lower,float upper){
    const float next=accumulated+delta;
    if(next<=upper){if(lower<=next)accumulated=next;else{delta=lower-accumulated;accumulated=lower;}}
    else{delta=upper-accumulated;accumulated=upper;}return delta;
}
float gravity_dot(const btVector3& g,const btVector3& n){return (g.y()*n.y()+g.x()*n.x())+g.z()*n.z();}
}
void solve_wheel_velocity(WheelVelocity* wheels,std::size_t count,int activation,bool active,float dt,const WheelVelocityServices& services){
    if(activation==ISLAND_SLEEPING||!active)return;
    if(services.drive)services.drive(services.context,dt);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){auto& w=wheels[i];if(!w.contact)continue;auto& c=w.suspension;auto& a=*w.a;auto& b=*w.b;
        const float relative=normal_relative(c.jacobian,a,b);
        float delta=clamp_impulse((c.rhs-c.impulse*c.cfm)-relative*c.diagonal,c.impulse,c.lower_limit,0);
        if(c.push_diagonal!=0){
            const float correction=c.correction_rhs-c.push_diagonal*relative;const float next=w.correction_impulse+correction;
            if(next<=0){w.correction_impulse=next;delta+=correction;}
            else{delta+=0.f-w.correction_impulse;w.correction_impulse=0;}
        }
        apply(a,b,w.normal,c.jacobian,delta*c.jacobian.projection);
        float gravity=0;
        if(!(0<gravity_dot(services.gravity(services.context),w.normal)))gravity=gravity_dot(services.gravity(services.context),w.normal);
        const float load=(c.impulse*c.jacobian.projection)/dt-gravity*w.mass_load;
        if(!(0<load))continue;
        fs15::TireForces forces;fs15::tire_forces(w.tire,w.slip_longitudinal,w.slip_lateral,load,forces);
        const float floor=(load*w.tire.friction)*w.friction_floor;
        float limit=std::abs(forces.longitudinal);if(limit<floor)limit=floor;limit*=dt;
        unsigned iteration=0;bool done;
        do{
            done=true;
            if(w.brake!=0){
                const float bound=(dt*w.inverse_inertia)*w.brake;
                float brake_delta=-w.speed;const float next=brake_delta+w.brake_impulse;
                if(next<=bound){if(-bound<=next){w.brake_impulse=next;done=false;}else{brake_delta=-bound-w.brake_impulse;w.brake_impulse=-bound;}}
                else{brake_delta=bound-w.brake_impulse;w.brake_impulse=bound;}
                w.speed=brake_delta+w.speed;
            }
            auto& longitudinal=w.longitudinal;
            const float d=clamp_impulse((w.tire.radius*w.speed-longitudinal_relative(longitudinal.jacobian,a,b))*longitudinal.diagonal+longitudinal.rhs,longitudinal.impulse,-limit,limit);
            w.speed=w.speed-(d*w.tire.radius)*w.inverse_inertia;
            apply(a,b,longitudinal.jacobian.axis,longitudinal.jacobian,d);
        }while(!done&&++iteration<10);
        auto& lateral=w.lateral;float lateral_limit=std::abs(forces.lateral);if(lateral_limit<floor)lateral_limit=floor;lateral_limit*=dt;
        const float d=clamp_impulse(lateral.rhs-lateral_relative(lateral.jacobian,a,b)*lateral.diagonal,lateral.impulse,-lateral_limit,lateral_limit);
        apply(a,b,lateral.jacobian.axis,lateral.jacobian,d);
    }
}
}
```

`src/ge6/vehicle_velocity.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "vehicle_constraint.h"
#include "tire_forces.h"
namespace fs15::ge6 {
struct WheelFrictionConstraint {
    WheelJacobian jacobian;
    float diagonal=0,rhs=0,impulse=0;
};
struct WheelVelocity {
    btSolverBody* a=nullptr;btSolverBody* b=nullptr;
    SuspensionConstraint suspension;
    float correction_impulse=0;
    WheelFrictionConstraint lateral,longitudinal;
    fs15::TireParameters tire{};
    btVector3 normal{0,0,0};
    float mass_load=0,friction_floor=0,slip_longitudinal=0,slip_lateral=0;
    float speed=0,inverse_inertia=0,brake=0,brake_impulse=0;
    bool contact=false;
};
// Explicit typed services for the original pre-wheel drivetrain call and
// world gravity query. A null drive means no differential network configured;
// it must not be presented as a recovered working drivetrain. Gravity is
// required when an active wheel has contact. Wheels/solver bodies are borrowed.
struct WheelVelocityServices {
    void* context=nullptr;
    void (*drive)(void*,float)=nullptr;
    btVector3 (*gravity)(void*)=nullptr;
};
// Bounded recovery of 0x1401540b0 over the existing recovered tire-force leaf.
// Finite valid tire parameters and positive dt are inherited caller contracts.
// Differential/motor implementation, complete vehicle setup and registration
// remain separate from this wheel velocity/friction phase.
void solve_wheel_velocity(WheelVelocity*,std::size_t count,int activation,bool active,float dt,const WheelVelocityServices&);
}
```

`src/ge6/vehicle_wheel.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vehicle_wheel.h"

namespace fs15::ge6 {
void wheel_ray_frame(const WheelSuspension& w,const btTransform& t,btVector3& p,btVector3& d){
    const auto& m=t.getBasis();const auto& o=t.getOrigin();
    d.setValue((w.direction.y()*m[0][1]+w.direction.x()*m[0][0])+w.direction.z()*m[0][2],
               (w.direction.y()*m[1][1]+w.direction.x()*m[1][0])+w.direction.z()*m[1][2],
               (w.direction.x()*m[2][0]+w.direction.y()*m[2][1])+w.direction.z()*m[2][2]);
    p.setValue(((w.attachment.y()*m[0][1]+w.attachment.x()*m[0][0])+w.attachment.z()*m[0][2])+o.x(),
               ((w.attachment.y()*m[1][1]+w.attachment.x()*m[1][0])+w.attachment.z()*m[1][2])+o.y(),
               ((w.attachment.x()*m[2][0]+w.attachment.y()*m[2][1])+w.attachment.z()*m[2][2])+o.z());
}
WheelRayCallback::WheelRayCallback(const btVector3& from,const btVector3& to,const btCollisionObject& owner,short group,short mask)
    :ClosestRayResultCallback(from,to),owner_(owner){m_collisionFilterGroup=group;m_collisionFilterMask=mask;}
bool WheelRayCallback::needsCollision(btBroadphaseProxy* proxy)const{
    // Literal recovered OR of same-field filter bits. Do not substitute the
    // stock cross-field AND; native differential fixtures exercise both.
    if(!(proxy->m_collisionFilterMask&m_collisionFilterMask)&&!(proxy->m_collisionFilterGroup&m_collisionFilterGroup))return false;
    const auto* object=static_cast<const btCollisionObject*>(proxy->m_clientObject);
    return object!=&owner_&&object->hasContactResponse()&&(object->getInternalType()&btCollisionObject::CO_RIGID_BODY)!=0&&owner_.checkCollideWith(object);
}
btScalar WheelRayCallback::addSingleResult(btCollisionWorld::LocalRayResult& r,bool in_world){
    m_closestHitFraction=r.m_hitFraction;m_collisionObject=r.m_collisionObject;
    if(in_world)m_hitNormalWorld=r.m_hitNormalLocal;
    else{
        const auto& m=r.m_collisionObject->getWorldTransform().getBasis();const auto& n=r.m_hitNormalLocal;
        // The callback uses y,x,z association on all three rows.
        m_hitNormalWorld.setValue((n.y()*m[0][1]+n.x()*m[0][0])+n.z()*m[0][2],
                                  (n.y()*m[1][1]+n.x()*m[1][0])+n.z()*m[1][2],
                                  (n.y()*m[2][1]+n.x()*m[2][0])+n.z()*m[2][2]);
    }
    const float inverse=1.f-r.m_hitFraction;
    m_hitPointWorld.setValue(inverse*m_rayFromWorld.x()+r.m_hitFraction*m_rayToWorld.x(),
                             inverse*m_rayFromWorld.y()+r.m_hitFraction*m_rayToWorld.y(),
                             inverse*m_rayFromWorld.z()+r.m_hitFraction*m_rayToWorld.z());
    return r.m_hitFraction;
}
WheelContact raycast_wheel(const WheelSuspension& w,const btCollisionObject& owner,const btCollisionWorld& world){
    btVector3 from,d;wheel_ray_frame(w,owner.getWorldTransform(),from,d);
    const float distance=(w.rest+w.droop)+w.radius;
    const btVector3 to(from.x()+d.x()*distance,from.y()+d.y()*distance,from.z()+d.z()*distance);
    WheelRayCallback ray(from,to,owner,w.group,w.mask);world.rayTest(from,to,ray);
    WheelContact hit;hit.body=ray.m_collisionObject;
    if(!hit.body){hit.point=to;hit.normal.setValue(-d.x(),-d.y(),-d.z());hit.length=w.rest+w.droop;return hit;}
    hit.point=ray.m_hitPointWorld;hit.normal=ray.m_hitNormalWorld;
    hit.plane=-((hit.normal.y()*hit.point.y()+hit.point.x()*hit.normal.x())+hit.normal.z()*hit.point.z());
    const float length=(((hit.point.y()-from.y())*d.y()+(hit.point.x()-from.x())*d.x())+(hit.point.z()-from.z())*d.z())-w.radius;
    // Preserve the native comparison order (including unordered values).
    float limit=w.rest-w.compression;
    if(limit<=length){limit=w.rest+w.droop;if(length<=limit)limit=length;}
    hit.length=limit;return hit;
}
void finish_wheels(WheelFinish* wheels,std::size_t count,int activation,bool active,float dt,float motor_impulse,float motor_scale,float& motor_output){
    if(activation==ISLAND_SLEEPING||!active)return;
    constexpr float turn=6.283185482025146484375f;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){auto& w=wheels[i];
        float angle=dt*w.speed+w.angle;
        if(angle>turn)angle-=turn;else if(angle<0)angle+=turn;
        w.angle=angle;w.force=-(w.normal_impulse/dt);w.slip[0]=w.longitudinal_slip;w.slip[1]=w.lateral_slip;
    }
    motor_output=motor_impulse/(dt*motor_scale);
}
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include <btBulletDynamicsCommon.h>
#include <cstddef>

namespace fs15::ge6 {
// Typed transport for inspected Bt2RaycastVehicle wheel fields. This is not
// the Windows object layout and is not yet a complete vehicle solver.
struct WheelSuspension {
    btVector3 attachment{0,0,0},direction{0,-1,0};
    float rest=0,compression=0,droop=0,radius=0;
    short group=1,mask=-1;
};
struct WheelContact {
    const btCollisionObject* body=nullptr;
    btVector3 point{0,0,0},normal{0,0,0};
    float plane=0,length=0;
};
// 0x140150a10: explicit native float association, no normalization.
void wheel_ray_frame(const WheelSuspension&,const btTransform&,btVector3& origin,btVector3& direction);
// 0x140151930 / 0x1400ba820. GE6's wheel filter differs from Bullet's default.
class WheelRayCallback final:public btCollisionWorld::ClosestRayResultCallback {
    const btCollisionObject& owner_;
public:
    WheelRayCallback(const btVector3& from,const btVector3& to,const btCollisionObject& owner,short group,short mask);
    bool needsCollision(btBroadphaseProxy*)const override;
    btScalar addSingleResult(btCollisionWorld::LocalRayResult&,bool normal_in_world) override;
};
// 0x140153330. Calls the middleware ray service; original GIANTS heightfield
// support must be supplied separately before original terrain is validated.
WheelContact raycast_wheel(const WheelSuspension&,const btCollisionObject& owner,const btCollisionWorld&);
struct WheelFinish {
    float speed=0,angle=0,normal_impulse=0,longitudinal_slip=0,lateral_slip=0;
    float force=0,slip[2]{};
};
// 0x140155140. Caller supplies solved impulses; this does not solve suspension.
// Preconditions inherited from solver: positive dt, valid wheel array.
void finish_wheels(WheelFinish*,std::size_t count,int body_activation,bool active,
                   float dt,float motor_impulse,float motor_scale,float& motor_output);
}
```

`src/ge6_linux/AUDIO_DEPENDENCY.md`:

```md
# Linux audio dependency and relinking

The native instruction transport calls unmodified **OpenAL Soft 1.24.3** through
authored Microsoft x64 to System V ABI adapters. This is third-party Linux audio
middleware, not a decompilation of the original OpenAL DLL or of GE6 audio code.

Source: https://openal-soft.org/openal-releases/openal-soft-1.24.3.tar.bz2

SHA-256: `cb5e6197a1c0da0edcf2a81024953cc8fa8545c3b9474e48c852af709d587892`.

OpenAL Soft is distributed under LGPL-2.0-or-later, with the upstream exceptions
and per-file notices. The accompanying complete source directory contains
`COPYING`, the bundled fmt license, and the original source notices. It has not
been modified. The installed archive contains the fmt objects as well.

For this diagnostic's static build, `main.cpp.o`, `libopenal.a`, the complete
OpenAL Soft source and `relink.sh` are supplied together. On Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64,
install `g++`, `cmake`, `libssl-dev`, `libasound2-dev`, `libpulse-dev` and `libpng-dev`.
Run `sh relink.sh` to relink the diagnostic, including with a compatible modified
OpenAL Soft archive. The adapters' source is in the public repository at the
artifact's source commit. No restriction is imposed on modifying this library
or reverse engineering this diagnostic to debug those modifications.

The executable also links the distribution libpng/zlib for PNG frames in PE
icon resources. Their copyright/license notices accompany the boot artifact.
The relink script links those distribution development archives as well.

The X11/GLX artifact supplies the same OpenAL source and relinking objects.
Its `link-mode.txt` selects dynamic X11, RandR and OpenGL libraries; install
`libx11-dev`, `libxrandr-dev` and `libgl-dev` before relinking on Ubuntu 24.04.
X11/RandR provide host display/window services and Mesa/GLX provides native
OpenGL. Neither is recovered GE6 code. The artifact includes distribution
copyright notices for these dependencies.

To rebuild OpenAL, use its supplied source with `-DLIBTYPE=STATIC`,
`-DALSOFT_UTILS=OFF -DALSOFT_EXAMPLES=OFF -DALSOFT_TESTS=OFF` and the backend
options in the transport CMake file; copy the resulting `libopenal.a` here.

ALSA and PulseAudio backends are compiled in and load their normal host shared
libraries at runtime. A fully static diagnostic still needs those libraries
and a working device/server for audible desktop output. The isolated VM and
authored CI fixtures explicitly select `ALSOFT_DRIVERS=null`; loopback tests
render synthetic PCM into memory. Neither proves audible gameplay.

Only the Windows router selectors `Generic Software` and `Generic Hardware`
map to the Linux default device, with a trace. Explicit device names are passed
unchanged and invalid names fail. No success, device, context or audio sample is
fabricated. Extensions are not exposed as unsafe System V function pointers.

```

```h
#pragma once
// Authored PCM and lifecycle checks; no original game audio is used.
#define AL_ALEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <AL/alext.h>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace ge6_audio {
inline void check(){
    auto require=[](bool value,const char* reason){if(!value)throw std::runtime_error(reason);};
    require(!ge6_audio::alcOpenDevice("FS15-authored-nonexistent-device"),"Unknown OpenAL device was accepted");
    auto* physical=ge6_audio::alcOpenDevice("Generic Software");require(physical,"Cannot open selected Linux audio backend");
    require(ge6_audio::alcGetString(physical,ALC_DEVICE_SPECIFIER)!=nullptr,"Missing actual device name");
    ALCint major=0,minor=0;ge6_audio::alcGetIntegerv(physical,ALC_MAJOR_VERSION,1,&major);ge6_audio::alcGetIntegerv(physical,ALC_MINOR_VERSION,1,&minor);
    require(major==1&&minor>=1&&ge6_audio::alcCloseDevice(physical),"Device version/close differs");
    // Loopback is a real software mixer, independent of an audio daemon/device.
    auto* device=::alcLoopbackOpenDeviceSOFT(nullptr);require(device,"Cannot open OpenAL Soft loopback");
    const ALCint attributes[]{ALC_FORMAT_CHANNELS_SOFT,ALC_STEREO_SOFT,ALC_FORMAT_TYPE_SOFT,ALC_FLOAT_SOFT,ALC_FREQUENCY,48000,0};
    auto* context=ge6_audio::alcCreateContext(device,attributes);
    require(context&&ge6_audio::alcMakeContextCurrent(context)&&ge6_audio::alcGetCurrentContext()==context&&ge6_audio::alcGetContextsDevice(context)==device,"OpenAL context lifecycle differs");
    ge6_audio::alListenerf(AL_GAIN,0.5f);ALfloat gain=0;ge6_audio::alGetListenerf(AL_GAIN,&gain);require(gain==0.5f,"Listener float ABI differs");
    const ALfloat orientation[]{0,0,-1,0,1,0};ge6_audio::alListenerfv(AL_ORIENTATION,orientation);ge6_audio::alDopplerFactor(1.0f);ge6_audio::alDistanceModel(AL_NONE);
    ALuint buffers[2]{},source=0;ge6_audio::alGenBuffers(2,buffers);ge6_audio::alGenSources(1,&source);require(ge6_audio::alIsBuffer(buffers[0]),"OpenAL buffer not created");
    std::array<int16_t,4096> pcm{};for(size_t i=0;i<pcm.size();++i)pcm[i]=int16_t(std::sin(double(i)*2*3.141592653589793*440/48000)*16000);
    for(auto buffer:buffers)ge6_audio::alBufferData(buffer,AL_FORMAT_MONO16,pcm.data(),ALsizei(pcm.size()*sizeof(int16_t)),48000);
    ge6_audio::alSourcei(source,AL_SOURCE_RELATIVE,AL_TRUE);ge6_audio::alSourcef(source,AL_GAIN,0.75f);const ALfloat position[]{0,0,-1};ge6_audio::alSourcefv(source,AL_POSITION,position);
    ge6_audio::alSourceQueueBuffers(source,2,buffers);ALint count=0;ge6_audio::alGetSourcei(source,AL_BUFFERS_QUEUED,&count);require(count==2,"PCM queue differs");
    ge6_audio::alSourcePlay(source);ge6_audio::alGetSourcei(source,AL_SOURCE_STATE,&count);require(count==AL_PLAYING,"Source did not play");
    std::array<float,2048> output{};::alcRenderSamplesSOFT(device,output.data(),ALCsizei(output.size()/2));
    double energy=0;for(auto sample:output){require(std::isfinite(sample),"Nonfinite mixed sample");energy+=double(sample)*sample;}
    require(energy>1.0&&energy<1024,"OpenAL loopback did not mix authored PCM");
    ge6_audio::alSourcePause(source);ge6_audio::alGetSourcei(source,AL_SOURCE_STATE,&count);require(count==AL_PAUSED,"Pause state differs");
    ge6_audio::alSourcePlay(source);ge6_audio::alSourceStop(source);ge6_audio::alGetSourcei(source,AL_BUFFERS_PROCESSED,&count);require(count==2,"Stopped queue not processed");
    ALuint unqueued[2]{};ge6_audio::alSourceUnqueueBuffers(source,2,unqueued);require(unqueued[0]==buffers[0]&&unqueued[1]==buffers[1],"Queue order differs");
    ge6_audio::alSourcef(source,AL_GAIN,-1.0f);require(ge6_audio::alGetError()==AL_INVALID_VALUE&&ge6_audio::alGetError()==AL_NO_ERROR,"Actual AL errors were not preserved/cleared");
    ge6_audio::alDeleteSources(1,&source);ge6_audio::alDeleteBuffers(2,buffers);require(!ge6_audio::alIsBuffer(buffers[0])&&ge6_audio::alGetError()==AL_NO_ERROR&&ge6_audio::alcGetError(device)==ALC_NO_ERROR,"Audio cleanup/error differs");
    require(ge6_audio::alcMakeContextCurrent(nullptr),"Cannot clear context");ge6_audio::alcDestroyContext(context);require(ge6_audio::alcCloseDevice(device),"Cannot close loopback device");
}
```

```h
#pragma once
// Authored Microsoft-x64 ABI adapters to upstream Linux OpenAL Soft.
// Device/context/source state and mixing belong to that library, not this host.
#include <AL/al.h>
#include <AL/alc.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
namespace ge6_audio {
#define GE6_AUDIO_MS __attribute__((ms_abi))
inline void(*trace)(const char*)=nullptr;
static_assert(sizeof(ALboolean)==1 && sizeof(ALCboolean)==1 && sizeof(ALint)==4 && sizeof(ALfloat)==4);
inline GE6_AUDIO_MS ALCdevice* alcOpenDevice(const ALCchar* name){
    trace("alcOpenDevice");
    // Windows OpenAL router implementation names have no Linux device identity.
    // Translate only its two legacy default selectors; preserve explicit names.
    if(name&&(!std::strcmp(name,"Generic Software")||!std::strcmp(name,"Generic Hardware"))){
        trace("OpenAL legacy default selector mapped to Linux default device");name=nullptr;
    }
    return ::alcOpenDevice(name);
}
#define AUDIO_WRAP(result,name,args,values) inline GE6_AUDIO_MS result name args{trace(#name);return ::name values;}
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alcGetIntegerv,(ALCdevice* d,ALCenum p,ALCsizei n,ALCint* v),(d,p,n,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(ALenum,alGetError,(),())
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alDeleteSources,(ALsizei n,const ALuint* v),(n,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(ALCcontext*,alcCreateContext,(ALCdevice* d,const ALCint* a),(d,a))
AUDIO_WRAP(const ALCchar*,alcGetString,(ALCdevice* d,ALCenum p),(d,p))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alDistanceModel,(ALenum v),(v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alDopplerFactor,(ALfloat v),(v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alListenerfv,(ALenum p,const ALfloat* v),(p,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alListenerf,(ALenum p,ALfloat v),(p,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alGetListenerf,(ALenum p,ALfloat* v),(p,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(ALCdevice*,alcGetContextsDevice,(ALCcontext* c),(c))
AUDIO_WRAP(ALCcontext*,alcGetCurrentContext,(),())
AUDIO_WRAP(ALCenum,alcGetError,(ALCdevice* d),(d))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alGenBuffers,(ALsizei n,ALuint* v),(n,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(ALboolean,alIsBuffer,(ALuint v),(v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alBufferData,(ALuint b,ALenum f,const ALvoid* d,ALsizei n,ALsizei rate),(b,f,d,n,rate))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alDeleteBuffers,(ALsizei n,const ALuint* v),(n,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alSourcei,(ALuint s,ALenum p,ALint v),(s,p,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alSourcef,(ALuint s,ALenum p,ALfloat v),(s,p,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alSourcefv,(ALuint s,ALenum p,const ALfloat* v),(s,p,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alGetSourcei,(ALuint s,ALenum p,ALint* v),(s,p,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alSourcePlay,(ALuint s),(s))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alSourceUnqueueBuffers,(ALuint s,ALsizei n,ALuint* v),(s,n,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alSourceQueueBuffers,(ALuint s,ALsizei n,const ALuint* v),(s,n,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alSourcePause,(ALuint s),(s))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alSourceStop,(ALuint s),(s))
AUDIO_WRAP(ALCboolean,alcMakeContextCurrent,(ALCcontext* c),(c))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alcDestroyContext,(ALCcontext* c),(c))
AUDIO_WRAP(ALCboolean,alcCloseDevice,(ALCdevice* d),(d))
AUDIO_WRAP(void,alGenSources,(ALsizei n,ALuint* v),(n,v))
AUDIO_WRAP(const ALchar*,alGetString,(ALenum p),(p))
#undef AUDIO_WRAP
inline uintptr_t resolve(const std::string& name){
#define AUDIO_BIND(n) if(name==#n)return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&n)
    AUDIO_BIND(alcOpenDevice);AUDIO_BIND(alcGetIntegerv);AUDIO_BIND(alGetError);AUDIO_BIND(alDeleteSources);
    AUDIO_BIND(alcCreateContext);AUDIO_BIND(alcGetString);AUDIO_BIND(alDistanceModel);AUDIO_BIND(alDopplerFactor);
    AUDIO_BIND(alListenerfv);AUDIO_BIND(alListenerf);AUDIO_BIND(alGetListenerf);AUDIO_BIND(alcGetContextsDevice);
    AUDIO_BIND(alcGetCurrentContext);AUDIO_BIND(alcGetError);AUDIO_BIND(alGenBuffers);AUDIO_BIND(alIsBuffer);
    AUDIO_BIND(alBufferData);AUDIO_BIND(alDeleteBuffers);AUDIO_BIND(alSourcei);AUDIO_BIND(alSourcef);
    AUDIO_BIND(alSourcefv);AUDIO_BIND(alGetSourcei);AUDIO_BIND(alSourcePlay);AUDIO_BIND(alSourceUnqueueBuffers);
    AUDIO_BIND(alSourceQueueBuffers);AUDIO_BIND(alSourcePause);AUDIO_BIND(alSourceStop);AUDIO_BIND(alcMakeContextCurrent);
    AUDIO_BIND(alcDestroyContext);AUDIO_BIND(alcCloseDevice);AUDIO_BIND(alGenSources);AUDIO_BIND(alGetString);
#undef AUDIO_BIND
    return 0; // Never expose a System-V extension pointer to original Windows code.
}
#undef GE6_AUDIO_MS
}
```

`src/ge6_linux/console_check.h`:

```h
#pragma once
// Authored signal callbacks; no original GE6 instructions in these fixtures.
#include "console_services.h"
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace ge6_console_test {
inline std::mutex mutex;
inline std::condition_variable changed;
inline std::vector<uint32_t> calls;
inline uint32_t tls=0,fls=0,main_tid=0;
inline std::atomic<uint32_t> cleaned{0};
inline bool broken=false;
inline __attribute__((ms_abi)) void cleanup(void*){++cleaned;}
inline __attribute__((ms_abi)) int handle(uint32_t event){
    uintptr_t self=0;asm("movq %%gs:0x30,%0":"=r"(self));uintptr_t stack=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&self),lower=0,upper=0;
    std::memcpy(&lower,reinterpret_cast<void*>(self+0x10),8);std::memcpy(&upper,reinterpret_cast<void*>(self+8),8);
    bool ok=lower<stack&&stack<upper&&uint32_t(syscall(SYS_gettid))!=main_tid&&ge6_slots::tls_get(tls)==nullptr;
    ge6_slots::fls_set(fls,reinterpret_cast<void*>(1));
    {std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);broken=broken||!ok;calls.push_back(event*10+1);}changed.notify_all();return 1;
}
inline __attribute__((ms_abi)) int decline(uint32_t event){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);calls.push_back(event*10+2);return 0;}
inline __attribute__((ms_abi)) int remove_self(uint32_t event){ge6_console::set_handler(remove_self,0);return decline(event);}
inline void check(){
    auto require=[](bool ok,const char* reason){if(!ok)throw std::runtime_error(reason);};
    ge6_console::Lifetime lifetime;ge6_native::Context context;main_tid=uint32_t(syscall(SYS_gettid));tls=ge6_slots::tls_alloc();fls=ge6_slots::fls_alloc(cleanup);ge6_slots::tls_set(tls,reinterpret_cast<void*>(123));
    auto wait=[&](size_t count){std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex);require(changed.wait_for(lock,std::chrono::seconds(3),[&](){return calls.size()>=count;}),"Console callback did not arrive");};
    require(!ge6_console::set_handler(handle,0),"Removed an unregistered handler");
    require(ge6_console::set_handler(handle,1)&&ge6_console::set_handler(decline,1),"Cannot register control handlers");
    require(kill(getpid(),SIGINT)==0,"Cannot send SIGINT");wait(2);
    require(kill(getpid(),SIGQUIT)==0,"Cannot send SIGQUIT");wait(4);
```

`src/ge6_linux/console_services.h`:

```h
#pragma once
// Authored console-control transport. Only SIGINT/CTRL_C and SIGQUIT/CTRL_BREAK.
// The POSIX signal handler only writes a byte; PE callbacks run on fresh threads.
#include "native_thread.h"
#include "thread_slots.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <iterator>
#include <mutex>
#include <signal.h>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
namespace ge6_console {
#define GE6_CONSOLE_MS __attribute__((ms_abi))
using Handler=int(GE6_CONSOLE_MS*)(uint32_t);
inline void(*trace)(const char*)=nullptr;
inline void(*set_error)(uint32_t)=nullptr;
inline void(*record)(const char*,uintptr_t,uint32_t)=nullptr;
inline std::atomic<int> signal_fd{-1};
inline std::atomic<bool> ignore_ctrl_c{false};
static_assert(decltype(signal_fd)::is_always_lock_free&&decltype(ignore_ctrl_c)::is_always_lock_free);
inline void receive(int signal){
    int saved=errno;
    if(signal!=SIGINT||!ignore_ctrl_c.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)){
        int fd=signal_fd.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);unsigned char code=signal==SIGINT?1:2;
        if(fd>=0){ssize_t written;do{written=write(fd,&code,1);}while(written<0&&errno==EINTR);}
    }
    errno=saved;
}
struct Service {
    std::mutex mutex;std::vector<Handler> handlers;int pipe[2]{-1,-1};
    struct sigaction previous[2]{};bool started=false,stopping=false;std::thread dispatcher;
    bool start(){ // registration mutex held
        if(started)return !stopping;
        if(pipe2(pipe,O_CLOEXEC))return false;
        if(fcntl(pipe[1],F_SETFL,O_NONBLOCK)<0){close(pipe[0]);close(pipe[1]);pipe[0]=pipe[1]=-1;return false;}
        struct sigaction action{};action.sa_handler=receive;action.sa_flags=SA_RESTART;sigemptyset(&action.sa_mask);
        signal_fd.store(pipe[1]);
        if(sigaction(SIGINT,&action,&previous[0])){signal_fd.store(-1);close(pipe[0]);close(pipe[1]);pipe[0]=pipe[1]=-1;return false;}
        if(sigaction(SIGQUIT,&action,&previous[1])){signal_fd.store(-1);sigaction(SIGINT,&previous[0],nullptr);stopping=true;return false;}
        try{dispatcher=std::thread([this](){run();});}
        catch(...){signal_fd.store(-1);sigaction(SIGINT,&previous[0],nullptr);sigaction(SIGQUIT,&previous[1],nullptr);stopping=true;return false;}
        started=true;return true;
    }
    void run(){
        unsigned char code=0;
        for(;;){
            auto count=read(pipe[0],&code,1);if(count<0&&errno==EINTR)continue;
            std::vector<Handler> snapshot;
            {std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);if(stopping||count!=1||!code)return;snapshot=handlers;}
            // Windows dispatches control handlers on another thread. Serialize
            // queued notifications, but give each one a fresh GS/TLS/FLS context.
            try{std::thread worker([snapshot,code](){
                try{ge6_native::Context context;bool handled=false;
                    for(auto it=snapshot.rbegin();it!=snapshot.rend();++it){auto entry=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(*it);record("CALL",entry,code-1);auto result=(*it)(code-1);record(result?"HANDLED":"DECLINED",entry,code-1);if(result){handled=true;break;}}
                    ge6_slots::cleanup();
                    if(!handled)std::_Exit(128+(code==1?SIGINT:SIGQUIT)); // Linux exit status, not Windows status parity.
                }catch(...){std::_Exit(125);}
            });worker.join();}catch(...){std::_Exit(125);}
        }
    }
    void shutdown(){
        {std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);if(!started||stopping)return;stopping=true;
            signal_fd.store(-1);sigaction(SIGINT,&previous[0],nullptr);sigaction(SIGQUIT,&previous[1],nullptr);
            unsigned char quit=0;auto written=write(pipe[1],&quit,1);(void)written;
        }
        dispatcher.join();
        // Keep the pipe descriptors owned until process exit: an already-entered
        // POSIX signal handler may still hold the old fd. Never recycle it beneath
        // that handler. Shutdown is terminal, not a reusable console attach API.
    }
    ~Service(){shutdown();} // OS reclaims the two retained descriptors at exit.
};
inline Service& service(){static Service state;return state;}
inline GE6_CONSOLE_MS int set_handler(Handler handler,int add){
    trace("SetConsoleCtrlHandler");auto& state=service();std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
    if(state.stopping){set_error(50);return 0;}
    if(!handler){if(!state.start()){set_error(8);return 0;}ignore_ctrl_c.store(add!=0);return 1;}
    if(!add){auto found=std::find(state.handlers.rbegin(),state.handlers.rend(),handler);if(found==state.handlers.rend()){set_error(87);return 0;}state.handlers.erase(std::next(found).base());record("REMOVE",reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(handler),0);return 1;}
    if(!state.start()){set_error(8);return 0;}
    state.handlers.push_back(handler);record("REGISTER",reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(handler),0);return 1;
}
struct Lifetime {~Lifetime(){service().shutdown();}}; // Destroy before the PE mapping.
#undef GE6_CONSOLE_MS
}
```

```h
#pragma once
// Authored PE resource lookup and image storage for Linux window transport.
// Original bytes are copied privately; PNG decoding is provided by libpng.
#include <png.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <tuple>
#include <vector>
namespace ge6_images {
#define GE6_IMAGE_MS __attribute__((ms_abi))
inline void(*trace)(const char*)=nullptr;
inline void(*set_error)(uint32_t)=nullptr;
inline void(*stop)(const char*,uintptr_t)=nullptr;
inline void(*record)(const char*,uint32_t,uint32_t)=nullptr;
struct Failure {uint32_t error;};
inline void need(bool ok,uint32_t error=193){if(!ok)throw Failure{error};}
template<class T>inline T field(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes,size_t at){need(at<=bytes.size()&&sizeof(T)<=bytes.size()-at);T value;std::memcpy(&value,bytes.data()+at,sizeof(value));return value;}
struct Name {uint32_t id=0;std::u16string text;bool integer=true;};
inline Name name(const uint16_t* raw){
    auto id=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(raw);if(id<=65535)return {uint32_t(id),{},true};
    std::u16string text;for(size_t i=0;i<256;++i){if(!raw[i]){
        if(text.size()>1&&text[0]==u'#'){uint32_t value=0;bool numeric=true;for(size_t j=1;j<text.size();++j){if(text[j]<u'0'||text[j]>u'9'||value>6553){numeric=false;break;}value=value*10+(text[j]-u'0');}if(numeric&&value<=65535)return {value,{},true};}
        return {0,text,false};}text.push_back(char16_t(raw[i]));}throw Failure{87};
}
struct Table {
    uint32_t rva=0;std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    uint32_t child(uint32_t directory,const Name& key,uint32_t absent)const{
        uint32_t n=field<uint16_t>(bytes,size_t(directory)+12)+uint32_t(field<uint16_t>(bytes,size_t(directory)+14));
        need(n<=4096&&size_t(directory)+16<=bytes.size()&&size_t(n)*8<=bytes.size()-directory-16);
        for(uint32_t i=0;i<n;++i){size_t at=size_t(directory)+16+i*8;uint32_t k=field<uint32_t>(bytes,at);bool match=false;
            if(k&0x80000000u){size_t p=k&0x7fffffffu;auto length=field<uint16_t>(bytes,p);need(length<=255&&p+2<=bytes.size()&&size_t(length)*2<=bytes.size()-p-2);if(!key.integer&&key.text.size()==length){match=true;for(size_t j=0;j<length;++j)if(char16_t(field<uint16_t>(bytes,p+2+j*2))!=key.text[j])match=false;}}
            else match=key.integer&&key.id==k;
            if(match)return field<uint32_t>(bytes,at+4);
        }throw Failure{absent};
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> find(uint32_t type,const Name& key)const{
        need(!bytes.empty(),1813);auto directory=child(0,{type,{},true},1813);need(directory&0x80000000u);
        directory=child(directory&0x7fffffffu,key,1814);need(directory&0x80000000u);directory&=0x7fffffffu;
        // Deterministic first available language. Full Windows language fallback
        // is not supplied; original icon names have one language in this image.
        auto n=uint32_t(field<uint16_t>(bytes,size_t(directory)+12))+field<uint16_t>(bytes,size_t(directory)+14);need(n>0,1815);need(n<=4096&&size_t(directory)+16<=bytes.size()&&size_t(n)*8<=bytes.size()-directory-16);
        auto data=field<uint32_t>(bytes,size_t(directory)+20);need(!(data&0x80000000u));
        uint32_t address=field<uint32_t>(bytes,data),size=field<uint32_t>(bytes,size_t(data)+4);need(address>=rva);
        size_t offset=address-rva;need(offset<=bytes.size()&&size<=bytes.size()-offset);
        return {bytes.begin()+offset,bytes.begin()+offset+size};
    }
};
struct Icon {uint32_t width=0,height=0;std::vector<uint8_t> rgba;bool shared=false;};
inline Icon decode(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes){
    Icon out;
    if(bytes.size()>=8&&!png_sig_cmp(bytes.data(),0,8)){
        png_image image{};image.version=PNG_IMAGE_VERSION;
        if(!png_image_begin_read_from_memory(&image,bytes.data(),bytes.size())){png_image_free(&image);throw Failure{193};}
        if(!image.width||!image.height||image.width>1024||image.height>1024){png_image_free(&image);throw Failure{193};}
        out.width=image.width;out.height=image.height;image.format=PNG_FORMAT_RGBA;out.rgba.resize(PNG_IMAGE_SIZE(image));
        auto ok=png_image_finish_read(&image,nullptr,out.rgba.data(),0,nullptr);png_image_free(&image);need(ok!=0);return out;
    }
    need(field<uint32_t>(bytes,0)==40&&field<uint16_t>(bytes,12)==1&&field<uint32_t>(bytes,16)==0);
    int32_t width=field<int32_t>(bytes,4),doubled=field<int32_t>(bytes,8);uint16_t bits=field<uint16_t>(bytes,14);
    need(width>0&&width<=1024&&doubled>0&&doubled<=2048&&!(doubled&1)&&(bits==8||bits==24||bits==32));
    out.width=uint32_t(width);out.height=uint32_t(doubled/2);uint32_t colors=bits==8?field<uint32_t>(bytes,32):0;if(bits==8&&!colors)colors=256;need(colors<=256);
    size_t pixels=40+colors*4,stride=((size_t(width)*bits+31)/32)*4,mask_stride=((size_t(width)+31)/32)*4,mask=pixels+stride*out.height;
    need(mask<=bytes.size()&&mask_stride*out.height<=bytes.size()-mask);out.rgba.resize(size_t(out.width)*out.height*4);
    bool has_alpha=false;if(bits==32)for(uint32_t y=0;y<out.height;++y)for(uint32_t x=0;x<out.width;++x)has_alpha=has_alpha||bytes[pixels+y*stride+x*4+3]!=0;
    for(uint32_t y=0;y<out.height;++y)for(uint32_t x=0;x<out.width;++x){size_t row=out.height-y-1,from=pixels+row*stride+x*(bits/8),to=(size_t(y)*out.width+x)*4;
        if(bits==8){auto index=bytes[from];need(index<colors);from=40+index*4;}
        out.rgba[to]=bytes[from+2];out.rgba[to+1]=bytes[from+1];out.rgba[to+2]=bytes[from];
        bool transparent=(bytes[mask+row*mask_stride+x/8]&(0x80>>(x%8)))!=0;
        out.rgba[to+3]=transparent?0:(bits==32&&has_alpha?bytes[from+3]:255);
    }return out;
}
inline std::mutex mutex;
inline uintptr_t module=0,next=0x74000000;
inline Table table;
```

```cpp
    for(int i=0;i<count;++i){int index=byte_index(source[i]);require(index>=0,"Unimplemented case-map character outside CP1252");out[i]=table[size_t(index)];}return count;
}
MS int narrow(uint32_t page,uint32_t flags,const uint16_t* source,int count,char* out,int capacity,const char* fallback,int* used){
    trace("WideCharToMultiByte");require((page==0||page==1252||page==65001)&&flags==0&&!fallback,"Unimplemented codepage/conversion flags");
    count=wide_count(source,count);require(capacity>=0,"Invalid wide conversion capacity");std::vector<char> bytes;bytes.reserve(size_t(count));bool defaulted=false;
    if(page==65001){try{auto converted=ge6_fs::utf8(source,size_t(count));bytes.assign(converted.begin(),converted.end());}catch(const std::range_error&){last_error=1113;return 0;}}
    else
    for(int i=0;i<count;++i){int value=page==65001?(source[i]<128?int(source[i]):-1):byte_index(source[i]);
        if(value<0&&page!=65001){auto found=std::find(ge6_ansi::bestfit_unicode.begin(),ge6_ansi::bestfit_unicode.end(),source[i]);if(found!=ge6_ansi::bestfit_unicode.end()){auto index=size_t(found-ge6_ansi::bestfit_unicode.begin());value=ge6_ansi::bestfit_byte[index];defaulted=defaulted||ge6_ansi::bestfit_default[index];}}
        if(value<0){last_error=1113;return 0;}bytes.push_back(char(value));}// Only observed CP1252 case substitutions are supported.
    if(used)*used=defaulted?1:0;
    auto required=int(bytes.size());if(capacity==0)return required;
    if(!out||capacity<required){last_error=122;return 0;}
    std::memcpy(out,bytes.data(),bytes.size());
    return required;
}

uintptr_t resolve(const std::string& library,const std::string& name){
    if(library=="ADVAPI32.dll"){
        if(name=="RegOpenKeyExA")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_system::open_key);
        if(name=="RegQueryValueExA")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_system::query_key);
        if(name=="RegCloseKey")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_system::close_key);
        if(name=="GetUserNameW")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_system::user_name);
        if(name=="GetUserNameA")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_system::user_name_a);
        if(name=="GetCurrentHwProfileA")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_system::hardware_profile_unavailable);
        if(name=="CryptAcquireContextA")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_crypto::acquire);
        if(name=="CryptGenRandom")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_crypto::random);
        if(name=="CryptReleaseContext")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_crypto::release);
        return 0;
    }
    if(library=="WINMM.dll"){
        if(name=="timeBeginPeriod")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_startup::begin);
        if(name=="timeEndPeriod")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_startup::end);
        if(name=="timeGetTime")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_startup::ticks);
        return 0;
    }
    if(library=="WS2_32.dll")return ge6_net::resolve(name);
    if(library=="IPHLPAPI.DLL"&&name=="GetAdaptersInfo")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_system::adapter_info_unavailable);
    if(library=="OpenAL32.dll")return ge6_audio::resolve(name);
    if(auto display=ge6_display::resolve(library,name))return display;
#ifdef GE6_X11
    if(auto window=ge6_windows::resolve(library,name))return window;
    if(auto gl=ge6_gl::resolve(library,name))return gl;
#endif
    if(library=="USER32.dll"){
        if(name=="LoadImageW")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_images::load);
        if(name=="DestroyIcon")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_images::destroy);
        if(name=="RegisterClassW")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_classes::add);
        if(name=="UnregisterClassW")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&ge6_classes::remove);
        return 0;
    }
    if(library=="fs15_local.dll"&&(image_kind=="local-platform"||image_kind=="fixture"))return ge6_local::resolve(name.c_str());
    if(library=="ole32.dll"&&name=="CoInitializeEx")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&com_initialize);
    if(library=="d3d9.dll"&&name=="Direct3DCreate9")return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&direct3d9_unavailable);
    if(library!="KERNEL32.dll")return 0;
    if(auto file=ge6_fs::resolve(name))return file;
#define BIND(n,f) if(name==n)return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&f)
    BIND("GetSystemTimeAsFileTime",file_time);BIND("GetCurrentProcessId",process_id);BIND("GetCurrentThreadId",thread_id);
    BIND("GetCurrentProcess",current_process);BIND("GetComputerNameA",ge6_system::computer_name);BIND("GetProcessTimes",ge6_system::process_times);BIND("GetSystemTimes",ge6_system::system_times);BIND("GetSystemRegistryQuota",ge6_system::registry_quota_unavailable);

    BIND("HeapSize",heap_size);BIND("HeapReAlloc",heap_realloc);
    BIND("InitializeCriticalSectionAndSpinCount",init_lock);BIND("InitializeCriticalSection",initialize_lock);BIND("EnterCriticalSection",enter_lock);BIND("LeaveCriticalSection",leave_lock);BIND("DeleteCriticalSection",delete_lock);
    BIND("FlsAlloc",ge6_slots::fls_alloc);BIND("TlsAlloc",ge6_slots::tls_alloc);BIND("FlsSetValue",ge6_slots::fls_set);BIND("TlsSetValue",ge6_slots::tls_set);BIND("FlsGetValue",ge6_slots::fls_get);BIND("TlsGetValue",ge6_slots::tls_get);BIND("FlsFree",ge6_slots::fls_free);BIND("TlsFree",ge6_slots::tls_free);

struct Image {
    uint8_t* mapped=nullptr;size_t size=0;uint8_t* trampolines=nullptr;size_t trampoline_bytes=65536;uint32_t entry=0;bool authored_fixture=false;
    ~Image(){if(mapped)munmap(mapped,size);if(trampolines)munmap(trampolines,trampoline_bytes);}
    template<class T>T get(uint32_t rva)const{require(rva<=size&&sizeof(T)<=size-rva,"PE virtual field outside image");T value;std::memcpy(&value,mapped+rva,sizeof(value));return value;}
    std::string name(uint32_t rva)const{require(rva<size,"PE name outside image");auto* begin=reinterpret_cast<const char*>(mapped+rva);auto* end=static_cast<const char*>(std::memchr(begin,0,std::min(size-rva,size_t(1024))));require(end!=nullptr,"Unterminated PE name");return std::string(begin,end);}
    void load(const std::vector<uint8_t>& raw,bool fixture){
        authored_fixture=fixture;
        require(read<uint16_t>(raw,0)==0x5a4d,"Not a PE image");auto pe=read<uint32_t>(raw,0x3c);require(read<uint32_t>(raw,pe)==0x4550&&read<uint16_t>(raw,pe+4)==0x8664,"Expected PE x86_64");
        auto count=read<uint16_t>(raw,pe+6),optional_size=read<uint16_t>(raw,pe+20);size_t opt=size_t(pe)+24;
        require(read<uint16_t>(raw,opt)==0x20b&&read<uint64_t>(raw,opt+24)==base,"Unsupported PE optional header/base");
        require(count&&count<=32&&optional_size>=240,"Unsupported PE section/directory count");
        auto stack_reserve=read<uint64_t>(raw,opt+72);if(stack_reserve)ge6_threads::default_stack=std::min(uint64_t(64*1024*1024),stack_reserve);
        size=read<uint32_t>(raw,opt+56);auto headers=read<uint32_t>(raw,opt+60);require(size>=4096&&size<=0x10000000&&size%4096==0&&headers<=size&&headers<=raw.size(),"Invalid PE image size");
        require(read<uint32_t>(raw,opt+112+9*8)==0,"PE TLS callbacks are not implemented");
        auto allocation=mmap(reinterpret_cast<void*>(base),size,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE,MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS|MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE,-1,0);
        require(allocation!=MAP_FAILED&&reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(allocation)==base,"GE6 preferred address range unavailable");mapped=static_cast<uint8_t*>(allocation);std::memcpy(mapped,raw.data(),headers);
        struct Section {uint32_t rva,length,flags;bool skip;};std::vector<Section> sections;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<count;++i){size_t offset=opt+optional_size+i*40;auto vs=read<uint32_t>(raw,offset+8),rva=read<uint32_t>(raw,offset+12),bytes=read<uint32_t>(raw,offset+16),file=read<uint32_t>(raw,offset+20),flags=read<uint32_t>(raw,offset+36);
            require(offset+8<=raw.size(),"Invalid PE section name");std::string section(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(raw.data()+offset),8);bool skip=section.rfind(".bind",0)==0;
            auto length=std::max(vs,bytes);require(rva>=4096&&rva%4096==0&&rva<=size&&length<=size-rva&&file<=raw.size()&&bytes<=raw.size()-file,"Invalid PE section bounds");
            for(const auto& old:sections)require(uint64_t(rva)+length<=old.rva||uint64_t(old.rva)+old.length<=rva,"Overlapping PE sections");
            if(!skip&&bytes)std::memcpy(mapped+rva,raw.data()+file,bytes);
            sections.push_back({rva,length,flags,skip});
        }
        auto resource=read<uint32_t>(raw,opt+128),resource_size=read<uint32_t>(raw,opt+132);
        if(resource||resource_size){require(resource&&resource_size&&uint64_t(resource)+resource_size<=size,"Invalid PE resource bounds");auto readable=std::find_if(sections.begin(),sections.end(),[&](const Section& section){return !section.skip&&(section.flags&0x40000000)&&resource>=section.rva&&uint64_t(resource)+resource_size<=uint64_t(section.rva)+section.length;});require(readable!=sections.end(),"PE resource directory outside readable section");}
        ge6_images::install(base,resource,resource_size?std::vector<uint8_t>(mapped+resource,mapped+resource+resource_size):std::vector<uint8_t>{});
        auto table=read<uint32_t>(raw,opt+120),table_size=read<uint32_t>(raw,opt+124);require(table&&table_size>=20&&table<size&&table_size<=size-table,"Invalid PE import directory");
        auto allocation2=mmap(nullptr,trampoline_bytes,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE,MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS,-1,0);require(allocation2!=MAP_FAILED,"Cannot allocate import-stop trampolines");trampolines=static_cast<uint8_t*>(allocation2);
        uint32_t supported=0;bool terminated=false;
        for(uint32_t off=0;off+20<=table_size;off+=20){auto lookup=get<uint32_t>(table+off),dll=get<uint32_t>(table+off+12),iat=get<uint32_t>(table+off+16);if(!lookup&&!dll&&!iat){terminated=true;break;}require(dll&&iat,"Invalid PE import descriptor");auto library=name(dll);if(!lookup)lookup=iat;
            for(uint32_t j=0;;++j){require(j<4096,"Unterminated PE import table");auto value=get<uint64_t>(lookup+j*8);if(!value)break;std::string symbol=(value>>63)?("ordinal:"+std::to_string(value&65535)):name(uint32_t(value)+2);auto target=resolve(library,symbol);
                if(target)++supported;else{require(imports.size()*32+32<=trampoline_bytes,"Import-stop space exhausted");uint32_t id=uint32_t(imports.size());imports.push_back(library+"!"+symbol);auto* code=trampolines+id*32;code[0]=0xb9;std::memcpy(code+1,&id,4);code[5]=0x48;code[6]=0xb8;uintptr_t stop=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&missing);std::memcpy(code+7,&stop,8);code[15]=0xff;code[16]=0xe0;target=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(code);}
                require(uint64_t(iat)+uint64_t(j)*8+8<=size,"IAT outside PE image");std::memcpy(mapped+iat+j*8,&target,8);
            }
        }require(terminated,"Unterminated PE import directory");require(mprotect(trampolines,trampoline_bytes,PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC)==0,"Cannot protect import-stop trampolines");
        // W^X: original executable pages become RX; mutable data stays RW.
        require(mprotect(mapped,size,PROT_NONE)==0,"Cannot protect PE image");require(mprotect(mapped,(headers+4095)&~size_t(4095),PROT_READ)==0,"Cannot protect PE headers");
        for(const auto& section:sections){if(!section.length||section.skip)continue;int protection=PROT_READ;if(section.flags&0x20000000)protection|=PROT_EXEC;if(section.flags&0x80000000)protection|=PROT_WRITE;require((protection&(PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC))!=(PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC),"Writable executable PE section rejected");require(mprotect(mapped+section.rva,(section.length+4095)&~size_t(4095),protection)==0,"Cannot protect PE section");}
        entry=fixture?read<uint32_t>(raw,opt+16):0x3fc96c;
        auto found=std::find_if(sections.begin(),sections.end(),[&](const Section& s){return !s.skip&&(s.flags&0x20000000)&&entry>=s.rva&&uint64_t(entry)<uint64_t(s.rva)+s.length;});require(found!=sections.end(),"CRT entry is not in executable code");
        std::cout<<"GE6_IMAGE_MAPPED base=0x"<<std::hex<<base<<" entry=0x"<<base+entry<<std::dec<<" supported_imports="<<supported<<" blocked_imports="<<imports.size()<<'\n';
    }
    void run(){ge6_native::Context thread;std::cout<<"GE6_NATIVE_NT_TIB_READY\n";using Entry=void(MS*)();auto entrypoint=reinterpret_cast<Entry>(mapped+entry);auto prefix=authored_fixture?"GE6_AUTHORED_FIXTURE":"GE6_ORIGINAL_CRT";std::cout<<prefix<<"_ENTER\n";entrypoint();ge6_slots::cleanup();std::cout<<prefix<<"_RETURN os_calls="<<calls<<'\n';}
};
}
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    std::cout.setf(std::ios::unitbuf);std::cerr.setf(std::ios::unitbuf);
    try{
        ge6_slots::trace=trace;ge6_slots::set_error=[](uint32_t value){last_error=value;};
        ge6_threads::trace=trace;ge6_threads::set_error=[](uint32_t value){last_error=value;};
        ge6_threads::record=[](const char* event,uintptr_t entry,uint32_t tid,uint32_t code){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(trace_mutex);std::cout<<"GE6_NATIVE_THREAD_"<<event<<" entry=0x"<<std::hex<<entry<<std::dec<<" tid="<<tid<<" code="<<code<<'\n';};
        ge6_fs::trace=trace;ge6_fs::set_error=[](uint32_t value){last_error=value;};
```

```h
    Context(){
        pthread_attr_t attr;if(pthread_getattr_np(pthread_self(),&attr))throw std::runtime_error("Cannot inspect Linux thread stack");

    }
```

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Run beside main.cpp.o and libopenal.a on Linux x86_64 (Ubuntu 24.04 toolchain).
# Replace libopenal.a with a compatible modified OpenAL Soft build if desired.
```
