```sh
  static) set -- -static ;;
  dynamic) set -- ;;
```

```h
#pragma once
// Authored process-local Windows counting semaphores using Linux C++ waits.
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
namespace ge6_semaphores {
#define GE6_SEM_MS __attribute__((ms_abi))
inline void(*trace)(const char*)=nullptr;
inline void(*set_error)(uint32_t)=nullptr;
inline void(*record)(const char*,uintptr_t,int32_t,int32_t,uintptr_t)=nullptr;
struct Semaphore {std::mutex mutex;std::condition_variable changed;int32_t count,maximum;Semaphore(int32_t initial,int32_t limit):count(initial),maximum(limit){}};
inline std::mutex registry_mutex;
inline std::map<uintptr_t,std::shared_ptr<Semaphore>> registry;
inline uintptr_t next=0x76000000;
inline std::shared_ptr<Semaphore> get(uintptr_t handle){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(registry_mutex);auto found=registry.find(handle);return found==registry.end()?nullptr:found->second;}
inline bool owns(uintptr_t handle){return bool(get(handle));}
inline GE6_SEM_MS uintptr_t create(void* security,int32_t initial,int32_t maximum,const char* name){
    trace("CreateSemaphoreA");if(security||name){set_error(50);return 0;}if(maximum<=0||initial<0||initial>maximum){set_error(87);return 0;}
    auto value=std::make_shared<Semaphore>(initial,maximum);uintptr_t handle;{std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(registry_mutex);handle=next++;registry.emplace(handle,std::move(value));}
    record("CREATE",handle,initial,maximum,reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(__builtin_return_address(0)));return handle;
}
```

```h
// Separate TLS/FLS index pools and per-thread values for native CRT state.

#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
```

```h
inline void events(){
    if(!display)return;
    while(XPending(display)){XEvent event{};XNextEvent(display,&event);uintptr_t handle=0;for(auto& item:windows)if(item.second.xid==event.xany.window){handle=item.first;break;}if(!handle)continue;
        auto& data=windows.at(handle);uint32_t type=0;uintptr_t wp=0;intptr_t lp=0;
        switch(event.type){case Expose:data.damaged.push_back({event.xexpose.x,event.xexpose.y,event.xexpose.x+event.xexpose.width,event.xexpose.y+event.xexpose.height});type=15;break;case ConfigureNotify:data.x=event.xconfigure.x;data.y=event.xconfigure.y;data.width=event.xconfigure.width;data.height=event.xconfigure.height;type=5;lp=intptr_t((uint32_t(data.height)<<16)|(uint32_t(data.width)&65535));break;case MapNotify:data.style|=0x10000000;type=24;wp=1;break;case UnmapNotify:data.style&=~0x10000000u;type=24;break;case FocusIn:foreground=handle;type=7;break;case FocusOut:if(foreground==handle)foreground=0;type=8;break;case ClientMessage:if(Atom(event.xclient.data.l[0])==XInternAtom(display,"WM_DELETE_WINDOW",False))type=16;break;default:break;}
        if(type)messages.push_back(Message{handle,type,0,wp,lp,milliseconds(),{0,0},0});
    }
}
inline GE6_WIN_MS int update_rect(uintptr_t handle,Rect* result,int erase){

inline GE6_WIN_MS int validate_rect(uintptr_t handle,const Rect* validated){
    trace("ValidateRect");std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(mutex);auto* data=window(handle);if(!data)return 0;events();

inline bool capture_on_stop(){
    const char* path=std::getenv("GE6_X11_CAPTURE");if(!path||!*path||!display)return false;
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(mutex);XSync(display,False);
    for(auto& item:windows){XWindowAttributes attributes{};if(XGetWindowAttributes(display,item.second.xid,&attributes))std::fprintf(stderr,"GE6_X11_WINDOW_SNAPSHOT hwnd=0x%lx xid=0x%lx width=%d height=%d viewable=%d procedure=0x%lx\n",item.first,item.second.xid,attributes.width,attributes.height,int(attributes.map_state==IsViewable),reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(item.second.procedure));}
    int width=DisplayWidth(display,0),height=DisplayHeight(display,0);if(width<=0||height<=0||width>8192||height>8192)return false;
    auto* source=XGetImage(display,DefaultRootWindow(display),0,0,unsigned(width),unsigned(height),AllPlanes,ZPixmap);if(!source)return false;
    std::vector<uint8_t> pixels(size_t(width)*size_t(height)*4);
    auto channel=[](unsigned long pixel,unsigned long mask){if(!mask)return uint8_t(0);while(!(mask&1)){mask>>=1;pixel>>=1;}return uint8_t(((pixel&mask)*255+mask/2)/mask);};
    for(int y=0;y<height;++y)for(int x=0;x<width;++x){auto value=XGetPixel(source,x,y);auto at=(size_t(y)*size_t(width)+size_t(x))*4;pixels[at]=channel(value,source->red_mask);pixels[at+1]=channel(value,source->green_mask);pixels[at+2]=channel(value,source->blue_mask);pixels[at+3]=255;}
    XDestroyImage(source);png_image image{};image.version=PNG_IMAGE_VERSION;image.width=unsigned(width);image.height=unsigned(height);image.format=PNG_FORMAT_RGBA;
    bool written=png_image_write_to_file(&image,path,0,pixels.data(),0,nullptr);if(written)std::fprintf(stderr,"GE6_X11_CAPTURE_SAVED width=%d height=%d path=%s\n",width,height,path);
    png_image_free(&image);return written;
}
```

```cpp
// Authored screenshot utility: reads actual X11 pixels, never draws game content.
#include "window_services.h"
#include <exception>
#include <sys/stat.h>
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    if(argc!=2){std::fprintf(stderr,"Usage: FS15GE6X11Snapshot output.png\n");return 2;}
    try{
        ge6_display::trace=[](const char*){};
        ge6_display::set_error=[](uint32_t){};
        if(!ge6_display::connect()||setenv("GE6_X11_CAPTURE",argv[1],1))return 1;
        if(!ge6_windows::capture_on_stop())return 1;
        struct stat result{};return stat(argv[1],&result)||result.st_size<24?1:0;
    }catch(const std::exception& error){std::fprintf(stderr,"X11 snapshot failed: %s\n",error.what());return 1;}
}
```

```cpp
// Original geometry/textures are local inputs. Fixed-function lighting and LOD0
// are temporary preview bindings, not recovered GE6 shaders/resource loading.
#define SDL_MAIN_HANDLED

constexpr float pi=3.14159265358979323846f;
void require(bool ok,const char* message){if(!ok)throw std::runtime_error(message);}
struct Input {
    std::ifstream file;
    explicit Input(const std::filesystem::path& path):file(path,std::ios::binary){require(bool(file),"Cannot open local scene resource");}
    void read(void* out,size_t size){file.read(static_cast<char*>(out),static_cast<std::streamsize>(size));require(bool(file),"Truncated scene resource");}
    template<class T>T get(){T out{};read(&out,sizeof(out));return out;}
    uint32_t count(uint32_t maximum){auto n=get<uint32_t>();require(n<=maximum,"Scene resource exceeds limit");return n;}
    std::string string(){auto n=count(1024);std::string out(n,'\0');read(out.data(),n);return out;}
    void end(){require(file.peek()==std::char_traits<char>::eof(),"Trailing resource data");}
};
template<class T>T symbol(const char* name){auto p=SDL_GL_GetProcAddress(name);require(p!=nullptr,name);return reinterpret_cast<T>(p);}
struct Driver {
    PFNGLGENBUFFERSPROC gen=symbol<PFNGLGENBUFFERSPROC>("glGenBuffers");
    PFNGLBINDBUFFERPROC bind=symbol<PFNGLBINDBUFFERPROC>("glBindBuffer");
    PFNGLBUFFERDATAPROC data=symbol<PFNGLBUFFERDATAPROC>("glBufferData");
    PFNGLDELETEBUFFERSPROC erase=symbol<PFNGLDELETEBUFFERSPROC>("glDeleteBuffers");
    using Range=void(APIENTRY*)(GLenum,GLuint,GLuint,GLsizei,GLenum,const void*);
    Range range=symbol<Range>("glDrawRangeElements");
    FS15GLBufferServices buffers{};
    FS15GLDrawServices draw{};
    alignas(16) std::array<uint8_t,0x190> state{};
    Driver(){
        buffers.user=this;
        buffers.gen=[](void* p,int n,uint32_t* b){static_cast<Driver*>(p)->gen(n,b);};
        buffers.bind=[](void* p,uint32_t t,uint32_t b){static_cast<Driver*>(p)->bind(t,b);};
        buffers.data=[](void* p,uint32_t t,size_t n,uintptr_t d,uint32_t u){static_cast<Driver*>(p)->data(t,static_cast<GLsizeiptr>(n),reinterpret_cast<void*>(d),u);};
        buffers.erase=[](void* p,int n,const uint32_t* b){static_cast<Driver*>(p)->erase(n,b);};
        buffers.allocate=[](void*,size_t n){return std::malloc(n);};buffers.release=[](void*,void* p){std::free(p);};
        draw.user=this;draw.point_size=[](void*,float s){glPointSize(s);};
        draw.arrays=[](void*,uint32_t m,int32_t first,int32_t n){glDrawArrays(m,first,n);};
        draw.elements=[](void*,uint32_t m,int32_t n,uint32_t t,uintptr_t o){glDrawElements(m,n,t,reinterpret_cast<const void*>(o));};
        draw.range=[](void* p,uint32_t m,uint32_t a,uint32_t b,int32_t n,uint32_t t,uintptr_t o){static_cast<Driver*>(p)->range(m,a,b,n,t,reinterpret_cast<const void*>(o));};
    }
};
struct Vertex {float p[3],n[3],uv[2];};
static_assert(sizeof(Vertex)==32);
struct Subset {uint32_t first,count;};
struct Mesh {
    FS15GLVertexBuffer* vertex=nullptr;FS15GLIndexBuffer index{};
    uint32_t vertex_count=0;std::vector<Subset> subsets;
    std::array<float,3> center{};float radius=0;
};
struct Material {std::array<float,4> color{};bool alpha=false;GLuint texture=0;};
struct Object {uint32_t mesh;std::array<float,16> world;std::vector<uint32_t> materials;std::array<float,3> center;float radius,clip;};
struct Scene {
    Driver& driver;std::map<uint32_t,Mesh> meshes;std::map<uint32_t,Material> materials;std::vector<Object> objects;
    std::map<std::string,GLuint> textures;std::array<float,5> camera{};
    explicit Scene(Driver& d):driver(d){}
    ~Scene(){for(auto& [id,m]:meshes){(void)id;if(m.vertex)fs15_gl_vertex_destroy(m.vertex,1,&driver.buffers);if(m.index.name)fs15_gl_index_destroy(&m.index,0,&driver.buffers);}for(auto& [name,id]:textures){(void)name;glDeleteTextures(1,&id);}}
    GLuint texture(const std::filesystem::path& folder,const std::string& name){
        if(name.empty())return 0;
        require(name.find('/')==std::string::npos&&name.find('\\')==std::string::npos&&name.find("..") == std::string::npos,"Invalid local texture name");
        auto found=textures.find(name);if(found!=textures.end())return found->second;
        Input input(folder/name);auto w=input.count(8192),h=input.count(8192);require(w&&h,"Empty texture");
        std::vector<uint8_t> pixels(size_t(w)*h*4);input.read(pixels.data(),pixels.size());input.end();
        GLuint id=0;glGenTextures(1,&id);textures.emplace(name,id);glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D,id);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,GL_LINEAR);glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,GL_LINEAR);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S,GL_REPEAT);glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D,GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T,GL_REPEAT);
        glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D,0,GL_RGBA,static_cast<GLsizei>(w),static_cast<GLsizei>(h),0,GL_RGBA,GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,pixels.data());return id;
    }
    void load_meshes(const std::filesystem::path& path){
        Input input(path);std::array<char,8> magic{};input.read(magic.data(),8);require(!std::memcmp(magic.data(),"FS15MSH\1",8),"Wrong mesh cache version");
        auto count=input.count(10000);
        for(uint32_t k=0;k<count;++k){
            auto id=input.get<uint32_t>(),nv=input.count(4000000),ni=input.count(12000000),ns=input.count(4096);
            require(nv&&ni&&ni%3==0,"Invalid mesh dimensions");require(meshes.find(id)==meshes.end(),"Duplicate mesh ID");
            auto& m=meshes[id];m.vertex_count=nv;m.subsets.resize(ns);
            for(auto& sub:m.subsets){sub.first=input.get<uint32_t>();sub.count=input.get<uint32_t>();require(sub.first<=ni&&sub.count<=ni-sub.first&&sub.count%3==0,"Invalid mesh subset");}
            if(!ns)m.subsets.push_back({0,ni});
            std::vector<Vertex> vertices(nv);std::vector<uint32_t> indices(ni);input.read(vertices.data(),vertices.size()*sizeof(Vertex));input.read(indices.data(),indices.size()*4);
            std::array<float,3> lo{vertices[0].p[0],vertices[0].p[1],vertices[0].p[2]};auto hi=lo;
            for(const auto& v:vertices){for(float x:v.p)require(std::isfinite(x),"Nonfinite position");for(float x:v.n)require(std::isfinite(x),"Nonfinite normal");for(float x:v.uv)require(std::isfinite(x),"Nonfinite UV");for(int j=0;j<3;++j){lo[j]=std::min(lo[j],v.p[j]);hi[j]=std::max(hi[j],v.p[j]);}}
            for(auto index:indices)require(index<nv,"Mesh index out of bounds");
            for(int j=0;j<3;++j)m.center[j]=(lo[j]+hi[j])*.5f;
            for(const auto& v:vertices){float r=0;for(int j=0;j<3;++j)r+=(v.p[j]-m.center[j])*(v.p[j]-m.center[j]);m.radius=std::max(m.radius,std::sqrt(r));}
            FS15GLBufferDesc vd{reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(vertices.data()),nv*uint32_t(sizeof(Vertex)),0,0};
            FS15GLBufferDesc ib{reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(indices.data()),ni*4,0,1};
            m.vertex=fs15_gl_vertex_create(driver.state.data(),driver.state.size(),&vd,&driver.buffers);
            require(m.vertex&&fs15_gl_index_construct(&m.index,&ib,&driver.buffers),"GE6 mesh buffer creation failed");
        }input.end();
    }
    void load(const std::filesystem::path& path){
        load_meshes(path.parent_path()/"scene.meshes");
        Input input(path);std::array<char,8> magic{};input.read(magic.data(),8);require(!std::memcmp(magic.data(),"GE6OBJ01",8),"Wrong scene adapter version");
        auto nm=input.count(10000),nn=input.count(500000);input.read(camera.data(),sizeof(camera));for(float x:camera)require(std::isfinite(x),"Invalid scene camera");
        for(uint32_t k=0;k<nm;++k){auto id=input.get<uint32_t>();Material m;input.read(m.color.data(),sizeof(m.color));for(float x:m.color)require(std::isfinite(x),"Invalid material color");m.alpha=input.count(1)!=0;m.texture=texture(path.parent_path(),input.string());require(materials.emplace(id,m).second,"Duplicate material");}
        std::vector<std::array<float,16>> worlds;std::vector<bool> visible;worlds.reserve(nn);visible.reserve(nn);
        for(uint32_t k=0;k<nn;++k){
            auto parent=input.get<int32_t>();require(parent>=-1&&parent<static_cast<int32_t>(k),"Invalid scene hierarchy");
            auto mesh=input.get<uint32_t>(),flags=input.count(1);std::array<float,10> trs{};input.read(trs.data(),sizeof(trs));for(float x:trs)require(std::isfinite(x),"Nonfinite scene transform");require(trs[9]>=0,"Negative clip distance");
            auto ni=input.count(4096);std::vector<uint32_t> ids(ni);for(auto& id:ids){id=input.get<uint32_t>();require(materials.find(id)!=materials.end(),"Missing material ID");}
            std::array<float,16> local{},world{};
            require(fs15_compose_trs(trs.data()+3,trs.data()+6,trs.data(),local.data(),16)!=0,"GE6 TRS composition failed");
            if(parent>=0)require(fs15_affine_multiply(worlds[parent].data(),16,local.data(),16,world.data(),16)!=0,"GE6 hierarchy composition failed");else world=local;
            bool shown=flags&&(parent<0||visible[parent]);worlds.push_back(world);visible.push_back(shown);
            auto found=meshes.find(mesh);if(!shown||!ni||found==meshes.end())continue;
            const auto& m=found->second;require(ni==m.subsets.size(),"Material/subset count mismatch");Object object{mesh,world,std::move(ids),{},0,trs[9]};
            float norm=0;for(int j=0;j<3;++j){object.center[j]=world[12+j];for(int a=0;a<3;++a){object.center[j]+=world[a*4+j]*m.center[a];norm+=world[a*4+j]*world[a*4+j];}}
            object.radius=m.radius*std::sqrt(norm);objects.push_back(std::move(object));
        }input.end();require(!objects.empty(),"No renderable scene objects");
        std::cout<<"GE6 object transport: "<<meshes.size()<<" decoded meshes, "<<objects.size()<<" eligible instances, "<<textures.size()<<" diffuse textures\n";
    }
};
struct Options {std::filesystem::path scene,capture;int frames=0;float distance=600;std::array<float,5> camera{};bool override_camera=false;};
Options options(int argc,char** argv){Options o;for(int i=1;i<argc;++i){std::string a=argv[i];auto next=[&](){require(i+1<argc,"Missing option value");return argv[++i];};
    if(a=="--scene")o.scene=next();else if(a=="--capture")o.capture=next();else if(a=="--frames")o.frames=std::stoi(next());else if(a=="--distance")o.distance=std::stof(next());else if(a=="--camera"){for(auto& x:o.camera)x=std::stof(next());o.override_camera=true;}else throw std::runtime_error("Unknown option: "+a);}
    require(!o.scene.empty(),"Usage: FS15GE6Objects --scene scene.ge6scene [--capture image.bmp --frames 1] [--camera x y z yaw pitch]");require(o.frames>=0&&std::isfinite(o.distance)&&o.distance>0&&o.distance<=10000,"Invalid frame/distance option");for(float x:o.camera)require(std::isfinite(x),"Invalid camera option");return o;}

int run(SDL_Window* window,const Options& o){
    Driver driver;Scene scene(driver);scene.load(o.scene);auto camera=o.override_camera?o.camera:scene.camera;
    std::cout<<"GL renderer: "<<glGetString(GL_RENDERER)<<"\nWASD/arrows or ZQSD: fly; Space/Ctrl: height; Shift: faster; right mouse: look; Escape: exit\n";
    glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK,GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
    const GLfloat ambient[]{.55f,.55f,.55f,1},diffuse[]{.7f,.7f,.65f,1};glLightModelfv(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_AMBIENT,ambient);glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0,GL_DIFFUSE,diffuse);glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE,GL_TRUE);
    glEnableClientState(GL_VERTEX_ARRAY);glEnableClientState(GL_NORMAL_ARRAY);glEnableClientState(GL_TEXTURE_COORD_ARRAY);glClearColor(.48f,.67f,.84f,1);
    FS15GLDrawState state{};state.layout=1;bool running=true;int frame=0;uint64_t previous=SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();size_t submitted=0,triangles=0;
    while(running){
        auto now=SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();float dt=std::min(.05f,float(double(now-previous)/double(SDL_GetPerformanceFrequency())));previous=now;
        SDL_Event event;while(SDL_PollEvent(&event)){if(event.type==SDL_QUIT)running=false;if(event.type==SDL_KEYDOWN&&event.key.keysym.sym==SDLK_ESCAPE)running=false;
            if(event.type==SDL_MOUSEMOTION&&(event.motion.state&SDL_BUTTON_RMASK)){camera[3]-=event.motion.xrel*.15f;camera[4]=std::clamp(camera[4]-event.motion.yrel*.15f,-89.f,89.f);}}
        auto keys=SDL_GetKeyboardState(nullptr);float speed=dt*(keys[SDL_SCANCODE_LSHIFT]?70.f:15.f),yaw=camera[3]*pi/180,pitch=camera[4]*pi/180;
        float forward=float(keys[SDL_SCANCODE_W]||keys[SDL_SCANCODE_Z]||keys[SDL_SCANCODE_UP])-float(keys[SDL_SCANCODE_S]||keys[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN]);
        float right=float(keys[SDL_SCANCODE_D]||keys[SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT])-float(keys[SDL_SCANCODE_A]||keys[SDL_SCANCODE_Q]||keys[SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT]);
        camera[0]+=speed*(-std::sin(yaw)*std::cos(pitch)*forward+std::cos(yaw)*right);camera[2]+=speed*(-std::cos(yaw)*std::cos(pitch)*forward-std::sin(yaw)*right);
        camera[1]+=speed*(std::sin(pitch)*forward+float(keys[SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE])-float(keys[SDL_SCANCODE_LCTRL]));
        int width,height;SDL_GL_GetDrawableSize(window,&width,&height);if(width<=0||height<=0){SDL_Delay(10);continue;}
        glViewport(0,0,width,height);glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
        float top=.1f*std::tan(60*pi/360),side=top*float(width)/float(height);
        std::array<float,16> projection{},camera_world{},view{},combined{};const float rotation[]{pitch,yaw,0},scale[]{1,1,1};
        require(fs15_scene_perspective(-side,side,-top,top,.1f,10000,projection.data(),16)!=0,"GE6 perspective failed");
        require(fs15_compose_trs(rotation,scale,camera.data(),camera_world.data(),16)&&fs15_affine_inverse(camera_world.data(),16,view.data(),16),"GE6 camera transform failed");
        require(fs15_scene_projective_multiply(projection.data(),16,view.data(),16,combined.data(),16)!=0,"GE6 view projection failed");
        FS15SceneFrustum frustum{};require(fs15_scene_frustum_matrix(&frustum,combined.data(),16)!=0,"GE6 frustum failed");
        glMatrixMode(GL_PROJECTION);glLoadMatrixf(projection.data());glMatrixMode(GL_MODELVIEW);glLoadMatrixf(view.data());const GLfloat light[]{-.4f,1,.3f,0};glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0,GL_POSITION,light);
        submitted=triangles=0;
        for(const auto& object:scene.objects){float dist2=0;for(int j=0;j<3;++j)dist2+=(object.center[j]-camera[j])*(object.center[j]-camera[j]);float limit=std::min(o.distance,object.clip)+object.radius;if(dist2>limit*limit)continue;
            const float sphere[]{object.center[0],object.center[1],object.center[2],object.radius};int visible=0;require(fs15_scene_frustum_sphere(&frustum,sphere,&visible)!=0,"GE6 object visibility query failed");if(!visible)continue;
            const auto& mesh=scene.meshes.at(object.mesh);driver.bind(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER,mesh.vertex->name);driver.bind(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER,mesh.index.name);
            glVertexPointer(3,GL_FLOAT,sizeof(Vertex),nullptr);glNormalPointer(GL_FLOAT,sizeof(Vertex),reinterpret_cast<void*>(12));glTexCoordPointer(2,GL_FLOAT,sizeof(Vertex),reinterpret_cast<void*>(24));
            glPushMatrix();glMultMatrixf(object.world.data());state.index=const_cast<FS15GLIndexBuffer*>(&mesh.index);
            for(size_t k=0;k<mesh.subsets.size();++k){const auto& material=scene.materials.at(object.materials[k]);const auto& sub=mesh.subsets[k];
                glColor4fv(material.color.data());if(material.texture){glEnable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D,material.texture);}else glDisable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
                if(material.alpha){glEnable(GL_ALPHA_TEST);glAlphaFunc(GL_GREATER,.4f);}else glDisable(GL_ALPHA_TEST);
                require(fs15_gl_draw(&state,sub.count,sub.first,0,0,mesh.vertex_count,&driver.draw)!=0,"GE6 subset draw failed");triangles+=sub.count/3;
            }glPopMatrix();++submitted;
        }
        require(glGetError()==GL_NO_ERROR,"OpenGL object rendering error");++frame;
        if(!o.capture.empty()&&(o.frames==0||frame==o.frames)){
            auto* surface=SDL_CreateRGBSurfaceWithFormat(0,width,height,24,SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGB24);require(surface!=nullptr,"Capture allocation failed");glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT,1);
            std::vector<uint8_t> pixels(size_t(width)*height*3);glReadPixels(0,0,width,height,GL_RGB,GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE,pixels.data());
            for(int y=0;y<height;++y)std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(surface->pixels)+y*surface->pitch,pixels.data()+size_t(height-1-y)*width*3,size_t(width)*3);
            int result=SDL_SaveBMP(surface,o.capture.string().c_str());SDL_FreeSurface(surface);require(result==0,"Cannot save capture");if(!o.frames)running=false;
        }
        SDL_GL_SwapWindow(window);if(o.frames&&frame>=o.frames)running=false;
        if(frame%30==0){std::string title="GE6 recovered draw | "+std::to_string(submitted)+" original objects | temporary materials";SDL_SetWindowTitle(window,title.c_str());}
    }
    std::cout<<"Submitted "<<submitted<<" object instances / "<<triangles<<" triangles in final frame; temporary lighting/LOD/material bindings\n";
    return 0;
}
}
int main(int argc,char** argv){
    SDL_Window* window=nullptr;SDL_GLContext context=nullptr;int result=1;
    try{auto o=options(argc,argv);SDL_SetMainReady();require(SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO)==0,SDL_GetError());SDL_GL_SetAttribute(SDL_GL_CONTEXT_MAJOR_VERSION,2);SDL_GL_SetAttribute(SDL_GL_CONTEXT_MINOR_VERSION,1);SDL_GL_SetAttribute(SDL_GL_DEPTH_SIZE,24);SDL_GL_SetAttribute(SDL_GL_DOUBLEBUFFER,1);
        window=SDL_CreateWindow("GE6 original objects - temporary material transport",SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED,SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED,1280,720,SDL_WINDOW_OPENGL|SDL_WINDOW_RESIZABLE|(o.frames?SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN:SDL_WINDOW_SHOWN));require(window!=nullptr,SDL_GetError());context=SDL_GL_CreateContext(window);require(context!=nullptr,SDL_GetError());SDL_GL_SetSwapInterval(o.frames?0:1);result=run(window,o);
    }catch(const std::exception& e){std::cerr<<e.what()<<'\n';}
    if(context)SDL_GL_DeleteContext(context);
    if(window)SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
    SDL_Quit();return result;
}
```

`src/launcher/main.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * Behavioral reconstruction of the FS15 launcher, NOT of the game engine.
 * Evidence: original FarmingSimulator2015.exe, SHA-256 recorded in analysis/pe/.
 * 0x00401860: XML startup.cmdline, x64/x86 prefix, forward arguments.
 * 0x004045e0: GetNativeSystemInfo/GetSystemInfo, architecture == AMD64 (9).
 * 0x004046e0: quote executable, CreateProcess, wait up to 5000 ms.
 * This source uses new C++17/Unicode/XML plumbing and does not claim binary parity.
 */
#include <windows.h>
#include <shlwapi.h>
#include <xmllite.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <iterator>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

static void check(HRESULT result, const char* operation) {
    if (FAILED(result)) throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + " failed (HRESULT " + std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned long>(result)) + ")");
}

static std::wstring trim(const std::wstring& text) {
    const auto first = text.find_first_not_of(L" \t\r\n");
    if (first == std::wstring::npos) return {};
    return text.substr(first, text.find_last_not_of(L" \t\r\n") - first + 1);
}

static std::wstring read_cmdline(const std::string& xml) {
    ComPtr<IStream> stream;
    stream.Attach(SHCreateMemStream(reinterpret_cast<const BYTE*>(xml.data()), static_cast<UINT>(xml.size())));
    if (!stream) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot create XML stream");
    ComPtr<IXmlReader> reader;
    check(CreateXmlReader(__uuidof(IXmlReader), reinterpret_cast<void**>(reader.GetAddressOf()), nullptr), "CreateXmlReader");
    check(reader->SetProperty(XmlReaderProperty_DtdProcessing, DtdProcessing_Prohibit), "SetProperty");
    check(reader->SetInput(stream.Get()), "SetInput");
    XmlNodeType type = XmlNodeType_None;
    bool root_seen = false, in_cmdline = false, found = false;
    std::wstring command;
    HRESULT result;
    while ((result = reader->Read(&type)) == S_OK) {
        UINT depth = 0;
        check(reader->GetDepth(&depth), "GetDepth");
        const WCHAR* text = nullptr;
        UINT length = 0;
        if (type == XmlNodeType_Element) {
            check(reader->GetLocalName(&text, &length), "GetLocalName");
            const std::wstring name(text, length);
            if (depth == 0) {
                if (name != L"startup") throw std::runtime_error("Expected <startup> root");
                root_seen = true;
            } else if (depth == 1 && name == L"cmdline") {
                if (found) throw std::runtime_error("Duplicate <cmdline>");
                in_cmdline = true;
                found = true;
                if (reader->IsEmptyElement()) in_cmdline = false;
            } else if (in_cmdline) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Nested XML is not a command line");
            }
        } else if (type == XmlNodeType_EndElement && depth == 1) {
            in_cmdline = false;
        } else if (in_cmdline && (type == XmlNodeType_Text || type == XmlNodeType_CDATA || type == XmlNodeType_Whitespace)) {
            check(reader->GetValue(&text, &length), "GetValue");
            command.append(text, length);
        }
    }
    check(result, "Read XML");
    command = trim(command);
    if (!root_seen || !found || command.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("Missing startup.cmdline");
    return command;
}

static bool native_amd64() {
    SYSTEM_INFO info{};
    const auto kernel = GetModuleHandleW(L"kernel32.dll");
    using GetInfo = void(WINAPI*)(LPSYSTEM_INFO);
    const auto get_native = reinterpret_cast<GetInfo>(GetProcAddress(kernel, "GetNativeSystemInfo"));
    if (get_native) get_native(&info); else GetSystemInfo(&info);
    return info.wProcessorArchitecture == PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE_AMD64;
}

// Encode one argument according to Windows argv parsing, including final backslashes.
static std::wstring quote(const std::wstring& text) {
    std::wstring result = L"\"";
    size_t backslashes = 0;
    for (wchar_t ch : text) {
        if (ch == L'\\') { ++backslashes; continue; }
        if (ch == L'\"') {
            result.append(backslashes * 2 + 1, L'\\');
            result += ch;
        } else {
            result.append(backslashes, L'\\');
            result += ch;
        }
        backslashes = 0;
    }
    result.append(backslashes * 2, L'\\');
    return result + L"\"";
}

struct Plan { fs::path executable; std::wstring arguments; };
static Plan make_plan(const fs::path& root, const std::wstring& startup, bool use_x64) {
    // The original launcher splits its configured command at the first space.
    const auto split = startup.find(L' ');
    const auto name = startup.substr(0, split);
    return {root / (use_x64 ? L"x64" : L"x86") / name,
            split == std::wstring::npos ? L"" : startup.substr(split + 1)};
}

static int self_test() {
    const std::string xml = "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\"?><startup><cmdline>FarmingSimulator2015Game.exe -name FarmingSimulator2015</cmdline></startup>";
    const auto command = read_cmdline(xml);
    const auto x64 = make_plan(L"C:\\Games\\FS15", command, true);
    const auto x86 = make_plan(L"C:\\Games\\FS15", command, false);
    auto require = [](bool passed, const char* name) { if (!passed) throw std::runtime_error(name); };
    require(x64.executable == fs::path(L"C:\\Games\\FS15\\x64\\FarmingSimulator2015Game.exe"), "x64 path");
    require(x86.executable == fs::path(L"C:\\Games\\FS15\\x86\\FarmingSimulator2015Game.exe"), "x86 path");
    require(x64.arguments == L"-name FarmingSimulator2015", "configured arguments");
    require(make_plan(L"C:\\FS15", L"game.exe", true).arguments.empty(), "no configured arguments");
    require(read_cmdline("<startup><cmdline>game.exe a&amp;b</cmdline></startup>") == L"game.exe a&b", "XML entities");
    require(quote(L"C:\\path with spaces\\") == L"\"C:\\path with spaces\\\\\"", "trailing slash quoting");
    require(quote(L"a\"b") == L"\"a\\\"b\"", "embedded quote");
    bool rejected = false;
    try { read_cmdline("<startup><cmdline>unterminated"); } catch (const std::exception&) { rejected = true; }
    require(rejected, "malformed XML rejection");
    rejected = false;
    try { read_cmdline("<startup/>"); } catch (const std::exception&) { rejected = true; }
    require(rejected, "missing command rejection");
    std::wcout << L"9 launcher checks passed. Native AMD64: " << (native_amd64() ? L"yes" : L"no") << L"\n";
    return 0;
}

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv) {
    const auto initialized = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    if (FAILED(initialized)) { std::cerr << "COM initialization failed\n"; return 1; }
    int exit_code = 0;
    try {
        fs::path root = LR"(C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Farming Simulator 15)";
        const DWORD required = GetEnvironmentVariableW(L"FS15_GAME_DIR", nullptr, 0);
        if (required) {
            std::wstring configured(required, L'\0');
            const DWORD length = GetEnvironmentVariableW(L"FS15_GAME_DIR", configured.data(), required);
            if (length && length < required) { configured.resize(length); root = configured; }
        }
        bool dry_run = false, use_x64 = native_amd64();
        fs::path steam;
        std::vector<std::wstring> extra;
        for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
            const std::wstring arg = argv[i];
            if (arg == L"--self-test") { exit_code = self_test(); CoUninitialize(); return exit_code; }
            if (arg == L"--dry-run") dry_run = true;
            else if (arg == L"--steam" && i + 1 < argc) steam = argv[++i];
            else if (arg == L"--game-dir" && i + 1 < argc) root = argv[++i];
            else if (arg == L"--arch" && i + 1 < argc) {
                const std::wstring arch = argv[++i];
                if (arch != L"x64" && arch != L"x86") throw std::runtime_error("--arch must be x64 or x86");
                use_x64 = arch == L"x64";
            } else if (arg == L"--") {
                while (++i < argc) extra.emplace_back(argv[i]);
                break;
            } else if (arg == L"--help") {
                std::wcout << L"FS15LauncherRebuilt [--game-dir PATH] [--arch x64|x86] [--steam CLIENT] [--dry-run] [-- game arguments]\nReconstructed launcher only; uses the original installed game.\n--steam requests the normal Steam app 313160 launch; architecture is selected by Steam.\n";
                CoUninitialize(); return 0;
            } else throw std::runtime_error("Unknown/incomplete option; use --help");
        }
        root = fs::absolute(root);
        std::ifstream file(root / L"FarmingSimulator2015.xml", std::ios::binary);
        if (!file) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open FarmingSimulator2015.xml in game directory");
        const std::string xml((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file)), {});
        const auto plan = make_plan(root, read_cmdline(xml), use_x64);
        if (!fs::is_regular_file(plan.executable)) throw std::runtime_error("Configured game executable does not exist");
        const auto launch_executable = steam.empty() ? plan.executable : fs::absolute(steam);
        if (!fs::is_regular_file(launch_executable)) throw std::runtime_error("Launch client does not exist");
        std::wstring cmdline = quote(launch_executable.wstring());
        if (!steam.empty()) cmdline += L" -applaunch 313160";
        else if (!plan.arguments.empty()) cmdline += L" " + plan.arguments;
        for (const auto& arg : extra) cmdline += L" " + quote(arg);
        std::wcout << L"Reconstructed launcher; original game executable.\nWorking directory: " << root.wstring() << L"\nCommand: " << cmdline << L"\n";
        if (!dry_run) {
            STARTUPINFOW startup{};
            startup.cb = sizeof(startup);
            PROCESS_INFORMATION process{};
            if (!CreateProcessW(launch_executable.c_str(), cmdline.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE,
                                NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS, nullptr, root.c_str(), &startup, &process)) {
                throw std::runtime_error("CreateProcessW failed: " + std::to_string(GetLastError()));
            }
            CloseHandle(process.hThread);
            WaitForSingleObject(process.hProcess, 5000);
            DWORD child_code = 0;
            GetExitCodeProcess(process.hProcess, &child_code);
            std::wcout << L"PID: " << process.dwProcessId << L"; status after 5s: " << child_code << L"\n";
            if (!steam.empty()) std::wcout << L"Steam launch request only; verify the native profile log for game startup.\n";
            CloseHandle(process.hProcess);
            if (child_code != STILL_ACTIVE) exit_code = static_cast<int>(child_code);
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        std::cerr << "Error: " << error.what() << "\n";
        exit_code = 1;
    }
    CoUninitialize();
    return exit_code;
}
```

```cpp
// Authored local-only platform adapter. No client, login, ownership or network
// service is implemented. Apps/User/UserStats deliberately return null.
#include <windows.h>
#include <cstdint>

static volatile LONG seen=0;
static void record(LONG bit,const char* name,DWORD bytes) {
    if(InterlockedOr(&seen,bit)&bit)return;
    wchar_t path[32768];
    const DWORD size=GetEnvironmentVariableW(L"FS15_LOCAL_TRACE",path,32768);
    if(!size||size>=32768)return;
    HANDLE file=CreateFileW(path,FILE_APPEND_DATA,FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE,nullptr,OPEN_ALWAYS,FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,nullptr);
    if(file==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)return;
    DWORD written;WriteFile(file,name,bytes,&written,nullptr);CloseHandle(file);
}
#define TRACE(BIT,NAME) record(1L<<(BIT),NAME "\n",sizeof(NAME))
static std::uintptr_t zero(){return 0;}
static std::uintptr_t app_id(){TRACE(13,"UTIL_APP_ID");return 313160;}
struct LocalUtils {std::uintptr_t (*methods[24])();};
static LocalUtils methods{};
struct Object {LocalUtils* methods;};
static Object utils{&methods};
BOOL WINAPI DllMain(HINSTANCE module,DWORD reason,LPVOID) {
    if(reason==DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH){DisableThreadLibraryCalls(module);for(auto& fn:methods.methods)fn=zero;methods.methods[9]=app_id;}
    return TRUE;
}
#define EXPORT extern "C" __declspec(dllexport)
EXPORT void* SteamUtils(){TRACE(0,"UTILS");return &utils;}
EXPORT void SteamAPI_RegisterCallback(void*,int){TRACE(1,"REGISTER_NOOP");}
EXPORT void* SteamUserStats(){TRACE(2,"USER_STATS_UNAVAILABLE");return nullptr;}
EXPORT void SteamAPI_WriteMiniDump(unsigned,unsigned,void*){TRACE(3,"MINIDUMP_NOOP");}
EXPORT void SteamAPI_SetMiniDumpComment(const char*){TRACE(4,"COMMENT_NOOP");}
EXPORT void SteamAPI_Shutdown(){TRACE(5,"SHUTDOWN_NOOP");}
EXPORT void* SteamClient(){TRACE(6,"CLIENT_UNAVAILABLE");return nullptr;}
EXPORT void SteamAPI_UnregisterCallback(void*){TRACE(7,"UNREGISTER_NOOP");}
EXPORT bool SteamAPI_Init(){TRACE(8,"INIT_UNAVAILABLE");return false;}
EXPORT void* SteamApps(){TRACE(9,"APPS_UNAVAILABLE");return nullptr;}
EXPORT bool SteamAPI_RestartAppIfNecessary(unsigned){TRACE(10,"NO_CLIENT_RESTART");return false;}
EXPORT void SteamAPI_RunCallbacks(){TRACE(11,"CALLBACKS_NOOP");}
EXPORT void* SteamUser(){TRACE(12,"USER_UNAVAILABLE");return nullptr;}
EXPORT unsigned fs15_local_adapter_version(){return 1;}
```

```lua
local keyActions = {
    [13] = InputBinding.MENU_ACCEPT, [27] = InputBinding.MENU_CANCEL,
    [37] = InputBinding.MENU_LEFT, [38] = InputBinding.MENU_UP,
    [39] = InputBinding.MENU_RIGHT, [40] = InputBinding.MENU_DOWN
}
function fs15_menu_key(vk, isDown)
    local action = keyActions[vk]
    if action ~= nil then
        if isDown and not pressed[action] then events[action] = true end
        pressed[action] = isDown == true
        if isDown and vk >= 37 and vk <= 40 then
            local focused = FocusManager:getFocusedElement()
            if focused == nil and g_gui.currentGuiName == "MainScreen" then
                FocusManager:setFocus(g_mainScreen.careerButton)
            end
        end
    end
    g_gui:keyEvent(0, vk, 0, isDown)
end
function fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, isDown, isUp, button)
    if button == Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP or button == Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN then
        local opposite = button == Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP and Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN or Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP
        Input.mouseButtonPressedThisFrame[opposite] = false
    end
    Input.updateMouseButtonState(button, isDown)
    g_gui:mouseEvent(x, y, isDown, isUp, button)
end
function fs15_menu_update(dt)
    g_gui:update(dt)
    events = {}
    Input.updateFrameEnd()
end

function fs15_menu_selfcheck()
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "MainScreen", "Expected MainScreen")
    assert(g_gui.currentGui.target == g_mainScreen, "Recovered MainScreen target missing")
    local visible = 0
    for _, name in ipairs({ "careerButton", "multiplayerButton", "tutorialsButton",
        "achievementsButton", "settingsButton", "creditsButton", "quitButton" }) do
        local button = assert(g_mainScreen[name], "Missing recovered button: " .. name)
        assert(button:getIsVisible(), "Recovered button is hidden: " .. name)
        assert(type(button.onClick) == "function", "Missing original callback: " .. name)
        assert(button.text ~= nil and not button.text:match("^Missing "), "Missing menu translation")
        visible = visible + 1
    end
    assert(visible == 7, "Steam edition must display seven main buttons")
    assert(g_gui.guis.CreditsScreen.target == g_creditsScreen, "Credits source not initialized")
    assert(g_gui.guis.CareerScreen.target == g_careerScreen, "Career source not initialized")
    fs15_newgame_selfcheck()
    return "current_gui=MainScreen; visible_buttons=7; recovered_callbacks=7; credits_initialized=true; career_initialized=true; newgame_initialized=true"
end

function fs15_menu_test_inputs()
    fs15_menu_selfcheck()
    local function click(button)
        assert(button:getIsVisible() and not button.disabled, "Test requires an active recovered button")
        local x = button.absPosition[1] + button.size[1] / 2
        local y = button.absPosition[2] + button.size[2] / 2
        fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, true, false, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
        fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, false, true, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
    end

    fs15_career_test_inputs()
    fs15_career_test_fixture_begin()
    local newgameOk, newgameFailure = xpcall(fs15_newgame_test_inputs, debug.traceback)
    fs15_career_test_fixture_end()
    if not newgameOk then error(newgameFailure, 0) end

    -- Exercise the recovered FocusManager navigation and activation logic.
    FocusManager:setFocus(g_mainScreen.careerButton)
    fs15_menu_key(40, true)
    fs15_menu_update(16)
    fs15_menu_key(40, false)
    assert(FocusManager:getFocusedElement() == g_mainScreen.multiplayerButton, "Down key did not move recovered focus")
    fs15_menu_key(13, true)
    fs15_menu_update(16)
    fs15_menu_key(13, false)
    assert(g_mainScreen.lastActiveButton == g_mainScreen.multiplayerButton, "Original multiplayer callback did not run")
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "MainScreen", "Unsupported multiplayer changed the menu")

    -- Credits use recovered source and XML, with their original return callback.
    click(g_mainScreen.creditsButton)
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "CreditsScreen", "Credits callback did not open the recovered screen")
    fs15_menu_update(800)
    assert(#g_creditsScreen.creditsLines > 0, "Recovered credits update did not create a line")
    menuCapture("CreditsScreen")
    click(g_creditsScreen.test1234)
    fs15_menu_selfcheck()

    -- Quit runs last. The native host records and verifies its exit request.
    click(g_mainScreen.quitButton)
    print("Menu input checks: recovered career/new-game flow; keyboard Down/Enter multiplayer boundary; credits mouse open/update/back; quit mouse callback")
end
```

`src/menu/career.lua`:

```lua
-- Authored integration for the recovered career screen and mission metadata.
-- The native save provider reads careerSavegame.xml; this adapter never saves,
-- deletes, loads a saved simulation, or executes a mission script.

local installed = false
local fixtureDepth, nativeGetInfo = 0, nil

local function unavailableWrite()
    menuUnavailable("Savegame changes (read-only career browser)")
end

local function finiteNumber(value)
    return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function supportedDisplayValues(savegame)
    return finiteNumber(savegame.difficulty) and savegame.difficulty >= 1 and savegame.difficulty <= 3
        and savegame.difficulty == math.floor(savegame.difficulty)
        and finiteNumber(savegame.money) and finiteNumber(savegame.playTime) and savegame.playTime >= 0
end

function fs15_install_career()
    assert(not installed, "Career adapter is already installed")
    assert(MapsUtil ~= nil, "Install the base-map menu catalogue before career")
    assert(type(saveGetInfoById) == "function", "Read-only save provider is required")

    -- These sources declare the original classes. World fruit/fill registries
    -- remain uninitialized; no vehicle, crop or simulation method is executed.
    source("dataS/scripts/FruitUtil.lua")
    source("dataS/scripts/vehicles/specializations/Fillable.lua")
    source("dataS/scripts/MissionInfo.lua")
    source("dataS/scripts/FSMissionInfo.lua")
    source("dataS/scripts/FSCareerMissionInfo.lua")
    source("dataS/scripts/gui/CareerScreen.lua")

    local recoveredOpen = CareerScreen.onOpen
    function CareerScreen:onOpen()
        recoveredOpen(self)
        self.buttonDeletePC:setDisabled(true)
        self.buttonDeleteConsole:setDisabled(true)
    end

    -- Keep the original list cloning, XML metadata parsing and text formatting.
    -- A failed metadata parse must not turn an occupied slot into a new game.
    local recoveredUpdateText = CareerScreen.updateSavegameText
    function CareerScreen:updateSavegameText(index)
        local savegame = self.savegames[index]
        local metadata, displayName = saveGetInfoById(index)
        -- Money is parsed by the recovered class with tonumber(string), so the
        -- native XML float reader's finite-value check cannot protect it here.
        -- Invalid metadata remains occupied/read only after resetting defaults.
        if savegame.isValid and (self.fs15ScanFailed or not supportedDisplayValues(savegame)) then
            savegame:loadDefaults()
        end
        savegame.fs15HasMetadata = self.fs15ScanFailed or metadata ~= ""
        savegame.fs15DisplayName = displayName
        savegame.fs15MetadataUnavailable = self.fs15ScanFailed or savegame.fs15HasMetadata and not savegame.isValid
        recoveredUpdateText(self, index)
        if savegame.fs15MetadataUnavailable and not savegame.isInvalidUser then
            local message = self.fs15ScanFailed
                and "Savegames could not be scanned. This slot is unavailable and read only."
                or "Save metadata is unavailable or unsupported. This slot is read only."
            self.listItemInfoText[index]:setText(message)
        end
    end

    local recoveredScanComplete = CareerScreen.onSaveGameUpdateComplete
    function CareerScreen:onSaveGameUpdateComplete(errorCode)
        self.fs15ScanFailed = errorCode ~= Savegame.ERROR_OK and errorCode ~= Savegame.ERROR_DATA_CORRUPT
        if errorCode == Savegame.ERROR_DATA_CORRUPT then
            -- Failed slots are explicitly labelled above. The original recovery
            -- dialog can lead to destructive operations unavailable in this host.
            self.ignoreCorruptOnNextUpdate = true
        elseif errorCode ~= Savegame.ERROR_OK then
            self:setIsWaitingForSaveGameInfo(false)
            self:updateSavegameListElements()
            menuUnavailable("Read savegame metadata (scan failed)")
            return
        end
        recoveredScanComplete(self, errorCode)
    end

    function CareerScreen:startSavegame(savegame)
        assert(savegame ~= nil, "Select a career slot before starting")
        self.currentSavegame = savegame
        if savegame.fs15MetadataUnavailable or savegame.isInvalidUser then
            menuUnavailable("Read saved game metadata for this slot")
        elseif savegame.isValid then
            self:startCurrentSavegame()
        else
            -- This opens the original DifficultyScreen. No storage allocation
            -- is requested because a menu selection never creates a savegame.
            self:onYesNoNotEnoughSpaceForNewSaveGame(true)
        end
    end

    function CareerScreen:startCurrentSavegame()
        local savegame = assert(self.currentSavegame, "No selected career slot")
        self.lastWorldRequest = {
            mapId = savegame.mapId,
            difficulty = savegame.difficulty,
            savegameIndex = savegame.savegameIndex,
            isExisting = savegame.isValid == true
        }
        fs15_last_world_request = self.lastWorldRequest
        if savegame.isValid then
            menuUnavailable("Load saved game simulation (map scene viewer available for new selections)")
        else
            if not menuLaunchWorld(savegame.mapId, savegame.difficulty, savegame.savegameIndex) then
                menuUnavailable("Launch world simulation (unavailable on this platform)")
            end
        end
    end

    -- Buttons and every recovered entry point to save mutations are blocked.
    -- The native provider independently rejects its write/delete API as well.
    CareerScreen.onClickCancel = unavailableWrite
    CareerScreen.onYesNoDeleteSavegame = unavailableWrite
    CareerScreen.deleteCurrentSavegame = unavailableWrite
    CareerScreen.backupSavegame = unavailableWrite
    CareerScreen.saveSavegame = unavailableWrite
    CareerScreen.onSaveStartComplete = unavailableWrite
    CareerScreen.onSaveComplete = unavailableWrite
    FSCareerMissionInfo.saveToXML = unavailableWrite

    g_careerScreen = CareerScreen:new()
    g_careerScreen:setIsMultiplayer(false)
    g_gui:loadGui("dataS/gui/CareerScreen.xml", "CareerScreen", g_careerScreen)
    g_careerScreen.buttonDeletePC:setDisabled(true)
    g_careerScreen.buttonDeleteConsole:setDisabled(true)
    installed = true
    print("Career adapter: recovered CareerScreen and mission metadata classes; 20 read-only slots; new selections launch map scenes; save writes/deletes and saved simulation unavailable")
end

function fs15_career_selfcheck()
    assert(installed, "Career adapter is not installed")
    assert(g_gui.guis.CareerScreen.target == g_careerScreen, "Recovered CareerScreen target missing")
    local screen = g_careerScreen
    if #screen.savegames == 0 then screen:recreateSavegameList() end
    assert(CareerScreen.numSavegames == 20, "Expected twenty PC save slots")
    assert(#screen.savegames == 20 and #screen.savegameList.listItems == 20, "Recovered career list did not clone twenty slots")
    assert(screen.savegameList.visibleItems == 3, "Original three-row layout changed")
    assert(screen.buttonDeletePC.disabled and screen.buttonDeleteConsole.disabled, "Delete must remain disabled")
    local existing, empty, unavailable = 0, 0, 0
    for index, savegame in ipairs(screen.savegames) do
        assert(savegame.savegameIndex == index, "Save slot identity mismatch")
        assert(screen.listItemTexts[index] and screen.listItemInfoText[index], "Missing original slot widget")
        if savegame.isValid then
            existing = existing + 1
            assert(savegame.map and screen.mapNameTexts[index].text == savegame.map.title, "Saved map title was not displayed")
            assert(screen.moneyTexts[index].text == g_i18n:formatMoney(savegame.money), "Saved money was not displayed")
            assert(screen.dateTexts[index].text == savegame.saveDate, "Saved date was not displayed")
            assert(screen.difficultyTexts[index].text == g_i18n:getText("Diff" .. savegame.difficulty), "Saved difficulty was not displayed")
        elseif savegame.fs15MetadataUnavailable then
            unavailable = unavailable + 1
            assert(screen.listItemTexts[index].visible, "Unavailable metadata must remain visible")
        else
            empty = empty + 1
            assert(screen.listItemInfoText[index].text == g_i18n:getText("This_savegame_is_currently_unused"), "Empty slot label missing")
        end
    end
    return string.format("career_slots=20; visible_rows=3; existing=%d; empty=%d; unavailable=%d; delete_disabled=true; metadata_classes=recovered", existing, empty, unavailable)
end

function fs15_career_test_fixture_begin()
    assert(installed, "Career adapter is not installed")
    if fixtureDepth == 0 then
        nativeGetInfo = saveGetInfoById
        saveGetInfoById = function(index)
            if index == 1 then
                return '<careerSavegame revision="2" valid="true" mapId="Map01" difficulty="3" money="123456" playTime="125" saveDate="2026-10-14"/>', "Authored read-only test save"
            elseif index == 3 then
                return "corrupt", "Authored corrupt metadata fixture"
            elseif index == 4 then
                return '<careerSavegame revision="2" valid="true" mapId="Missing_Test_Map"/>', "Authored unsupported-map fixture"
            elseif index == 5 then
                return '<careerSavegame revision="2" valid="true" mapId="Map01" difficulty="99"/>', "Authored invalid-difficulty fixture"
            elseif index == 6 then
                return '<careerSavegame revision="2" valid="true" mapId="Map01" money="nan"/>', "Authored nonfinite-money fixture"
            elseif index == 7 then
                return '<careerSavegame revision="2" valid="true" mapId="Map01" money="inf"/>', "Authored infinite-money fixture"
            elseif index == 8 then
                return '<careerSavegame revision="2" valid="true" mapId="Map01" playTime="-1"/>', "Authored negative-duration fixture"
            elseif index == 9 then
                return '<careerSavegame revision="2" valid="true" mapId="Map01" money="-500"/>', "Authored negative-money fixture"
            end
            return "", "Authored empty slot " .. index
        end
        g_careerScreen:recreateSavegameList()
    end
    fixtureDepth = fixtureDepth + 1
end

function fs15_career_test_fixture_end()
    assert(fixtureDepth > 0, "Career test fixture is not active")
    fixtureDepth = fixtureDepth - 1
    if fixtureDepth == 0 then
        saveGetInfoById, nativeGetInfo = nativeGetInfo, nil
        g_careerScreen:recreateSavegameList()
    end
end

local function click(element)
    assert(element:getIsVisible() and not element.disabled, "Test requires an active career element")
    local x = element.absPosition[1] + element.size[1] / 2
    local y = element.absPosition[2] + element.size[2] / 2
    fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, true, false, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
    fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, false, true, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
end

local function callbackButton(parent, callback)
    if parent.onClick == callback and parent:getIsVisible() then return parent end
    for _, child in ipairs(parent.elements or {}) do
        local found = callbackButton(child, callback)
        if found ~= nil then return found end
    end
    return nil
end

function fs15_career_test_inputs()
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "MainScreen", "Career checks start at MainScreen")
    fs15_career_test_fixture_begin()
    local ok, failure = xpcall(function()
        click(g_mainScreen.careerButton)
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "CareerScreen", "Original career callback did not open CareerScreen")
        print("Career input check: " .. fs15_career_selfcheck())
        local screen, list = g_careerScreen, g_careerScreen.savegameList
        local widgets = g_gui.guis.CareerScreen

        local back = assert(callbackButton(widgets, CareerScreen.onClickBack), "Recovered Back button missing")

        assert(screen.timePlayedTexts[1].text == "02:05 " .. g_i18n:getText("shortTime"), "Recovered duration formatter failed")
        assert(screen.savegames[9].isValid and screen.savegames[9].money == -500, "Finite negative money must remain valid")

        -- The native bridge forwards wheel events to the original list widget.
        local x = list.absPosition[1] + list.size[1] / 2
        local y = list.absPosition[2] + list.size[2] / 2
        fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, true, false, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN)
        fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, false, true, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN)
        assert(list.firstVisibleItem == 2, "Recovered wheel scrolling failed")
        list:setSelectedRow(20, true)
        assert(screen.selectedIndex == 20 and list.firstVisibleItem == 18, "Slot twenty is not reachable")

        list:setSelectedRow(1, true)
        click(start)
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "CareerScreen", "Existing save crossed the world boundary")
        assert(screen.lastWorldRequest.isExisting and screen.lastWorldRequest.mapId == "Map01", "Existing save did not reach explicit load boundary")
        local previousRequest = screen.lastWorldRequest
        for _, row in ipairs({3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}) do
            assert(screen.savegames[row].fs15MetadataUnavailable and not screen.savegames[row].isValid, "Unsupported metadata was not marked read only")
            list:setSelectedRow(row, true)
            click(start)
            assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "CareerScreen" and screen.lastWorldRequest == previousRequest, "Unavailable save metadata entered a new game")
        end

        -- A failed scan does not prove any slot is empty. Even fixture slot two
        -- must stay unavailable until a later successful scan rebuilds the list.
        screen:onSaveGameUpdateComplete(Savegame.ERROR_SCAN_FAILED)
        for _, savegame in ipairs(screen.savegames) do
            assert(savegame.fs15MetadataUnavailable and not savegame.isValid, "Failed scan exposed an empty/new-game slot")
        end
        list:setSelectedRow(2, true)
        click(start)
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "CareerScreen" and screen.lastWorldRequest == previousRequest, "Failed scan entered a new game")
        screen:onSaveGameUpdateComplete(Savegame.ERROR_OK)
        assert(not screen.fs15ScanFailed and screen.savegames[1].isValid, "Successful scan did not restore valid metadata")
        assert(not screen.savegames[2].fs15MetadataUnavailable, "Successful scan did not restore the empty slot")

        list:setSelectedRow(2, true)
        click(start)
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "DifficultyScreen", "Empty slot did not reach the original difficulty screen")
        g_difficultyScreen:onClickBack()
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "CareerScreen", "Difficulty Back did not return to career")
        screen:onClickCancel()
        assert(screen.buttonDeletePC.disabled and g_gui.currentGuiName == "CareerScreen", "Read-only delete guard failed")
        click(back)
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "MainScreen", "Recovered career Back did not return to main")
        print("Career input checks: original mouse Career/Start/Back; wheel scroll; all twenty slots; recovered XML metadata and duration; existing-world boundary; unreadable/numeric metadata guards; failed-scan recovery; empty-slot Difficulty; disabled Delete")
    end, debug.traceback)
    fs15_career_test_fixture_end()
    if not ok then error(failure, 0) end
end
```

```cpp
#ifdef _WIN32
static std::wstring wide(const std::string& text) {
    if (text.empty()) return {};
    const int count = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), nullptr, 0);
    if (count <= 0) return L"Invalid UTF-8 message";
    std::wstring result(count, L'\0');
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), result.data(), count);
    return result;
}

#endif
static fs::path relative_resource(const std::string& name) {
    std::string normalized = name;
    std::replace(normalized.begin(), normalized.end(), '\\', '/');
    if (normalized.empty() || normalized.find(':') != std::string::npos || normalized.front() == '/')
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid resource path: " + name);
    fs::path relative = fs::u8path(normalized);
    for (const auto& part : relative) {
        if (part == L".." || part == L".") throw std::runtime_error("Invalid resource traversal: " + name);
    }
    return relative;
}

static fs::path resolve_asset(const std::string& name) {
    const auto relative = relative_resource(name);
    // Engine filenames use .png while the local archive contains .dds textures.
    for (const auto& base : {resource_root / "assets", resource_root / "recovered/gar"}) {
        auto candidate = base / relative;
        if (fs::is_regular_file(candidate)) {
            const auto asset = candidate.lexically_relative(base).generic_u8string();
            if (loaded_assets.insert(asset).second) log_line("ASSET " + asset);
            return candidate;
        }
        if (candidate.extension() == L".png") {
            candidate.replace_extension(L".dds");
            if (fs::is_regular_file(candidate)) {
                const auto asset = candidate.lexically_relative(base).generic_u8string();
                if (loaded_assets.insert(asset).second) log_line("ASSET " + asset);
                return candidate;
            }
        }
    }
    throw std::runtime_error("Missing recovered asset: " + name + ". Run GAR extraction and package-menu.ps1 first.");
}

static fs::path resolve_script(const std::string& name) {
    const auto relative = relative_resource(name);
    if (relative.extension() != L".lua") throw std::runtime_error("Menu source must be recovered .lua: " + name);
    for (const auto& base : {resource_root / "lua", resource_root / "recovered/lua"}) {
        const auto candidate = base / relative;
        if (fs::is_regular_file(candidate)) return candidate;
    }
    throw std::runtime_error("Missing recovered Lua source: " + name + ". Run script recovery first.");
}

static int traceback(lua_State* state) {
    luaL_traceback(state, state, lua_tostring(state, 1), 1);
    return 1;
}

static void call_checked(int arguments, int results = 0) {
    const int function_index = lua_gettop(vm) - arguments;
    lua_pushcfunction(vm, traceback);
    lua_insert(vm, function_index);
    const int status = lua_pcall(vm, arguments, results, function_index);
    lua_remove(vm, function_index);
    if (status) {
        const char* message = lua_tostring(vm, -1);
        std::string error = message ? message : "Unknown Lua error";
        lua_pop(vm, 1);
        throw std::runtime_error(error);
    }
}

static void execute_file(const fs::path& path, const std::string& chunk_name) {
    const auto body=fs15platform::read_file_string_bounded(path,8*1024*1024);
    if (body.empty() || static_cast<unsigned char>(body.front()) == 0x1b)
        throw std::runtime_error("Refusing compiled/original bytecode as recovered source: " + chunk_name);
    if (luaL_loadbufferx(vm, body.data(), body.size(), ("@" + chunk_name).c_str(), "t")) {
        std::string error = lua_tostring(vm, -1);
        lua_pop(vm, 1);
        throw std::runtime_error(error);
    }
    call_checked(0);
}

static int source(lua_State* state) {
    const char* name = luaL_checkstring(state, 1);
    bool error = false;
    {
        try {
            execute_file(resolve_script(name), name);
            loaded_scripts.emplace_back(name);
            log_line("SOURCE " + std::string(name));
        } catch (const std::exception& exception) {
            lua_pushstring(state, exception.what());
            error = true;
        }
    }
    return error ? lua_error(state) : 0;
}

static int adapter_source(lua_State* state) {
    const char* name = luaL_checkstring(state, 1);
    bool error = false;
    {
        try {
            if (std::string(name) != "career.lua" && std::string(name) != "newgame.lua")
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown authored menu module");
            const auto local = resource_root / name;
            execute_file(fs::is_regular_file(local) ? local : resource_root / "src/menu" / name,
                "fs15-menu/" + std::string(name));
            log_line("ADAPTER " + std::string(name));
        } catch (const std::exception& exception) { lua_pushstring(state, exception.what()); error = true; }
    }
    return error ? lua_error(state) : 0;
}

static int capture_screen(lua_State* state) {
    const char* name = luaL_checkstring(state, 1);
    bool error = false;
    {
        try {
            const std::string label = name;
            if (label.empty() || label.find_first_not_of("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-") != std::string::npos)
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid menu capture label");
            draw();
            if (!capture_directory.empty()) {
                fs::create_directories(capture_directory);
                renderer->save_png(capture_directory / (label + ".png"));
                log_line("CAPTURE " + label);
            }
        } catch (const std::exception& exception) { lua_pushstring(state, exception.what()); error = true; }
    }
    return error ? lua_error(state) : 0;
}

static int print(lua_State* state) {
    std::string message;
    for (int i = 1; i <= lua_gettop(state); ++i) {
        if (i > 1) message += '\t';
        const char* item = lua_tostring(state, i);
        message += item ? item : lua_typename(state, lua_type(state, i));
    }
    log_line("LUA " + message);
    return 0;
}

static int file_exists(lua_State* state) {
    bool exists = false;
    try { resolve_asset(luaL_checkstring(state, 1)); exists = true; }
    catch (const std::exception&) { }
    lua_pushboolean(state, exists);
    return 1;
}

    if (!fs15menu::delete_xml(handle) && renderer) renderer->delete_overlay(handle);
    return 0;
}

        MessageBoxW(menu_window, message.c_str(), L"FS15 reconstruction progress", MB_OK | MB_ICONINFORMATION);
    }
    #else
    if (!smoke_mode) SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_INFORMATION,"Linux frontend test",

    #endif

}

static std::wstring quote_argument(const std::wstring& value) {
    std::wstring out=L"\"";size_t slashes=0;
    for(wchar_t ch:value){if(ch==L'\\'){++slashes;continue;}
        out.append(slashes*(ch==L'\"'?2:1)+(ch==L'\"'?1:0),L'\\');out+=ch;slashes=0;}
    out.append(slashes*2,L'\\');return out+L"\"";
}

static int upper_utf8(lua_State* state) {
    const char* input = luaL_checkstring(state, 1);

        try {
            const auto text = wide(input);
            if (text.empty()) { lua_pushliteral(state, ""); return 1; }
            const int length = LCMapStringEx(LOCALE_NAME_INVARIANT, LCMAP_UPPERCASE, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr, 0);
            if (!length) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot uppercase UTF-8 menu text");
            std::wstring uppercase(length, L'\0');
            LCMapStringEx(LOCALE_NAME_INVARIANT, LCMAP_UPPERCASE, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), uppercase.data(), length, nullptr, nullptr, 0);
            const int size = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, uppercase.data(), length, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
            std::string result(size, '\0');
            WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, uppercase.data(), length, result.data(), size, nullptr, nullptr);
            lua_pushlstring(state, result.data(), result.size());
        } catch (const std::exception& exception) { lua_pushstring(state, exception.what()); error = true; }
    }
    return error ? lua_error(state) : 1;
    #else
    // English frontend only. Preserve non-ASCII bytes; no Unicode parity claim.
    std::string text=input;
    for(char& c:text)if(c>='a'&&c<='z')c=static_cast<char>(c-'a'+'A');
    lua_pushlstring(state,text.data(),text.size());return 1;
    #endif
}

static void global_number(const char* name, double value) { lua_pushnumber(vm, value); lua_setglobal(vm, name); }
static void global_string(const char* name, const std::string& value) { lua_pushlstring(vm, value.data(), value.size()); lua_setglobal(vm, name); }

static void boot(const std::string& language) {
    vm = luaL_newstate();
    if (!vm) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot create LuaJIT VM");
    luaL_openlibs(vm);
    lua_register(vm, "source", source);
    lua_register(vm, "menuSource", adapter_source);
    lua_register(vm, "menuCapture", capture_screen);
    lua_register(vm, "print", print);
    lua_register(vm, "fileExists", file_exists);
    lua_register(vm, "delete", delete_resource);
    lua_register(vm, "doExit", exit_menu);
    lua_register(vm, "menuUnavailable", menu_unavailable);
    lua_register(vm, "menuLaunchWorld", launch_world);
    lua_register(vm, "getScreenModeInfo", get_screen_info);
    lua_register(vm, "getScreenMode", get_screen_mode);
    lua_register(vm, "getNumOfGamepads", num_gamepads);
    lua_register(vm, "utf8ToUpper", upper_utf8);
    global_number("g_screenWidth", screen_width);
    global_number("g_screenHeight", screen_height);
    global_number("g_screenAspectRatio", double(screen_width) / screen_height);
    global_string("g_languageShort", language);
    global_string("g_languageSuffix", "_" + language);
    fs15menu::register_xml(vm, resolve_asset);
    fs15menu::register_savegames(vm, save_directory);
    renderer = std::make_unique<fs15menu::Renderer>(resolve_asset, screen_width, screen_height);
    renderer->register_lua(vm);
    const auto packaged = resource_root / "bootstrap.lua";
    execute_file(fs::is_regular_file(packaged) ? packaged : resource_root / "src/menu/bootstrap.lua", "fs15-menu/bootstrap.lua");
    lua_getglobal(vm, "fs15_menu_selfcheck");
    call_checked(0);
    log_line("BOOT_OK recovered Lua MainScreen opened; original game engine not loaded");
}

static void update() {
    lua_getglobal(vm, "fs15_menu_update");
    lua_pushnumber(vm, 16);
    call_checked(1);
    #ifdef _WIN32
    if (exit_requested && menu_window) PostMessageW(menu_window, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
    #endif
}

static void draw(fs15menu::DrawTarget dc) {
    renderer->begin_frame();
    lua_getglobal(vm, "fs15_menu_draw");
    call_checked(0);
    if (dc) renderer->present(dc);
    ++frame_count;
}

static void mouse(int x, int y, bool down, bool up, int button = 1) {
    lua_getglobal(vm, "fs15_menu_mouse");
    lua_pushnumber(vm, double(x) / screen_width);
    lua_pushnumber(vm, 1.0 - double(y) / screen_height);
    lua_pushboolean(vm, down);
    lua_pushboolean(vm, up);
    lua_pushinteger(vm, button);
    call_checked(5);
}

static void report_failure(const std::exception& exception) {
    if (failed) return;
    failed = true;
    fatal_error = exception.what();
    log_line("FATAL " + fatal_error);
    #ifdef _WIN32
    if (!smoke_mode) MessageBoxW(menu_window, wide(fatal_error).c_str(), L"FS15 menu startup error", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
    #else
    std::cerr << fatal_error << std::endl;
    if (!smoke_mode) SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR,"FS15 Linux menu error",fatal_error.c_str(),menu_window);
    #endif
}

#ifdef _WIN32
static LRESULT CALLBACK window_proc(HWND window, UINT message, WPARAM wparam, LPARAM lparam) {
    try {
        switch (message) {
        case WM_CREATE:
            SetTimer(window, 1, 16, nullptr);
            return 0;
        case WM_ERASEBKGND: return 1;
        case WM_TIMER:
            update();
            InvalidateRect(window, nullptr, FALSE);
            return 0;
        case WM_PAINT: {
            PAINTSTRUCT paint{};
            const auto dc = BeginPaint(window, &paint);
            try { draw(dc); } catch (...) { EndPaint(window, &paint); throw; }
            EndPaint(window, &paint);
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_MOUSEMOVE: mouse(GET_X_LPARAM(lparam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lparam), false, false); return 0;
        case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: SetCapture(window); mouse(GET_X_LPARAM(lparam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lparam), true, false); return 0;
        case WM_LBUTTONUP: ReleaseCapture(); mouse(GET_X_LPARAM(lparam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lparam), false, true); return 0;
        case WM_MOUSEWHEEL: {
            POINT point{GET_X_LPARAM(lparam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lparam)};
            ScreenToClient(window, &point);
            const int delta = GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM(wparam);
            const int wheel_button = delta > 0 ? 4 : 5;
            const int steps = std::max(1, std::abs(delta) / WHEEL_DELTA);
            for (int i = 0; i < steps; ++i) {
                mouse(point.x, point.y, true, false, wheel_button);
                mouse(point.x, point.y, false, true, wheel_button);
            }
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_KEYDOWN:
        case WM_KEYUP:
            lua_getglobal(vm, "fs15_menu_key");
            lua_pushinteger(vm, static_cast<int>(wparam));
            lua_pushboolean(vm, message == WM_KEYDOWN);
            call_checked(2);
            return 0;
        case WM_DESTROY:
            KillTimer(window, 1);
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            return 0;
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& exception) {
        report_failure(exception);
        PostMessageW(window, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(window, message, wparam, lparam);
}

static fs::path executable_directory() {
    wchar_t buffer[32768];
    const auto size = GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, buffer, 32768);
    if (!size || size >= 32768) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot locate menu executable");
    return fs::path(std::wstring(buffer, size)).parent_path();
}

static fs::path default_save_directory() {
    PWSTR documents = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_Documents, KF_FLAG_DONT_VERIFY, nullptr, &documents))) return {};
    const auto directory = fs::path(documents) / "My Games/FarmingSimulator2015";
    CoTaskMemFree(documents);
    return fs::is_directory(directory) ? directory : fs::path{};
}

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE instance, HINSTANCE, PWSTR, int show) {
    SetProcessDPIAware();
    const HRESULT com = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED);
    fs::path screenshot;
    int result = 0;
    try {
        resource_root = executable_directory();
        if (!fs::exists(resource_root / "bootstrap.lua") && !fs::exists(resource_root / "src/menu/bootstrap.lua")) {
            auto parent = resource_root.parent_path().parent_path();
            if (fs::exists(parent / "src/menu/bootstrap.lua")) resource_root = parent;
        }
        std::string language = "en";
        std::wstring start_screen = L"MainScreen";
        bool test_inputs = false, save_directory_explicit = false;
        int count = 0;
        auto arguments = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &count);
        if (!arguments) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot parse menu arguments");
        for (int i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
            const std::wstring argument = arguments[i];
            if (argument == L"--root" && i + 1 < count) resource_root = fs::absolute(arguments[++i]);
            else if (argument == L"--smoke") smoke_mode = true;
            else if (argument == L"--test-inputs") test_inputs = true;
            else if (argument == L"--save-dir" && i + 1 < count) { save_directory = fs::absolute(arguments[++i]); save_directory_explicit = true; }
            else if (argument == L"--empty-saves") { save_directory.clear(); save_directory_explicit = true; }
            else if (argument == L"--capture-dir" && i + 1 < count) capture_directory = fs::absolute(arguments[++i]);
            else if (argument == L"--screen" && i + 1 < count) start_screen = arguments[++i];
            else if (argument == L"--screenshot" && i + 1 < count) screenshot = fs::absolute(arguments[++i]);
            else throw std::runtime_error("Usage: FS15MenuRebuilt.exe [--root PATH] [--smoke] [--test-inputs] [--screen MainScreen|CareerScreen|DifficultyScreen|MapSelectionScreen|CreditsScreen] [--save-dir PATH|--empty-saves] [--capture-dir PATH] [--screenshot PATH]");
        }
        LocalFree(arguments);
        if (!save_directory_explicit && !smoke_mode) save_directory = default_save_directory();
        fs::create_directories(resource_root / "logs");
        runtime_log.open(resource_root / "logs/menu-runtime.log", std::ios::trunc);
        if (!runtime_log) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot write menu-runtime.log");
        log_line("FS15 independently compiled menu host; recovered source execution; 1280x720");
        log_line(std::string("SAVE_SERVICE read_only=true profile=") + (save_directory.empty() ? "empty-slots" : "local-profile"));
        boot(language);
        auto show_start_screen = [&]() {
            if (start_screen != L"MainScreen") {
                const std::vector<std::wstring> allowed{L"CareerScreen", L"DifficultyScreen", L"MapSelectionScreen", L"CreditsScreen"};
                if (std::find(allowed.begin(), allowed.end(), start_screen) == allowed.end()) throw std::runtime_error("Unknown frontend screen");
                lua_getglobal(vm, "fs15_menu_show");
                std::string name;
                for (wchar_t character : start_screen) name.push_back(static_cast<char>(character));
                lua_pushlstring(vm, name.data(), name.size());
                call_checked(1);
            }
        };
        if (smoke_mode) {
            if (!test_inputs) show_start_screen();
            for (int i = 0; i < 120; ++i) { update(); draw(); }
            if (test_inputs) {
                lua_getglobal(vm, "fs15_menu_test_inputs");
                call_checked(0);
                if (!exit_requested) throw std::runtime_error("Recovered Quit callback did not request exit");
                if (!unavailable_count) throw std::runtime_error("Unavailable engine boundary was not exercised");
                log_line("INPUT_CHECK_OK actual recovered button handlers exercised");
            }
            if (test_inputs) { show_start_screen(); draw(); }
            if (renderer->missing_asset_count()) throw std::runtime_error("Missing assets in rendered menu");
            if (!screenshot.empty()) renderer->save_png(screenshot);
            log_line("SMOKE_OK frames=" + std::to_string(frame_count) + " scripts=" + std::to_string(loaded_scripts.size()) + " overlays=" + std::to_string(renderer->overlay_count()));
        } else {
            show_start_screen();
            WNDCLASSW window_class{};
            window_class.lpfnWndProc = window_proc;
            window_class.hInstance = instance;
            window_class.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
            window_class.lpszClassName = L"FS15ReconstructedMenuHost";
            if (!RegisterClassW(&window_class)) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot register menu window");
            const DWORD style = WS_OVERLAPPED | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU | WS_MINIMIZEBOX;
            RECT rectangle{0, 0, screen_width, screen_height};
            AdjustWindowRect(&rectangle, style, FALSE);
            menu_window = CreateWindowW(window_class.lpszClassName, L"Farming Simulator 15 - Reconstructed Frontend", style,
                CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, rectangle.right - rectangle.left, rectangle.bottom - rectangle.top,
                nullptr, nullptr, instance, nullptr);
            if (!menu_window) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot create menu window");
            ShowWindow(menu_window, show);
            UpdateWindow(menu_window);
            log_line("WINDOW_OPEN main menu");
            if (!screenshot.empty()) { draw(); renderer->save_png(screenshot); }
            MSG message{};
            while (GetMessageW(&message, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) {
                TranslateMessage(&message);
                DispatchMessageW(&message);
            }
            if (failed) result = 1;
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& exception) {
        report_failure(exception);
        result = 1;
    }
    log_line("SHUTDOWN exit=" + std::to_string(result) + " frames=" + std::to_string(frame_count));
    // Lua finalizers must run while the overlay service is still alive.
    if (vm) { lua_close(vm); vm = nullptr; }
    renderer.reset();
    if (SUCCEEDED(com)) CoUninitialize();
    return result;
}

static int menu_key(SDL_Keycode key) {
    switch(key){
    case SDLK_UP:return 38;case SDLK_DOWN:return 40;case SDLK_LEFT:return 37;case SDLK_RIGHT:return 39;
    case SDLK_RETURN:case SDLK_KP_ENTER:return 13;case SDLK_ESCAPE:return 27;
    case SDLK_TAB:return 9;case SDLK_BACKSPACE:return 8;case SDLK_SPACE:return 32;
    case SDLK_DELETE:return 46;case SDLK_HOME:return 36;case SDLK_END:return 35;
    case SDLK_PAGEUP:return 33;case SDLK_PAGEDOWN:return 34;
    default:return key>=SDLK_a&&key<=SDLK_z?int(key-'a'+'A'):int(key);
    }
}
```
