```lua
-- Authored menu integration. Selection, descriptions, markers, list cloning and
-- navigation run the recovered FS15 classes and XML. No mission is loaded here.

function fs15_install_newgame_screens()
    assert(g_difficultyScreen == nil and g_mapSelectionScreen == nil,
        "New-game screens must be installed once")
    if MapsUtil == nil then source("dataS/scripts/MapsUtil.lua") end
    source("dataS/scripts/gui/DifficultyScreen.lua")
    source("dataS/scripts/gui/MapSelectionScreen.lua")

    -- Same two base-map registrations as recovered main.lua, lines 1289-1295.
    -- Loading the mission classes or vehicle files belongs to the world engine.
    assert(#MapsUtil.mapList == 0, "Expected an uninitialized base-map catalogue")
    MapsUtil.addMapItem("Map01", "dataS/scripts/missions/CareerMap01.lua", "CareerMap01",
        "dataS2/menu/briefingScreen/careerMap01", "careerMap01",
        "profileTemplate/careerVehicles_map01.xml", g_i18n:getText("Map01_Title"),
        g_i18n:getText("Map01_Description"), "data/maps/map01/map_preview.png", "", nil, true)
    MapsUtil.addMapItem("Map02", "dataS/scripts/missions/CareerMap02.lua", "CareerMap02",
        "dataS2/menu/briefingScreen/americanMap", "americanMap",
        "profileTemplate/careerVehicles_map02.xml", g_i18n:getText("AmericanMap_Title"),
        g_i18n:getText("AmericanMap_Description"), "data/maps/map02/map_preview.png", "", nil, true)

    g_difficultyScreen = DifficultyScreen:new()
    g_mapSelectionScreen = MapSelectionScreen:new()
    g_gui:loadGui("dataS/gui/DifficultyScreen.xml", "DifficultyScreen", g_difficultyScreen)
    g_gui:loadGui("dataS/gui/MapSelectionScreen.xml", "MapSelectionScreen", g_mapSelectionScreen)
end

local function element(screen, id)
    local focus = assert(FocusManager.guiFocusData[screen], "Missing recovered focus table: " .. screen)
    return assert(focus.idToElementMapping[tostring(id)], "Missing recovered focus element: " .. screen .. ":" .. id)
end

local function click(button)
    assert(button:getIsVisible() and not button.disabled, "Expected an active recovered button")
    local x = button.absPosition[1] + button.size[1] / 2
    local y = button.absPosition[2] + button.size[2] / 2
    fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, true, false, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
    fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, false, true, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
end

local function select_empty_career()
    assert(g_careerScreen ~= nil, "Career screen must be installed")
    g_careerScreen:setIsMultiplayer(false)
    g_gui:showGui("CareerScreen")
    fs15_menu_update(16)
    local index
    for i, savegame in ipairs(g_careerScreen.savegames) do
        if not savegame.isValid and not savegame.isInvalidUser and not savegame.fs15MetadataUnavailable then
            index = i
            break
        end
    end
    assert(index ~= nil, "All career slots are occupied; choose an empty slot to start a new game")
    g_careerScreen.savegameList:setSelectedRow(index)
    return index
end

-- Used by the host's direct-screen preview command. This follows normal career
-- callbacks with an actually empty slot; it never creates or overwrites a save.
function fs15_newgame_show(name)
    assert(name == "DifficultyScreen" or name == "MapSelectionScreen", "Unexpected new-game screen")
    select_empty_career()
    g_careerScreen:onClickOk()
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "DifficultyScreen", "Empty career did not reach difficulty selection")
    if name == "MapSelectionScreen" then
        g_difficultyScreen:onClickNormal()
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == name, "Difficulty callback did not reach map selection")
    end
end

function fs15_newgame_state()
    local savegame = g_careerScreen and g_careerScreen.currentSavegame
    local row = g_mapSelectionScreen.mapList.selectedRow
    local map = g_mapSelectionScreen.maps and g_mapSelectionScreen.maps[row]
    return {
        screen = g_gui.currentGuiName,
        difficulty = savegame and savegame.difficulty,
        mapId = map and map.id,
        selectedRow = row,
        worldRequested = g_careerScreen and g_careerScreen.lastWorldRequest ~= nil
    }
end

function fs15_newgame_selfcheck()
    assert(g_gui.guis.DifficultyScreen.target == g_difficultyScreen, "Difficulty source not initialized")
    assert(g_gui.guis.MapSelectionScreen.target == g_mapSelectionScreen, "Map selection source not initialized")
    assert(#MapsUtil.mapList == 2 and MapsUtil.getMapById("Map01") and MapsUtil.getMapById("Map02"),
        "Expected the two installed base maps")
    for i, map in ipairs(MapsUtil.mapList) do
        assert(map.customEnvironment == nil and map.isMultiplayerSupported, "Unexpected mod map")
        assert(map.title and map.title ~= "" and not map.title:match("^Missing "), "Missing map title")
        assert(map.description and map.description ~= "" and not map.description:match("^Missing "), "Missing map description")
        assert(map.iconFilename == string.format("data/maps/map%02d/map_preview.png", i), "Unexpected base-map preview")
    end
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local button = element("DifficultyScreen", i)
        assert(type(button.onClick) == "function" and type(button.onFocus) == "function", "Missing original difficulty callback")
    end
    assert(type(element("MapSelectionScreen", 2).onClick) == "function", "Missing original map Start callback")
    return "difficulty_choices=3; base_maps=2; recovered_newgame_callbacks=true; original_map_scene=true; simulation=false"
end

-- The caller brackets this with the authored career fixture, so existing user
-- saves are neither required nor changed. Mouse events go through recovered GUI
-- hit testing, then the original career/difficulty/map callbacks.
function fs15_newgame_test_inputs()
    fs15_newgame_selfcheck()
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "MainScreen", "New-game test must start from MainScreen")
    click(g_mainScreen.careerButton)
    local slot = select_empty_career()
    menuCapture("CareerScreen")
    click(element("CareerScreen", 2))
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "DifficultyScreen", "Career Start did not open difficulty selection")
    menuCapture("DifficultyScreen")
    click(element("DifficultyScreen", 4))
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "CareerScreen", "Difficulty Back did not restore CareerScreen")

    for difficulty = 1, 3 do
        g_careerScreen.savegameList:setSelectedRow(slot)
        click(element("CareerScreen", 2))
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "DifficultyScreen", "Career Start did not reopen difficulty selection")
        click(element("DifficultyScreen", difficulty))
        assert(g_careerScreen.currentSavegame.difficulty == difficulty, "Original difficulty callback did not store selection")
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "MapSelectionScreen", "Difficulty callback did not open map selection")
        assert(#g_mapSelectionScreen.maps == 2 and #g_mapSelectionScreen.mapList.listItems == 2,
            "Original map list did not clone both base-map items")
        for row, item in ipairs(g_mapSelectionScreen.mapList.listItems) do
            assert(item.elements[1].overlay.filename == MapsUtil.mapList[row].iconFilename, "Map item has wrong preview")
            assert(item.elements[2].text == MapsUtil.mapList[row].title, "Map item has wrong title")
            assert(item.elements[3].text == MapsUtil.mapList[row].description, "Map item has wrong description")
        end
        -- Avoid a previous test click becoming a double-click on a reopened list.
        fs15_menu_update(1100)
        local list = g_mapSelectionScreen.mapList
        local row = difficulty % 2 + 1
        local x = list.absPosition[1] + list.size[1] / 2
        local y = list.absPosition[2] + list.size[2] - list.listItemStartYOffset
            - (row - 0.5) * list.listItemHeight - (row - 1) * list.listItemSpacing
        fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, true, false, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
        fs15_menu_mouse(x, y, false, true, Input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
        assert(list.selectedRow == row, "Recovered map list mouse selection failed")
        menuCapture("MapSelectionScreen")
        g_careerScreen.lastWorldRequest = nil
        click(element("MapSelectionScreen", 2))
        local request = assert(g_careerScreen.lastWorldRequest, "Map Start did not reach the explicit world boundary")
        assert(request.mapId == MapsUtil.mapList[row].id and request.difficulty == difficulty
            and request.savegameIndex == slot, "World boundary lost the selected map/difficulty/slot")
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "MapSelectionScreen", "Scene launch plan unexpectedly changed the frontend screen")
        click(element("MapSelectionScreen", 3))
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "DifficultyScreen", "Map Back did not restore DifficultyScreen")
        click(element("DifficultyScreen", 4))
        assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "CareerScreen", "Difficulty Back did not restore CareerScreen")
    end
    click(element("CareerScreen", 4))
    assert(g_gui.currentGuiName == "MainScreen", "Career Back did not restore MainScreen")
    print("New-game input checks: recovered difficulty Back; all three difficulty buttons; both base-map previews and mouse selection; map/difficulty/slot preserved at guarded world boundary; map and difficulty Back")
end
```

```cpp
using Bytes = std::vector<std::uint8_t>;
Bytes read_bytes(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    return fs15platform::read_file_bounded(path,512*1024*1024);
}
std::uint32_t little32(const Bytes& b, std::size_t p) {
    if (p + 4 > b.size()) throw std::runtime_error("Truncated DDS header");
    return b[p] | std::uint32_t(b[p+1])<<8 | std::uint32_t(b[p+2])<<16 | std::uint32_t(b[p+3])<<24;
}
std::uint32_t big32(const Bytes& b, std::size_t p) {
    if (p + 4 > b.size()) throw std::runtime_error("Truncated font record");
    return std::uint32_t(b[p])<<24 | std::uint32_t(b[p+1])<<16 | std::uint32_t(b[p+2])<<8 | b[p+3];
}
float big_float(const Bytes& b, std::size_t p) {
    auto value = big32(b,p); float result; std::memcpy(&result, &value, 4); return result;
}
std::uint32_t rgb565(unsigned c) {
    unsigned r=(c>>11)&31, g=(c>>5)&63, b=c&31;
    return 0xff000000u | ((r<<3)|(r>>2))<<16 | ((g<<2)|(g>>4))<<8 | (b<<3)|(b>>2);
}
std::uint32_t interpolate_rgb(std::uint32_t a, std::uint32_t b, unsigned wa, unsigned wb, unsigned divisor) {
    std::uint32_t result=0xff000000u;
    for (unsigned shift : {0u,8u,16u}) result |= ((((a>>shift)&255)*wa+((b>>shift)&255)*wb)/divisor)<<shift;
    return result;
}
struct Texture {
    int width=0, height=0;
    bool opaque=false;
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> pixels;
#ifdef _WIN32
    std::unique_ptr<Bitmap> bitmap;
#else
    SDL_Texture* bitmap=nullptr;
    ~Texture(){if(bitmap)SDL_DestroyTexture(bitmap);}
#endif
    void finish() {
        opaque=std::all_of(pixels.begin(),pixels.end(),[](std::uint32_t value){return(value>>24)==255;});
        #ifdef _WIN32
        bitmap=std::make_unique<Bitmap>(width,height,width*4,PixelFormat32bppARGB,reinterpret_cast<BYTE*>(pixels.data()));
        if (bitmap->GetLastStatus()!=Ok) throw std::runtime_error("Could not create decoded bitmap");
        #endif
    }
};
std::shared_ptr<Texture> decode_dds(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    const Bytes b=read_bytes(path);
    if (b.size()<128 || little32(b,0)!=0x20534444 || little32(b,4)!=124 || little32(b,76)!=32)
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid DDS: "+path.u8string());
    auto t=std::make_shared<Texture>();
    const auto width=little32(b,16), height=little32(b,12);
    if (!width || !height || width>16384 || height>16384 || std::uint64_t(width)*height>67108864)
        throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported DDS dimensions");
    t->width=static_cast<int>(width); t->height=static_cast<int>(height); t->pixels.resize(std::size_t(width)*height);
    const auto flags=little32(b,80), fourcc=little32(b,84);
    if (flags&4) {
        const bool bc1=fourcc==0x31545844, bc2=fourcc==0x33545844, bc3=fourcc==0x35545844;
        if (!bc1&&!bc2&&!bc3) throw std::runtime_error("DDS codec unsupported (need DXT1, DXT3 or DXT5)");
        const unsigned blockBytes=bc1?8:16, blocksX=(width+3)/4, blocksY=(height+3)/4;
        if (128ull+std::uint64_t(blocksX)*blocksY*blockBytes>b.size()) throw std::runtime_error("Truncated DDS blocks");
        for (unsigned by=0;by<blocksY;++by) for(unsigned bx=0;bx<blocksX;++bx) {
            const std::size_t start=128+(std::size_t(by)*blocksX+bx)*blockBytes, cpos=start+(bc1?0:8);
            const unsigned c0=b[cpos]|unsigned(b[cpos+1])<<8, c1=b[cpos+2]|unsigned(b[cpos+3])<<8;
            std::array<std::uint32_t,4> colors{rgb565(c0),rgb565(c1),0,0};
            if (c0>c1 || !bc1) { colors[2]=interpolate_rgb(colors[0],colors[1],2,1,3); colors[3]=interpolate_rgb(colors[0],colors[1],1,2,3); }
            else { colors[2]=interpolate_rgb(colors[0],colors[1],1,1,2); colors[3]=0; }
            const auto indices=little32(b,cpos+4);
            std::array<unsigned,8> alpha{}; std::uint64_t alphaIndices=0;
            if (bc3) {
                alpha[0]=b[start]; alpha[1]=b[start+1];
                if(alpha[0]>alpha[1]) for(unsigned i=2;i<8;++i) alpha[i]=((8-i)*alpha[0]+(i-1)*alpha[1])/7;
                else { for(unsigned i=2;i<6;++i) alpha[i]=((6-i)*alpha[0]+(i-1)*alpha[1])/5; alpha[6]=0;alpha[7]=255; }
                for(unsigned i=0;i<6;++i) alphaIndices|=std::uint64_t(b[start+2+i])<<(i*8);
            }
            for(unsigned y=0;y<4;++y) for(unsigned x=0;x<4;++x) {
                const unsigned n=y*4+x; auto pixel=colors[(indices>>(n*2))&3];
                if(bc2) pixel=(pixel&0xffffffu)|std::uint32_t(((b[start+n/2]>>((n%2)*4))&15)*17)<<24;
                if(bc3) pixel=(pixel&0xffffffu)|std::uint32_t(alpha[(alphaIndices>>(n*3))&7])<<24;
                if(bx*4+x<width&&by*4+y<height) t->pixels[std::size_t(by*4+y)*width+bx*4+x]=pixel;
            }
        }
    } else {
        const unsigned bits=little32(b,88); const bool luminance=(flags&0x20000)!=0;
        if ((bits!=8&&bits!=16&&bits!=24&&bits!=32) || (!(flags&0x40) && !luminance))
            throw std::runtime_error("DDS uncompressed pixel format unsupported");
        const std::array<unsigned,4> masks{little32(b,92),little32(b,96),little32(b,100),little32(b,104)};
        const unsigned pixelBytes=bits/8, packedPitch=width*pixelBytes;
        const unsigned pitch=(little32(b,8)&8)?little32(b,20):packedPitch;
        if(pitch<packedPitch || 128ull+std::uint64_t(pitch)*height>b.size()) throw std::runtime_error("Truncated DDS pixels");
        auto channel=[](unsigned value,unsigned mask,unsigned absent) {
            if(!mask) return absent;
            unsigned shift=0;while((mask&1)==0){mask>>=1;++shift;}
            return unsigned((std::uint64_t((value>>shift)&mask)*255+mask/2)/mask);
        };
        for(unsigned y=0;y<height;++y) for(unsigned x=0;x<width;++x) {
            unsigned value=0; for(unsigned i=0;i<pixelBytes;++i) value|=unsigned(b[128+std::size_t(y)*pitch+x*pixelBytes+i])<<(i*8);
            const unsigned r=channel(value,masks[0],0),g=luminance?r:channel(value,masks[1],0),bl=luminance?r:channel(value,masks[2],0),a=channel(value,masks[3],255);
            t->pixels[std::size_t(y)*width+x]=(a<<24)|(r<<16)|(g<<8)|bl;
        }
    }
    t->finish(); return t;
}
std::shared_ptr<Texture> decode_image(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    auto ext=path.extension().wstring(); std::transform(ext.begin(),ext.end(),ext.begin(),::towlower);
    if(ext==L".dds") return decode_dds(path);
    #ifdef _WIN32
    Bitmap source(path.c_str(),FALSE);
    if(source.GetLastStatus()!=Ok) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot decode image: "+path.u8string());
    auto t=std::make_shared<Texture>(); t->width=static_cast<int>(source.GetWidth()); t->height=static_cast<int>(source.GetHeight());
    if(!t->width||!t->height||t->width>16384||t->height>16384) throw std::runtime_error("Invalid image dimensions");
    t->pixels.resize(std::size_t(t->width)*t->height);
    Rect rect(0,0,t->width,t->height);BitmapData data{};
    if(source.LockBits(&rect,ImageLockModeRead,PixelFormat32bppARGB,&data)!=Ok) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot read decoded image");
    for(int y=0;y<t->height;++y) std::memcpy(t->pixels.data()+std::size_t(y)*t->width,static_cast<BYTE*>(data.Scan0)+std::ptrdiff_t(y)*data.Stride,std::size_t(t->width)*4);
    source.UnlockBits(&data); t->finish(); return t;
    #else
    auto* decoded=IMG_Load(path.c_str());
    if(!decoded)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot decode image: "+path.u8string()+": "+IMG_GetError());
    auto* surface=SDL_ConvertSurfaceFormat(decoded,SDL_PIXELFORMAT_ARGB8888,0);
    SDL_FreeSurface(decoded);
    if(!surface)throw std::runtime_error(SDL_GetError());
    std::unique_ptr<SDL_Surface,decltype(&SDL_FreeSurface)> owned(surface,SDL_FreeSurface);
    auto t=std::make_shared<Texture>();t->width=surface->w;t->height=surface->h;
    if(t->width<=0||t->height<=0||t->width>16384||t->height>16384)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid image dimensions");
    t->pixels.resize(std::size_t(t->width)*t->height);
    for(int y=0;y<t->height;++y)std::memcpy(t->pixels.data()+std::size_t(y)*t->width,static_cast<const char*>(surface->pixels)+std::ptrdiff_t(y)*surface->pitch,std::size_t(t->width)*4);
    t->finish();return t;
    #endif
}
float clamp(float v){return std::clamp(v,0.0f,1.0f);}
unsigned byte(float v){return static_cast<unsigned>(std::lround(clamp(v)*255));}
float linear_to_srgb(float v){v=clamp(v);return v<=0.0031308f?12.92f*v:1.055f*std::pow(v,1.0f/2.4f)-0.055f;}
float srgb_to_linear(float v){return v<=0.04045f?v/12.92f:std::pow((v+0.055f)/1.055f,2.4f);}
std::vector<std::uint32_t> codepoints(const std::string& text) {
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> result;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<text.size();) {
        const auto c=static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i++]); std::uint32_t value=c; unsigned count=0;
        if(c>=0xf0){value=c&7;count=3;}else if(c>=0xe0){value=c&15;count=2;}else if(c>=0xc0){value=c&31;count=1;}
        else if(c>=0x80) throw std::runtime_error("Invalid UTF-8 text");
        for(unsigned k=0;k<count;++k){if(i==text.size()||(static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i])&0xc0)!=0x80) throw std::runtime_error("Invalid UTF-8 text");value=(value<<6)|(static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i++])&63);}
        result.push_back(value);
    }return result;
}
// Byte offsets at UTF-8 codepoint boundaries, including the one-past-end offset.
// The string natives use codepoint indices, whereas Lua's own string library
// indexes bytes. Validate complete scalar values before returning a slice.
std::vector<std::size_t> utf8_boundaries(const std::string& text) {
    std::vector<std::size_t> result{0};
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<text.size();) {
        const auto first=static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i++]);
        std::uint32_t value=first,minimum=0;unsigned remaining=0;
        if(first<=0x7f) {}
        else if(first>=0xc2&&first<=0xdf){value=first&0x1f;minimum=0x80;remaining=1;}
        else if(first>=0xe0&&first<=0xef){value=first&0x0f;minimum=0x800;remaining=2;}
        else if(first>=0xf0&&first<=0xf4){value=first&7;minimum=0x10000;remaining=3;}
        else throw std::runtime_error("Invalid UTF-8 text");
        for(unsigned j=0;j<remaining;++j){
            if(i==text.size())throw std::runtime_error("Truncated UTF-8 text");
            const auto next=static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i++]);
            if((next&0xc0)!=0x80)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid UTF-8 continuation byte");
            value=(value<<6)|(next&0x3f);
        }
        if(value<minimum||value>0x10ffff||(value>=0xd800&&value<=0xdfff))
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid UTF-8 scalar value");
        result.push_back(i);
    }
    return result;
}
}

struct Renderer::Impl {
    struct Glyph {unsigned x=0,y=0,w=0,h=0;int dx=0,dy=0;float advance=0;};
    struct Overlay {std::shared_ptr<Texture> texture,tinted;
#ifdef _WIN32
    std::unique_ptr<Bitmap> raster;
#endif
    const Texture* rasterTexture=nullptr;int rasterWidth=0,rasterHeight=0;std::array<float,8> rasterUV{};std::array<float,8> uv{0,0,0,1,1,0,1,1};std::array<float,4> color{1,1,1,1};float angle=0,cx=0,cy=0;};
    struct Line {std::vector<std::uint32_t> chars;float width=0;std::size_t consumed=0;};
    ResourceResolver resolver;int width,height,nextOverlay=1,missingAssets=0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    ULONG_PTR token=0;
    std::unique_ptr<Bitmap> canvas;std::unique_ptr<Graphics> graphics;
#else
    SDL_Surface* canvas=nullptr;
    SDL_Renderer* graphics=nullptr;
#endif
    std::unordered_map<int,Overlay> overlays;
    std::map<std::filesystem::path,std::weak_ptr<Texture>> textureCache;
    std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t,std::array<Glyph,2>> glyphs;
    std::shared_ptr<Texture> fontTexture; float nominalFontSize=40;
    std::map<std::tuple<std::uint32_t,bool,int>,std::shared_ptr<Texture>> glyphCache;
    std::array<float,4> textColor{1,1,1,1};bool bold=false;int alignment=0,verticalAlignment=0,firstLine=0,lineLimit=0;
    float wrapWidth=0,lineScale=1;

    Impl(ResourceResolver r,int w,int h):resolver(std::move(r)),width(w),height(h) {
        if(width<=0||height<=0||width>16384||height>16384) throw std::runtime_error("Invalid renderer size");
        #ifdef _WIN32
        GdiplusStartupInput startup;
        if(GdiplusStartup(&token,&startup,nullptr)!=Ok) throw std::runtime_error("GDI+ startup failed");
        try {
            canvas=std::make_unique<Bitmap>(width,height,PixelFormat32bppARGB);
            if(canvas->GetLastStatus()!=Ok) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot allocate menu canvas");
            reset_graphics();load_font();
        }catch(...){graphics.reset();canvas.reset();GdiplusShutdown(token);token=0;throw;}
    }
    ~Impl(){graphics.reset();overlays.clear();glyphCache.clear();fontTexture.reset();canvas.reset();if(token)GdiplusShutdown(token);}
    void reset_graphics() {
        graphics=std::make_unique<Graphics>(canvas.get());
        graphics->SetCompositingMode(CompositingModeSourceOver);
        graphics->SetCompositingQuality(CompositingQualityHighQuality);
        graphics->SetInterpolationMode(InterpolationModeHighQualityBilinear);
        graphics->SetPixelOffsetMode(PixelOffsetModeHalf);
    }
    #else
        canvas=SDL_CreateRGBSurfaceWithFormat(0,width,height,32,SDL_PIXELFORMAT_ARGB8888);
        if(!canvas)throw std::runtime_error(SDL_GetError());
        graphics=SDL_CreateSoftwareRenderer(canvas);
        if(!graphics){SDL_FreeSurface(canvas);throw std::runtime_error(SDL_GetError());}
        SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_RENDER_SCALE_QUALITY,"linear");
        try{load_font();}catch(...){SDL_DestroyRenderer(graphics);SDL_FreeSurface(canvas);throw;}
    }
    ~Impl(){overlays.clear();glyphCache.clear();fontTexture.reset();SDL_DestroyRenderer(graphics);SDL_FreeSurface(canvas);}
    // SDL owns only the platform drawing transport. DDS decoding, UV origin,
    // original font metrics, SDF coverage and GUI layout remain shared.
    void copy(Texture& texture,const SDL_Rect& src,const SDL_FRect& dst,double angle=0,const SDL_FPoint* center=nullptr,SDL_RendererFlip flip=SDL_FLIP_NONE,const std::array<float,4>* color=nullptr){
        if(!texture.bitmap){
            texture.bitmap=SDL_CreateTexture(graphics,SDL_PIXELFORMAT_ARGB8888,SDL_TEXTUREACCESS_STATIC,texture.width,texture.height);
            if(!texture.bitmap)throw std::runtime_error(SDL_GetError());
            if(SDL_UpdateTexture(texture.bitmap,nullptr,texture.pixels.data(),texture.width*4)!=0||SDL_SetTextureBlendMode(texture.bitmap,SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND)!=0)throw std::runtime_error(SDL_GetError());
        }
        SDL_SetTextureColorMod(texture.bitmap,color?byte(linear_to_srgb((*color)[0])):255,color?byte(linear_to_srgb((*color)[1])):255,color?byte(linear_to_srgb((*color)[2])):255);
        SDL_SetTextureAlphaMod(texture.bitmap,color?byte((*color)[3]):255);
        if(SDL_RenderCopyExF(graphics,texture.bitmap,&src,&dst,angle,center,flip)!=0)throw std::runtime_error(SDL_GetError());
    }
    #endif
    std::shared_ptr<Texture> load_texture(const std::string& name) {
        try {
            const auto path=resolver(name);
            if(auto existing=textureCache[path].lock())return existing;
            auto t=decode_image(path);textureCache[path]=t;return t;
        }catch(...){++missingAssets;throw;}
    }
    void load_font() {
        const Bytes b=read_bytes(resolver("shared/font/defaultFont.font"));
        nominalFontSize=big_float(b,0);const auto count=big32(b,8);
        if(!std::isfinite(nominalFontSize)||nominalFontSize<=0||count>65536||b.size()!=12ull+count*28ull)throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported bitmap font metrics");
        fontTexture=load_texture("shared/font/defaultFont.png");
        for(unsigned i=0;i<count;++i){const std::size_t p=12+std::size_t(i)*28;std::array<Glyph,2> pair;
            for(unsigned j=0;j<2;++j){const std::size_t k=p+4+j*12;auto& g=pair[j];g.x=unsigned(b[k])<<8|b[k+1];g.y=unsigned(b[k+2])<<8|b[k+3];g.w=b[k+4];g.h=b[k+5];g.dx=static_cast<std::int8_t>(b[k+6]);g.dy=static_cast<std::int8_t>(b[k+7]);g.advance=big_float(b,k+8);
                if(g.x+g.w>unsigned(fontTexture->width)||g.y+g.h>unsigned(fontTexture->height)||!std::isfinite(g.advance)||g.advance<0)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid bitmap font glyph");}
            glyphs.emplace(big32(b,p),pair);
        }
    }
    const Glyph& glyph(std::uint32_t c)const {
        auto found=glyphs.find(c);if(found==glyphs.end())found=glyphs.find('?');
        if(found==glyphs.end())throw std::runtime_error("Font missing fallback glyph");
        return found->second[bold?1:0];
    }
    std::vector<Line> layout(float pixelSize,const std::string& text)const {
        auto chars=codepoints(text);std::vector<Line> lines(1);const float scale=pixelSize/nominalFontSize,maxWidth=wrapWidth*width;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<chars.size();++i){const auto c=chars[i];if(c=='\r')continue;
            if(c=='\n'){lines.back().consumed=i+1;lines.emplace_back();continue;}
            float advance=glyph(c).advance*scale;
            if(maxWidth>0 && !lines.back().chars.empty() && lines.back().width+advance>maxWidth){
                auto& old=lines.back();auto split=std::find(old.chars.rbegin(),old.chars.rend(),std::uint32_t(' '));
                if(split!=old.chars.rend()) {
                    const auto index=old.chars.size()-1-std::size_t(split-old.chars.rbegin());
                    Line next;next.chars.assign(old.chars.begin()+index+1,old.chars.end());old.chars.resize(index);
                    old.width=0;for(auto v:old.chars)old.width+=glyph(v).advance*scale;
                    next.width=0;for(auto v:next.chars)next.width+=glyph(v).advance*scale;old.consumed=i-next.chars.size();lines.push_back(std::move(next));
                } else {old.consumed=i;lines.emplace_back();}
                if(c==' '){lines.back().consumed=i+1;continue;}
            }
            lines.back().chars.push_back(c);lines.back().width+=advance;lines.back().consumed=i+1;
        }return lines;
    }
    std::shared_ptr<Texture> raster_glyph(std::uint32_t c,float pixelSize) {
        const int keySize=std::max(1,int(std::lround(pixelSize*64)));const auto key=std::make_tuple(c,bold,keySize);
        auto it=glyphCache.find(key);if(it!=glyphCache.end())return it->second;
        const auto& g=glyph(c);const float scale=float(keySize)/64/nominalFontSize;
        auto t=std::make_shared<Texture>();t->width=std::max(1,int(std::ceil(g.w*scale)));t->height=std::max(1,int(std::ceil(g.h*scale)));t->pixels.resize(std::size_t(t->width)*t->height);
        // The original PNG stores a signed-distance field in its luminance.
        // Reconstruct coverage after sampling at the output resolution.
        const float edge=std::max(3.0f,7.5f/std::max(0.01f,scale));
        auto sample=[&](int x,int y){x=std::clamp(x,int(g.x),int(g.x+g.w)-1);y=std::clamp(y,int(g.y),int(g.y+g.h)-1);return float(fontTexture->pixels[std::size_t(y)*fontTexture->width+x]&255);};
        for(int y=0;y<t->height;++y)for(int x=0;x<t->width;++x){
            const float sx=g.x+(x+0.5f)/scale-0.5f,sy=g.y+(y+0.5f)/scale-0.5f;const int ix=int(std::floor(sx)),iy=int(std::floor(sy));const float fx=sx-ix,fy=sy-iy;
            const float value=(sample(ix,iy)*(1-fx)+sample(ix+1,iy)*fx)*(1-fy)+(sample(ix,iy+1)*(1-fx)+sample(ix+1,iy+1)*fx)*fy;
            float a=clamp((value-(128-edge))/(2*edge));a=a*a*(3-2*a);t->pixels[std::size_t(y)*t->width+x]=(byte(a)<<24)|0xffffffu;
        }
        t->finish();glyphCache.emplace(key,t);return t;
    }
    Overlay& overlay(lua_State* L){int id=int(luaL_checkinteger(L,1));auto it=overlays.find(id);if(it==overlays.end())throw std::runtime_error("Unknown overlay id: "+std::to_string(id));return it->second;}
    static Impl& self(lua_State* L){return *static_cast<Impl*>(lua_touserdata(L,lua_upvalueindex(1)));}

    int draw_overlay(lua_State* L){auto& o=overlay(L);const float x=float(luaL_checknumber(L,2)),y=float(luaL_checknumber(L,3)),w=float(luaL_checknumber(L,4)),h=float(luaL_checknumber(L,5));

        // DDS/native overlay UVs use the lower left as their texture origin.

        if(left==right||top==bottom)return 0;
        #ifdef _WIN32

            &&std::abs(w*width-rasterWidth)<0.001f&&std::abs(h*height-rasterHeight)<0.001f&&std::abs(x*width-rasterX)<0.001f&&std::abs((1-y-h)*height-rasterY)<0.001f;
        Status status;

            // expensive with GDI+. Cache only opaque, integer-aligned draws;
            // alpha overlays and fractional geometry retain the normal path.
            if(!o.raster||o.rasterTexture!=texture.get()||o.rasterWidth!=rasterWidth||o.rasterHeight!=rasterHeight||o.rasterUV!=o.uv){

                if(status!=Ok){o.raster.reset();graphics->Restore(saved);throw std::runtime_error("Background cache drawing failed");}
                o.rasterTexture=texture.get();o.rasterWidth=rasterWidth;o.rasterHeight=rasterHeight;o.rasterUV=o.uv;
            }
            status=graphics->DrawImage(o.raster.get(),rasterX,rasterY,rasterWidth,rasterHeight);
        }else status=graphics->DrawImage(texture->bitmap.get(),dest,3,std::min(left,right),std::min(top,bottom),std::abs(right-left),std::abs(bottom-top),UnitPixel,&attributes);
        graphics->Restore(saved);if(status!=Ok)throw std::runtime_error("Overlay drawing failed");return 0;
        #else
        const SDL_Rect src{int(std::floor(std::min(left,right))),int(std::floor(std::min(top,bottom))),
            std::max(1,int(std::ceil(std::abs(right-left)))),std::max(1,int(std::ceil(std::abs(bottom-top))))};
        const SDL_FRect dst{x*width,(1-y-h)*height,w*width,h*height};
        if(w<0||h<0)throw std::runtime_error("Negative overlay dimensions are unsupported");
        const SDL_FPoint center{o.cx*width,(h-o.cy)*height};
        const auto flip=static_cast<SDL_RendererFlip>((right<left?SDL_FLIP_HORIZONTAL:0)|(bottom<top?SDL_FLIP_VERTICAL:0));
        copy(*texture,src,dst,-o.angle*180/3.14159265358979323846,&center,flip);
        return 0;
        #endif
    }

        // embedded NULs and actual normal/bold font advances. Restore text state.
        const bool savedBold=bold;
        const int check=luaL_dostring(L,R"lua(
            local text=string.char(65,0xc3,0xa9,0xe4,0xb8,0xad,0xf0,0x9f,0x9a,0x9c,90)
            assert(utf8Strlen(text)==5 and utf8Strlen('')==0)
            assert(utf8Substr(text,1,3)==text:sub(2,-2))
            assert(utf8Substr(text,4)=='Z' and utf8Substr(text,5)=='')

            assert(utf8Strlen('A'..string.char(0)..'B')==3)

                assert(getTextLineLength(size,'A',-1)==0)
                assert(getTextLineLength(size,'',1)==0)
            end
        )lua");
        bold=savedBold;
        if(check!=0){const std::string message=lua_tostring(L,-1);lua_pop(L,1);throw std::runtime_error("Text bridge self-check failed: "+message);}
```

```cpp
// Independently authored metadata adapter for the recovered CareerScreen.
#include "savegames.h"
#include "xml_bridge.h"

extern "C" {
#include "lua.h"
#include "lauxlib.h"
}

#include <array>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <new>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>
#include <utility>

namespace fs15menu {
namespace {

constexpr int slot_count = 20;
constexpr size_t max_metadata_bytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

// These stable host identifiers are shared with the Lua scripts by name. Their
// numeric correspondence with the original native engine has not been verified.
enum SaveError {
    error_ok = 0,
    error_data_corrupt = 1,
    error_scan_in_progress = 2,
    error_scan_failed = 3,
    error_device_unavailable = 4,
};

struct Slot {
    std::string metadata;
    std::string display_name;
};

struct Context {
    std::filesystem::path directory;
    std::string profile_path;
    std::array<Slot, slot_count> slots;
    int snapshot_error = error_ok;
    bool scanned = false;

    explicit Context(std::filesystem::path selected) : directory(std::move(selected)) {
        if (!directory.empty()) {
            profile_path = directory.generic_u8string();
            if (profile_path.back() != '/') profile_path += '/';
        }
        for (int index = 0; index < slot_count; ++index) {
            slots[index].display_name = "Savegame " + std::to_string(index + 1);
        }
    }

    void scan() {
        snapshot_error = error_ok;
        for (auto& slot : slots) slot.metadata.clear();
        scanned = true;
        if (directory.empty()) return;

        std::error_code ec;
        if (!std::filesystem::is_directory(directory, ec) || ec) {
            snapshot_error = error_scan_failed;
            return;
        }
        for (int index = 0; index < slot_count; ++index) {
            const auto filename = directory / ("savegame" + std::to_string(index + 1)) / "careerSavegame.xml";
            ec.clear();
            const bool present = std::filesystem::exists(filename, ec);
            if (!present && !ec) continue;
            try {
                if (ec || !std::filesystem::is_regular_file(filename)) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Cannot read save metadata");
                }
                const auto length = std::filesystem::file_size(filename);
                if (!length || length > max_metadata_bytes) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Save metadata exceeds the size limit or is empty");
                }
                std::ifstream file(filename, std::ios::binary);
                if (!file) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open save metadata for reading");
                std::string metadata(static_cast<size_t>(length), '\0');
                file.read(metadata.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(metadata.size()));
                if (!file || file.peek() != std::char_traits<char>::eof()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Save metadata changed while reading");
                }
                validate_xml_memory(metadata, "careerSavegame");
                slots[index].metadata = std::move(metadata);
            } catch (const std::exception&) {
                // The recovered CareerScreen recognizes this sentinel. Raw user
                // metadata and profile filenames are never written to a log.
                slots[index].metadata = "corrupt";
                snapshot_error = error_data_corrupt;
            }
        }
    }
};

Context* context(lua_State* state) {
    return static_cast<Context*>(lua_touserdata(state, lua_upvalueindex(1)));
}

template<int (*Body)(lua_State*)>
int protected_call(lua_State* state) {
    try {
        return Body(state);
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        lua_pushstring(state, error.what());
    } catch (...) {
        lua_pushliteral(state, "Unexpected save metadata error");
    }
    return lua_error(state);
}

int slot_info(lua_State* state) {
    const lua_Integer checked_index = luaL_checkinteger(state, 1);
    if (checked_index < 1 || checked_index > slot_count) throw std::out_of_range("Savegame index must be between 1 and 20");
    const int index = static_cast<int>(checked_index);
    auto* selected = context(state);
    if (!selected->scanned) selected->scan();
    const auto& slot = selected->slots[static_cast<size_t>(index - 1)];
    lua_pushlstring(state, slot.metadata.data(), slot.metadata.size());
    lua_pushlstring(state, slot.display_name.data(), slot.display_name.size());
    return 2;
}

int invoke_callback(lua_State* state) {
    lua_pushvalue(state, 2);
    lua_gettable(state, 1);
    if (!lua_isfunction(state, -1)) return luaL_error(state, "Save metadata callback is not a target method");
    lua_pushvalue(state, 1);
    lua_pushvalue(state, 3);
    lua_call(state, 2, 0);
    return 0;
}

int update_list(lua_State* state) {
    const char* callback = luaL_checkstring(state, 1);
    luaL_checktype(state, 2, LUA_TTABLE);
    auto* selected = context(state);
    selected->scan();
    // Both the method lookup (including __index for recovered classes) and the
    // callback execute inside a protected Lua call. No C++ objects span it.
    lua_pushcfunction(state, invoke_callback);
    lua_pushvalue(state, 2);
    lua_pushstring(state, callback);
    lua_pushinteger(state, selected->snapshot_error);
    if (lua_pcall(state, 3, 0, 0) != 0) {
        const char* message = lua_tostring(state, -1);
        const std::string detail = message ? message : "non-string Lua error";
        lua_pop(state, 1);
        throw std::runtime_error("Save metadata callback failed: " + detail);
    }
    return 0;
}

int num_slots(lua_State* state) {
    lua_pushinteger(state, slot_count);
    return 1;
}

int profile_path(lua_State* state) {
    const auto& path = context(state)->profile_path;
    lua_pushlstring(state, path.data(), path.size());
    return 1;
}

int no_operation(lua_State*) {
    // Storage devices are fixed to the caller-selected directory. The menu host
    // has no physics scene, so neither reset nor flush has work to perform.
    return 0;
}

int no_write_space(lua_State* state) {
    lua_pushboolean(state, 0);
    return 1;
}

int reject_mutation(lua_State* state) {
    const char* name = lua_tostring(state, lua_upvalueindex(2));
    throw std::runtime_error(std::string(name ? name : "Save operation") +
                             " is unavailable: this menu reads save metadata only");
}

int snapshot_count(lua_State* state) {
    auto* selected = context(state);
    if (!selected->scanned) selected->scan();
    int populated = 0;
    int corrupt = 0;
    for (const auto& slot : selected->slots) {
        if (slot.metadata == "corrupt") ++corrupt;
        else if (!slot.metadata.empty()) ++populated;
    }
    lua_pushinteger(state, populated);
    lua_pushinteger(state, corrupt);
    return 2;
}

int destroy_context(lua_State* state) {
    static_cast<Context*>(lua_touserdata(state, 1))->~Context();
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace

void register_savegames(lua_State* state, const std::filesystem::path& directory) {
    if (!state) throw std::invalid_argument("Save metadata service requires a Lua state");
    new (lua_newuserdata(state, sizeof(Context))) Context(directory);
    if (luaL_newmetatable(state, "fs15menu.SaveContext")) {
        lua_pushcfunction(state, destroy_context);
        lua_setfield(state, -2, "__gc");
    }
    lua_setmetatable(state, -2);
    const int context_index = lua_gettop(state);
    const luaL_Reg functions[] = {
        {"saveGetInfoById", protected_call<slot_info>},
        {"saveUpdateList", protected_call<update_list>},
        {"saveGetNumOfSaveGames", protected_call<num_slots>},
        {"saveResetStorageDeviceSelection", no_operation},
        {"flushPhysicsCaches", no_operation},
        {"saveGetHasSpaceForSaveGame", no_write_space},
        {"getUserProfileAppPath", protected_call<profile_path>},
        {"fs15_save_snapshot_count", protected_call<snapshot_count>},
        {"saveDeleteSavegame", protected_call<reject_mutation>},
        {"saveWriteSavegameStart", protected_call<reject_mutation>},
        {"saveWriteSavegameFinish", protected_call<reject_mutation>},
        {nullptr, nullptr}
    };
    for (const auto* function = functions; function->name; ++function) {
        lua_pushvalue(state, context_index);
        lua_pushstring(state, function->name);
        lua_pushcclosure(state, function->func, 2);
        lua_setglobal(state, function->name);
    }
    lua_pop(state, 1);

    lua_newtable(state);
    const std::pair<const char*, int> constants[] = {
        {"ERROR_OK", error_ok},
        {"ERROR_DATA_CORRUPT", error_data_corrupt},
        {"ERROR_SCAN_IN_PROGRESS", error_scan_in_progress},
        {"ERROR_SCAN_FAILED", error_scan_failed},
        {"ERROR_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE", error_device_unavailable}
    };
    for (const auto& constant : constants) {
        lua_pushinteger(state, constant.second);
        lua_setfield(state, -2, constant.first);
    }
    lua_setglobal(state, "Savegame");
}

}  // namespace fs15menu
```

```cpp
    std::string text;

// The menu runs Lua and host callbacks on its UI thread. Handles are globally
// distinct so the host can implement delete(handle) without a Lua state argument.
std::unordered_map<int, std::unique_ptr<Node>> documents;

constexpr size_t max_xml_bytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

    ~Context() {
        for (int handle : owned) documents.erase(handle);

#ifdef _WIN32
void check(HRESULT result, const char* operation) {
    if (FAILED(result)) {
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + " failed (HRESULT " +
                                 std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned long>(result)) + ")");
    }
}

std::string utf8(const WCHAR* value, UINT length) {
    if (!length) return {};
    const int size = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, value,
                                         static_cast<int>(length), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (!size) throw std::runtime_error("XML contains invalid Unicode");
    std::string result(static_cast<size_t>(size), '\0');
    if (!WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, value,
                            static_cast<int>(length), result.data(), size, nullptr, nullptr)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Cannot convert XML text to UTF-8");
    }
    return result;
}

std::string node_name(IXmlReader* reader) {
    const WCHAR* value = nullptr;
    UINT length = 0;
    check(reader->GetQualifiedName(&value, &length), "Read XML name");
    return utf8(value, length);
}

std::string node_value(IXmlReader* reader) {
    const WCHAR* value = nullptr;
    UINT length = 0;
    check(reader->GetValue(&value, &length), "Read XML value");
    return utf8(value, length);
}

std::unique_ptr<Node> parse_xml_stream(IStream* stream) {
    STATSTG details{};
    check(stream->Stat(&details, STATFLAG_NONAME), "Read XML stream size");
    if (details.cbSize.QuadPart > max_xml_bytes) throw std::runtime_error("XML exceeds the 8 MiB limit");
    ComPtr<IXmlReader> reader;
    check(CreateXmlReader(__uuidof(IXmlReader),
                          reinterpret_cast<void**>(reader.GetAddressOf()), nullptr), "Create XML reader");
    // Prohibit every DTD, including internal declarations. No entity resolver is
    // installed; external paths and network entities cannot be requested.
    check(reader->SetProperty(XmlReaderProperty_DtdProcessing, DtdProcessing_Prohibit), "Prohibit XML DTD");
    check(reader->SetProperty(XmlReaderProperty_MaxElementDepth, 512), "Set XML depth limit");
    check(reader->SetInput(stream), "Set XML input");

    std::unique_ptr<Node> root;
    std::vector<Node*> stack;
    size_t count = 0;
    XmlNodeType type = XmlNodeType_None;
    HRESULT result;
    while ((result = reader->Read(&type)) == S_OK) {
        if (type == XmlNodeType_Element) {
            if (++count > 200000) throw std::runtime_error("XML has too many elements");
            auto node = std::make_unique<Node>();
            node->name = node_name(reader.Get());
            const bool empty = reader->IsEmptyElement() != FALSE;
            const HRESULT first = reader->MoveToFirstAttribute();
            check(first, "Read XML attributes");
            if (first == S_OK) {
                HRESULT attribute;
                do {
                    auto name = node_name(reader.Get());
                    if (!node->attributes.emplace(std::move(name), node_value(reader.Get())).second) {
                        throw std::runtime_error("Duplicate XML attribute");
                    }
                    attribute = reader->MoveToNextAttribute();
                } while (attribute == S_OK);
                check(attribute, "Read next XML attribute");
                check(reader->MoveToElement(), "Return to XML element");
            }
            Node* current = node.get();
            if (stack.empty()) {
                if (root) throw std::runtime_error("XML has multiple root elements");
                root = std::move(node);
            } else {
                stack.back()->children.push_back(std::move(node));
            }
            if (!empty) stack.push_back(current);
        } else if (type == XmlNodeType_EndElement) {
            if (stack.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("Unmatched XML closing element");
            stack.pop_back();
        } else if (!stack.empty() &&
                   (type == XmlNodeType_Text || type == XmlNodeType_CDATA || type == XmlNodeType_Whitespace)) {
            stack.back()->text += node_value(reader.Get());
        }
    }
    if (FAILED(result)) {
        UINT line = 0, column = 0;
        reader->GetLineNumber(&line);
        reader->GetLinePosition(&column);
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid XML at line " + std::to_string(line) +
                                 ", column " + std::to_string(column) + " (HRESULT " +
                                 std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned long>(result)) + ")");
    }
    if (!root || !stack.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("XML has no complete root element");
    return root;
}

std::unique_ptr<Node> parse_xml(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    ComPtr<IStream> stream;
    const HRESULT opened = SHCreateStreamOnFileEx(path.c_str(), STGM_READ | STGM_SHARE_DENY_WRITE,
                                                  FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, FALSE, nullptr, stream.GetAddressOf());
    if (FAILED(opened)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open XML file " + path.u8string() + " (HRESULT " +
                                 std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned long>(opened)) + ")");
    }
    return parse_xml_stream(stream.Get());
}

std::unique_ptr<Node> parse_xml_memory(std::string_view xml) {
    if (xml.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("XML memory input is empty");
    if (xml.size() > max_xml_bytes) throw std::runtime_error("XML exceeds the 8 MiB limit");
    ComPtr<IStream> stream;
    stream.Attach(SHCreateMemStream(reinterpret_cast<const BYTE*>(xml.data()), static_cast<UINT>(xml.size())));
    if (!stream) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot create XML memory stream");
    return parse_xml_stream(stream.Get());
}
#else
// Expat is a third-party XML decoder, not the recovered GE6 tokenizer. The
// platform-neutral DOM/property/ownership layer below remains shared with the
// Windows XmlLite adapter. Never unwind a C++ exception through Expat callbacks.
struct Parser {
    XML_Parser parser=nullptr;
    std::unique_ptr<Node> root;
    std::vector<Node*> stack;
    size_t count=0;
    std::exception_ptr error;
    Parser(){parser=XML_ParserCreate(nullptr);if(!parser)throw std::bad_alloc();}
    ~Parser(){XML_ParserFree(parser);}
    template<class F> void callback(F body) noexcept {
        if(error)return;
        try{body();}catch(...){error=std::current_exception();XML_StopParser(parser,XML_FALSE);}
    }
    static void start(void* user,const XML_Char* name,const XML_Char** attributes){
        auto& p=*static_cast<Parser*>(user);p.callback([&]{
            if(++p.count>200000)throw std::runtime_error("XML has too many elements");
            if(p.stack.size()>=512)throw std::runtime_error("XML exceeds the depth limit");
            auto node=std::make_unique<Node>();node->name=name;
            for(size_t i=0;attributes[i];i+=2)if(!node->attributes.emplace(attributes[i],attributes[i+1]).second)throw std::runtime_error("Duplicate XML attribute");
            Node* current=node.get();
            if(p.stack.empty()){if(p.root)throw std::runtime_error("XML has multiple root elements");p.root=std::move(node);}
            else p.stack.back()->children.push_back(std::move(node));
            p.stack.push_back(current);
        });
    }
    static void end(void* user,const XML_Char*){auto& p=*static_cast<Parser*>(user);p.callback([&]{if(p.stack.empty())throw std::runtime_error("Unmatched XML closing element");p.stack.pop_back();});}
    static void text(void* user,const XML_Char* text,int size){auto& p=*static_cast<Parser*>(user);p.callback([&]{if(!p.stack.empty())p.stack.back()->text.append(text,static_cast<size_t>(size));});}
    static void dtd(void* user,const XML_Char*,const XML_Char*,const XML_Char*,int){auto& p=*static_cast<Parser*>(user);p.callback([]{throw std::runtime_error("XML DTD is prohibited");});}
    static int external(XML_Parser,const XML_Char*,const XML_Char*,const XML_Char*,const XML_Char*){return XML_STATUS_ERROR;}
};
std::unique_ptr<Node> parse_xml_memory(std::string_view xml){
    if(xml.empty())throw std::runtime_error("XML memory input is empty");
    if(xml.size()>max_xml_bytes)throw std::runtime_error("XML exceeds the 8 MiB limit");
    Parser p;XML_SetUserData(p.parser,&p);XML_SetElementHandler(p.parser,Parser::start,Parser::end);XML_SetCharacterDataHandler(p.parser,Parser::text);
    XML_SetStartDoctypeDeclHandler(p.parser,Parser::dtd);XML_SetExternalEntityRefHandler(p.parser,Parser::external);XML_SetParamEntityParsing(p.parser,XML_PARAM_ENTITY_PARSING_NEVER);
    const auto result=XML_Parse(p.parser,xml.data(),static_cast<int>(xml.size()),XML_TRUE);
    if(p.error)std::rethrow_exception(p.error);
    if(result!=XML_STATUS_OK)throw std::runtime_error("Invalid XML at line "+std::to_string(XML_GetCurrentLineNumber(p.parser))+": "+XML_ErrorString(XML_GetErrorCode(p.parser)));
    if(!p.root||!p.stack.empty())throw std::runtime_error("XML has no complete root element");
    return std::move(p.root);
}
std::unique_ptr<Node> parse_xml(const std::filesystem::path& path){
    const auto bytes=fs15platform::read_file_bounded(path,max_xml_bytes);
    if(bytes.empty())throw std::runtime_error("XML memory input is empty");
    return parse_xml_memory(std::string_view(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()),bytes.size()));
}
#endif

struct Segment {
    std::string_view name;
    size_t index = 0;
};

std::optional<Segment> parse_segment(std::string_view value) {
    if (value.empty()) return {};
    const size_t open = value.find('(');
    if (open == std::string_view::npos) {
        if (value.find(')') != std::string_view::npos) return {};
        return Segment{value, 0};
    }
    if (!open || value.back() != ')') return {};
    const auto index_text = value.substr(open + 1, value.size() - open - 2);
    if (index_text.empty()) return {};
    size_t index = 0;
    const auto parsed = std::from_chars(index_text.data(), index_text.data() + index_text.size(), index);
    if (parsed.ec != std::errc() || parsed.ptr != index_text.data() + index_text.size()) return {};
    return Segment{value.substr(0, open), index};
}

struct Property {
    const Node* node = nullptr;
    const std::string* value = nullptr;
    bool exists = false;
};

Property lookup(int handle, std::string_view key) {
    const auto found = documents.find(handle);
    if (found == documents.end()) return {};
    const size_t hash = key.find('#');
    const auto path = key.substr(0, hash);
    const auto attribute = hash == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view{} : key.substr(hash + 1);
    if (path.empty() || (hash != std::string_view::npos &&
                         (attribute.empty() || attribute.find('#') != std::string_view::npos))) return {};
    const Node* current = nullptr;
    size_t offset = 0;
    while (offset < path.size()) {
        const size_t dot = path.find('.', offset);
        const size_t end = dot == std::string_view::npos ? path.size() : dot;
        const auto part = parse_segment(path.substr(offset, end - offset));
        if (!part) return {};
        if (!current) {
            current = found->second.get();
            if (part->index || current->name != part->name) return {};
        } else {
            const Node* next = nullptr;
            size_t matching = 0;
            for (const auto& child : current->children) {
                if (child->name == part->name && matching++ == part->index) {
                    next = child.get();
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!next) return {};
            current = next;
        }
        if (dot == std::string_view::npos) break;
        offset = dot + 1;
        if (offset == path.size()) return {};
    }
    if (hash == std::string_view::npos) return {current, &current->text, true};
    const auto found_attribute = current->attributes.find(std::string(attribute));
    if (found_attribute == current->attributes.end()) return {};
    return {current, &found_attribute->second, true};
}

std::string_view trim(std::string_view value) {
    const auto first = value.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
    if (first == std::string_view::npos) return {};
    return value.substr(first, value.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n") - first + 1);
}

// Exceptions unwind C++ objects before calling lua_error(), which can longjmp.
// luaL_check* argument checks occur before a callback creates C++ local objects.
template<int (*Body)(lua_State*)>
int protected_call(lua_State* state) {
    try {
        return Body(state);
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        lua_pushstring(state, error.what());
    } catch (...) {
        lua_pushliteral(state, "Unexpected XML bridge error");
    }
    return lua_error(state);
}

int store_document(lua_State* state, std::unique_ptr<Node> root) {
    auto* context = static_cast<Context*>(lua_touserdata(state, lua_upvalueindex(1)));
    if (next_handle == std::numeric_limits<int>::max()) throw std::runtime_error("XML handle range exhausted");
    const int handle = next_handle++;
    context->owned.insert(handle);
    documents.emplace(handle, std::move(root));
    lua_pushinteger(state, handle);
    return 1;
}

int load_document(lua_State* state) {
    luaL_checkstring(state, 1);  // Diagnostic document name; path controls loading.
    const char* path = luaL_checkstring(state, 2);
    auto* context = static_cast<Context*>(lua_touserdata(state, lua_upvalueindex(1)));
    return store_document(state, parse_xml(context->resolve(path)));
}

int load_memory_document(lua_State* state) {
    luaL_checkstring(state, 1);
    size_t size = 0;
    const char* xml = luaL_checklstring(state, 2, &size);
    return store_document(state, parse_xml_memory({xml, size}));
}

int read_string(lua_State* state) {
    const int handle = static_cast<int>(luaL_checkinteger(state, 1));
    const char* key = luaL_checkstring(state, 2);
    const auto property = lookup(handle, key);
    if (property.exists) lua_pushlstring(state, property.value->data(), property.value->size());
    else lua_pushnil(state);
    return 1;
}

int read_integer(lua_State* state) {
    const int handle = static_cast<int>(luaL_checkinteger(state, 1));
    const char* key = luaL_checkstring(state, 2);
    const auto property = lookup(handle, key);
    if (property.exists) {
        auto value = trim(*property.value);
        if (!value.empty() && value.front() == '+') value.remove_prefix(1);
        if (value.empty()) { lua_pushnil(state); return 1; }
        int32_t number = 0;
        const auto result = std::from_chars(value.data(), value.data() + value.size(), number);
        if (!value.empty() && result.ec == std::errc() && result.ptr == value.data() + value.size()) {
            lua_pushinteger(state, number);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    lua_pushnil(state);
    return 1;
}

int read_float(lua_State* state) {
    const int handle = static_cast<int>(luaL_checkinteger(state, 1));
    const char* key = luaL_checkstring(state, 2);
    const auto property = lookup(handle, key);
    if (property.exists) {
        auto value = trim(*property.value);
        if (!value.empty() && value.front() == '+') value.remove_prefix(1);
        if (value.empty()) { lua_pushnil(state); return 1; }
        double number = 0;
        const auto result = std::from_chars(value.data(), value.data() + value.size(), number);
        if (!value.empty() && result.ec == std::errc() && result.ptr == value.data() + value.size() && std::isfinite(number)) {
            lua_pushnumber(state, number);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    lua_pushnil(state);
    return 1;
}

int read_bool(lua_State* state) {
    const int handle = static_cast<int>(luaL_checkinteger(state, 1));
    const char* key = luaL_checkstring(state, 2);
    const auto property = lookup(handle, key);
    if (property.exists) {
        auto value = trim(*property.value);
        auto equals = [value](std::string_view wanted) {
            if (value.size() != wanted.size()) return false;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < value.size(); ++i) {
                const char c = value[i] >= 'A' && value[i] <= 'Z' ? value[i] + ('a' - 'A') : value[i];
                if (c != wanted[i]) return false;
            }
            return true;
        };
        if (equals("true") || equals("1")) { lua_pushboolean(state, 1); return 1; }
        if (equals("false") || equals("0")) { lua_pushboolean(state, 0); return 1; }
    }
    lua_pushnil(state);
    return 1;
}

int has_property(lua_State* state) {
    const int handle = static_cast<int>(luaL_checkinteger(state, 1));
    const char* key = luaL_checkstring(state, 2);
    const auto property = lookup(handle, key);
    lua_pushboolean(state, property.exists);
    return 1;
}

int destroy_context(lua_State* state) {
    static_cast<Context*>(lua_touserdata(state, 1))->~Context();
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace

void register_xml(lua_State* state, ResourceResolver resolver) {
    if (!state || !resolver) throw std::invalid_argument("XML bridge requires a Lua state and resource resolver");
    auto* context = new (lua_newuserdata(state, sizeof(Context))) Context{std::move(resolver), {}};
    (void)context;
    if (luaL_newmetatable(state, "fs15menu.XMLContext")) {
        lua_pushcfunction(state, destroy_context);
        lua_setfield(state, -2, "__gc");
    }
    lua_setmetatable(state, -2);
    const int context_index = lua_gettop(state);
    const luaL_Reg functions[] = {
        {"loadXMLFile", protected_call<load_document>},
        {"loadXMLFileFromMemory", protected_call<load_memory_document>},
        {"getXMLString", protected_call<read_string>},
        {"getXMLInt", protected_call<read_integer>},
        {"getXMLFloat", protected_call<read_float>},
        {"getXMLBool", protected_call<read_bool>},
        {"hasXMLProperty", protected_call<has_property>},
        {nullptr, nullptr}
    };
    for (const luaL_Reg* function = functions; function->name; ++function) {
        lua_pushvalue(state, context_index);
        lua_pushcclosure(state, function->func, 1);
        lua_setglobal(state, function->name);
    }
    lua_pop(state, 1);
}

bool delete_xml(int handle) {
    return documents.erase(handle) != 0;
}

int xml_document_count() {
    return static_cast<int>(documents.size());
}

void validate_xml_memory(std::string_view xml, std::string_view expected_root) {
    const auto root = parse_xml_memory(xml);
    if (!expected_root.empty() && root->name != expected_root) {
        throw std::runtime_error("XML has an unexpected root element");
    }
}

}  // namespace fs15menu
```

`src/native_engine/activate.lua`:

```lua
-- Authored integration boundary. The recovered helpers also run in the home host.
-- Keep GE6 rendering, contacts, suspension, scene loading and mission lifecycle.
assert(FS15NativeProbe.comparisons == 104, 'Recovered helper parity must pass before activation')
local original, recovered = FS15NativeProbe.originalWheels, WheelsUtil
local names = {'getTireType', 'getTireFriction', 'getGroundType'}
local saved, installed = {}, {}
local function activate()
    if FS15NativeProbe.gameplayActivated then return end
    -- Preserve tire registrations from the original game and any earlier mods.
    recovered.tireTypes = original.tireTypes
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        saved[name] = original[name]
        local implementation, label = assert(recovered[name]), name
        local used = false
        installed[name] = function(...)
            if not used then
                print('FS15_HYBRID_HELPER_USED name=' .. label)
                used = true
            end
            return implementation(...)
        end
        original[name] = installed[name]
    end
    FS15NativeProbe.gameplayActivated = true
    print('FS15_HYBRID_RECOVERED_ACTIVE helpers=3')
end
activate()
local listener = {}
-- FS15 loads mod scripts once; reactivate if another map follows deleteMap.
function listener:loadMap() activate() end
function listener:update() end
function listener:draw() end
function listener:keyEvent() end
function listener:mouseEvent() end
function listener:deleteMap()
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        -- Do not undo another mod's later wrapper.
        if original[name] == installed[name] then original[name] = saved[name] end
    end
    FS15NativeProbe.gameplayActivated = false
    print('FS15_HYBRID_RECOVERED_RESTORED')
end
addModEventListener(listener)
```

```cpp
#include "file_transport.h"

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <cerrno>
#include <fcntl.h>

#include <unistd.h>
#endif

namespace fs15platform {
namespace {
uint64_t token(const std::array<unsigned char,0x38>& record){uint64_t result;std::memcpy(&result,record.data()+8,8);return result;}
uint32_t read_os(void*,uint64_t file,void* output,uint32_t count,uint32_t* consumed){
#ifdef _WIN32
    DWORD actual=0;
    const auto ok=ReadFile(reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(file)),output,count,&actual,nullptr);
    *consumed=actual;
    return ok?0:GetLastError();
#else
    ssize_t actual;
    do{actual=::read(static_cast<int>(file),output,count);}while(actual<0&&errno==EINTR);
    if(actual<0)return errno==EBADF?6:31;
    *consumed=static_cast<uint32_t>(actual);return 0;
#endif
}
uint32_t seek_os(void*,uint64_t file,int32_t distance,uint32_t origin){
#ifdef _WIN32
    return SetFilePointer(reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(file)),distance,nullptr,origin);
#else
    const auto result=::lseek(static_cast<int>(file),distance,origin==0?SEEK_SET:SEEK_CUR);
    return result<0?UINT32_MAX:static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(result));
#endif
}
uint32_t size_os(void*,uint64_t file){
#ifdef _WIN32
    return GetFileSize(reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(file)),nullptr);
#else
    struct stat info{};
    return ::fstat(static_cast<int>(file),&info)!=0?UINT32_MAX:static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(info.st_size));
#endif
}
}
ReadOnlyFile::ReadOnlyFile(const std::filesystem::path& path){
    uint64_t file=UINT64_MAX;
#ifdef _WIN32
    const auto opened=CreateFileW(path.c_str(),GENERIC_READ,FILE_SHARE_READ,nullptr,OPEN_EXISTING,FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,nullptr);
    if(opened==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open resource: "+path.u8string());
    if(GetFileType(opened)!=FILE_TYPE_DISK){CloseHandle(opened);throw std::runtime_error("Resource is not a disk file");}
    file=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(opened);
#else
    const int opened=::open(path.c_str(),O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NONBLOCK);
    if(opened<0)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open resource: "+path.u8string());
    struct stat info{};
    if(::fstat(opened,&info)!=0||!S_ISREG(info.st_mode)){::close(opened);throw std::runtime_error("Resource is not a regular file");}
    file=static_cast<uint64_t>(opened);
#endif
    std::memcpy(record_.data()+8,&file,8);
    services_={nullptr,read_os,seek_os,size_os,nullptr};
}
ReadOnlyFile::~ReadOnlyFile(){
#ifdef _WIN32
    CloseHandle(reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(token(record_))));
#else
    ::close(static_cast<int>(token(record_)));
#endif
}
uint32_t ReadOnlyFile::read(void* output,uint32_t count){return fs15_file_read(record_.data(),record_.size(),output,count,&services_);}
bool ReadOnlyFile::seek(uint32_t position){return fs15_file_seek(record_.data(),record_.size(),position,&services_)!=0;}
uint32_t ReadOnlyFile::size() const{return fs15_file_size(record_.data(),record_.size(),&services_);}
uint32_t ReadOnlyFile::tell() const{return fs15_file_tell(record_.data(),record_.size(),&services_);}
uint64_t ReadOnlyFile::full_size() const{
#ifdef _WIN32
    LARGE_INTEGER value{};
    if(!GetFileSizeEx(reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(token(record_))),&value)||value.QuadPart<0)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot measure resource");
    return static_cast<uint64_t>(value.QuadPart);
#else
    struct stat value{};
    if(::fstat(static_cast<int>(token(record_)),&value)!=0||value.st_size<0)throw std::runtime_error("Cannot measure resource");
    return static_cast<uint64_t>(value.st_size);
#endif
}
std::vector<uint8_t> read_file_bounded(const std::filesystem::path& path,uint64_t maximum){
    BufferedReadOnlyFile file(path);
    const auto size=file.full_size();
    if(size>maximum||size>=UINT32_MAX)throw std::runtime_error("Resource exceeds bounded stream size: "+path.u8string());
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(size));
    if(file.read(bytes.data(),static_cast<uint32_t>(size))!=size)throw std::runtime_error("Resource changed or read failed: "+path.u8string());
    return bytes;
}
BufferedReadOnlyFile::BufferedReadOnlyFile(const std::filesystem::path& path):file_(path){
    std::memcpy(record_.data(),file_.record_.data(),file_.record_.size());
}
uint32_t BufferedReadOnlyFile::read(void* output,uint32_t count){return fs15_buffered_file_read(record_.data(),record_.size(),output,count,count,&file_.services_);}
uint32_t BufferedReadOnlyFile::seek(uint32_t offset,int origin){return fs15_buffered_file_seek(record_.data(),record_.size(),offset,origin,&file_.services_);}
uint32_t BufferedReadOnlyFile::status() const{return fs15_buffered_file_status(record_.data(),record_.size());}
std::string read_file_string_bounded(const std::filesystem::path& path,uint64_t maximum){
    const auto bytes=read_file_bounded(path,maximum);ReadOnlyMemoryFile view(bytes.data(),bytes.size());
    std::string result(bytes.size(),'\0');
    if(view.read(result.data(),result.size(),static_cast<uint32_t>(result.size()))!=result.size())throw std::runtime_error("Memory resource read failed");
    return result;
}
```

```h
};
```

```h
#pragma once
#include "../core/memory_file.h"
#include <array>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cstring>
namespace fs15platform {
// Authored borrowed-storage initialization, not the original owning factory.
// The source storage must outlive this view; it is never released or modified.
class ReadOnlyMemoryFile {
public:
    ReadOnlyMemoryFile(const void* source,size_t bytes):capacity_(bytes){
        if(bytes>UINT32_MAX||(!source&&bytes))throw std::runtime_error("Invalid memory-file extent");
        const uint64_t pointer=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(source?source:&empty_);
        const auto length=static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes);
        std::memcpy(record_.data()+8,&pointer,8);std::memcpy(record_.data()+0x14,&length,4);
    }
    uint32_t read(void* destination,size_t capacity,uint32_t count){return fs15_memory_file_read(record_.data(),record_.size(),capacity_,destination,capacity,count);}
    bool seek(uint32_t offset){return fs15_memory_file_seek(record_.data(),record_.size(),offset)!=0;}
    uint32_t size()const{return fs15_memory_file_size(record_.data(),record_.size());}
    uint32_t tell()const{return fs15_memory_file_tell(record_.data(),record_.size());}
    bool eof()const{return fs15_memory_file_eof(record_.data(),record_.size())!=0;}
    bool valid()const{return fs15_memory_file_valid(record_.data(),record_.size())!=0;}
    ReadOnlyMemoryFile(const ReadOnlyMemoryFile&)=delete;
    ReadOnlyMemoryFile& operator=(const ReadOnlyMemoryFile&)=delete;
private:
    std::array<unsigned char,0x20> record_{};
    unsigned char empty_=0;
    size_t capacity_;
};
```

```cpp
#include "physics_worker.h"
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
namespace fs15::platform {
void PhysicsWorker::Event::signal(){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);signaled=true;condition.notify_one();}
bool PhysicsWorker::Event::wait(bool bounded){
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
    // Idle request waits retain native INFINITE behavior. Only a submitting
    // caller's completion wait has an authored failure watchdog.
    if(bounded){if(!condition.wait_for(lock,std::chrono::seconds(10),[this]{return signaled;}))return false;}
    else condition.wait(lock,[this]{return signaled;});
    signaled=false;return true;
}
PhysicsWorker::PhysicsWorker(uintptr_t scene,float step,uint32_t iterations,const FS15PhysicsDispatchServices& backend,const PostBackend* post):backend_(backend),services_{this,simulate,world,collect,wait,signal}{
    if(!backend.simulate||!backend.world||!backend.collect||!std::isfinite(step)||step<=0||!iterations)throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid physics worker backend/settings");
    state_.scene=scene;state_.fixed_step=step;state_.iterations=iterations;state_.active=1;state_.asynchronous=1;
    state_.request_event=1;state_.completion_event=2;
    for(auto* head:{&empty_objects_,&empty_wheels_}){head->left=head->right=head->parent=head;head->nil=1;}
    auto* object_head=&empty_objects_;auto* wheel_head=&empty_wheels_;
    std::memcpy(reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&state_)+0x3a8,&object_head,sizeof(object_head));
    std::memcpy(reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&state_)+0x250,&wheel_head,sizeof(wheel_head));
    if(post)post_backend_=post->services;
    if(bool(post_backend_.allocate)!=bool(post_backend_.release))throw std::invalid_argument("Physics post-step allocator must have matching release");
    post_services_={this,wait,object,frame,arctangent,allocate,release,observer,pending,cancel,post_backend_.part_limit,nullptr,nullptr,post_backend_.contact_row_limit};
    if(post&&post->configure&&!post->configure(post_backend_.user,&state_))throw std::invalid_argument("Physics post-step configuration failed");
    uintptr_t listener_begin=0,listener_end=0;
    std::memcpy(&listener_begin,reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&state_)+0x198,sizeof(listener_begin));
    std::memcpy(&listener_end,reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&state_)+0x1a0,sizeof(listener_end));
    if(listener_begin!=listener_end&&!post_backend_.observer)throw std::invalid_argument("Physics contact listeners require an observer service");
    thread_=std::thread([this]{result_=fs15_physics_worker(&state_,sizeof(state_),&stop_,&services_);completion_.signal();});
}
PhysicsWorker::~PhysicsWorker(){stop();while(!post_allocations_.empty())release(this,post_allocations_.back());}
int PhysicsWorker::simulate(void* p,uintptr_t scene,float seconds,uint32_t iterations,float step){auto& self=*static_cast<PhysicsWorker*>(p);return self.backend_.simulate(self.backend_.user,scene,seconds,iterations,step);}
uintptr_t PhysicsWorker::world(void* p,uintptr_t scene){auto& self=*static_cast<PhysicsWorker*>(p);return self.backend_.world(self.backend_.user,scene);}
int PhysicsWorker::collect(void* p,void* observations,uintptr_t world_token){auto& self=*static_cast<PhysicsWorker*>(p);return self.backend_.collect(self.backend_.user,observations,world_token);}
uint32_t PhysicsWorker::wait(void* p,uintptr_t token,uint32_t timeout,uint8_t alertable){auto& self=*static_cast<PhysicsWorker*>(p);if(timeout!=UINT32_MAX||alertable)return UINT32_MAX;if(token==1)return self.request_.wait(false)?0:UINT32_MAX;if(token==2)return self.completion_.wait()&&self.result_==-1?0:UINT32_MAX;return UINT32_MAX;}
int PhysicsWorker::signal(void* p,uintptr_t token){auto& self=*static_cast<PhysicsWorker*>(p);if(token==1)self.request_.signal();else if(token==2)self.completion_.signal();else return 0;return 1;}
bool PhysicsWorker::tick(float milliseconds){
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(control_);
    if(stop_||failed_||result_!=-1||!std::isfinite(milliseconds))return false;
    if(!fs15_physics_dispatch(&state_,sizeof(state_),milliseconds,&services_))return false;
    if(!state_.busy)return true;
    if(!fs15_physics_post_step(&state_,sizeof(state_),&post_services_)){failed_=true;return false;}
    ++completed_;return true;
}
bool PhysicsWorker::stop(){
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(control_);
    if(!thread_.joinable())return result_==1;
    stop_=1;request_.signal();thread_.join();return result_==1;
}
int PhysicsWorker::object(void* p,uintptr_t token){auto& self=*static_cast<PhysicsWorker*>(p);return self.post_backend_.object&&self.post_backend_.object(self.post_backend_.user,token);}
```

`src/platform/physics_worker.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "physics_dispatch.h"
#include "physics_post.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
namespace fs15::platform {
/* Authored event/thread transport. Native dispatch/worker control flow stays
 * in the recovered core. Backends outlive this object; no solver is supplied.
 * Calls are serialized. tick waits for completion; callback reentry forbidden.
 * Completion runs the recovered post-step finalizer. */
class PhysicsWorker {
public:
    struct PostBackend {FS15PhysicsPostServices services;int (*configure)(void*,FS15PhysicsDispatchState*);};
    PhysicsWorker(uintptr_t scene,float fixed_step,uint32_t iterations,const FS15PhysicsDispatchServices& backend,const PostBackend* post=nullptr);
    ~PhysicsWorker();
    PhysicsWorker(const PhysicsWorker&)=delete;
    PhysicsWorker& operator=(const PhysicsWorker&)=delete;
    bool tick(float milliseconds);
    bool stop();
    unsigned completed() const noexcept{return completed_.load();}
private:
    struct Event {
        std::mutex mutex;std::condition_variable condition;bool signaled=false;
        void signal();bool wait(bool bounded=true);
    } request_,completion_;
    FS15PhysicsDispatchState state_{};FS15PhysicsDispatchServices backend_,services_;
    FS15PhysicsTreeNode empty_objects_{},empty_wheels_{};
    FS15PhysicsPostServices post_backend_{},post_services_{};
    std::vector<void*> post_allocations_;
    uint8_t stop_=0;bool failed_=false;std::thread thread_;std::mutex control_;std::atomic<int> result_{-1};std::atomic<unsigned> completed_{0};
    static int simulate(void*,uintptr_t,float,uint32_t,float);
    static uintptr_t world(void*,uintptr_t);
    static int collect(void*,void*,uintptr_t);
    static uint32_t wait(void*,uintptr_t,uint32_t,uint8_t);
    static int signal(void*,uintptr_t);
    static int object(void*,uintptr_t);
    static int frame(void*,const void*,int32_t,float*);
    static float arctangent(void*,float);
    static void* allocate(void*,size_t,size_t);
    static void release(void*,void*);
    static int observer(void*,uintptr_t,uintptr_t,uintptr_t,uintptr_t,uint32_t,uint32_t);
    static int pending(void*,uintptr_t,uint32_t,float,uint8_t*);
    static int cancel(void*,void*,uint32_t);
};
}
```

```cs
// Authored compatibility adapter: apply the upstream cipher to the requested
// byte range only. Modern BinaryReader may use a buffer larger than its read.
using System;
using System.IO;
namespace I3DShapesTool.Lib.Container {
public sealed class CipherStream : Stream {
    readonly Stream source; readonly ICipher cipher; ulong block;
    public CipherStream(Stream input,ICipher decoder){source=input;cipher=decoder;}
    public override bool CanRead=>source.CanRead;
    public override bool CanSeek=>false;
    public override bool CanWrite=>source.CanWrite;
    public override long Length=>source.Length;
    public override long Position{get=>source.Position;set=>source.Position=value;}
    public override void Flush()=>source.Flush();
    public override int Read(byte[] buffer,int offset,int count){
        var data=new byte[count]; int n=0;
        while(n<count){int got=source.Read(data,n,count-n);if(got==0)throw new EndOfStreamException();n+=got;}
        block=cipher.Process(data,block);Array.Copy(data,0,buffer,offset,count);return count;
    }
    public override void Write(byte[] buffer,int offset,int count){var data=new byte[count];Array.Copy(buffer,offset,data,0,count);block=cipher.Process(data,block);source.Write(data,0,count);}
    public override long Seek(long offset,SeekOrigin origin)=>throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override void SetLength(long value)=>throw new NotSupportedException();
}
}
```
