```cs
// Local resource bridge. The MIT-licensed I3DShapesTool library decodes the
// original GIANTS binary meshes; no replacement buildings or trees are made.
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using I3DShapesTool.Lib.Model;
using I3DShapesTool.Lib.Container;
using System.Buffers.Binary;

if(args.Length==2 && args[0]=="--cipher-fixtures") {
    var cases=new System.Collections.Generic.List<object>();
    foreach(byte seed in new byte[]{0,80,210,255})foreach(ulong block in new ulong[]{0,1,0xffffffff,0x100000000})foreach(int length in new[]{1,4,63,64,65,128,257,4096}){
        byte[] input=Enumerable.Range(0,length).Select(i=>(byte)((i*37+11)&255)).ToArray(), decoded=(byte[])input.Clone();
        ulong next=new I3DCipher(seed).Process(decoded,block);
        cases.Add(new{seed,block,length,input=Convert.ToHexString(input),output=Convert.ToHexString(decoded),next});
    }
    File.WriteAllText(args[1],JsonSerializer.Serialize(cases));return;
}
if (args.Length != 2) throw new ArgumentException("FS15ShapeBridge INPUT.i3d.shapes OUTPUT.meshes");
var shapes = new ShapesFile();
using (var source = File.OpenRead(args[0])) {
    var header=FileHeader.Read(source);
    if(header.Version!=3)throw new InvalidDataException("This FS15 bridge is validated only for shape container version 3");
    source.Position=0; shapes.Load(source, strict: true);
}
var meshes = shapes.Shapes.ToArray();
using (var output = new BinaryWriter(File.Create(args[1]))) {
    output.Write(new byte[]{(byte)'F',(byte)'S',(byte)'1',(byte)'5',(byte)'M',(byte)'S',(byte)'H',1});
    output.Write(meshes.Length);
    foreach (var mesh in meshes) {
        output.Write(mesh.Id); output.Write(mesh.Positions.Length); output.Write(mesh.Triangles.Length * 3);
        output.Write(mesh.Subsets.Length);
        foreach (var subset in mesh.Subsets) { output.Write(subset.FirstIndex); output.Write(subset.NumIndices); }
        for (int i=0; i<mesh.Positions.Length; ++i) {
            var p=mesh.Positions[i]; var n=mesh.Normals?[i]; var uv=mesh.UVSets[0]?[i];
            output.Write((float)p.X); output.Write((float)p.Y); output.Write((float)p.Z);
            output.Write((float)(n?.X ?? 0)); output.Write((float)(n?.Y ?? 1)); output.Write((float)(n?.Z ?? 0));
            output.Write((float)(uv?.U ?? 0)); output.Write((float)(uv?.V ?? 0));
        }
        foreach (var triangle in mesh.Triangles) { output.Write(triangle.P1Idx-1); output.Write(triangle.P2Idx-1); output.Write(triangle.P3Idx-1); }
    }
}
Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new {
    inputVersion=shapes.Version, inputSeed=shapes.Seed,
    parts=shapes.Parts.Length, meshes=meshes.Length,
    vertices=meshes.Sum(m=>(long)m.Positions.Length), triangles=meshes.Sum(m=>(long)m.Triangles.Length),
    skinned=meshes.Count(m=>m.BlendIndices!=null),
    samples=meshes.Take(8).Select(m=>new {m.Id,m.Name,vertices=m.Positions.Length,triangles=m.Triangles.Length})
},new JsonSerializerOptions{WriteIndented=true}));
```

```cs
using System.ComponentModel;

namespace FS15Reconstruction;

// Managed selection control keeps the dark theme consistent in the window,
// keyboard navigation and WinForms layout captures. Choices remain ordinary
// accessible menu items when the popup is open.
internal sealed class LauncherChoice : Control
{
    private int selectedIndex = -1;
    private ContextMenuStrip? popup;
    [DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)] internal List<string> Items { get; } = [];
    [DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
    internal int SelectedIndex
    {
        get => selectedIndex;
        set
        {
            if (value < -1 || value >= Items.Count) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value));
            if (selectedIndex == value) return;
            selectedIndex = value; Text = value >= 0 ? Items[value] : ""; Invalidate(); SelectedIndexChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
            AccessibilityNotifyClients(AccessibleEvents.ValueChange, -1);
        }
    }
    internal event EventHandler? SelectedIndexChanged;
    internal LauncherChoice()
    {
        SetStyle(ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer | ControlStyles.Selectable, true);
        TabStop = true; Height = 34; Cursor = Cursors.Hand; AccessibleRole = AccessibleRole.ComboBox;
        BackColor = LauncherTheme.Surface; ForeColor = LauncherTheme.Text;
    }
    protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
    {
        e.Graphics.Clear(BackColor);
        float unit = DeviceDpi / 96f;
        using var border = new Pen(Focused ? LauncherTheme.Green : LauncherTheme.Border);
        e.Graphics.DrawRectangle(border, 0, 0, Width - 1, Height - 1);
        var rect = new Rectangle((int)(12 * unit), 0, Math.Max(0, Width - (int)(38 * unit)), Height);
        TextRenderer.DrawText(e.Graphics, Text, Font, rect, Enabled ? ForeColor : LauncherTheme.Muted,
            TextFormatFlags.Left | TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter | TextFormatFlags.EndEllipsis | TextFormatFlags.NoPrefix);
        float x = Width - 17 * unit, y = Height / 2f;
        using var arrow = new Pen(Enabled ? LauncherTheme.Text : LauncherTheme.Muted, 1.5f * unit);
        e.Graphics.DrawLines(arrow, [new PointF(x - 4 * unit, y - 2 * unit), new PointF(x, y + 2 * unit), new PointF(x + 4 * unit, y - 2 * unit)]);
    }
    protected override void OnGotFocus(EventArgs e) { Invalidate(); base.OnGotFocus(e); }
    protected override void OnLostFocus(EventArgs e) { Invalidate(); base.OnLostFocus(e); }
    protected override void OnEnabledChanged(EventArgs e) { if (!Enabled) popup?.Close(); Invalidate(); base.OnEnabledChanged(e); }
    protected override void OnClick(EventArgs e) { base.OnClick(e); Focus(); ShowChoices(); }
    private void ShowChoices()
    {
        if (!Enabled || Items.Count == 0) return;
        popup?.Dispose(); popup = new ContextMenuStrip { BackColor = LauncherTheme.Surface, ForeColor = LauncherTheme.Text,
            ShowImageMargin = false, ShowCheckMargin = false, Font = Font, Renderer = new ChoiceRenderer(), AutoSize = false, Width = Width };
        int height = (int)(36 * DeviceDpi / 96f); popup.Height = Items.Count * height + 6;
        for (int i = 0; i < Items.Count; i++)
        {
            int index = i; var item = new ToolStripMenuItem(Items[i]) { AutoSize = false, Height = height, Width = Width - 6, ForeColor = LauncherTheme.Text };
            item.Click += (_, _) => { SelectedIndex = index; Focus(); }; popup.Items.Add(item);
        }
        ContextMenuStrip = popup;
        popup.Show(this, new Point(0, Height)); if (selectedIndex >= 0) popup.Items[selectedIndex].Select();
    }
    protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData) => (keyData & Keys.KeyCode) is Keys.Up or Keys.Down or Keys.Home or Keys.End || base.IsInputKey(keyData);
    protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
    {
        if ((e.Alt && e.KeyCode == Keys.Down) || e.KeyCode is Keys.Space or Keys.Enter) { ShowChoices(); e.Handled = e.SuppressKeyPress = true; }
        else if (Items.Count > 0 && e.KeyCode is Keys.Up or Keys.Down or Keys.Home or Keys.End)
        {
            SelectedIndex = e.KeyCode switch { Keys.Up => Math.Max(0, selectedIndex - 1), Keys.Down => Math.Min(Items.Count - 1, selectedIndex + 1), Keys.Home => 0, _ => Items.Count - 1 };
            e.Handled = e.SuppressKeyPress = true;
        }
        base.OnKeyDown(e);
    }
    protected override AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance() => new ChoiceAccessible(this);
    private sealed class ChoiceAccessible(LauncherChoice owner) : ControlAccessibleObject(owner)
    {
```

```cs
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;

namespace FS15Reconstruction;

internal static class LauncherTheme
{
    internal static readonly Color Background = Color.FromArgb(20, 22, 24), Sidebar = Color.FromArgb(29, 31, 33),
        Surface = Color.FromArgb(37, 40, 43), Border = Color.FromArgb(57, 61, 63),
        Text = Color.FromArgb(244, 245, 242), Muted = Color.FromArgb(165, 174, 170), Green = Color.FromArgb(93, 174, 61);

    internal static Image? Scene(string name)
    {
        using var stream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream("FS15.Scene." + name);
        if (stream == null) return null;
        using var original = Image.FromStream(stream); return new Bitmap(original);
    }

    internal static void Cover(Graphics graphics, Image image, Rectangle bounds)
    {
        float scale = Math.Max(bounds.Width / (float)image.Width, bounds.Height / (float)image.Height);
        float width = bounds.Width / scale, height = bounds.Height / scale;
        graphics.DrawImage(image, bounds, (image.Width - width) / 2, (image.Height - height) / 2, width, height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace FS15Reconstruction;

internal sealed partial class LauncherForm : Form
{
    private void BrowseFolder(TextBox field)
    { using var dialog = new FolderBrowserDialog { Description = "Select your Farming Simulator 15 installation", UseDescriptionForTitle = true }; if (Directory.Exists(field.Text)) dialog.InitialDirectory = field.Text; if (dialog.ShowDialog(this) == DialogResult.OK) { field.Text = dialog.SelectedPath; SaveSettings(); } }
    private void BrowseExe(TextBox field)
    { using var dialog = new OpenFileDialog { Filter = "Executable (*.exe)|*.exe" }; if (dialog.ShowDialog(this) == DialogResult.OK) field.Text = dialog.FileName; }
    private void LoadSettings()
    {
        Settings settings = new();
        try { if (File.Exists(settingsPath)) settings = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Settings>(File.ReadAllText(settingsPath)) ?? settings; } catch (Exception error) when (error is IOException or JsonException) { Append("Settings: " + error.Message); }
        game.Text = settings.GameDirectory.Length > 0 ? settings.GameDirectory : Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("FS15_GAME_DIR") ?? "";
        string bundled = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.UserProfile), ".cache", "codex-runtimes", "codex-primary-runtime", "dependencies", "python", "python.exe");
        python.Text = settings.Python.Length > 0 ? settings.Python : File.Exists(bundled) ? bundled : "python.exe"; steam.Text = settings.Steam;
        mode.SelectedIndex = Math.Clamp(settings.Mode, 0, 2); transport.SelectedIndex = Math.Clamp(settings.Transport, 0, 3); map.SelectedIndex = Math.Clamp(settings.Map, 0, 1); difficulty.SelectedIndex = Math.Clamp(settings.Difficulty, 0, 2);
    }
    private void SaveSettings()
    {
        try { Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(settingsPath)!); File.WriteAllText(settingsPath, JsonSerializer.Serialize(new Settings { GameDirectory = game.Text, Python = python.Text, Steam = steam.Text, Mode = mode.SelectedIndex, Transport = transport.SelectedIndex, Map = map.SelectedIndex, Difficulty = difficulty.SelectedIndex }, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true })); }
        catch (IOException error) { Append("Cannot save settings: " + error.Message); }
    }
    private void UpdateMode()
    {
        bool home = mode.SelectedIndex == 1; transport.Enabled = steam.Enabled = !busy && !home; map.Enabled = difficulty.Enabled = !busy && home;
        description.Text = home ? "Experimental gameplay · local assets" : mode.SelectedIndex == 0 ? "Original GE6 + recovered helpers" : "Original GE6 · comparison baseline";
        if (!home && transport.SelectedIndex == 3) description.Text = "Local GE6 · Steam services / licensed DLC unavailable";
        nativeCard.Selected = !home; homeCard.Selected = home; nativeCard.Invalidate(); homeCard.Invalidate();
    }
    private void Append(string line)
    {
        if (IsDisposed) return; if (InvokeRequired) { BeginInvoke(() => Append(line)); return; }
        if (line.StartsWith("LAUNCHER_EVENT ", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            try { using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(line[15..]); HandleEvent(document.RootElement); } catch (JsonException) { }
        }
        if (output.TextLength > 150000) output.Text = output.Text[^100000..];
        output.AppendText(line + Environment.NewLine); output.SelectionStart = output.TextLength; output.ScrollToCaret();
    }
    private void HandleEvent(JsonElement data)
    {
        string? kind = data.GetProperty("event").GetString();
        if (data.TryGetProperty("percent", out var percent)) progress.Value = Math.Clamp(percent.GetInt32(), 0, 100);
        if (data.TryGetProperty("title", out var title)) status.Text = title.GetString();
        if (kind == "installations")
        {
            var paths = data.GetProperty("paths").EnumerateArray().Select(p => p.GetString()!).ToArray();
            if (paths.Length > 0) { game.Text = paths.Contains(game.Text) ? game.Text : paths[0]; SaveSettings(); status.Text = paths.Length == 1 ? "FS15 installation detected." : "Multiple installations found. First selected; use Browse to choose another."; }
            else status.Text = "FS15 installation not found. Select it using Browse.";
        }
        if (kind is "resources" or "complete")
        {
            bool present = data.GetProperty("assets_present").GetBoolean();
            libraryStatus.Text = present ? "Resources found on this PC" : "Resource setup needed";
            resources.Text = present ? "LOCAL RESOURCES FOUND\n\nYour maps, textures, recovered scripts and starting fleets are available.\n\n" + (data.GetProperty("host_built").GetBoolean() ? "ReFarm is built and available in your launch profiles." : "Build ReFarm using scripts/build.ps1 to enable its launch profile.") + "\n\nUse Prepare / repair to check source files and rebuild the local caches."
                : "PREPARATION REQUIRED\n\n" + string.Join("\n", data.GetProperty("missing").EnumerateArray().Take(8).Select(v => "• " + v.GetString())) + "\n\nSelect your installation, then choose Prepare / repair assets.";
            if (data.TryGetProperty("preparation_incomplete", out var unfinished) && unfinished.GetBoolean())
                resources.Text = "PREPARATION INTERRUPTED OR FAILED\n\nRun Prepare / repair assets to repair unfinished caches. ReFarm startup is blocked until preparation completes.\n\n" + resources.Text;
        }
    }
    private async Task<int> Worker(string script, IEnumerable<string> args)
    {
        var start = new ProcessStartInfo(python.Text.Trim()) { WorkingDirectory = root, UseShellExecute = false, CreateNoWindow = true, RedirectStandardOutput = true, RedirectStandardError = true, StandardOutputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, StandardErrorEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8 };
        start.Environment["PYTHONUTF8"] = "1"; start.ArgumentList.Add("-u"); start.ArgumentList.Add(Path.Combine(root, "scripts", script)); foreach (string arg in args) start.ArgumentList.Add(arg);
        using var child = new Process { StartInfo = start }; worker = child;
        try
        {
            child.Start();
            async Task Pump(StreamReader stream) { while (await stream.ReadLineAsync() is { } line) Append(line); }
            var stdout = Pump(child.StandardOutput); var stderr = Pump(child.StandardError);
            await child.WaitForExitAsync(); await Task.WhenAll(stdout, stderr); return child.ExitCode;
        }
        finally { worker = null; }
    }
    private async Task Operation(string title, Func<Task<int>> action, string success)
    {
        if (busy) return; busy = true; cancelled = false; progress.Value = 0; status.Text = title;
        foreach (var button in actions) button.Enabled = false; foreach (var control in configuration) control.Enabled = false; cancel.Enabled = true;
        try { int code = await action(); status.Text = cancelled ? "Operation cancelled. Run preparation again to repair unfinished caches." : code == 0 ? success : "Operation failed. Inspect the log below for the missing input or failed step."; if (code == 0) progress.Value = 100; }
        catch (Exception error) { Append(error.Message); status.Text = "Operation failed. Check paths and the log below."; }
        finally { busy = false; foreach (var button in actions) button.Enabled = true; foreach (var control in configuration) control.Enabled = true; cancel.Enabled = false; UpdateMode(); RefreshEvidence(); if (closing) Close(); }
    }
    private void CancelWorker()
    { cancelled = true; try { if (worker is { HasExited: false }) worker.Kill(entireProcessTree: true); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { } status.Text = "Cancelling local operation..."; }
    private Task Detect() => Operation("Looking for FS15 installations...", () => Worker("launcher_assets.py", ["detect"]), "Installation search complete.");
    private Task CheckResources() => Operation("Checking local resources...", () => Worker("launcher_assets.py", ["status"]), "Resource preflight complete.");
    private Task PrepareAssets()
    {
        SaveSettings(); return Operation("Preparing original resources...", () => Worker("launcher_assets.py", ["prepare", "--game-dir", game.Text.Trim()]), "Resources prepared and recorded locally. You can now check the launch plan.");
    }
    private Task PrepareLocal()
    {
        SaveSettings(); return Operation("Preparing the local GE6 runtime...", () => Worker("prepare_local_engine.py", ["--game-dir", game.Text.Trim(), "--activate-recovered"]), "Local GE6 prepared. Select Local GE6 (experimental) under Native startup.");
    }
    private Task Run(bool dryRun)
    {
        SaveSettings(); var args = new List<string> { "--mode", new[] { "hybrid", "refarm", "ge6" }[mode.SelectedIndex], "--transport", new[] { "auto", "direct", "steam", "local" }[transport.SelectedIndex], "--map", map.SelectedIndex == 0 ? "Map01" : "Map02", "--difficulty", (difficulty.SelectedIndex + 1).ToString() };
        if (game.Text.Trim().Length > 0) args.AddRange(["--game-dir", game.Text.Trim()]); if (steam.Text.Trim().Length > 0) args.AddRange(["--steam", steam.Text.Trim()]); if (dryRun) args.Add("--dry-run");
        return Operation(dryRun ? "Checking launch configuration..." : "Starting runtime...", () => Worker("unified_launcher.py", args), dryRun ? "Launch plan checked. No game process started." : "Runtime started. Inspect its window and session evidence.");
    }
    private Task Verify() => Operation("Checking native log evidence...", () => Worker("verify_native_engine.py", transport.SelectedIndex == 3 ? ["--local"] : []), "Native log evidence verified. Visual gameplay checks remain separate.");
    private void OpenLogs()
    { string path = mode.SelectedIndex == 1 ? Path.Combine(root, "logs") : Path.Combine(root, "build", transport.SelectedIndex == 3 ? "ge6-local" : "native-engine", "profile"); Directory.CreateDirectory(path); Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo("explorer.exe", path) { UseShellExecute = true }); }
    private void RefreshEvidence()
    {
        try
        {
            using var report = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, "analysis", transport.SelectedIndex == 3 ? "local-engine-script-validation.json" : "native-engine-validation.json"))); var data = report.RootElement;
            evidence.Text = (transport.SelectedIndex == 3 ? "SAVED LOCAL GE6 CHECKS" : "SAVED SESSION CHECKS") + "  ·  GE6 boot: " + (data.GetProperty("native_boot_verified").GetBoolean() ? "recorded" : "pending") + "  ·  Recovered source: " + (data.GetProperty("recovered_script_execution_verified").GetBoolean() ? "104 comparisons passed" : "pending") + "\n\n" + (data.TryGetProperty("hybrid_runtime_verified", out var h) && h.GetBoolean() ? "Three recovered wheel helpers were used in a recorded native session." : "Native helper integration is pending verification.") + "\nSaved checks describe earlier sessions. Complete GE6 reconstruction remains in progress.";
        }
        catch (Exception error) when (error is IOException or JsonException or KeyNotFoundException) { evidence.Text = "No saved native session evidence. Start a career inside GE6, then verify the session."; }
    }
    internal async Task SmokeAsync(string path, bool prepare)
    {
        // Real WinForms layouts. Game startup is deliberately excluded here.
        while (busy) await Task.Delay(50);
        await Detect(); await CheckResources();
        if (prepare) { await PrepareAssets(); preparedInSmoke = progress.Value == 100; }
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);

        {
            SelectPage(page); await Task.Delay(100); PerformLayout(); Refresh();

        }

        map.SelectedIndex = 1; await Capture(Suffix("-home"), 0);
        nativeCard.PerformClick(); bool nativeSelection = mode.SelectedIndex == 0 && !map.Enabled && !difficulty.Enabled && transport.Enabled;
        var originalSize = ClientSize; ClientSize = new Size(1100, 760); await Capture(Suffix("-compact"), 0); ClientSize = originalSize;
        mode.SelectedIndex = 2; bool baselineAvailable = !map.Enabled && transport.Enabled;
        transport.SelectedIndex = 3; bool localTransport = transport.Text == "Local GE6 (experimental)" && transport.Enabled;
        await Capture(Suffix("-local-settings"), 2); SelectPage(0);

            choices.Items[0].PerformClick(); popupSelection &= mode.SelectedIndex == 0; choices.Close();

        bool verified = homeSelection && nativeSelection && baselineAvailable && visualAssets && keyboardSelection && accessibleSelection && popupSelection && localTransport;

            installation_found = game.Text.Length > 0, asset_status_displayed = resources.Text.Contains("LOCAL RESOURCES FOUND"),
            preparation_requested = prepare, preparation_succeeded = preparedInSmoke, game_launched = false, size = new { Width, Height } }, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
```

`src/unified_launcher/Program.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace FS15Reconstruction;

internal sealed class Settings
{
    public string GameDirectory { get; set; } = "";
    public string Python { get; set; } = "";
    public string Steam { get; set; } = "";
    public int Mode { get; set; }
    public int Transport { get; set; }
    public int Map { get; set; }
    public int Difficulty { get; set; }
}
internal static class Program
{
    [STAThread]
    private static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        ApplicationConfiguration.Initialize();
        try
        {
            string? root = null;
            int rootIndex = Array.IndexOf(args, "--root");
            if (rootIndex >= 0 && rootIndex + 1 < args.Length) root = Path.GetFullPath(args[rootIndex + 1]);
            for (var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory); root == null && dir != null; dir = dir.Parent)
                if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "scripts", "unified_launcher.py"))) root = dir.FullName;
            if (root == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Keep the launcher inside the reconstruction workspace, or pass --root PATH.");
            var form = new LauncherForm(root);
            int smokeIndex = Array.IndexOf(args, "--smoke-capture");
            if (smokeIndex >= 0 && smokeIndex + 1 < args.Length)
                form.Shown += async (_, _) => await form.SmokeAsync(Path.GetFullPath(args[smokeIndex + 1]), args.Contains("--smoke-prepare"));
            Application.Run(form);
        }
        catch (Exception error) { MessageBox.Show(error.Message, "FS15 Reconstruction", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error); }
    }
}
```

```cpp
// Asset-free invariants, separate from comparisons with original machine code.
#include "animation.h"
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace {
void require(bool ok,const char* message){if(!ok)throw std::runtime_error(message);}
void word(float& f,uint32_t v){std::memcpy(&f,&v,4);}
template<class T,size_t N>FS15SceneVector view(std::array<T,N>& a) {
    const auto p=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(a.data());return {p,p+sizeof(a),p+sizeof(a)};
}
struct Key {FS15AnimationKey header;float translation[3];int16_t xyzw[4];float scale[3];};
struct Host {
    unsigned refreshed=0,matrices=0,transforms=0,visibility=0;
    static int refresh(void* p,FS15SceneStateRecord* n){++static_cast<Host*>(p)->refreshed;n->flags&=~0x80u;return 1;}
    static int matrix(void* p,FS15SceneStateRecord* n,const float* m){++static_cast<Host*>(p)->matrices;std::memcpy(n->local,m,64);n->flags|=0x80u;return 1;}
    static int propagate(void* p,FS15SceneStateRecord*,uint32_t mask,int32_t origin) {
        auto& h=*static_cast<Host*>(p);if(origin)return 0;if(mask==1)++h.transforms;else if(mask==2)++h.visibility;else return 0;return 1;
    }
};
void run() {
    std::array<uint32_t,512> seeds{};require(fs15_animation_rsqrt_table(seeds.data(),seeds.size())&&seeds[256]==0x7f8000u,"Recovered rsqrt boundary seed");
    float zero[4]{};require(fs15_animation_normalize(zero,4)&&zero[0]==0,"Zero quaternion preserves native zero result");
    float q[4]={2,0,0,0};require(fs15_animation_normalize(q,4)&&q[0]==1,"Native normalization");
    float a[4]={1,0,0,0},b[4]={-1,0,0,0};
    require(fs15_animation_nlerp(a,b,0.5f,q,4)&&q[0]==1,"Antipodal shortest path");
    const std::array<float,4> saved={q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3]};
    require(!fs15_animation_nlerp(a,b,std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity(),q,4)&&!std::memcmp(q,saved.data(),16),"Nonfinite interpolation rejects without output writes");
    Key first{{1,0x8000,12,20},{0,0,0},{0,0,0,32767},{1,1,1}};
    Key last{{3,0,12,20},{10,20,30},{0,0,0,32767},{2,3,4}};
    std::array<const FS15AnimationKey*,2> keys={&first.header,&last.header};
    FS15AnimationChannel channel{};channel.flags=15;channel.keys=view(keys);channel.index_scale=32;channel.last_time=3;
    for(auto& i:channel.lookup)i=1;
    std::array<FS15AnimationChannel*,1> channels={&channel};FS15AnimationClip clip{};clip.duration=4;clip.channels=view(channels);
    require(fs15_animation_sample(&clip,4,1)&&channel.first==&last.header&&channel.second==&first.header&&channel.weights[0]==0.5f,"Exact duration endpoint uses loop seam");
    require(fs15_animation_sample(&clip,-0.5f,1)&&channel.weights[0]==0.75f,"Negative looping time");
    require(fs15_animation_sample(&clip,9,1)&&channel.first==&first.header&&channel.weights[0]==1,"Positive time wraps");
    require(fs15_animation_sample(&clip,2,0)&&channel.weights[0]==0.5f,"Middle key bracket");
    last.header.flags=0x10;require(fs15_animation_sample(&clip,2.5f,0)&&channel.weights[0]==0.15625f&&channel.weights[1]==0.25f,"Per-component easing bits");last.header.flags=0;
    const auto snapshot=channel;channel.lookup[32]=0;
    require(!fs15_animation_sample(&clip,2,0)&&channel.first==snapshot.first&&channel.weights[0]==snapshot.weights[0],"Invalid lookup rejected before sample commit");channel.lookup[32]=1;
    FS15CharacterData data{};std::array<FS15AnimationClip*,1> clips={&clip};data.clips=view(clips);
    std::memcpy(clip.name,"walk",5);size_t size=4,cap=15;std::memcpy(clip.name+16,&size,8);std::memcpy(clip.name+24,&cap,8);
    FS15CharacterSet set{};set.data=&data;set.flags=0x0101;word(set.state[0],7);set.state[8]=1;set.state[16]=1;
    uint32_t found=9;require(fs15_animation_find_clip(&set,"walk",5,&found)&&found==0,"Short clip name");
    require(fs15_animation_find_clip(&set,"Walk",5,&found)&&found==UINT32_MAX,"Clip lookup is case sensitive");
    set.flags=1;set.state[12]=5;require(fs15_animation_set_time(&set,0,6)&&set.flags==1&&set.state[12]==6,"Dirty uses clamped values, stores raw time on loops too");
    require(fs15_animation_set_time(&set,0,2)&&set.flags==0x101,"In-range seek dirties pose");
    FS15SceneStateRecord node{};for(unsigned i=0;i<4;++i)node.local[i*5]=1;node.flags=1;
    std::array<FS15SceneStateRecord*,1> nodes={&node};set.transforms=view(nodes);
    std::array<float,3> translation={0,0,0},scale={1,1,1};std::array<uint32_t,1> visibility={1};
    data.translation=view(translation);data.scale=view(scale);data.visibility_words=view(visibility);data.visibility_count=1;
    Host host;FS15AnimationServices services{&host,Host::refresh,Host::matrix,Host::propagate};
    require(fs15_animation_update(&set,0,&services)&&node.local[12]==5&&node.local[13]==10&&node.local[14]==15,"Four-track update applies sampled translation");
    require(node.local[0]==1.5f&&node.local[5]==2&&node.local[10]==2.5f&&host.matrices==1&&host.transforms==1&&host.refreshed==0,"Quaternion basis plus scale");
    require(set.flags==1&&host.visibility==0,"Dirty cleared, unchanged visibility suppressed");
    require(fs15_animation_set_time(&set,0,3.5f)&&fs15_animation_update(&set,0,&services)&&host.visibility==1&&(node.flags&1u)==0,"Visibility uses first selected key");
    channel.flags=4;node.scale[0]=1.5f;node.scale[1]=2;node.scale[2]=2.5f;
    require(fs15_animation_set_time(&set,0,2)&&fs15_animation_update(&set,0,&services)&&host.refreshed==1,"Scale-only update refreshes cached TRS");
    channel.flags=1;word(set.state[0],3);word(set.state[1],3);
    set.state[8]=set.state[9]=0;set.state[16]=set.state[17]=0.5f;set.flags=0x101;
    set.state[12]=1;set.state[13]=3;
    require(fs15_animation_update(&set,0,&services)&&node.local[12]==10,"Shared clip selection uses last active track for both contributions");
    set.flags=0;const auto before=node;const float clock=set.state[12];
    require(fs15_animation_update(&set,1,&services)&&set.state[12]==clock&&!std::memcmp(&node,&before,sizeof(node)),"Disabled set does not advance clocks");
    require(!fs15_animation_set_weight(&set,4,1)&&!fs15_animation_set_time(&set,4,0),"Reject fifth track");
}
}
int main(){try{run();std::cout<<"Recovered animation invariants passed; full engine/skinning not tested.\n";return 0;}catch(const std::exception& e){std::cerr<<e.what()<<'\n';return 1;}}
```

`tests/animation_fixture.h`:

```h
#pragma once
// Shared allocator/scene fixture for resource-to-pose integration tests.
#include "animation_resources.h"
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace fs15_animation_test {
inline void require(bool ok,const char* message){if(!ok)throw std::runtime_error(message);}
struct Owner {
    std::map<void*,size_t> blocks;std::map<uint32_t,void*> registry;uint32_t id=0;int fail_after=-1;
    FS15SharedSceneContext context{};FS15SceneLifecycleServices memory{};
    FS15SceneStateRecord* node=nullptr;FS15CharacterSet* last=nullptr;unsigned diagnostic=0,groups=0;
    Owner() {
        memory={this,allocate,release,next,registered,unregistered,nullptr,nullptr,shared};
        node=static_cast<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(allocate(this,sizeof(FS15SceneStateRecord)));
        require(fs15_scene_construct(node,sizeof(*node),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,"node",5,0,1,&memory),"Construct resource fixture node");
    }
    ~Owner(){for(const auto& b:blocks)std::free(b.first);}
    static void* allocate(void* p,size_t size) {
        auto& o=*static_cast<Owner*>(p);if(o.fail_after==0)return nullptr;if(o.fail_after>0)--o.fail_after;
        void* block=std::malloc(size);if(block){std::memset(block,0xa5,size);o.blocks.emplace(block,size);}return block;
    }
    static void release(void* p,void* block){if(!block)return;auto& o=*static_cast<Owner*>(p);if(!o.blocks.erase(block))std::abort();std::free(block);}
    static uint32_t next(void* p){return ++static_cast<Owner*>(p)->id;}
    static void registered(void* p,uint32_t id,void* object){static_cast<Owner*>(p)->registry.emplace(id,object);}
    static void unregistered(void* p,uint32_t id,void*){static_cast<Owner*>(p)->registry.erase(id);}

    void cleanup() {
        // A group with no transform references is explicitly owned by the host.
        if(last) {
            uint32_t identifier;std::memcpy(&identifier,last->object_header+0x18,4);
            if(registry.count(identifier)&&last->references==0)

        require(blocks.empty(),"Resource loading owns no leaked buffers");last=nullptr;
    }
};

    uint8_t kind=FS15_SCENE_TRS_NODE;FS15SceneStateArena arena{};
    explicit PoseHost(FS15SceneStateRecord* node){arena={node,sizeof(*node),sizeof(*node),nullptr,0,nullptr,0,reinterpret_cast<FS15ScenePropertyView*>(node->properties),1,&kind,1,SIZE_MAX};}
```

```cpp
namespace {
void check(bool ok){if(!ok)throw std::runtime_error("Buffered file assertion failed");}
uint32_t get(const void* p,size_t offset){uint32_t n;std::memcpy(&n,static_cast<const char*>(p)+offset,4);return n;}

struct IO{std::vector<unsigned char> data;uint32_t position=0,reads=0,seeks=0;bool error=false;};
uint32_t read(void* user,uint64_t,void* output,uint32_t count,uint32_t* actual){
    auto& io=*static_cast<IO*>(user);++io.reads;if(io.error)return 6;
    *actual=io.position>=io.data.size()?0:static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<size_t>(count,io.data.size()-io.position));
    if(*actual)std::memcpy(output,io.data.data()+io.position,*actual);
    io.position+=*actual;return 0;
}
```

```py
"""Exercise the native-code loader with authored PE instructions, never game code."""
import argparse

def fixture(blocked=False):
    data = bytearray(0x1000)
    def put(offset, fmt, *values):
        struct.pack_into('<' + fmt, data, offset, *values)
    data[:2] = b'MZ'
    put(0x3c, 'I', 0x80)
    data[0x80:0x84] = b'PE\0\0'
    put(0x84, 'HHIIIHH', 0x8664, 3, 0, 0, 0, 240, 0x22)
    opt = 0x98
    put(opt, 'H', 0x20b)

    put(opt + 56, 'II', 0x4000, 0x400)
    put(opt + 108, 'I', 16)
    put(opt + 120, 'II', 0x2000, 40)
    for index, (name, rva, raw, size, flags) in enumerate((
            (b'.text', 0x1000, 0x400, 0x200, 0x60000020),
            (b'.rdata', 0x2000, 0x600, 0x600, 0x40000040),
            (b'.data', 0x3000, 0xc00, 0x400, 0xc0000040))):
        at = opt + 240 + index * 40
        data[at:at + 8] = name.ljust(8, b'\0')
        put(at + 8, 'IIII', 0x1000 if name == b'.data' else size, rva, size, raw)
        put(at + 36, 'I', flags)
    put(0x600, '5I', 0x2080, 0, 0, 0x2040, 0x2100)
    data[0x640:0x64d] = b'KERNEL32.dll\0'

def audio_fixture():
    """Authored Windows x64 instructions call real Linux OpenAL via the IAT."""
    data = fixture()
    data[0x640:0x650] = b'OpenAL32.dll\0'.ljust(16, b'\0')
    names = ('alcOpenDevice', 'alcCreateContext', 'alcMakeContextCurrent',
             'alListenerf', 'alGetListenerf', 'alGetError', 'alcDestroyContext', 'alcCloseDevice')
    data[0x680:0x700] = bytes(0x80)
    data[0x700:0x780] = bytes(0x80)
    for index, name in enumerate(names):
        for table in (0x680, 0x700):
            struct.pack_into('<Q', data, table + index * 8, 0x2200 + index * 64)
        at = 0x802 + index * 64
        encoded = name.encode() + b'\0'
        data[at:at + len(encoded)] = encoded
    code = bytearray(b'\x48\x83\xec\x28')
    def call(index):
        code.extend(b'\xff\x15' + struct.pack('<i', 0x2100 + index * 8 - (0x1000 + len(code) + 6)))
    def load_rcx(address):
        code.extend(b'\x48\xb9' + struct.pack('<Q', address) + b'\x48\x8b\x09')
    def save_rax(address):
        code.extend(b'\x48\xa3' + struct.pack('<Q', address))
    def nonnull():
        code.extend(b'\x48\x85\xc0\x75\x02\x0f\x0b')
    code += b'\x31\xc9'  # Linux default selected explicitly by test environment.
    call(0); nonnull(); save_rax(0x140003000)
    load_rcx(0x140003000); code += b'\x31\xd2'
    call(1); nonnull(); save_rax(0x140003008)
    load_rcx(0x140003008); call(2)
    code += b'\x3c\x01\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    # Microsoft ABI's second argument is XMM1 (not the System V XMM0).
    code += b'\xb9\x0a\x10\x00\x00\xb8' + struct.pack('<f', 0.375) + b'\x66\x0f\x6e\xc8'
    call(3)
    code += b'\xb9\x0a\x10\x00\x00\x48\xba' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003010)
    call(4)
    code += b'\x48\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003010) + b'\x81\x38' + struct.pack('<f', 0.375) + b'\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    call(5); code += b'\x85\xc0\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    code += b'\x31\xc9'; call(2)
    load_rcx(0x140003008); call(6)
    load_rcx(0x140003000); call(7)
    code += b'\x3c\x01\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\x83\xc4\x28\xc3'
    assert len(code) <= 0x200
    data[0x400:0x600] = code.ljust(0x200, b'\0')
    return data


def console_fixture():
    """A PE callback receives a real SIGINT on another native ABI thread."""
    data = fixture()
    data[0x680:0x700] = bytes(0x80)
    data[0x700:0x780] = bytes(0x80)
    data[0xc00:0xc40] = bytes(0x40)
    for index, name in enumerate((b'SetConsoleCtrlHandler', b'Sleep', b'GetCurrentThreadId')):
        for table in (0x680, 0x700):
            struct.pack_into('<Q', data, table + index * 8, 0x2200 + index * 64)
        at = 0x802 + index * 64
        data[at:at + len(name) + 1] = name + b'\0'
    code = bytearray(b'\x48\x83\xec\x28')
    def call(index, start=0x1000):
        code.extend(b'\xff\x15' + struct.pack('<i', 0x2100 + index * 8 - (start + len(code) + 6)))
    call(2)
    code += b'\xa3' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003014)
    code += b'\x48\xb9' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140001100) + b'\xba\x01\x00\x00\x00'
    call(0)
    code += b'\x85\xc0\x75\x02\x0f\x0b'
    loop = len(code)
    code += b'\x48\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003000) + b'\x83\x38\x01\x74\x0d\xb9\x05\x00\x00\x00'
    call(1)
    code += b'\xeb' + struct.pack('<b', loop - (len(code) + 2))
    # Compare the callback's Linux TID against the PE main thread's TID.
    code += b'\x48\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003010) + b'\x8b\x08\x3b\x48\x04\x75\x02\x0f\x0b'
    code += b'\x48\xb9' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140001100) + b'\x31\xd2'
    call(0)
    code += b'\x48\x83\xc4\x28\xc3'
    assert len(code) <= 0x100
    data[0x400:0x500] = code.ljust(0x100, b'\0')
    code = bytearray(b'\x48\x83\xec\x28\x85\xc9\x74\x02\x0f\x0b')
    code += b'\x65\x48\x8b\x04\x25\x30\x00\x00\x00\x48\x3b\x40\x30\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    call(2, 0x1100)
    code += b'\xa3' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003010)
    code += b'\x48\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003000) + b'\xc7\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00'
    code += b'\xb8\x01\x00\x00\x00\x48\x83\xc4\x28\xc3'
    data[0x500:0x600] = code.ljust(0x100, b'\0')
    return data


def window_resource_fixture():
    """An authored PE loads a real icon and registers its native class layout."""
    data = fixture()
    data[0x640:0x650] = b'USER32.dll\0'.ljust(16, b'\0')
    data[0x680:0x700] = bytes(0x80)
    data[0x700:0x780] = bytes(0x80)
    data[0xc00:] = bytes(0x400)
    for index, name in enumerate((b'LoadImageW', b'RegisterClassW', b'DestroyIcon', b'UnregisterClassW')):
        for table in (0x680, 0x700):
            struct.pack_into('<Q', data, table + index * 8, 0x2200 + index * 64)
        at = 0x802 + index * 64
        data[at:at + len(name) + 1] = name + b'\0'
    struct.pack_into('<II', data, 0x98 + 128, 0x3200, 0x200)
    # WNDCLASSW, copied UTF-16 class name, and a harmless native procedure.
    struct.pack_into('<I4xQiiQQQQQQ', data, 0xc00, 0x1020, 0x140001100, 0, 0, 0x140000000, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x140003080)
    label = 'AuthoredWindow\0'.encode('utf-16le')
    data[0xc80:0xc80 + len(label)] = label
    def put(at, fmt, *values):
        struct.pack_into('<' + fmt, data, 0xe00 + at, *values)
    put(14, 'H', 2)
    put(16, 'II', 3, 0x800000c0); put(24, 'II', 14, 0x80000020)
    put(0x2e, 'H', 1); put(0x30, 'II', 101, 0x80000050)
    put(0x5e, 'H', 1); put(0x60, 'II', 1033, 0x70)
    put(0x70, 'II', 0x32a0, 20)
    put(0xa0, 'HHHBBBBHHIH', 0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 0, 0, 1, 32, 64, 7)
    put(0xce, 'H', 1); put(0xd0, 'II', 7, 0x800000e0)
    put(0xee, 'H', 1); put(0xf0, 'II', 1033, 0x100)
    put(0x100, 'II', 0x3340, 64)
    put(0x140, 'IiiHH', 40, 2, 4, 1, 32)
    data[0xf68:0xf78] = bytes((255, 0, 0, 255)) * 4
    code = bytearray(b'\x48\x83\xec\x38')
    def call(index):
        code.extend(b'\xff\x15' + struct.pack('<i', 0x2100 + index * 8 - (0x1000 + len(code) + 6)))
    def pointer(value):
        code.extend(b'\x48\xb9' + struct.pack('<Q', value))
    def success():
        code.extend(b'\x48\x85\xc0\x75\x02\x0f\x0b')
    pointer(0x140000000)
    code += b'\xba\x65\x00\x00\x00\x41\xb8\x01\x00\x00\x00\x45\x31\xc9'
    code += b'\xc7\x44\x24\x20\x00\x00\x00\x00\xc7\x44\x24\x28\x00\x00\x00\x00'
    call(0); success()
    code += b'\x48\xa3' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003020)
    pointer(0x140003000); call(1); success()
    pointer(0x140003020); code += b'\x48\x8b\x09'; call(2); success()
    pointer(0x140003080); code += b'\x48\xba' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140000000); call(3); success()
    code += b'\x48\x83\xc4\x38\xc3'
    assert len(code) < 0x100
    data[0x400:0x500] = code.ljust(0x100, b'\0')
    data[0x500:0x506] = b'\x31\xc0\xc3\x90\x90\x90'
    return data


def message_fixture():
    """Seven Microsoft-ABI arguments, UTF-16 result and untouched buffer guard."""
    data = fixture()
    data[0x680:0x700] = bytes(0x80)
    data[0x700:0x780] = bytes(0x80)
    for table in (0x680, 0x700):
        struct.pack_into('<Q', data, table, 0x2200)
    data[0x802:0x811] = b'FormatMessageW\0'
    data[0xc00:0xc80] = bytes((0xa5,)) * 0x80
    code = bytearray(b'\x48\x83\xec\x38\xb9\x00\x10\x00\x00\x31\xd2\x41\xb8\x7f\x00\x00\x00\x45\x31\xc9')
    code += b'\x48\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003000) + b'\x48\x89\x44\x24\x20'
    code += b'\x48\xc7\x44\x24\x28\x40\x00\x00\x00\x48\xc7\x44\x24\x30\x00\x00\x00\x00'
    code += b'\xff\x15' + struct.pack('<i', 0x2100 - (0x1000 + len(code) + 6))
    code += b'\x83\xf8\x2d\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003000)
    code += b'\x81\x38' + struct.pack('<I', 0x00680054) + b'\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    code += b'\x48\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x14000305a)
    code += b'\x81\x38' + struct.pack('<I', 0xa5a50000) + b'\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\x83\xc4\x38\xc3'
    data[0x400:0x600] = code.ljust(0x200, b'\0')
    return data


def check(exe, workdir):
    workdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-singleton'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-version'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-network'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-startup'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-system'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-events'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-semaphores'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-virtual-memory'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-threads'], check=True, timeout=15, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-environment'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-window-resources'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-modules'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-user-module'], check=True, timeout=15)
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-format-message'], check=True, timeout=15)
    message_path = workdir / 'authored-system-message.exe'
    message_path.write_bytes(message_fixture())
    message = subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--fixture', str(message_path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    assert message.returncode == 0 and 'GE6_AUTHORED_FIXTURE_RETURN' in message.stdout, message.stdout + message.stderr
    window_path = workdir / 'authored-window-resources.exe'
    window_path.write_bytes(window_resource_fixture())
    window = subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--fixture', str(window_path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    assert window.returncode == 0 and 'GE6_IMAGE_RESOURCE_LOADED first=2 second=2' in window.stdout and 'GE6_WINDOW_CLASS_REGISTER' in window.stdout and 'GE6_AUTHORED_FIXTURE_RETURN' in window.stdout, window.stdout + window.stderr
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-console'], check=True, timeout=15, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    unhandled = subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-console-default'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    assert unhandled.returncode == 130 and 'GE6_CONSOLE_CALL' in unhandled.stdout, unhandled
    console_path = workdir / 'authored-console-abi.exe'
    console_path.write_bytes(console_fixture())
    process = subprocess.Popen([str(exe.resolve()), '--fixture', str(console_path)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    prefix = b''
    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while b'GE6_CONSOLE_REGISTER entry=0x140001100' not in prefix:
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            assert remaining > 0 and select.select([process.stdout], [], [], remaining)[0], prefix
            chunk = os.read(process.stdout.fileno(), 65536)
            assert chunk, prefix
            prefix += chunk
        process.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
        output, error = process.communicate(timeout=10)
        output = prefix + output
        assert process.returncode == 0 and b'GE6_CONSOLE_CALL entry=0x140001100' in output and b'GE6_AUTHORED_FIXTURE_RETURN' in output, output + error
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.communicate()
    audio_env = dict(os.environ, ALSOFT_DRIVERS='null')
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-audio'], check=True, timeout=15, env=audio_env)
    audio_path = workdir / 'authored-openal-abi.exe'
    audio_path.write_bytes(audio_fixture())
    audio = subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--fixture', str(audio_path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15, env=audio_env)
    assert audio.returncode == 0 and 'GE6_AUTHORED_FIXTURE_RETURN' in audio.stdout, audio.stdout + audio.stderr
    rejected = subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-unknown-exception'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    assert rejected.returncode == 78 and 'KERNEL32.dll!RaiseException' in rejected.stderr and 'exception=0xdeadbeef' in rejected.stderr, rejected
    rejected = subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-alertable-wait'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    assert rejected.returncode == 78 and 'KERNEL32.dll!WaitForSingleObjectEx' in rejected.stderr and 'alertable=1' in rejected.stderr, rejected
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=workdir) as directory:
        subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--check-files', directory], check=True, timeout=15)
    path = workdir / 'authored.exe'
    def run(data, mode='--fixture'):
        path.write_bytes(data)
        return subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), mode, str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    result = run(fixture())
    assert result.returncode == 0 and 'GE6_AUTHORED_FIXTURE_RETURN os_calls=6' in result.stdout, result
    assert 'supported_imports=5 blocked_imports=0' in result.stdout, result
    assert 'GE6_ORIGINAL_MAIN_REACHED' not in result.stdout, result
    result = run(fixture(True))
    assert result.returncode == 78 and 'KERNEL32.dll!UnsupportedFixtureAPI' in result.stderr and 'caller=0x140001' in result.stderr, result
    result = run(fixture(), '--image')
    assert result.returncode == 1 and 'hash differs' in result.stderr, result
    arithmetic = fixture()
    arithmetic[0x400:0x408] = b'\x31\xc0\x31\xd2\x31\xc9\xf7\xf1'  # Authored div ecx with zero divisor.
    result = run(arithmetic)
    assert result.returncode == 136 and 'GE6_NATIVE_FAULT signal=8 rip=0x140001006' in result.stderr and 'rcx=0x0' in result.stderr, result
    threaded = fixture()
    thread_names = (b'CreateThread', b'WaitForSingleObject', b'CloseHandle', b'GetCurrentThreadId', b'TlsGetValue', b'TlsSetValue', b'TlsAlloc', b'TlsFree')
    for i, name in enumerate(thread_names):
        struct.pack_into('<Q', threaded, 0x680 + i * 8, 0x2200 + i * 64)
        struct.pack_into('<Q', threaded, 0x700 + i * 8, 0x2200 + i * 64)
        at = 0x802 + i * 64
        threaded[at:at + 62] = (name + b'\0').ljust(62, b'\0')
    def thread_code(rva):
        code = bytearray(b'\x53\x48\x83\xec' + (b'\x40' if rva == 0x1000 else b'\x20'))
        def call(iat):
            code.extend(b'\xff\x15' + struct.pack('<i', iat - (rva + len(code) + 6)))
        return code, call
    code, call = thread_code(0x1000)
    call(0x2130)  # TlsAlloc; parent and child use the same index.
    code += b'\x48\xbb' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003000) + b'\x89\x03\x89\xc1\xba\x11\x11\x00\x00'
    call(0x2128)
    code += b'\x83\xf8\x01\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    call(0x2118)
    code += b'\x89\x43\x04\x31\xc9\x31\xd2\x49\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140001100)
    code += b'\x49\x89\xd9\x48\xc7\x44\x24\x20\x00\x00\x00\x00\x48\x8d\x43\x0c\x48\x89\x44\x24\x28'
    call(0x2100)  # Six-argument Microsoft ABI CreateThread.
    code += b'\x48\x85\xc0\x75\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\x89\xc3\x48\x89\xd9\xba\x88\x13\x00\x00'
    call(0x2108)
    code += b'\x85\xc0\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\x89\xd9'
    call(0x2110)
    code += b'\x83\xf8\x01\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\xbb' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003000) + b'\x8b\x0b'
    call(0x2120)
    code += b'\x48\x3d\x11\x11\x00\x00\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x8b\x43\x04\x3b\x43\x08\x75\x02\x0f\x0b\x8b\x0b'
    call(0x2138)
    code += b'\x48\x83\xc4\x40\x5b\xc3'
    assert len(code) <= 0x100
    threaded[0x400:0x500] = code.ljust(0x100, b'\0')
    code, call = thread_code(0x1100)
    code += b'\x48\x89\xcb\x65\x48\x8b\x04\x25\x30\x00\x00\x00\x48\x3b\x40\x30\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    code += b'\x65\x48\x8b\x04\x25\x10\x00\x00\x00\x48\x39\xc4\x77\x02\x0f\x0b'
    call(0x2118)
    code += b'\x89\x43\x08\x8b\x0b'
    call(0x2120)
    code += b'\x48\x85\xc0\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x8b\x0b\xba\x22\x22\x00\x00'
    call(0x2128)
    code += b'\xb8\x42\x00\x00\x00\x48\x83\xc4\x20\x5b\xc3'
    assert len(code) <= 0x100
    threaded[0x500:0x600] = code.ljust(0x100, b'\0')
    result = run(threaded)
    assert result.returncode == 0 and 'GE6_NATIVE_THREAD_FIRST_OS name=GetCurrentThreadId entry=0x140001100' in result.stdout, result
    assert 'GE6_NATIVE_THREAD_EXIT entry=0x140001100' in result.stdout and 'code=66' in result.stdout, result
    network = fixture()
    network[0x640:0x660] = b'WS2_32.dll\0'.ljust(32, b'\0')
    for i, ordinal in enumerate((115, 116, 111, 0, 0)):
        value = (1 << 63) | ordinal if ordinal else 0
        struct.pack_into('<Q', network, 0x680 + i * 8, value)
        struct.pack_into('<Q', network, 0x700 + i * 8, value)
    network[0xc00 + 408] = 0xa5
    code = bytearray(b'\x48\x83\xec\x28')
    def net_call(iat):
        code.extend(b'\xff\x15' + struct.pack('<i', iat - (0x1000 + len(code) + 6)))
    code += b'\xb9\x02\x02\x00\x00\x48\xba' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003000)
    net_call(0x2100)
    code += b'\x85\xc0\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\xb8' + struct.pack('<Q', 0x140003000)
    code += b'\x81\x38\x02\x02\x02\x02\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    code += b'\x80\xb8' + struct.pack('<I', 408) + b'\xa5\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    net_call(0x2108)
    code += b'\x85\xc0\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    net_call(0x2108)
    code += b'\x83\xf8\xff\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    net_call(0x2110)
    code += b'\x3d' + struct.pack('<I', 10093) + b'\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\x83\xc4\x28\xc3'
    network[0x400:0x600] = code.ljust(0x200, b'\x00')
    result = run(network)
    assert result.returncode == 0 and 'supported_imports=3 blocked_imports=0' in result.stdout and 'GE6_OS WSAStartup' in result.stdout, result
    local = fixture()
    local[0x640:0x640 + 15] = b'fs15_local.dll\0'
    names = (b'SteamAPI_Init', b'SteamApps', b'SteamUtils', b'SteamUser', b'SteamUserStats')
    for i, name in enumerate(names):
        start = 0x802 + i * 64
        local[start:start + 64] = bytes(64)
        local[start:start + len(name)] = name
    code = bytearray(b'\x48\x83\xec\x28')
    def call(iat):
        code.extend(b'\xff\x15' + struct.pack('<i', iat - (0x1000 + len(code) + 6)))
    for i in (0, 1, 3, 4):
        call(0x2100 + i * 8)
        code += b'\x48\x85\xc0\x74\x02\x0f\x0b'
    call(0x2110)
    code += b'\x48\x89\xc1\x48\x8b\x00\xff\x50\x48'
    code += b'\x3d' + struct.pack('<I', 313160) + b'\x74\x02\x0f\x0b\x48\x83\xc4\x28\xc3'
    local[0x400:0x600] = code.ljust(0x200, b'\x00')
    result = run(local)
    assert result.returncode == 0 and 'INIT_UNAVAILABLE' in result.stdout and 'UTIL_APP_ID' in result.stdout, result
    assert 'APPS_UNAVAILABLE' in result.stdout and 'USER_UNAVAILABLE' in result.stdout, result
    broken = fixture()
    struct.pack_into('<I', broken, 0x98 + 240 + 12, 0x2000)
    result = run(broken)
    assert result.returncode == 1 and 'Overlapping PE sections' in result.stderr, result
    print('Native GE6 boot transport: authored PE mapping, Microsoft ABI import call/writeback, named missing-import stop, pinned-image rejection and overlap rejection passed. No original engine is booted by these fixtures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--exe', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--workdir', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    check(args.exe, args.workdir)
```

```py
"""Actual framebuffer integration check using only authored geometry/resources."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess


def check(exe, workdir):
    workdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # One triangle, shared by two objects, with an intermediate transformed parent.
    vertices = b''.join(struct.pack('<8f', x, y, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)
                        for x, y in ((-.4, -.4), (.4, -.4), (0, .4)))
    (workdir / 'scene.meshes').write_bytes(b'FS15MSH\1' + struct.pack('<7I', 1, 7, 3, 3, 1, 0, 3)
                                        + vertices + struct.pack('<3I', 0, 1, 2))
    (workdir / 'green.rgba').write_bytes(struct.pack('<II4B', 1, 1, 0, 255, 0, 255))
    pack = bytearray(b'GE6OBJ01' + struct.pack('<II5f', 2, 3, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0))
    for mid, color, texture in ((1, (1, 0, 0, 1), b''), (2, (1, 1, 1, 1), b'green.rgba')):
        pack += struct.pack('<I4fII', mid, *color, 0, len(texture)) + texture
    for parent, shape, x, ids in ((-1, 0, -.6, ()), (0, 7, 0, (1,)), (-1, 7, .6, (2,))):
        pack += struct.pack('<iII10fI', parent, shape, 1, x, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 100, len(ids))
        pack += struct.pack(f'<{len(ids)}I', *ids)
    scene = workdir / 'scene.ge6scene'
    scene.write_bytes(pack)
    capture = workdir / 'frame.bmp'
    subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--scene', str(scene), '--capture', str(capture), '--frames', '1'], check=True)
    image = capture.read_bytes()
    offset = struct.unpack_from('<I', image, 10)[0]
    width, height = struct.unpack_from('<ii', image, 18)
    assert struct.unpack_from('<H', image, 28)[0] == 24
    pitch = (width * 3 + 3) & ~3

    def pixel(x, y):
        b, g, r = image[offset + (height - 1 - y) * pitch + x * 3:][:3]
        return r, g, b
    red, green = pixel(515, 370), pixel(765, 370)
    assert red[0] > 100 and red[1] < 10 and red[2] < 10, red
    assert green[1] > 100 and green[0] < 10 and green[2] < 10, green
    assert pixel(640, 370)[2] > 150, 'Background between objects was overwritten'
    # Bounds rejection must fail rather than submit invalid GPU index data.
    broken = bytearray((workdir / 'scene.meshes').read_bytes())
    struct.pack_into('<I', broken, len(broken) - 4, 99)
    (workdir / 'scene.meshes').write_bytes(broken)
    result = subprocess.run([str(exe.resolve()), '--scene', str(scene), '--frames', '1'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode != 0 and 'Mesh index out of bounds' in result.stderr, result
    print('GE6 object framebuffer: hierarchy placement, shared mesh, diffuse color, texture binding and bounds rejection passed (authored fixtures)')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--exe', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--workdir', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    check(args.exe, args.workdir)

```

`tests/check_linux_menu.py`:

```py
"""SDL frontend transport checks with entirely authored resources.

This verifies drawing pixels and failures, not the recovered original menu.
Original-resource testing is deliberately private and separate.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import tarfile
import zlib


def dds(width, height, pixels):
    header = [0] * 31
    header[0:5] = [124, 0x100F, height, width, width * 4]
    header[18:26] = [32, 0x41, 0, 32, 0xFF0000, 0xFF00, 0xFF, 0xFF000000]
    header[26] = 0x1000
    return b'DDS ' + struct.pack('<31I', *header) + struct.pack('<'+'I'*len(pixels), *pixels)


def read_png(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    assert data[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    pos = 8
    packed = b''
    while pos < len(data):
        size = struct.unpack_from('>I', data, pos)[0]
        kind, body = data[pos+4:pos+8], data[pos+8:pos+8+size]
        if kind == b'IHDR':
            width, height, depth, color, _, _, interlace = struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB', body)
            assert depth == 8 and color in (2, 6) and interlace == 0
        if kind == b'IDAT':
            packed += body
        pos += size + 12
    bpp = 4 if color == 6 else 3
    raw = zlib.decompress(packed)
    rows, previous = [], bytearray(width*bpp)
    for y in range(height):
        offset = y*(width*bpp+1)
        method = raw[offset]
        row = bytearray(raw[offset+1:offset+1+width*bpp])
        for x in range(len(row)):
            a = row[x-bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
            b, c = previous[x], previous[x-bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
            if method == 0:
                prediction = 0
            elif method == 1:
                prediction = a
            elif method == 2:
                prediction = b
            elif method == 3:
                prediction = (a+b)//2
            elif method == 4:
                p = a+b-c
                distances = [abs(p-v) for v in (a, b, c)]
                prediction = (a, b, c)[distances.index(min(distances))]
            else:
                raise AssertionError('Unknown PNG filter')
            row[x] = (row[x]+prediction) & 255
        rows.append(row)
        previous = row
    return width, height, lambda x, y: tuple(rows[y][x*bpp:x*bpp+3])


BOOTSTRAP = '''-- Authored transport fixture. No original game logic or assets.
source('dataS/scripts/probe.lua')
local image, checker
function fs15_menu_selfcheck()
    assert(probeLoaded)
    image=createImageOverlay('probe.dds')
    checker=createImageOverlay('checker.dds')
end
function fs15_menu_show(name) assert(name=='MainScreen') end
function fs15_menu_update(dt) assert(dt==16) end
function fs15_menu_draw()
    setOverlayColor(image,1,0,0,1)
    renderOverlay(image,0.1,0.1,0.8,0.8)
    set2DClipArea(0.25,0.25,0.5,0.5)
    setOverlayColor(image,0,0,1,1)
    renderOverlay(image,0.1,0.1,0.8,0.8)
    reset2DClipArea()
    setOverlayUVs(checker,0,0,0,1,1,0,1,1)
    renderOverlay(checker,0.3,0.3,0.1,0.1)
    setOverlayUVs(checker,1,0,1,1,0,0,0,1)
    renderOverlay(checker,0.5,0.3,0.1,0.1)
    setTextColor(0,1,0,1)
    renderText(0.8,0.8,0.05,'ABC')
end
function fs15_menu_test_inputs()
    assert(not menuLaunchWorld('Map01',2,1))
    menuUnavailable('authored fixture boundary')
    doExit()
end
'''


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--exe', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--workdir', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--report', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    exe = args.exe.resolve()
    args.workdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    checks = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=args.workdir.resolve(), prefix='sdl-') as tmp:
        tmp = Path(tmp)
        root = tmp/'resource directory'
        font = root/'assets/shared/font'
        font.mkdir(parents=True)
        scripts = root/'lua/dataS/scripts'
        scripts.mkdir(parents=True)
        (scripts/'probe.lua').write_text('probeLoaded=true\n')
        (root/'bootstrap.lua').write_text(BOOTSTRAP)
        (root/'assets/probe.dds').write_bytes(dds(2, 2, [0xFFFFFFFF]*4))
        (root/'assets/checker.dds').write_bytes(dds(2, 2, [0xFFFF0000, 0xFF00FF00, 0xFF0000FF, 0xFFFFFFFF]))
        (font/'defaultFont.dds').write_bytes(dds(8, 8, [0xFFFFFFFF]*64))
        metrics = struct.pack('>fII', 40, 0, 95)
        for char in range(32, 127):
            metrics += struct.pack('>I', char)
            for bold in (False, True):
                metrics += struct.pack('>HHBBbbf', 0, 0, 8, 8, 0, 8, 10 if bold else 8)
        (font/'defaultFont.font').write_bytes(metrics)
        before = {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                  for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        env = dict(os.environ, SDL_VIDEODRIVER='dummy')

        def run(*options, expected=0):
            proc = subprocess.run([str(exe), *map(str, options)], cwd=tmp, env=env,
                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
            assert proc.returncode == expected, (proc.returncode, proc.stdout, proc.stderr)
            return proc

        run('--help')
        checks.append('help_without_assets')
        image = tmp/'frame.png'
        output = tmp/'result'
        run('--root', root, '--output-dir', output, '--smoke', '--test-inputs', '--screenshot', image)
        log = (output/'menu-runtime.log').read_text()
        assert all(marker in log for marker in ('BOOT_OK', 'SMOKE_OK', 'INPUT_CHECK_OK', 'WORLD_UNAVAILABLE', 'SHUTDOWN exit=0'))
        checks.append('bootstrap_source_input_callbacks_and_world_boundary')
        w, h, pixel = read_png(image)
        assert (w, h) == (1280, 720)
        for xy, rgb in [((10, 10), (0, 0, 0)), ((200, 360), (255, 0, 0)), ((640, 360), (0, 0, 255)), ((640, 600), (255, 0, 0))]:
            assert pixel(*xy) == rgb, (xy, pixel(*xy), rgb)
        assert any(pixel(x, y)[1] > 200 for y in range(130, 150) for x in range(1020, 1050))
        # Sample well inside each quadrant; interpolation is immaterial there.
        for xy, channel in [((390, 435), 0), ((505, 435), 1), ((390, 500), 2), ((646, 435), 1)]:
            rgb = pixel(*xy)
            assert rgb[channel] > 200 and sum(rgb)-rgb[channel] < 60, (xy, rgb)
        checks.append('png_dimensions_overlay_tint_uv_origin_clip_and_font_pixels')
        run('--root', root, '--output-dir', output, '--smoke', '--screen', 'UnknownScreen', expected=1)
        checks.append('unknown_screen_failure')
        after = {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                 for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        assert before == after
        checks.append('resources_unchanged')
        (scripts/'probe.lua').write_bytes(b'\x1bLJfake')
        run('--root', root, '--output-dir', output, '--smoke', expected=1)
        assert 'Refusing compiled/original bytecode' in (output/'menu-runtime.log').read_text()
        checks.append('bytecode_refused')
        (scripts/'probe.lua').write_text('probeLoaded=true\n')
        (root/'assets/probe.dds').unlink()
        run('--root', root, '--output-dir', output, '--smoke', expected=1)
        assert 'Missing recovered asset' in (output/'menu-runtime.log').read_text()
        checks.append('missing_texture_failure')
        (root/'assets/probe.dds').write_bytes(dds(2, 2, [0xFFFFFFFF]*4))
        # Exercise SDL window creation/presentation as well as the offscreen
        # renderer. The dummy display is explicit: this is not desktop evidence.
        (root/'bootstrap.lua').write_text(BOOTSTRAP+'''\nlocal frames=0
function fs15_menu_update(dt)
    assert(dt==16)
    frames=frames+1
    if frames==3 then doExit() end
end
''')
        run('--root', root, '--output-dir', output, '--screenshot', image)
        assert 'WINDOW_OPEN linux' in (output/'menu-runtime.log').read_text()
        checks.append('dummy_display_window_create_present_and_exit')
        package = tmp/'tester package'
        shutil.copytree(exe.parent.parent, package)
        shutil.copytree(root, package/'resources')
        files = [{'path': p.relative_to(package).as_posix(),
                  'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
                 for p in package.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
        (package/'TESTER-MANIFEST.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files': files}))
        proc = subprocess.run(['sh', str(package/'start-linux.sh'), '--smoke'],
                              cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
        assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.stdout, proc.stderr)
        archives = list((package/'test-results').glob('*.tar.gz'))
        assert len(archives) == 1
        with tarfile.open(archives[0]) as tar:
            names = tar.getnames()
            assert not any('/assets/' in name or '/lua/' in name for name in names)
            name = next(n for n in names if n.endswith('/report.json'))
            assert json.load(tar.extractfile(name))['status'] == 'passed'
        checks.append('installed_launcher_smoke_and_report_archive_without_resources')
        (package/'resources/bootstrap.lua').write_text('tampered=true')
        proc = subprocess.run(['sh', str(package/'start-linux.sh'), '--smoke'],
                              cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        assert proc.returncode == 1 and 'Package verification failed' in proc.stderr
        checks.append('installed_launcher_rejects_tampered_package')
    args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.report.write_text(json.dumps({'platform': 'linux-x64', 'original_resources_executed': False,
                                     'fixture_origin': 'authored', 'checks': checks, 'passed': True}, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(f'{len(checks)} Linux menu transport checks passed; original resources not exercised')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tests/check_ljd_tables.py`:

```py
"""Check table initialization recovery using authored Lua and exact bytecode."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    runtime = ROOT / 'tools/LuaJIT/src/luajit.exe'
    output = ROOT / 'build/table-initialization-regression'
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    original = output / 'original.luc'
    reconstructed = output / 'reconstructed.lua'
    subprocess.run([str(runtime), str(ROOT / 'scripts/lua/compile_chunk.lua'),
                    str(ROOT / 'tests/fixtures/table_initialization.lua'), str(original)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / 'scripts/ljd_driver.py'),
                    str(ROOT / 'tools/luajit-decompiler/main.py'), '--file', str(original),
                    '--output', str(reconstructed), '--unsafe', 'false'], check=True)
    for chunk in (original, reconstructed):
        subprocess.run([str(runtime), str(ROOT / 'tests/fixtures/check_table_initialization.lua'),
                        str(chunk)], check=True)
    result = subprocess.run([str(runtime), str(ROOT / 'scripts/lua/check_chunk.lua'),
                             str(original), str(reconstructed)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.stdout.strip() != 'exact_match':
        raise AssertionError(f'Table initialization did not round trip: {result.stdout}')
    print('Table initialization fixture: exact stripped-bytecode round trip')

    # Check the comparison itself: template hash order may vary, whereas
    # changed constants, calls or allocation instructions must still fail.
    comparisons = [
        ('return {a=1,b=2,c=3,d=4,e=5}', 'return {e=5,d=4,c=3,b=2,a=1}', 'exact_match'),
        ('return {a=1,b=2,c=3}', 'return {a=1,b=2,c=4}', 'syntax_only'),
        ('local t={} t.x=17 return t', 'local t={x=17} return t', 'syntax_only'),
        ('return first()', 'return second()', 'syntax_only'),
        ('error("must not execute")', 'error("must not execute")', 'exact_match'),
    ]
    for i, (left, right, expected) in enumerate(comparisons):
        paths = [output / f'comparison-{i}-{side}.lua' for side in ('left', 'right')]
        for path, source in zip(paths, (left, right)):
            path.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
        result = subprocess.run([str(runtime), str(ROOT / 'scripts/lua/check_chunk.lua'),
                                 *map(str, paths)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if result.stdout.strip() != expected:
            raise AssertionError(f'Comparison control {i}: expected {expected}, got {result.stdout}')
    print('Deterministic comparison: hash-order equality and four comparison/execution controls pass')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
"""Authored I3D/RG16/DDS fixture exercises the real native D3D11 WARP path."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import zlib


def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + kind + data + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(kind + data))


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--exe', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--fixtures', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    parent = Path(os.path.abspath(args.fixtures))
    parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='engine-authored-', dir=parent)
    root = Path(os.path.abspath(temporary.name))
    if root.parent != parent or not root.name.startswith('engine-authored-'):
        raise RuntimeError('Fixture must remain within its verified build directory')
    try:
        maps = root / 'assets/data/maps'
        textures = maps / 'map01'
        textures.mkdir(parents=True)
        values = [round(32768 + 10000 * math.sin(x / 10) * math.sin(z / 10))
                  for z in range(33) for x in range(33)]
        rows = []
        for z in range(33):
            rows.append(b'\0' + b''.join(bytes((v >> 8, v & 255, 0)) for v in values[z*33:(z+1)*33]))
        png = (b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', 33, 33, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
               + chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(b''.join(rows))) + chunk(b'IEND', b''))
        (textures / 'dem.png').write_bytes(png)
        header = bytearray(128)
        header[:4] = b'DDS '
        for offset, value in [(4,124), (8,0x81007), (12,4), (16,4), (20,8),
                              (28,1), (76,32), (80,4), (84,0x31545844), (108,0x1000)]:
            struct.pack_into('<I', header, offset, value)
        (textures / 'pda_map_H.dds').write_bytes(header + struct.pack('<HHI', 0x07e0, 0x001f, 0x44332211))
        scene = ('<i3D><Files><File fileId="1" filename="map01/dem.png"/></Files><Scene>'
                 '<TerrainTransformGroup nodeId="1" heightMapId="1" heightScale="255" unitsPerPixel="2"/>'
                 '<TransformGroup nodeId="2" name="deferred"><Shape nodeId="3" shapeId="1"/></TransformGroup>'
                 '</Scene></i3D>')
        (maps / 'map01.i3d').write_text(scene, encoding='utf-8')
        report, image = root / 'result.json', root / 'result.png'
        command = [str(args.exe), '--root', str(root), '--map', 'Map01', '--smoke', '--warp',
                   '--report', str(report), '--capture', str(image)]
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=30)
        data = json.loads(report.read_text())
        assert data['ready'] and data['driver'] == 'WARP' and not data['original_engine_loaded']
        assert data['scene_nodes'] == 3 and data['source_shape_nodes'] == 1
        assert data['source_width'] == 33 and data['world_width'] == 64
        assert data['vertices'] == 289 and data['triangles'] == 512
        assert abs(data['min_height'] - min(values) * 255 / 65535) < 0.001
        assert abs(data['max_height'] - max(values) * 255 / 65535) < 0.001
        assert data['visible_gpu_samples'] > 0 and data['camera_math_check']
        assert image.read_bytes().startswith(b'\x89PNG')
        # A real mesh above the terrain exercises hierarchy/rotation/scale,
        # subset upload, instancing, material color and independent GPU samples.
        vertices = [(-10,0,-10,0,1,0,0,0), (10,0,-10,0,1,0,1,0), (0,10,10,0,1,0,0.5,1)]
        mesh = (b'FS15MSH\x01' + struct.pack('<I',1) + struct.pack('<4I',7,3,3,1)
                + struct.pack('<2I',0,3) + b''.join(struct.pack('<8f',*v) for v in vertices)
                + struct.pack('<3I',0,1,2))
        (maps / 'map01.meshes').write_bytes(mesh)
        object_scene = scene.replace('<Scene>', '<Materials><Material materialId="1" diffuseColor="0.7 0.3 0.2"/></Materials><Scene>')
        object_scene = object_scene.replace('</Scene>',
            '<TransformGroup name="fixture" translation="4 180 -4" rotation="0 90 0" scale="2 2 2" nodeId="4">'
            '<Shape shapeId="7" materialIds="1" translation="1 0 2" nodeId="5"/>'
            '<Shape shapeId="7" materialIds="1" nonRenderable="true" nodeId="6"/>'
            '<Shape name="fixture_lod1" shapeId="7" materialIds="1" nodeId="7"/>'
            '</TransformGroup></Scene>')
        (maps / 'map01.i3d').write_text(object_scene, encoding='utf-8')
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=30)
        data = json.loads(report.read_text())
        assert data['decoded_meshes'] == 1 and data['rendered_instances'] == 1 and data['object_triangles'] == 1
        assert data['visible_object_gpu_samples'] > 0
        matrix = data['first_instance_world']
        assert all(abs(matrix[12+i] - expected) < 0.001 for i,expected in enumerate([8,180,-6]))
        assert abs(matrix[2]+2) < 0.001 and abs(matrix[8]-2) < 0.001
        (maps / 'map01.meshes').write_bytes(mesh[:-1])
        assert subprocess.run(command, timeout=30).returncode != 0

        print('Authored heights, transformed/filtered mesh instances, WARP terrain/object visibility, camera and failure fixtures passed')
    finally:
        if Path(os.path.abspath(temporary.name)).parent != parent:
            raise RuntimeError('Unsafe fixture cleanup target')
        temporary.cleanup()
```

`tests/environment_render.py`:

```py
"""Actual GE6 sky/injection/shadow GPU comparisons, with stdlib PNG decoding."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import zlib


def png_rgb(path):
    source = path.read_bytes()
    assert source[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    at, compressed = 8, bytearray()
    while at < len(source):
        length, = struct.unpack_from('>I',source,at)
        kind, data = source[at+4:at+8], source[at+8:at+8+length]
        if kind == b'IHDR':
            width,height,bits,color,compression,filtering,interlace = struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',data)
            assert bits == 8 and color in (2,6) and compression == filtering == interlace == 0
        if kind == b'IDAT':
            compressed.extend(data)
        at += length+12
    bpp = 3 if color == 2 else 4
    decoded = zlib.decompress(compressed)
    stride, at, previous, pixels = width*bpp, 0, bytearray(width*bpp), bytearray()
    assert len(decoded) == height*(stride+1)
    for _ in range(height):
        method = decoded[at]
        row = bytearray(decoded[at+1:at+1+stride]);at += stride+1
        for i in range(stride):
            left = row[i-bpp] if i >= bpp else 0
            up = previous[i]
            corner = previous[i-bpp] if i >= bpp else 0
            if method == 0: predictor = 0
            elif method == 1: predictor = left
            elif method == 2: predictor = up
            elif method == 3: predictor = (left+up)//2
            elif method == 4:
                p = left+up-corner
                a,b,c = abs(p-left),abs(p-up),abs(p-corner)
                predictor = left if a <= b and a <= c else up if b <= c else corner
            else: raise AssertionError('Unsupported PNG row filter')
            row[i] = (row[i]+predictor)&255
        if bpp == 3: pixels.extend(row)
        else:
            for i in range(0,stride,4):pixels.extend(row[i:i+3])
        previous = row
    return width,height,pixels


def changed(first,second):
    assert first[:2] == second[:2]
    a,b=first[2],second[2]
    return sum(max(abs(a[i]-b[i]),abs(a[i+1]-b[i+1]),abs(a[i+2]-b[i+2]))>2 for i in range(0,len(a),3))


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--exe',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--root',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    reports,images={},{}
    close=['--camera','230','110','245','--look-at','262','105','255']
    variants={'day':[],'motion':['--time','1'],'night':['--hour','22'],
              'shadow':close,'unshadowed':close+['--no-shadows']}
    for name,extra in variants.items():
        report,image=args.output/(name+'.json'),args.output/(name+'.png')
        subprocess.run([str(args.exe),'--root',str(args.root),'--map','Map02','--smoke',
                        '--report',str(report),'--capture',str(image)]+extra,check=True,timeout=60)
        data=json.loads(report.read_text())
        assert data['ready'] and data['environment_ready'] and data['original_shader_injections']==5
        assert data['animated_draws']>0 and data['visible_object_gpu_samples']>0
        assert data['shadow_depth_pixels']>0 if name!='unshadowed' else data['shadow_depth_pixels']==0
        reports[name]=data;images[name]=png_rgb(image)
    motion=changed(images['day'],images['motion'])
    night=changed(images['day'],images['night'])
    shadow=changed(images['shadow'],images['unshadowed'])
    assert motion>100, f'Original shader animation not visible: {motion}'
    assert shadow>10000, f'Shadow depth is populated but casting is not visible: {shadow}'
    assert night>images['day'][0]*images['day'][1]//2
    assert sum(images['night'][2]) < sum(images['day'][2])*0.4
    summary=dict(scope='Original sky mesh/textures, recovered Lua curves and five compiled GE6 shader injections; authored single-map shadow host',
                 status='passed',map='Map02',shaderInjections=5,originalCurveSamples=1441,
                 animatedDraws=reports['day']['animated_draws'],motionChangedPixels=motion,
                 nightChangedPixels=night,shadowChangedPixels=shadow,
                 shadowDepthPixels=reports['shadow']['shadow_depth_pixels'],shadowResolution=reports['shadow']['shadow_resolution'],
                 dayImageSha256=hashlib.sha256((args.output/'day.png').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                 nightImageSha256=hashlib.sha256((args.output/'night.png').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    (args.root/'analysis/environment-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':
```
