```cpp
// Authored ownership invariants; original-code comparisons are Windows-only.
#include "scene_lifecycle.h"
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>

namespace {
void require(bool value,const char* message){if(!value)throw std::runtime_error(message);}
struct Owner {
    std::map<void*,size_t> allocations;
    std::map<uint32_t,void*> registry;
    std::map<void*,unsigned> kinds;
    std::vector<uint32_t> deleted;
    std::vector<uint32_t> registration_flags;
    uint32_t sequence=0xfffffffe;
    int fail_after=-1;
    FS15SceneLifecycleServices services{};
    Owner() {
        services={this,allocate,release,next,registered,unregistered,unlink,destroy_child};
    }
    ~Owner(){for(const auto& entry:allocations)std::free(entry.first);}
    static Owner& self(void* user){return *static_cast<Owner*>(user);}
    static void* allocate(void* user,size_t size) {
        auto& owner=self(user);
        if(owner.fail_after==0)return nullptr;
        if(owner.fail_after>0)--owner.fail_after;
        void* p=std::malloc(size);
        if(p){std::memset(p,0xa5,size);owner.allocations.emplace(p,size);}
        return p;
    }
    static void release(void* user,void* pointer) {
        if(!pointer)return;
        auto& owner=self(user);
        if(!owner.allocations.erase(pointer))std::abort();
        std::free(pointer);
    }
    static uint32_t next(void* user){return ++self(user).sequence;}
    static void registered(void* user,uint32_t id,void* object) {
        auto& owner=self(user);owner.registry.emplace(id,object);
        owner.registration_flags.push_back(static_cast<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(object)->type_flags);
    }
    static void unregistered(void* user,uint32_t id,void*) {
        auto& owner=self(user);owner.registry.erase(id);owner.deleted.push_back(id);
    }
    static int unlink(void*,void* parent,uint32_t slot,int suppress) {
        auto& p=*static_cast<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(parent);
        if(!suppress||p.vtable!=0x1404c7dd0)return 0;
        auto* children=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(p.children_begin);
        const size_t count=(p.children_end-p.children_begin)/sizeof(uintptr_t);
        if(slot>=count)return 0;
        reinterpret_cast<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(children[slot])->parent=0;
        std::memmove(children+slot,children+slot+1,(count-slot-1)*sizeof(uintptr_t));
        p.children_end-=sizeof(uintptr_t);return 1;
    }
    static int destroy_child(void* user,void* object) {
        auto& owner=self(user);
        return fs15_scene_destruct(object,sizeof(FS15SceneStateRecord),owner.kinds.at(object),1,&owner.services);
    }
    FS15SceneStateRecord* create(unsigned kind,const char* name,uint32_t tag=42) {
        auto* object=static_cast<FS15SceneStateRecord*>(allocate(this,sizeof(FS15SceneStateRecord)));
        require(object&&fs15_scene_construct(object,sizeof(*object),kind,name,std::strlen(name)+1,tag,1,&services),"Create recovered object");
        kinds.emplace(object,kind);return object;
    }
    void children(FS15SceneStateRecord* parent,std::initializer_list<FS15SceneStateRecord*> list) {
        auto* slots=static_cast<uintptr_t*>(allocate(this,list.size()*sizeof(uintptr_t)));size_t at=0;
        for(auto* child:list){slots[at++]=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(child);child->parent=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(parent);}
        parent->children_begin=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(slots);
        parent->children_end=parent->children_capacity=parent->children_begin+list.size()*sizeof(uintptr_t);
    }
};
void run() {
    Owner owner;auto* root=owner.create(FS15_OBJECT_TRS,"farm-root");
    require(root->type_flags==0x72&&root->flags==0x41,"Recovered TRS flags");
    require(root->local[0]==1&&root->local[5]==1&&root->local[10]==1&&root->local[15]==1,"Recovered identity local matrix");
    require(root->translation[0]==0&&root->rotation[2]==0&&root->scale[0]==1&&root->scale[2]==1,"Recovered initial TRS cache");
    require(root->local_clip[0]==1000000&&root->local_clip[1]==0&&root->local_masks[0]==0xffff&&root->local_masks[1]==0xffffffff,"Recovered clip and mask defaults");
    uint32_t opaque=0;std::memcpy(&opaque,root->world,4);
    require(opaque==0xa5a5a5a5,"Constructor preserves opaque lazy world cache bytes");
    require(root->class_tag==0x1d,"TRS constructor fixes class tag");
    auto* first=owner.create(FS15_OBJECT_MATRIX,"");auto* second=owner.create(FS15_OBJECT_TRS_TYPED,"tractor",77);
    auto* grandchild=owner.create(FS15_OBJECT_NODE,"attachment");
    require(owner.registry.count(0xffffffff)&&owner.registry.count(0)&&owner.registry.count(1)&&owner.registry.count(2),"Identifiers wrap as native uint32");
    for(uint32_t flags:owner.registration_flags)require(flags==0,"Registration occurs before derived type flags");
    require(second->class_tag==77,"Typed TRS constructor retains class tag");
    require(fs15_scene_rename(first,sizeof(*first),"",1,&owner.services)&&first->name&&*reinterpret_cast<char*>(first->name)==0,"Empty rename allocates a NUL string");
    require(fs15_scene_rename(second,sizeof(*second),"vehicle",8,&owner.services),"Rename existing object");
    auto* current=reinterpret_cast<char*>(second->name);
    require(!fs15_scene_rename(second,sizeof(*second),current+6,2,&owner.services)&&std::strcmp(current,"vehicle")==0,"Reject aliased rename before freeing");
    owner.children(root,{first,second});owner.children(second,{grandchild});
    require(fs15_scene_destruct(root,sizeof(*root),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&owner.services),"Delete recovered owned forest");
    require(owner.deleted==std::vector<uint32_t>({0,2,1,0xffffffff}),"Children are deleted in order, descendants before parent");
    require(owner.registry.empty()&&owner.allocations.empty(),"All names, sentinels, properties, child vectors and objects released");

    Owner guards;auto* protected_node=guards.create(FS15_OBJECT_TRS,"protected");
    auto* props=reinterpret_cast<FS15ScenePropertyView*>(protected_node->properties);
    props->flags=0x1008;const auto count=guards.allocations.size();
    require(!fs15_scene_destruct(protected_node,sizeof(*protected_node),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&guards.services)&&guards.allocations.size()==count&&guards.registry.size()==1,"Active-trigger teardown rejects before external frees");
    props->flags=0;auto* bytes=reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(protected_node);
    protected_node->attribute_count=1;
    require(!fs15_scene_destruct(protected_node,sizeof(*protected_node),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&guards.services)&&guards.allocations.size()==count,"Nonempty attribute teardown rejects before frees");
    protected_node->attribute_count=0;
    const uint64_t original_property_table=props->unknown00;props->unknown00=123;
    require(!fs15_scene_destruct(protected_node,sizeof(*protected_node),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&guards.services)&&guards.allocations.size()==count,"Unknown derived property destructor rejects before frees");
    props->unknown00=original_property_table;
    uintptr_t resource=123;std::memcpy(bytes+0x120,&resource,sizeof(resource));
    require(!fs15_scene_destruct(protected_node,sizeof(*protected_node),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&guards.services)&&guards.allocations.size()==count,"Unrecovered shared resource rejects before frees");
    resource=0;std::memcpy(bytes+0x120,&resource,sizeof(resource));
    const auto snapshot=*protected_node;
    require(!fs15_scene_rename(protected_node,sizeof(*protected_node),"unterminated",5,&guards.services)&&std::memcmp(&snapshot,protected_node,sizeof(snapshot))==0,"Reject unterminated name before mutation");
    require(fs15_scene_destruct(protected_node,sizeof(*protected_node),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&guards.services),"Delete after unsupported state cleared");

    for(int failure=0;failure<3;++failure) {
        Owner failing;FS15SceneStateRecord record;std::memset(&record,0xa5,sizeof(record));failing.fail_after=failure;
        require(!fs15_scene_construct(&record,sizeof(record),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,"name",5,0,1,&failing.services)&&failing.allocations.empty()&&failing.registry.empty(),"Allocation failure releases acquired members and registry entry");
    }
}
}
int main() {
    try {run();std::cout<<"Recovered scene object lifetime invariants passed; platform allocator/registry/dispatch are authored services.\n";return 0;}
    catch(const std::exception& error){std::cerr<<error.what()<<'\n';return 1;}
}
```

```cpp
        if(i)deep[i].parent=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&deep[i-1]);
        if(i<links.size()) {
            links[i]=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&deep[i+1]);
            deep[i].children_begin=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&links[i]);
            deep[i].children_end=deep[i].children_begin+sizeof(uintptr_t);
        }
    }
    FS15SceneStateArena deep_arena={deep.data(),deep.size()*sizeof(deep[0]),sizeof(deep[0]),
        links.data(),links.size(),nullptr,0,nullptr,0,kinds.data(),kinds.size(),0};
    require(!fs15_scene_state_update(&deep_arena,0,FS15_SCENE_MARK_INHERITED,0,0,events.data(),events.size(),&used),"Excessive descendant depth rejected");
    for(const auto& node:deep)require(node.flags==0,"Depth guard preserves complete tree");
}
}
int main() {
    try {run();std::cout<<"Recovered scene state and authored bounded-view guards passed. No allocator or engine startup tested.\n";return 0;}
    catch(const std::exception& e){std::cerr<<e.what()<<'\n';return 1;}
```

```cpp
// Independent ownership/binding invariants; original-code proof is separate.
#include "shared_scene.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace {
void require(bool ok,const char* message){if(!ok)throw std::runtime_error(message);}
struct Owner {
    std::map<void*,size_t> blocks;std::map<uint32_t,void*> registry;uint32_t id=0;int fail_after=-1;
    FS15SharedSceneContext context{};FS15SceneLifecycleServices services{};
    Owner(){services={this,allocate,release,next,registered,unregistered,nullptr,nullptr,shared};}
    ~Owner(){for(const auto& b:blocks)std::free(b.first);}
    static void* allocate(void* u,size_t size) {
        auto& o=*static_cast<Owner*>(u);if(o.fail_after==0)return nullptr;if(o.fail_after>0)--o.fail_after;
        void* p=std::malloc(size);if(p){std::memset(p,0xa5,size);o.blocks.emplace(p,size);}return p;
    }
    static void release(void* u,void* p){if(p){auto& o=*static_cast<Owner*>(u);if(!o.blocks.erase(p))std::abort();std::free(p);}}
    static uint32_t next(void* u){return ++static_cast<Owner*>(u)->id;}
    static void registered(void* u,uint32_t id,void* p){static_cast<Owner*>(u)->registry.emplace(id,p);}
    static void unregistered(void* u,uint32_t id,void*){static_cast<Owner*>(u)->registry.erase(id);}
    static int shared(void* u,void* p){auto& o=*static_cast<Owner*>(u);return fs15_shared_scene_release(p,0x10,&o.context,&o.services);}
    template<class T>T* memory(){auto* p=static_cast<T*>(allocate(this,sizeof(T)));require(p!=nullptr,"Allocate fixture record");return p;}
    FS15CharacterSet* set(FS15CharacterData* data=nullptr) {
        auto* p=memory<FS15CharacterSet>();require(fs15_character_set_construct(p,sizeof(*p),"set",4,data,&context,&services),"Construct CharacterSet");return p;
    }
    FS15SceneStateRecord* node() {
        auto* p=memory<FS15SceneStateRecord>();require(fs15_scene_construct(p,sizeof(*p),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,"bone",5,0,1,&services),"Construct bone");return p;
    }
    void clear_context() {
        require(context.active.begin==context.active.end&&context.pending.begin==context.pending.end,"All observers removed");
        release(this,reinterpret_cast<void*>(context.active.begin));release(this,reinterpret_cast<void*>(context.pending.begin));context={};
    }
};
void run() {
    Owner o;auto* data=o.memory<FS15CharacterData>();require(fs15_character_data_construct(data,sizeof(*data)),"Construct shared data");
    auto* first=o.set(data);auto* second=o.set(data);
    require(data->references==2&&first->references==0&&first->reference_table==0x1404c9688,"Native data ownership and embedded interface");
    require(first->state[0]==0&&first->state[8]==1&&first->state[12]==0&&first->state[16]==1,"Native initial animation state");
    std::array<FS15SceneStateRecord*,3> bones={o.node(),o.node(),o.node()};
    for(size_t i=0;i<bones.size();++i){bones[i]->translation[0]=float(i*2);bones[i]->translation[1]=3;bones[i]->scale[0]=2;}
    int diagnostic=-1;
    require(fs15_character_set_bind(first,bones.data(),bones.size(),&o.context,&o.services,&diagnostic)&&diagnostic==0,"Bind default poses");
    require(first->references==3&&first->flags==0x101&&data->visibility_count==3&&data->translation.end-data->translation.begin==36,"Pose and visibility counts");
    const auto* positions=reinterpret_cast<const float*>(data->translation.begin);
    require(positions[0]==0&&positions[1]==3&&positions[6]==4&&reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(data->visibility_words.begin)[0]==7,"Original translation and visibility data");
    ++first->references;
    require(fs15_character_set_bind(second,bones.data(),bones.size(),&o.context,&o.services,&diagnostic)&&first->references==1&&second->references==3&&data->references==2,"Rebinding releases old transform references without duplicating shared data");
    require(fs15_shared_scene_release(reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(first)+0x28,0x10,&o.context,&o.services)&&data->references==1,"Last old-set reference deletes set and retains shared pose data");
    for(auto* bone:bones)require(fs15_scene_destruct(bone,sizeof(*bone),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&o.services),"Node lifetime releases CharacterSet reference");
    o.clear_context();require(o.blocks.empty()&&o.registry.empty(),"Last node releases both set and data");

    Owner prefix;auto* set=prefix.set();auto* valid=prefix.node();auto* invalid=prefix.node();invalid->type_flags&=~uint32_t(0x40);
    std::array<FS15SceneStateRecord*,2> mixed={valid,invalid};
    require(fs15_character_set_bind(set,mixed.data(),2,&prefix.context,&prefix.services,&diagnostic)&&diagnostic==1&&set->references==1&&set->flags==0&&invalid->shared_resource==0,"Non-TRS warning preserves native bound prefix");
    require(fs15_scene_destruct(valid,sizeof(*valid),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&prefix.services)&&fs15_scene_destruct(invalid,sizeof(*invalid),FS15_OBJECT_TRS,1,&prefix.services),"Clean up warning prefix");
    prefix.clear_context();require(prefix.blocks.empty(),"Warning prefix owns no leaked resources");

    Owner guard;uint64_t unknown[2]={123,10};
    require(!fs15_shared_scene_release(unknown,sizeof(unknown),&guard.context,&guard.services)&&unknown[1]==10,"Reject unknown resource dispatch before decrement");
    FS15SceneStateRecord record{};
    for(int failure=0;failure<3;++failure) {
        guard.fail_after=failure;
        FS15CharacterSet failed{};
        require(!fs15_character_set_construct(&failed,sizeof(failed),"set",4,nullptr,&guard.context,&guard.services)&&guard.blocks.empty()&&guard.registry.empty(),"Failed shared construction cleans acquired storage and registration");
    }
    (void)record;
}
}
```

```cpp
#include "../src/engine/simulation_clock.h"
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>

static void require(bool value,const char* reason){if(!value)throw std::runtime_error(reason);}
int main(){try{
    for(unsigned hz:{5,15,30,60,144,240}){
        SimulationClock clock;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<hz*10;++i)clock.advance(1.0/hz);
        require(clock.ticks()==600,"Simulation tick count depends on render rate");
        require(clock.discarded_seconds()==0,"Normal frame time was discarded");
    }
    SimulationClock irregular;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<100;++i){irregular.advance(0.001);irregular.advance(0.004);irregular.advance(0.025);}
    require(irregular.ticks()==180,"Irregular frame partitions changed simulation duration");
    SimulationClock stalled;
    require(stalled.advance(10)==15,"Stall recovery is not bounded to 15 ticks");
    require(std::abs(stalled.discarded_seconds()-9.75)<1e-9,"Discarded stall time was not accounted for");
    stalled.advance(SimulationClock::step_seconds/2);stalled.set_paused(true);
    require(stalled.advance(120)==0&&stalled.ticks()==15,"Pause advanced simulation");
    stalled.set_paused(false);
    require(stalled.advance(SimulationClock::step_seconds/2)==0,"Pause retained fractional catch-up debt");
    require(stalled.advance(SimulationClock::step_seconds/2)==1,"Resume did not accept new elapsed time");
    for(double value:{-1.0,std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(),std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN()}){
        bool rejected=false;try{stalled.advance(value);}catch(const std::invalid_argument&){rejected=true;}
        require(rejected,"Invalid elapsed time accepted");
    }
    std::cout<<"Fixed-step rates, irregular frames, stalls, pause/resume and invalid elapsed-time checks pass\n";
    return 0;
}catch(const std::exception& error){std::cerr<<error.what()<<'\n';return 1;}}
```

`tests/test_gar.py`:

```py
"""Format validation tests with synthetic records, not original game data."""
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts"))
from gar import GarArchive, safe_relative_name, normalize_luajit


def fixture(names=("scripts/example.lua",), contents=(b"return 1",)):
    header = bytearray(512)
    header[0x60:0x64] = b"GAR "
    struct.pack_into("<III", header, 0x64, 0x50003, 0, len(names))
    index = bytearray()
    payload = bytearray()
    start = 512 + len(names) * 512
    for name, content in zip(names, contents):
        padding = 8 - len(content) % 8
        padded = content + bytes([padding]) * padding
        record = bytearray(512)
        struct.pack_into("<IIQQQQ", record, 0, 1, 0, len(padded), len(content), start + len(payload), 0)
        encoded_name = name.encode("utf-8")
        record[40:40 + len(encoded_name)] = encoded_name
        index.extend(record)
        payload.extend(padded)
    return header + index + payload


class GarTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.fixture_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "build/test-fixtures"
        self.fixture_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=self.fixture_root)
        self.path = Path(self.temporary.name) / "synthetic.gar"

    def tearDown(self):
        if not Path(self.temporary.name).resolve().is_relative_to(self.fixture_root.resolve()):
            raise RuntimeError("Temporary test directory escaped the workspace")
        self.temporary.cleanup()

    def archive(self, data, decrypt=lambda data: data):
        self.path.write_bytes(data)
        return GarArchive(self.path, decrypt)

    def test_valid_record_and_exact_payload_length(self):
        with self.archive(fixture()) as archive:
            self.assertEqual(archive.header_counts, (0, 1))
            self.assertEqual(archive.entries[0].name, "scripts/example.lua")
            self.assertEqual(archive.read(archive.entries[0]), b"return 1")

    def test_both_header_counts_are_added(self):
        data = fixture(("a", "b"), (b"A", b"B"))
        struct.pack_into("<II", data, 0x68, 1, 1)
        with self.archive(data) as archive:
            self.assertEqual([archive.read(entry) for entry in archive.entries], [b"A", b"B"])

    def test_unsafe_paths_rejected(self):
        for name in ("../escape", "a/../../escape", "/absolute", "C:/absolute", "a//b", "a/./b", "\\\\server\\file", "a\0b"):
            with self.subTest(name=name), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                safe_relative_name(name)

    def test_archive_traversal_rejected_before_writing(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Unsafe archive path"):
            self.archive(fixture(("../escape",)))

    def test_windows_device_names_and_aliases_rejected(self):
        for name in ("NUL", "a/CON.lua", "LPT1.xml", "COM9", ".. /escape", "a./file", "file ", "file?.lua"):
            with self.subTest(name=name), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                safe_relative_name(name)

    def test_case_collision_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Colliding archive path"):
            self.archive(fixture(("File.lua", "file.lua"), (b"a", b"b")))

    def test_bad_magic_rejected(self):
        data = fixture()
        data[0x60] = 0
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "supported GAR"):
            self.archive(data)

    def test_other_version_rejected(self):
        data = fixture()
        struct.pack_into("<I", data, 0x64, 0x50002)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "version"):
            self.archive(data)

    def test_index_count_cannot_exceed_file(self):
        data = fixture()
        struct.pack_into("<I", data, 0x6c, 0xffffffff)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "index extends"):
            self.archive(data)

    def test_short_decoded_index_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "index length"):
            self.archive(fixture(), lambda data: data[:-1])

    def test_payload_outside_archive_rejected(self):
        data = fixture()
        struct.pack_into("<Q", data, 512 + 24, len(data) + 8)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "outside the archive"):
            self.archive(data)

    def test_overlapping_payloads_rejected(self):
        data = fixture(("a", "b"), (b"A", b"B"))
        first_offset = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, 512 + 24)[0]
        struct.pack_into("<Q", data, 1024 + 24, first_offset)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Overlapping payload"):
            self.archive(data)

    def test_impossible_plain_length_rejected(self):
        data = fixture()
        struct.pack_into("<Q", data, 512 + 16, 1000)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "padding"):
            self.archive(data)

    def test_unknown_record_metadata_rejected(self):
        data = fixture()
        struct.pack_into("<I", data, 512 + 4, 1)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Unsupported GAR record"):
            self.archive(data)

    def test_unterminated_name_rejected(self):
        data = fixture()
        data[512 + 40:1024] = b"A" * (512 - 40)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Unterminated name"):
            self.archive(data)

    def test_script_version_two_is_unchanged(self):
        source = b"\x1bLJ\x02\x00\x01test"
        self.assertEqual(normalize_luajit(source, bytes(range(8))), (source, False))

    def test_script_version_three_known_transform(self):
        source = b"\x1bLJ\x03" + b"\x00" * 8
        expected = b"\x1bLJ\x02\x08\x0a\x0c\x0e\x08\x0a\x0c\x0e"
        self.assertEqual(normalize_luajit(source, bytes(range(8))), (expected, True))

    def test_text_script_is_unchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual(normalize_luajit(b"return 42", bytes(8)), (b"return 42", False))

    def test_invalid_script_key_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            normalize_luajit(b"\x1bLJ\x03", b"short")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ge6_linux_boot_evidence.py`:

```py
"""Authored logs test provenance parsing, not original engine execution."""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts'))
from ge6_linux_images import LOCAL_IMAGE
from verify_ge6_linux_boot import verify


class BootEvidenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_local_input_is_explicitly_modified(self):
        result = self.parse('local-platform')
        self.assertEqual(result['original_image_sha256'], LOCAL_IMAGE)
        self.assertTrue(result['native_instruction_patches'])
        self.assertFalse(result['linux_loader_patches_instructions'])
        self.assertFalse(result['menu_verified'])
        self.assertEqual(result['stopped_at']['symbol'], 'ordinal:115')
        self.assertIn('src/ge6_linux/network_services.h', result['committed_source_sha256'])

    def test_local_input_cannot_be_reported_as_reference(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'provenance'):
            self.parse('reference')

    def test_faulted_run_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'faulted'):
            self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_NATIVE_FAULT signal=11\n')

    def test_startup_journal_does_not_establish_complete_engine_boot(self):
        result = self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_ORIGINAL_LOG_BEGIN\nGIANTS Engine Runtime 6.0.2 64bit (authored fixture)\nGE6_ORIGINAL_LOG_END\n')
        self.assertTrue(result['original_core_startup_log_observed'])
        self.assertIsNotNone(result['captured_original_log_sha256'])
        self.assertFalse(result['full_engine_initialization_verified'])
        self.assertFalse(result['menu_verified'])

    def test_worker_entry_without_native_os_call_is_not_execution_evidence(self):
        result = self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_NATIVE_THREAD_ENTER entry=0x140043620 tid=12 code=0\n')
        self.assertEqual(result['original_workers_with_os_calls'], [])

    def test_null_audio_startup_log_does_not_establish_audible_sound(self):
        result = self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_VM_AUDIO_BACKEND=null\nGE6_ORIGINAL_LOG_BEGIN\nSound System\n  Driver: OpenAL\nGE6_ORIGINAL_LOG_END\n')
        self.assertTrue(result['original_audio_startup_log_observed'])
        self.assertEqual(result['vm_audio_backend'], 'null')
        self.assertFalse(result['audible_audio_verified'])
        self.assertFalse(result['full_engine_initialization_verified'])

    def test_console_registration_is_not_callback_execution(self):
        result = self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_CONSOLE_REGISTER entry=0x1404009d8 event=0 tid=12\n')
        self.assertEqual(result['original_console_handlers_registered'], ['0x1404009d8'])
        self.assertEqual(result['original_console_callback_returns'], [])
        result = self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_CONSOLE_REGISTER entry=0x1404009d8 event=0 tid=12\nGE6_CONSOLE_CALL entry=0x1404009d8 event=0 tid=13\nGE6_CONSOLE_HANDLED entry=0x1404009d8 event=0 tid=13\n')
        self.assertEqual(result['original_console_callback_returns'], [dict(entry='0x1404009d8', event=0, linux_tid=13, handled=True)])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'matching registered'):
            self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_CONSOLE_HANDLED entry=0x1404009d8 event=0 tid=13\n')

    def test_window_class_registration_does_not_establish_an_os_window(self):
        result = self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_WINDOW_CLASS_REGISTER atom=49152 procedure=0x14037cf00\nGE6_IMAGE_RESOURCE_ABSENT first=1814 second=0\n')
        self.assertEqual(result['original_window_classes_registered'], [dict(atom=49152, procedure='0x14037cf00')])
        self.assertTrue(result['missing_optional_icon_observed'])
        self.assertFalse(result['original_renderer_initialized'])
        self.assertFalse(result['menu_verified'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Window class atom/procedure'):
            self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_WINDOW_CLASS_REGISTER atom=0 procedure=0x14037cf00\n')

    def test_worker_execution_requires_matching_image_entry(self):
        result = self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_NATIVE_THREAD_ENTER entry=0x140043620 tid=12 code=0\nGE6_NATIVE_THREAD_FIRST_OS name=SetEvent entry=0x140043620 tid=12\n')
        self.assertEqual(result['original_workers_with_os_calls'], [dict(entry='0x140043620', linux_tid=12, first_os_call='SetEvent')])
        self.assertFalse(result['original_worker_shutdown_verified'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Worker OS-call'):
            self.parse('local-platform', 'GE6_NATIVE_THREAD_FIRST_OS name=SetEvent entry=0x140043620 tid=13\n')

    def parse(self, kind, extra=''):
        fixtures = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'build/test-fixtures/ge6-boot-evidence'
        fixtures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=fixtures) as directory:
            log = Path(directory) / 'authored.log'
            executable = Path(directory) / 'authored.elf'
            executable.write_bytes(b'authored test payload')
            log.write_text('GE6_LINUX_VM_STARTED\nLinux authored-fixture\n'
                           'GE6_VM_IMAGE_KIND=local-platform\nGE6_IMAGE_KIND=local-platform\n'
                           'GE6_IMAGE_MAPPED base=0x140000000 entry=0x1403fc96c supported_imports=83 blocked_imports=341\n'
                           'GE6_NATIVE_NT_TIB_READY\nGE6_ORIGINAL_CRT_ENTER\n'
                           'GE6_ORIGINAL_MAIN_REACHED caller=0x14000c9f5\n'
                           'GE6_BLOCKED_IMPORT WS2_32.dll!ordinal:115 caller=0x1400011cc os_calls=160\n'
                           'GE6_LINUX_VM_RESULT=78\n' + extra)
            def git_output(args, **kwargs):
                if args[1] == 'ls-tree':
                    return b'src/ge6_linux/network_services.h\n'
                return 'a' * 40 if args[1] == 'rev-parse' else b'authored source fixture'
            with patch('verify_ge6_linux_boot.subprocess.check_output', side_effect=git_output):
                result = verify(log, executable, 'HEAD', 1, kind)
            self.assertEqual(result['private_serial_log_sha256'], hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ge6_linux_vm.py`:

```py
"""Authored payloads validate private VM packaging; no original code executes."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts'))
from check_ge6_linux_vm import archive_entries, build_initramfs


class VmPackagingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_integrity_inputs_are_preserved_with_unique_parent_directories(self):
        fixtures = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'build/test-fixtures/ge6-vm'
        fixtures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=fixtures) as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            alpine, executable, image = (root / name for name in ('alpine', 'elf', 'image'))
            for item in (alpine, executable, image):
                item.write_bytes(b'authored fixture')
            resources = root / 'resources'
            names = ('game.xml', 'FarmingSimulator2015.xml', 'VERSION', 'steamdata.dat', 'crc_files.xml',
                     'data/maps/map01.i3d', 'data/maps/map01/map01_dem.png')
            for name in names:
                path = resources / name
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.write_bytes(('unchanged authored input: ' + name).encode())
            alpine_entries = [('usr/bin/busybox', b'authored busybox'), ('usr/lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1', b'authored libc')]
            with patch('check_ge6_linux_vm.image_kind', return_value='fixture'), patch('check_ge6_linux_vm.archive_entries', return_value=alpine_entries):
                payload = build_initramfs(alpine, executable, image, resources, integrity=True)
            entries = list(archive_entries(payload))
            self.assertEqual(len(entries), len(dict(entries)))
            unpacked = dict(entries)
            for name in names:
                self.assertEqual(unpacked['game/' + name], (resources / name).read_bytes())
                digest = hashlib.sha256((resources / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                self.assertIn(f'path={name} sha256={digest}'.encode(), unpacked['init'])
            self.assertIn('game/data/maps/map01', unpacked)
            self.assertNotIn('game/dataS.gar', unpacked)
            self.assertIn(b'-profile Z:/profile', unpacked['init'])
            self.assertIn(b'export ALSOFT_DRIVERS=null', unpacked['init'])
            self.assertIn(b'GE6_VM_AUDIO_BACKEND=null', unpacked['init'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

```py
"""Authored log fixtures verify evidence boundaries, not game execution."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'scripts'))
from verify_ge6_x11_boot import observations

LOG='''Linux fixture 6.0 x86_64 Linux
GE6_GRAPHICS_ENV=X11 DISPLAY=:99 LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 ALSOFT_DRIVERS=null
GE6_IMAGE_KIND=local-platform
GE6_IMAGE_MAPPED base=0x140000000 entry=0x1403fc96c supported_imports=200 blocked_imports=224
GE6_NATIVE_NT_TIB_READY
GE6_ORIGINAL_CRT_ENTER
GE6_ORIGINAL_MAIN_REACHED
GE6_X11_WINDOW_CREATE hwnd=0x10 xid=0x20 width=1280 height=720 mapped=0 procedure=0x14037cf00 caller=0x1403833ce
GE6_X11_DC window=0x10 dc=0x30 drawable=0x20
GE6_X11_WINDOW_SHOW hwnd=0x10 visible=1 caller=0x14035a374
GE6_GLX_CONTEXT_CREATE handle=0x40 dc=0x30 caller=0x1403820dc
GE6_GLX_CURRENT handle=0x40 renderer=Authored fixture version=0.0 fixture caller=0x140381e2b
GE6_BLOCKED_IMPORT GDI32.dll!GetDeviceGammaRamp caller=0x140382f02 os_calls=2000
GE6_X11_WINDOW_SNAPSHOT hwnd=0x10 xid=0x20 width=1280 height=720 viewable=1 procedure=0x14037cf00
GE6_X11_CAPTURE_SAVED width=1280 height=720 path=/work/fixture.png
GE6_GRAPHICS_RESULT=78
'''


class X11EvidenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_explicit_x11_display_is_recorded(self):
        self.assertEqual(observations(LOG.replace('DISPLAY=:99','DISPLAY=:98'))['x11_display'],':98')

    def test_bounded_run_is_not_complete_startup(self):
        text=LOG.replace('GE6_BLOCKED_IMPORT GDI32.dll!GetDeviceGammaRamp caller=0x140382f02 os_calls=2000\n','').replace('GE6_GRAPHICS_RESULT=78','GE6_GRAPHICS_BOUNDED_TIMEOUT seconds=90 elapsed=90.100\nGE6_GRAPHICS_RESULT=143')
        result=observations(text)
        self.assertEqual(result['stopped_at']['kind'],'controlled-test-timeout')
        self.assertFalse(result['stopped_at']['startup_completion_verified'])
        self.assertFalse(result['menu_verified'])
        for bad in (text.replace('elapsed=90.100','elapsed=2.000'),text.replace('GE6_GRAPHICS_BOUNDED_TIMEOUT','absent-marker'),text+'GE6_NATIVE_FAULT signal=8\n'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                observations(bad)

    def test_visible_context_is_not_rendering_or_playability(self):
        result=observations(LOG)
        self.assertTrue(result['original_main_window']['viewable'])
        self.assertEqual(result['original_main_window_gl_context']['dc'],'0x30')
        for field in ('original_frame_rendered','original_renderer_initialized','menu_verified','playable_game_verified'):
            self.assertFalse(result[field])

    def test_hidden_window_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'visible window'):
            observations(LOG.replace('viewable=1','viewable=0'))

    def test_probe_context_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Probe contexts'):
            observations(LOG.replace('caller=0x1403820dc','caller=0x140381837'))

    def test_unrelated_dc_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Probe contexts'):
            observations(LOG.replace('window=0x10 dc=0x30','window=0x99 dc=0x30'))

    def test_fault_and_reference_provenance_are_rejected(self):
        for log in (LOG+'GE6_NATIVE_FAULT signal=11\n',LOG.replace('local-platform','reference')):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'faulted or wrong-provenance'):
                observations(log)

    def test_draw_and_swap_use_the_original_main_context(self):
        drawing='GE6_NATIVE_GL_CALL name=glDrawArrays caller=0x14006560d context=0x40\n'
        swap='GE6_NATIVE_SWAP frame=1 draws=2 dc=0x30 context=0x40 caller=0x14000922e\n'
        result=observations(LOG+drawing+swap)
        self.assertEqual(result['original_gl_calls'][0]['name'],'glDrawArrays')
        self.assertEqual(result['original_buffer_swaps'][0]['draw_calls'],2)
        self.assertFalse(result['original_frame_rendered']) # Call logs alone do not confirm pixels.
        self.assertFalse(observations(LOG+swap.replace('dc=0x30','dc=0x99'))['original_buffer_swaps'])

    def test_authored_host_drawing_is_not_original_execution(self):
        for extra in ('GE6_NATIVE_GL_CALL name=glDrawArrays caller=0x1234 context=0x40\n',
                      'GE6_NATIVE_SWAP frame=1 draws=2 dc=0x30 context=0x40 caller=0x1234\n'):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'outside original image'):
                observations(LOG+extra)
```

```py
def ready_host(root):
    def write(relative,data=b'authored fixture'):
        path=root/relative;path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_bytes(data);return path
    write('FS15EngineRebuilt.exe')
    for name in HOME_FILES:write('recovered/gar/'+name)

    write('recovered/gar/data/vehicles/fixture.runtime.i3d');write('recovered/gar/data/vehicles/fixture.runtime.meshes')
    return write


class LauncherAssets(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_steam_libraries_handle_current_and_legacy_vdf(self):

        self.assertFalse(copy_verified(source,target));self.assertEqual(target.stat().st_mtime_ns,stamp)
        target.write_bytes(b'corrupted');self.assertTrue(copy_verified(source,target));self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(),source.read_bytes())

    def test_interrupted_copy_is_repaired(self):
        source=self.game/'FarmingSimulator2015.xml';target=self.root/'fixture.xml'
        target.with_name(target.name+'.importing').write_bytes(b'interrupted copy')
        self.assertTrue(copy_verified(source,target));self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(),source.read_bytes())
        self.assertFalse(target.with_name(target.name+'.importing').exists())

        except OSError:self.skipTest('Creating directory symlinks requires privileges on this Windows host')

        (self.root/'recovered/gar/data/vehicles/fixture.runtime.meshes').unlink()

        self.assertFalse(any('extract_gar.py' in str(command) for command in commands))

    def test_missing_native_image_reports_the_real_blocker(self):
        self.setup_prepared();(self.root/'recovered/lua/dataS/scripts/fixture.lua').write_bytes(b'changed source')
        with patch('launcher_assets.shutil.which',return_value='authored-pwsh'),redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'native analysis image'):prepare_assets(self.root,self.game,lambda _:self.fail('No game capture or process should start'))
        report=json.loads((self.root/'build/launcher/assets.json').read_text())
        self.assertEqual(report['status'],'failed');self.assertFalse(resource_status(self.root)['home_launch_ready'])

    def test_failed_step_cannot_leave_a_complete_import_marker(self):
        self.setup_prepared()

        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.root/'build/launcher/assets.json').read_text())['status'],'failed')
```

`tests/test_linux_tester_package.py`:

```py
"""Archive extraction guards for the local Linux tester preparation tool."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest

SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('prepare_linux_tester', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'scripts/prepare_linux_tester.py')
PACKAGE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(PACKAGE)


def fixture_directory():
    base = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'build/tester-package-fixtures'
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=base)


class LinuxTesterPackage(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_archive(self, root, extra=None, machine=62, optional=False):
        archive = root/'runtime.tar.gz'
        elf = bytearray(64)
        elf[:6] = b'\x7fELF\x02\x01'
        struct.pack_into('<H', elf, 18, machine)
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'w:gz') as tar:
            for binary in PACKAGE.BINARIES | (PACKAGE.OPTIONAL_BINARIES if optional else set()):
                item = tarfile.TarInfo('bin/'+binary)
                item.size = len(elf)
                tar.addfile(item, io.BytesIO(elf))
            if extra:
                tar.addfile(extra, io.BytesIO(b'x') if extra.isfile() else None)
        (root/'runtime.sha256').write_text(hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+'  runtime.tar.gz\n')
        return archive

    def test_regular_elfs_extract_without_original_resources(self):
        with fixture_directory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            PACKAGE.extract_runtime(self.make_archive(root), root/'result')
            self.assertEqual({p.name for p in (root/'result/bin').iterdir()}, PACKAGE.BINARIES)

    def test_traversal_is_rejected_before_writes(self):
        with fixture_directory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            item = tarfile.TarInfo('../escape')
            item.size = 1
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                PACKAGE.extract_runtime(self.make_archive(root, item), root/'result')
            self.assertFalse((root/'result').exists())
            self.assertFalse((root/'escape').exists())

    def test_optional_gl_check_is_validated_and_preserved(self):
        with fixture_directory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            PACKAGE.extract_runtime(self.make_archive(root, optional=True), root/'result')
            self.assertTrue((root/'result/bin/FS15GLDriverCheck').is_file())

    def test_invalid_optional_gl_check_is_rejected_before_writes(self):
        with fixture_directory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            item = tarfile.TarInfo('bin/FS15GLDriverCheck')
            item.size = 1
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'FS15GLDriverCheck'):
                PACKAGE.extract_runtime(self.make_archive(root, item), root/'result')
            self.assertFalse((root/'result').exists())

    def test_links_are_rejected_before_writes(self):
        with fixture_directory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            item = tarfile.TarInfo('share/link')
            item.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE
            item.linkname = '../../outside'
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                PACKAGE.extract_runtime(self.make_archive(root, item), root/'result')
            self.assertFalse((root/'result').exists())

    def test_wrong_architecture_is_rejected(self):
        with fixture_directory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'x86_64'):
                PACKAGE.extract_runtime(self.make_archive(root, machine=183), root/'result')
            self.assertFalse((root/'result').exists())

    def test_checksum_mismatch_is_rejected(self):
        with fixture_directory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            archive = self.make_archive(root)
            archive.write_bytes(archive.read_bytes()+b'changed')
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'SHA-256'):
                PACKAGE.extract_runtime(archive, root/'result')
            self.assertFalse((root/'result').exists())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

```py
"""Authored PE fixtures for local-runtime preparation. No original code executes."""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys
import unittest
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'scripts'))
from inventory import PE
from prepare_local_engine import local_image


def fixture():
    raw=bytearray(0x4400)
    raw[:2]=b'MZ';struct.pack_into('<I',raw,0x3c,0x80);raw[0x80:0x84]=b'PE\0\0'
    struct.pack_into('<HHIIIHH',raw,0x84,0x8664,4,0,0,0,0xf0,0x22)
    opt=0x98;struct.pack_into('<H',raw,opt,0x20b);struct.pack_into('<I',raw,opt+16,0x1694310)
    struct.pack_into('<Q',raw,opt+24,0x140000000);struct.pack_into('<I',raw,opt+60,0x400)
    struct.pack_into('<H',raw,opt+68,2);struct.pack_into('<I',raw,opt+108,16)
    struct.pack_into('<II',raw,opt+112+8,0x472100,40)
    for i,(name,rva,offset) in enumerate(((b'.text',0xc000,0x400),(b'.crt',0x3fc000,0x1400),
                                         (b'.idata',0x472000,0x2400),(b'.bind',0x1694000,0x3400))):
        header=opt+0xf0+i*40;raw[header:header+8]=name.ljust(8,b'\0')
        struct.pack_into('<IIII',raw,header+8,0x1000,rva,0x1000,offset)
        struct.pack_into('<I',raw,header+36,0x60000020)
    raw[0xc10:0xc15]=bytes.fromhex('48896c2418') # Match only the bounded signature, not a native function.
    struct.pack_into('<IIIII',raw,0x2500,0x472400,0,0,0x472200,0x472420)
    name=b'steam_api64.dll\0';raw[0x2600:0x2600+len(name)]=name
    struct.pack_into('<Q',raw,0x2800,0x472440);struct.pack_into('<Q',raw,0x2820,0x472440)
    symbol=b'\0\0SteamAPI_RunCallbacks\0';raw[0x2840:0x2840+len(symbol)]=symbol
    return bytes(raw)


class LocalEngineImage(unittest.TestCase):
    def patch(self,data):return local_image(data,hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())

    def test_only_explicit_bootstrap_fields_are_changed(self):
        source=fixture();result=self.patch(source)
        self.assertEqual(len(source),len(result));self.assertEqual(PE(result).entry_rva,0x3fc96c)
        self.assertEqual(PE(result).imports()[0]['dll'],'fs15_local.dll')
        self.assertEqual(result[0xc10],0xc3)
        allowed=set(range(0x98+16,0x98+20))|{0xc10}|set(range(0x2600,0x2600+16))
        self.assertTrue(all(a==b or i in allowed for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(source,result))))
        self.assertEqual(PE(source).entry_rva,0x1694310)

    def test_unpinned_image_is_rejected_before_parsing(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'pinned'):local_image(fixture())

    def test_changed_native_signature_is_rejected(self):
        source=bytearray(fixture());source[0xc10]=0
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'signature'):self.patch(source)

    def test_unknown_import_cannot_reach_the_bounded_adapter(self):
        source=bytearray(fixture());source[0x2842]=ord('X')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'import interface'):self.patch(source)

    def test_ambiguous_library_name_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ambiguous'):self.patch(fixture()+b'steam_api64.dll\0')

    def test_unexpected_tls_or_entry_layout_is_rejected(self):
        source=bytearray(fixture());struct.pack_into('<II',source,0x98+112+9*8,0x1694000,40)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'TLS layout'):self.patch(source)
        source=bytearray(fixture());struct.pack_into('<I',source,0x98+16,0xc810)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'layout'):self.patch(source)


if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_native_descriptors.py`:

```py
"""Authored pseudocode-shaped fixtures; no recovered game code is embedded."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts'))
from index_native_exports import descriptors


class DescriptorRecovery(unittest.TestCase):
    def fixture(self, name_first=False, label=False, service='140031bc0'):
        fields = ['local_a0 = &PTR_FUN_1404b6300;', 'local_40 = "authoredFixtureApi";',
                  'local_38 = ' + ('&LAB_' if label else 'FUN_') + '140111111;']
        if name_first:
            fields[0], fields[1] = fields[1], fields[0]
        call = ('FUN_' + service + '(local_context,' + ('FUN_140222222,' if service == '140031bc0' else '') + '&local_a0);')
        return '\n'.join(fields + [call])

    def test_name_before_vtable_and_wrapper_are_recovered(self):
        rows = list(descriptors(self.fixture(name_first=True), '140333333'))
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 1)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]['name'], 'authoredFixtureApi')
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]['wrapper'], '0x140222222')

    def test_code_label_is_distinguished_from_function(self):
        row = next(descriptors(self.fixture(label=True), '140333333'))
        self.assertEqual(row['implementation_kind'], 'code_label')

    def test_existing_registration_service_remains_supported(self):
        row = next(descriptors(self.fixture(service='140024f50'), '140333333'))
        self.assertNotIn('wrapper', row)

    def test_unrelated_or_stale_slots_do_not_match(self):
        for code in (self.fixture().replace('local_40', 'local_48'),
                     self.fixture().replace('&PTR_FUN_1404b6300', '&PTR_FUN_140000000'),
                     self.fixture().replace('local_38 =', '\n' * 41 + 'local_38 =')):
            self.assertEqual(list(descriptors(code, '140333333')), [])

    def test_reused_descriptor_does_not_reuse_old_name(self):
        code = self.fixture(service='140024f50') + '\nlocal_a0 = &PTR_FUN_1404b6300;\nlocal_38 = FUN_140444444;\nFUN_140024f50(local_context,&local_a0);'
        self.assertEqual(len(list(descriptors(code, '140333333'))), 1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_native_engine.py`:

```py
"""Asset-free staging guards; none of these tests execute a GIANTS runtime."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts'))
from prepare_native_engine import MOD_NAME, WHEELS, prepare
from verify_native_engine import inspect_log, verify


class NativeEnginePreparation(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fixtures = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'build/test-fixtures/native-engine-guards'
        fixtures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=fixtures)
        if not Path(self.temp.name).resolve().is_relative_to(fixtures.resolve()):
            raise AssertionError('Temporary fixture escaped the workspace')
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name) / 'workspace'
        self.game = Path(self.temp.name) / 'installed-game'
        (self.game / 'x64').mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.game / 'FarmingSimulator2015.xml').write_text('<startup/>')
        (self.game / 'x64/FarmingSimulator2015Game.exe').write_bytes(b'authored fixture, not executable')
        self.source = self.root / 'recovered/lua/dataS/scripts/vehicles/WheelsUtil.lua'
        self.source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.source.write_text('WheelsUtil = {}\n')
        (self.root / 'analysis').mkdir()
        row = dict(path=WHEELS, status='exact_match', source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(self.source.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        (self.root / 'analysis/lua-recovery.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(files=[row])))
        probes = self.root / 'src/native_engine'
        probes.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in ('bootstrap.lua', 'verify.lua', 'activate.lua'):
            (probes / name).write_text('-- authored fixture\n')

    def test_isolated_profile_and_source_order(self):
        before = (self.game / 'FarmingSimulator2015.xml').read_bytes()
        manifest = prepare(self.root, self.game)
        self.assertFalse(manifest['native_boot_verified'])
        self.assertFalse(manifest['recovered_script_execution_verified'])
        self.assertEqual(manifest['command'][-2], '-profile')
        self.assertFalse(manifest['command'][-1].endswith('/'))
        mod = Path(manifest['profile']) / 'mods' / MOD_NAME
        sources = ET.parse(mod / 'modDesc.xml').findall('./extraSourceFiles/sourceFile')
        self.assertEqual([x.get('filename') for x in sources], ['bootstrap.lua', 'recovered/WheelsUtil.lua', 'verify.lua'])
        self.assertEqual((mod / 'recovered/WheelsUtil.lua').read_bytes(), self.source.read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual((self.game / 'FarmingSimulator2015.xml').read_bytes(), before)

    def test_changed_source_rejected_before_staging(self):
        self.source.write_text('changed source\n')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'unchanged hash'):
            prepare(self.root, self.game)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'build').exists())

    def test_preferred_bytecode_is_rejected(self):
        manifest = prepare(self.root, self.game)
        (Path(manifest['profile']) / 'mods' / MOD_NAME / 'recovered/WheelsUtil.luc').write_bytes(b'authored fixture')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'neighboring .luc'):
            prepare(self.root, self.game)

    def test_profile_link_outside_workspace_is_rejected(self):
        (self.root / 'build').mkdir()
        try:
            (self.root / 'build/native-engine').symlink_to(self.game, target_is_directory=True)
        except OSError:
            self.skipTest('Directory symlink creation unavailable')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'stay inside'):
            prepare(self.root, self.game)
        self.assertFalse((self.game / 'profile').exists())

    def native_log(self):
        return ('GIANTS Engine Runtime 6.0.2 64bit (authored fixture)\n'
                'OpenGL initialization successful\n'
                'Load mod: FS15_ReconstructionProbe\n'
                'FS15_NATIVE_PROBE_BEGIN\n'
                'FS15_NATIVE_RECOVERED_LUA_OK comparisons=104\n')

    def test_descriptor_discovery_is_not_script_execution(self):
        text = self.native_log().split('FS15_NATIVE_PROBE_BEGIN')[0]
        report = inspect_log(text)
        self.assertTrue(report['native_boot_verified'])
        self.assertFalse(report['recovered_script_execution_verified'])

    def test_order_and_comparison_count_are_required(self):
        for text in (self.native_log().replace('comparisons=104', 'comparisons=103'),
                     self.native_log().replace('FS15_NATIVE_PROBE_BEGIN\n', '') + 'FS15_NATIVE_PROBE_BEGIN\n',
                     self.native_log().replace('GIANTS Engine Runtime', 'Authored test host')):
            self.assertFalse(inspect_log(text)['recovered_script_execution_verified'])

    def test_stale_log_cannot_validate_new_launch(self):
        manifest = prepare(self.root, self.game)
        (Path(manifest['profile']) / 'log.txt').write_text(self.native_log())
        manifest['launch_requested_utc'] = '2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'
        (self.root / 'build/native-engine/manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'predates'):
            verify(self.root)

    def test_lua_failure_prevents_validation(self):
        manifest = prepare(self.root, self.game)
        (Path(manifest['profile']) / 'log.txt').write_text(self.native_log() + 'Error: Running LUA method loadMap\n')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Lua errors'):
            verify(self.root)

    def test_hybrid_activation_is_after_verified_source(self):
        manifest = prepare(self.root, self.game, activate_recovered=True)
        mod = Path(manifest['profile']) / 'mods' / MOD_NAME
        sources = ET.parse(mod / 'modDesc.xml').findall('./extraSourceFiles/sourceFile')
        self.assertEqual([x.get('filename') for x in sources][-2:], ['verify.lua', 'activate.lua'])
        self.assertTrue(manifest['recovered_gameplay_enabled'])

    def test_hybrid_requires_real_helper_calls(self):
        text = self.native_log() + 'FS15_HYBRID_RECOVERED_ACTIVE helpers=3\n'
        self.assertFalse(inspect_log(text)['hybrid_runtime_verified'])
        for helper in ('getTireType', 'getTireFriction', 'getGroundType'):
            text += 'FS15_HYBRID_HELPER_USED name=' + helper + '\n'
        self.assertTrue(inspect_log(text)['hybrid_runtime_verified'])
        self.assertTrue(inspect_log(text.replace('\n', '\r\n'))['hybrid_runtime_verified'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

```py
"""Asset-free checks that an incomplete static graph cannot hide missing work."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'scripts'))
from index_portability import closure


class PortabilityGraph(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_recursive_call_cycles_terminate_and_keep_missing_dependencies(self):
        graph={'a':{'callees':['b','missing']},'b':{'callees':['a','b']}}
        reached,missing=closure(graph,{'a'})
        self.assertEqual(reached,{'a','b','missing'})
        self.assertEqual(missing,{'missing'})

    def test_uncatalogued_roots_are_explicit_and_disconnected_code_stays_out(self):
        graph={'leaf':{'callees':[]},'unrelated':{'callees':[]}}
        self.assertEqual(closure(graph,{'leaf','unknown'}),({'leaf','unknown'},{'unknown'}))
```

`tests/test_public_repo.py`:

```py
"""Publication regressions use authored files and synthetic credentials only."""
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts'))
import check_public_repo as audit


class PublicationHistoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.parent = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'build/test-fixtures').resolve()
        self.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='public-audit-', dir=self.parent)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name).resolve()
        self.git('init', '-q')
        self.assertEqual(Path(self.git('rev-parse', '--show-toplevel').strip()).resolve(), self.root)

    def tearDown(self):
        if self.root.parent != self.parent:
            raise RuntimeError('Unsafe publication-fixture cleanup target')
        self.temporary.cleanup()

    def git(self, *args):
        result = subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'user.name=AuditFixture', '-c', 'user.email=fixture@example.invalid',
                                 '-c', 'commit.gpgsign=false', '-c', 'core.hooksPath=' + str(self.root / 'no-hooks'), *args],
                                cwd=self.root, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        return result.stdout

    def commit(self):
        self.git('add', '--all')
        self.git('commit', '-qm', 'Authored audit fixture')

    def check(self):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with patch.object(audit, 'ROOT', self.root), redirect_stdout(output):
            failed = audit.main()
        return failed, json.loads(output.getvalue()), output.getvalue()

    def test_clean_source_passes(self):
        (self.root / 'README.md').write_text('Authored synthetic repository.\n')
        self.commit()
        failed, result, _ = self.check()
        self.assertFalse(failed)
        self.assertEqual(result['commits'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result['findings'], [])

    def test_removed_synthetic_credential_still_blocks_history(self):
        synthetic = 'ghp_' + 'A' * 36
        path = self.root / 'example.txt'
        path.write_text(synthetic)
        self.commit()
        path.write_text('Removed fixture credential.\n')
        self.commit()
        failed, result, printed = self.check()
        self.assertTrue(failed)
        self.assertTrue(any(row['scope'] == 'history' and row['rule'] == 'github-credential' for row in result['findings']))
        self.assertNotIn(synthetic, printed)

    def test_renaming_an_excluded_history_path_does_not_hide_it(self):
        folder = self.root / 'inputs'
        folder.mkdir()
        (folder / 'authored.txt').write_text('Synthetic reference content.\n')
        self.commit()
        self.git('mv', 'inputs/authored.txt', 'README.md')
        self.commit()
        failed, result, _ = self.check()
        self.assertTrue(failed)
        self.assertTrue(any(row['path'] == 'inputs/authored.txt' and row['scope'] == 'history' for row in result['findings']))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

`tools/bootstrap_ghidra.py`:

```py
"""Download a pinned official Ghidra release into this workspace only."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TAG = "Ghidra_11.4.2_build"
SHA256 = "795a02076af16257bd6f3f4736c4fc152ce9ff1f95df35cd47e2adc086e037a6"


def main():
    ready = list((ROOT / "tools").glob("ghidra_11.4.2_PUBLIC/support/analyzeHeadless.bat"))
    if ready:
        print(f"Already available: {ready[0]}", flush=True)
        return
    api = f"https://api.github.com/repos/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra/releases/tags/{TAG}"
    req = urllib.request.Request(api, headers={"User-Agent": "FS15-local-research"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
        release = json.load(response)
    asset = next(a for a in release["assets"] if a["name"].endswith(".zip"))
    destination = ROOT / "tools" / "downloads" / asset["name"]
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not destination.exists():
        url = asset["browser_download_url"]
        if not url.startswith(f"https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra/releases/download/{TAG}/"):
            raise ValueError("Unexpected asset origin")
        temporary = destination.with_suffix(".partial")
        print(f"Downloading official release: {asset['name']} ({asset['size']} bytes)", flush=True)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60) as response, temporary.open("wb") as out:
            size = 0
            last_bucket = -1
            while block := response.read(1024 * 1024):
                out.write(block)
                size += len(block)
                bucket = size // (64 * 1024 * 1024)
                if bucket != last_bucket:
                    print(f"Downloaded {size // (1024 * 1024)} MiB", flush=True)
                    last_bucket = bucket
        if size != asset["size"]:
            raise ValueError(f"Truncated download: {size} != {asset['size']}")
        temporary.replace(destination)
    with destination.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    if digest != SHA256:
        raise ValueError(f"SHA-256 mismatch: {digest}")
    print(f"SHA-256 verified: {digest}", flush=True)
    tools_root = (ROOT / "tools").resolve()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(destination) as archive:
        for entry in archive.infolist():
            target = (tools_root / entry.filename).resolve()
            if not target.is_relative_to(tools_root):
                raise ValueError(f"Unsafe ZIP entry: {entry.filename}")
        archive.extractall(tools_root)
    (ROOT / "analysis").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (ROOT / "analysis" / "ghidra-tool.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "tag": TAG, "asset": asset["name"], "url": asset["browser_download_url"],
        "sha256": digest, "release_url": release["html_url"],
    }, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print("Ghidra ready.", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
